jobs.title: Software Engineer - Database Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re hiring talented Software Engineers to join the Snowflake Database Engineering team! In this role you will work directly with our team to evolve our elastic, large scale, high-performance data processing system. We need smart engineers who can pick up and understand complex technical areas quickly – and who are enthusiastic about building new technologies!

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Design, develop, and support a petabyte-scale cloud database that is highly parallel and fault-tolerant.

  • Build high-quality and highly reliable software to meet the needs of some of the largest companies on the planet.

  • Analyze and understand performance and scalability bottlenecks in the system and solve them.

  • Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions.

  • Design and implement novel query optimization or distributed data processing algorithms which allow Snowflake to provide industry leading data warehousing capabilities.

  • Design and implement the new service architecture required to enable the Snowflake Data Cloud

  • Develop tools for improving our customers' insights into their workloads.

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years industry experience working on commercial or open-source software.

  • Fluency in Java or C++.

  • Familiarity with development in a Linux environment.

  • Excellent problem solving skills, and strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Systems programming skills including multi-threading, concurrency, etc.

  • Experience with implementation testing, debugging and documentation.

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field; Masters or PhD preferred.

  • Ability to work on-site in our Menlo Park / Bellevue / Berlin office.

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

  • SQL or other database technologies including internal design and implementation.

  • Query optimization, query execution, compiler design and implementation.

  • Experience with internals of distributed key value stores like FoundationDB and storage engines like RocksDB, InnoDB, BerkeleyDB etc.

  • Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL internals

  • Data warehouse design, database systems, and large-scale data processing solutions like Hadoop and Spark.

  • Large scale distributed systems, transactions and consistency models.

  • Experience in database replication technology

  • Big data storage technologies and their applications, e.g., HDFS, Cassandra, Columnar Databases, etc.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our sales team is expanding and we are seeking a qualified Account Executive with expertise in the ability to manage and expand key accounts. In this role you will use your executive presence and sales skills to strategically manage and expand customers.

Your role will encompass prospecting, developing, and closing business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability and be open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team carries a deep curiosity to learn and are always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers needs.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Become an expert on Snowflake’s product and conduct discovery calls, customized demos, and presentations to prospective customers

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

  • Gain trust, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory & account list

  • Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 6+ years field sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

  • A track record in expanding current accounts

  • Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

  • This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

  • A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Product
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Product Data Science team is looking for a Full-stack Senior Data Scientist to come aboard and be part of Snowflake’s most critical initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams on everything from core operations, to innovative AI/ML tools, to our fastest-growing new and experimental features. You will work on long-running analytical initiatives yielding substantial product enhancements. This is a strategic, high-impact role that will help shape the future of Snowflake products and services.

PLEASE NOTE: The position level is determined during the interview process and is influenced by various factors, including experience, educational attainment, skill level requirements, and overall interview performance.


AS A SENIOR FULL STACK DATA SCIENTIST AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Be a proactive partner to Product Management and Engineering to shape feature roadmaps and help design metrics and analytical workflows to evaluate their success and effectiveness.  

  • Build efficient data models and high quality production pipelines and partner with Engineering for all necessary telemetry. 

  • Build scalable and extensible analytics/ML/causal inference frameworks to uncover feature usage patterns, subtle issues with the system, potential performance enhancements, and areas to improve customer experience.

  • Be an early adopter/pro user of Snowflake features and provide feedback on design parameters.  

  • Evaluate the right surface (Snowflake Notebook/Worksheet/Snowsight Dashboards/Streamlit Apps) to disseminate your insights for maximal impact. 

  • Influence decisions and drive initiatives with the Product Management and Engineering teams to drive better outcomes for our customers.

  • Answer questions from the executive team for reporting to the board and contribute to industry reports and similar publications.

  • Think creatively and be scrappy to find optimal solutions to our complex, often unstructured problems.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • MS/Ph.D. in quantitative discipline (Math, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Engineering, or CS). 

  • 8+ years of relevant data science or related experience.    

  • Expert-level experience working with SQL & Python including scikit-learn, numpy, and pandas.

  • Expert in working with large-scale machine generated data (e.g., logs, application telemetry, or customer usage data).

  • High fluency with MPP databases, such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Vertica, etc. 

  • Expert data-driven storytelling skills to convey insights to business leaders and technical stakeholders and influence decisions. 

  • The ability to thrive in a dynamic environment, being flexible and willing to jump in and do whatever it takes to contribute to the success of your area.

    Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Sales Development Representative for our Sales Development team, focused on the German market. You will work hand in hand with our sales and marketing teams to generate leads and build customer pipeline. This is an early-career role with a dedicated growth path and the training to become a great technical sales professional.

AS A SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build qualified pipeline by booking meetings with senior data, business and AI leaders at our largest strategic customers in Germany. You'll use multi-threaded outbound prospecting and careful lead follow-up to show how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud can solve their hardest data and AI problems.

  • Partner with Global Account Managers, and Solution Engineers to find, qualify and source high-value use cases that move through the funnel and drive measurable consumption and revenue. Join customer meetings when needed and hand off opportunities with strong context.

  • Work with Marketing to turn inbound leads, event attendees and campaign responses into qualified conversations, clear next steps and progress across complex buying groups.

  • Research target accounts in depth and personalize your outreach, using AI-assisted tools to find the right people, the right timing and the right message.

  • Give prospects a clear, high-level introduction to Snowflake, including the AI Data Cloud, Cortex AI and Snowflake Marketplace, and connect it to their business priorities.

  • Track your activity and pipeline in Salesforce so the team always has a clear view of progress.

  • Keep your knowledge of the data and AI market current through product trainings, team enablement and local industry events.

OUR IDEAL SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 1+ years of experience in a prospecting, sales, or customer-facing role preferred.

  • A university degree, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English, in person, by phone, and in writing.

  • Confidence engaging with people at all levels of an organization, from individual contributors to senior leaders.

  • The ability to give clear presentations, both formal and informal, to colleagues and customers.

  • Strong organization skills: you can prioritize, manage your time, and adjust focus as team goals change.

  • A self-directed, curious, and positive approach, with a track record of owning goals and delivering results.

  • A genuine interest in building a career in technology sales.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake Services Delivery is the implementation and strategy experts for the Snowflake platform. We engage with customers at all phases of the customer journey to optimise, accelerate, and achieve business outcomes. Our teams of Solutions Architects demonstrate technical leadership everyday by writing code, constructing solution architectures and guiding customers through decision paths to achieve impactful outcomes and thoughtfully use AI to augment their business. We advise everyone from developers through senior executives on how best to utilise Snowflake for their data and AI tool suite to make their business successful. Our Solution Architects are comfortable with change and live on the cutting edge of data and AI.

AS A SNOWFLAKE SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT YOU WILL :

  • Customer Engagement & Advisory

    • Directly engage with customers individually or as part of a technical delivery team as a trusted advisor for thought leadership and solution approaches

    • Extract business requirements from customers and translate them into a well-architected recommendation

    • Develop and provide forward-looking guidance and future-state roadmaps

    • Leverage known best practices and solutions to reduce risk to customer implementations

    • Collaborate with Snowflake “Go to Market” teams and product teams to ensure customer alignment to Snowflake goals

  • Technical Leadership & Architecture

    • Oversee and advise on the implementation of the customer’s Snowflake platform

    • Demonstrate technical leadership through personally developed code, solution architectures, and implementation recommendations

  • AI/ML Solutions & ML Ops

    • Design, prototype, and implement end-to-end AI/ML solutions on the Snowflake platform, ensuring scalability and performance

    • Provide customers with standard practices and advice related to AI/ML workloads in Snowflake

    • Define and advise on MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) standard practices for model deployment, monitoring, and governance within the customer’s Snowflake environment

  • Product Adoption

    • Drive the adoption of Snowflake’s AI product suite (e.g., Cortex, Streamlit in Snowflake, Snowflake Intelligence) within customer solutions

    • Experience replatforming AI/ML workloads to Snowflake in line with business and operational requirements

    • Coach and guide customers on how to best leverage Snowflake’s AI product suite to unlock new business value

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE FOR A SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT WILL HAVE :

  • BA/BS in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent practical experience

  • 3 years of technical consulting experience

  • Experience in a lead role for analytics projects for large enterprises

  • Experience implementing and operating Snowflake centric solutions

  • Understanding of complete data analytics stack and workflow, from ETL to data platform design to BI and analytics tools

  • Deep understanding of the complete AI/ML lifecycle, from data preparation and feature engineering to model training, deployment, and ongoing monitoring

  • Familiarity with AI/ML and Transformation technologies

  • Hands-on experience with modern MLOps tools and frameworks for deploying, managing, and governing machine learning models at scale

  • Proven experience with developing generative AI and LLM use cases

  • Familiarity with industry common BI and ETL solutions

  • Hands-on experience in a technical role leveraging SQL and Python (optionally Java or Spark) to build, operate and maintain data analytics solutions

  • Extensive knowledge of and experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Snowflake, Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, etc.)

  • Proficiency in implementing data security measures, access controls, and design specifically within the Snowflake platform

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques

AS A BONUS, A STRONG CANDIDATE WILL ADDITIONALLY HAVE :

  • Hands-on experience or significant familiarity with building and managing AI/ML workloads

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a solutions architect, data architect, database administrator, or data engineer

  • Experience in the services organization of a product company

  • Experience in a leadership position executing technical projects

  • Application Development experience

  • AWS, Google or Microsoft Cloud certification(s)

  • Snowflake Snowpro Advanced Certification(s)

How do you want to make your impact?

Build the Future of Data. Join the Snowflake Team.

We are actively hiring software engineers from Europe and around the world for our European Engineering Center. Our office is located at Potsdamer Platz, in the heart of Berlin. It’s easily accessible by train, subway, bus, or bicycle – with numerous restaurants, cafes, and shops within walking distance. The official language for this office is English.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team of skilled engineers, building and maintaining the future of the Java infrastructure that powers the data cloud. As part of this team, you will work on the core Java libraries and JVM infrastructure that support our scalable, high-performance platform, impacting millions of users globally.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON THE JAVA PLATFORM TEAM, YOU WILL:

  • Contribute to building the next-generation systems that make using Java safe, efficient, and secure

  • Help provide a consistent, high-performance platform that Snowflake engineers can use to deliver high-quality solutions to production.

  • Identify performance and availability issues, implement effective solutions, and instrument key components as needed.

  • Collaborate with global teams to solve real-world, large-scale challenges in data infrastructure.

  • Continuously improve the reliability and performance of our Java infrastructure through proactive monitoring and automation.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOFTWARE ENGINEERS WHO:

  • Have experience building, supporting, and troubleshooting complex Java systems.

  • Understand Java fundamentals, including the JVM and core libraries.

  • Have solid computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Are eager to learn about JVM internals and performance tuning.

  • Thrive in collaborative environments, contributing to shared team goals.

  • Have a BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience (advanced degrees a plus).

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with multi-threading, concurrency, and caching.

  • Knowledge of database or Linux internals.

  • Previous experience with large-scale, high-performance systems.

Join us and be a part of a team that is driving the future of the data cloud.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Majors Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake
Snowflake is the world's leading AI Data Cloud company, powering the future of data and artificial intelligence. Our mission is to mobilize the world's data — breaking down silos and enabling every organization to unify, govern, and unlock the full value of their data at scale. Built on a single, fully managed platform that is Easy, Connected, and Trusted, Snowflake empowers enterprises to run all of their data, AI, and application workloads — from advanced analytics and machine learning to generative AI and agentic applications — without moving data out of a secure, governed environment.
With thousands of customers across every major industry worldwide and a consumption-based model that scales with value delivered, Snowflake is one of the fastest-growing enterprise platforms in the cloud era. We believe that there is no AI strategy without a data strategy — and we are building the platform that makes both possible.

Account Executive Team
The Account Executive team works closely with internal cross-functional teams and partners to deliver Snowflake's value to customers and serve as trusted advisors on long-term data strategy. The Korea sales organization operates across four industry-aligned teams to drive deep vertical expertise and customer intimacy. As part of our continued investment in Korea, we are seeking a Majors Account Executive to lead the strategic relationship with Global Electronics customer — one of the most iconic and globally significant technology and manufacturing conglomerates. This individual will represent Snowflake across customer's diverse business divisions and serve as the single point of executive accountability for the account.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Champion data innovation across a global conglomerate: Lead Snowflake's data cloud strategy for the global Electronics customer, driving adoption and expansion across its diverse business divisions — including semiconductors, mobile, display, home appliances, and enterprise IT — in partnership with customers and ecosystem partners.

  • Become a Snowflake expert: Conduct discovery calls, deliver customised demos, and present tailored solutions to prospects and stakeholders across multiple global customer's business units.

  • Be the trusted advisor: Deeply understand the global Electronics customer's existing and future IT roadmap, digital transformation priorities, and industry-specific challenges to position Snowflake as a strategic platform partner.

  • Drive full-lifecycle sales execution: Own pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and deal closure across the global Electronics customer account — landing new use cases, expanding existing deployments, and deepening platform adoption.

  • Build and execute a strategic account plan: Develop and maintain a comprehensive account plan with targeted stakeholder mapping, opportunity pipeline, and quarterly/annual revenue targets. Proactively identify whitespace and cross-sell opportunities across business divisions.

  • Cultivate executive relationships: Build and sustain trusted relationships with CxOs, IT executives, Line-of-Business leaders, and key decision-makers across the global Electronics customer's corporate and divisional leadership.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration: Lead engagement across Snowflake's internal teams — including Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Finance — as well as regional and global counterparts, to deliver a seamless and unified customer experience.


Who You Are
Experience & Track Record

  • 10+ years of field sales experience in the technology industry, with a strong focus on enterprise or major account management in areas such as Data Warehousing, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS), Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and/or AI/ML.

  • Proven track record of managing and growing a major, multi-division account (or comparable large-scale enterprise account) with demonstrated success in exceeding revenue targets and driving significant business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated experience in navigating complex organizational structures — engaging and delivering results across multiple business units, divisions, or subsidiaries within a single global account.

  • Experience in the manufacturing, technology, or electronics industry is highly preferred; existing industry relationships and domain expertise are a strong advantage.

Executive Engagement & Relationship Building

  • Established ability to build and maintain C-level and senior executive relationships — including CxOs, VPs of IT/Data, and Line-of-Business leaders — and to leverage these relationships to drive strategic alignment and accelerate deal velocity.

  • Proven capability to engage key decision-makers and influencers at the executive level, with a track record of converting executive sponsorship into long-term, enterprise-wide platform adoption.

Strategic Mindset & Growth Orientation

  • A growth mindset with a passion for identifying and capitalizing on new opportunities — whether expanding into new business units, introducing new use cases, or driving platform adoption in untapped areas.

  • Strong strategic thinking with the ability to develop and execute long-term account strategies that align Snowflake's platform capabilities with the customer's business priorities, digital transformation goals, and competitive landscape.

  • Expertise in value-based selling — accurately diagnosing customer challenges, mapping Snowflake solutions to business outcomes, and articulating quantifiable ROI to senior stakeholders.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Leadership

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and orchestrate cross-functional, cross-regional teams — including domestic (Korea) and international (HQ, APAC, global) stakeholders — to deliver coordinated account strategies and exceptional customer outcomes.

  • Experience working in a matrixed, global organization where success depends on influencing without authority, rallying internal resources, and maintaining alignment across time zones and cultures.

  • A One Team mindset — collaborative, supportive, and committed to driving collective success across Sales Engineering, Services Delivery, Product, Partners, and other internal teams.

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills — with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in business terms to diverse audiences, from technical architects to C-suite executives.

  • Self-driven with the ability to independently build account plans, sales strategies, and pipeline while maintaining rigor in CRM hygiene and operational excellence.

  • Passion for data and technology — a continuous learner who stays ahead of industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies.

  • Fluency in Korean (native or business-level) and English (professional proficiency) is required to operate effectively across domestic and global teams.



Korea Benefits (Highlights)

  • Retirement Pension (DC plan)

  • RSU (Restricted Stock Units)

  • Mobile data and personal fitness expense support

  • Annual health check-up for employee and one dependent

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Year-end company holiday

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Forward Deployed Engineering team embeds directly inside enterprise customers' environments to design, build, and deploy production AI systems. We lead with AI transformation programs and expand into high-impact use cases built by our engineers and researchers. This work is specific, technical, and consequential — we do not do pilots that never ship.

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you are the partner enterprise customers turn to when they are serious about transforming how their business runs on AI. You sit inside the FDE product org, working alongside the engineers and researchers who deliver these programs.

The revenue is the result of trust, not a pitch.

What You Will Do

Understand the customer's business. Sit with C-level executives (CEO, COO, CFO, and beyond), and their teams on where AI changes how they operate. Learn how they make money and where the friction is. Find the problems worth solving and bring a point of view they cannot get from their own staff.

Turn strategy into programs. Translate executive conversations into real engagements. Qualify opportunities rigorously, structure commercial commitments honestly, and author Statements of Work that reflect what Snowflake's FDE team can actually deliver. Work with legal to navigate IP, data rights, and contract terms specific to custom AI engagements.

Grow the relationship. Expand from a first engagement into a portfolio across business units. Done well, these become Snowflake's deepest enterprise relationships.

Qualify field-originated pipeline. Serve as the filter for opportunities originated by Snowflake's field AE organization. Evaluate each for FDE fit across technical complexity, deployment readiness, and commercial viability. Protect FDE capacity. Improve conversion.

Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside AEs on contracting and commercials. You own the engagement scope, product pricing, and delivery commitments. They own the primary commercial relationship.

Partner with Marketing. Collaborate on field enablement, go-to-market campaigns, and thought leadership that builds awareness for FDE's offerings.

Feed signal back. Bring what you hear in qualification — customer pain points, use case patterns, competitive dynamics — directly to FDE product and engineering leadership.

Earn trust over the long run. Make the call that serves the customer, including when an FDE engagement is not right for them. You will be more valuable to Snowflake because of it.

What You Bring

A track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives. You have built and held C-suite relationships independently. You bring a point of view, not a pitch.

Fluency in both technology and business strategy. You can hold a conversation on AI architecture and on the P&L, and translate between the two. You earn technical credibility with engineers and customer CTOs in the same meeting.

Experience scoping and closing complex enterprise engagements. You have written and negotiated Statements of Work for custom technical solutions. You understand scope risk and structure commitments that are honest about what will and will not be delivered.

A consistent track record in enterprise software or technical solutions, working alongside a field sales organization to qualify and close.

The judgment to navigate multi-stakeholder procurement, legal, and security review without reading as a salesperson.

AI-native in practice. You use frontier AI tools in your daily work and can speak credibly to a customer about what they change at the operational level. You’re comfortable building executive level slides and technical demos to exemplify the AI path to outcome.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Role will be based in Mexico City, Mexico

We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately help customers grow in their use of Snowflake.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the AI Data platform space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at Snowflake customers and prospects

  • Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology; identify use cases, and guide the customer to successfully take them from demo to implementation, and a successful go-live.

  • Present Customers with the innovations in Snowflake and the value these innovations add to their business.

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics

  • Ability to understand a customer’s specific business problems and translate these to Snowflake use cases

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred

  • Travel Required

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

  • Mentor Solutions Engineering peers and contribute reusable field assets, reference architectures, and product feedback that improve execution across the region.

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in solutions engineering, data architecture, cloud platforms, analytics, or an equivalent customer-facing technical role.

  • A strong foundation in data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, and enterprise security.

  • Experience leading technical discovery and designing solutions for complex enterprise requirements.

  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, business leaders, and executives.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and at least one major cloud platform as supporting capabilities for solution design and validation.

  • A record of influencing customer decisions through consultative problem solving, demonstrations, and proofs of concept.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to lead across sales, product, services, partners, and customer teams without direct authority.

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with Snowflake, Cortex AI, Snowpark, Streamlit in Snowflake, or native application development.

  • Familiarity with GenAI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, model governance, and AI-assisted solution engineering workflows.

  • Experience supporting data platform modernization or migration programs in large enterprises.

  • Knowledge of data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations relevant to customers in India.

  • Experience mentoring technical presales professionals or leading cross-account technical initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - ML/AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER — ML/AI, YOU WILL:

  • Own and drive complex, cross-team ML/AI programs end-to-end — from scoping and planning through execution and launch — across model infrastructure, inference pipelines, AI functions, Cortex AI services, and AI-powered application features

  • Partner with ML Engineers, Research Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to define program roadmaps, surface dependencies, and build execution plans that account for the unique uncertainty and iteration cycles inherent to ML/AI development

  • Coordinate cross-org launches for AI features that span ML infrastructure, application surfaces (Streamlit, Notebooks, Cortex Code), and core platform — ensuring all teams ship cohesively and on time

  • Navigate the ambiguity of AI development — adapt program structures to handle model experimentation cycles, evaluation gates, accuracy/latency tradeoffs, and the non-linear nature of ML research-to-production timelines

  • Establish program governance and reporting cadences — track milestones, risks, decisions, and engineering health with clarity and rigor, and proactively escalate to leadership when programs need intervention

  • Drive cross-functional alignment between ML/AI engineering, product, design, infrastructure, security, and legal/compliance teams on AI feature launches, model deployment, and responsible AI practices

  • Identify and resolve systemic execution bottlenecks — design lightweight processes and tooling-backed workflows that improve engineering velocity without adding overhead

  • Own AI launch readiness — coordinate model evaluation sign-off, performance benchmarking, safety review, and documentation across engineering, product, and trust/safety teams

  • Represent ML/AI programs to senior leadership with crisp, data-backed status updates and strategic recommendations that connect program execution to business outcomes

OUR IDEAL SENIOR TPM — ML/AI WILL HAVE:

Required:

  • 5+ years of technical program management experience at a cloud or AI-native technology company, with a track record of owning cross-team programs end-to-end

  • Demonstrated experience with ML/AI programs — you understand the ML development lifecycle (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and can manage programs around its unique iteration patterns and uncertainty

  • Strong technical depth — ability to engage meaningfully with ML engineers and research scientists on model architecture, inference infrastructure, evaluation metrics, and deployment tradeoffs

  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguity — ML/AI programs don't follow predictable timelines; you know how to structure execution around experimentation cycles and adapt plans as signals emerge

  • Experience managing programs spanning 4+ engineering teams with competing roadmaps and shared dependencies

  • Excellent communication skills — you synthesize complex technical and research concepts into clear, actionable narratives for leadership, product, and cross-functional audiences

  • Strong program management fundamentals: dependency management, risk frameworks, milestone governance, stakeholder alignment, and escalation discipline

Preferred:

  • Experience with LLM inference, fine-tuning, RAG architectures, or AI function platforms at production scale

  • Background in model serving infrastructure, GPU/accelerator resource management, or ML platform engineering

  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices — model evaluation, bias detection, safety review, and compliance workflows

  • Experience with Snowflake's architecture or data cloud ecosystem

  • Working knowledge of ML observability — monitoring model performance, drift detection, and production quality metrics

  • Background in launching customer-facing AI features where accuracy, latency, and cost are critical tradeoffs

SNOWFLAKE VALUES WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Get It Done — You turn the inherent ambiguity of ML/AI into executable plans and deliver outcomes. You don't wait for perfect clarity — you create it.

  • Own It — You treat your programs as your own end-to-end. You anticipate risks before they surface and drive resolution without being asked.

  • Make Each Other the Best — You build bridges across ML research, engineering, and product. You create shared context and alignment that makes the whole organization move faster.

  • Think Big — You see beyond the current sprint. You think about what it takes for Snowflake's AI capabilities to operate at 10x scale and help build the frameworks to get there.

COMPENSATION

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Base Salary RangeTotal Target Compensation$166,000 – $249,000$190,900 – $286,350

In addition to base salary and bonus (15% target), this role is eligible for equity in the form of RSUs and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP, generous PTO, and more.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

 - Represent ML/AI programs to senior leadership with crisp, data-backed status updates and strategic recommendations that connect program execution to business outcomes

Required:

 - 5+ years of technical program management experience at a cloud or AI-native technology company, with a track record of owning cross-team programs end-to-end

 - Demonstrated experience with ML/AI programs — you understand the ML development lifecycle (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and can manage programs around its unique iteration patterns and uncertainty

 - Strong technical depth — ability to engage meaningfully with ML engineers and research scientists on model architecture, inference infrastructure, evaluation metrics, and deployment tradeoffs

 - Proven ability to operate in ambiguity — ML/AI programs don't follow predictable timelines; you know how to structure execution around experimentation cycles and adapt plans as signals emerge

 - Experience managing programs spanning 4+ engineering teams with competing roadmaps and shared dependencies

 - Excellent communication skills — you synthesize complex technical and research concepts into clear, actionable narratives for leadership, product, and cross-functional audiences

 - Strong program management fundamentals: dependency management, risk frameworks, milestone governance, stakeholder alignment, and escalation discipline

Preferred:

 - Experience with LLM inference, fine-tuning, RAG architectures, or AI function platforms at production scale

 - Background in model serving infrastructure, GPU/accelerator resource management, or ML platform engineering

 - Familiarity with responsible AI practices — model evaluation, bias detection, safety review, and compliance workflows

 - Experience with Snowflake's architecture or data cloud ecosystem

 - Working knowledge of ML observability — monitoring model performance, drift detection, and production quality metrics

 - Background in launching customer-facing AI features where accuracy, latency, and cost are critical tradeoffs


SNOWFLAKE VALUES WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Get It Done — You turn the inherent ambiguity of ML/AI into executable plans and deliver outcomes. You don't wait for perfect clarity — you create it.

 - Own It — You treat your programs as your own end-to-end. You anticipate risks before they surface and drive resolution without being asked.

 - Make Each Other the Best — You build bridges across ML research, engineering, and product. You create shared context and alignment that makes the whole organization move faster.

 - Think Big — You see beyond the current sprint. You think about what it takes for Snowflake's AI capabilities to operate at 10x scale and help build the frameworks to get there.

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. ABOUT THE ROLE

The Snowflake Cortex team is on a mission to bring the transformative power of generative AI and machine learning to enterprise customers, seamlessly and securely within the Snowflake Data Cloud. We are seeking an entrepreneurial and customer-obsessed Product Manager to lead the product vision and execution for our AI Solutions and Services.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for some of our most exciting AI services. You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining the product roadmap, and working with a world-class engineering team to deliver innovative solutions that make it easy for any user to leverage AI. You will sit at the critical intersection of customers, our forward-deployed engineering team, core engineering, and GTM strategy, driving the future of AI within the Data Cloud. If you are obsessed with building products that are both powerful and simple, and thrive on turning ambiguity into impact, this is the role for you.

AS A STAFF APPLIED AI PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the Product Vision & Roadmap: Define and articulate a clear, compelling strategy for large-scale AI solutions. You will architect and own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from deep discovery and detailed requirements to hands-on development, launch, and the analysis of metrics to ensure a successful impact.

  • Lead from the Front: Serve as the unequivocal cross-functional leader for a dedicated pod of world-class engineers, data scientists, and solution architects. You will drive execution, partner with design, marketing, and sales to bring products to market, and act as the evangelist for your product vision.

  • Be the Voice of the Customer: Act as the critical bridge between customer objectives and our technical capabilities. You will engage deeply with users and executives to gather insights, validate hypotheses, and ensure the solutions you build solve their most pressing, high-value problems.

  • Commercialize Innovation: Masterfully distill insights from bespoke customer solutions into a strategic vision for scalable, repeatable products. You will own the roadmap for turning successful 1-of-1 deployments into 1-to-many platform features.

  • Shape Business Strategy: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with leadership at both Snowflake and our customer organizations to define product strategy and execute on high-stakes business goals.

OUR IDEAL STAFF PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of shipping successful enterprise software or cloud services.

  • Deep technical fluency to confidently lead architectural discussions with senior engineers and have hands-on experience with data science workflows and modern AI paradigms (e.g., LLMs, vector databases, agentic workflows).

  • Demonstrated ability to develop a product strategy and translate it into a concrete, actionable roadmap.

  • Strong customer empathy and experience working directly with enterprise customers to understand their needs and challenges.

  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills. You can command a room of C-level stakeholders and inspire a team around a shared vision.

  • A "get it done" attitude with a passion for building exceptional products.

Bonus Points (Nice to Haves):

  • Experience building and launching products for developers or data scientists.

  • Familiarity with the Snowflake platform and Data Cloud ecosystem.

  • Management consulting experience.

  • Experience operating in a high-growth, high-ambiguity environment where you were responsible for creating clarity and driving focus.

  • Experience in a role that directly supported a professional services or forward-deployed engineering team.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer II - Interoperable Foundations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's rise as a revolutionary cloud data warehouse was fueled by a key architectural tenet: separating compute from storage through a world-class metadata engine. Now, as we transition to the “Interoperable Data + AI Cloud”, metadata and open standards are the keys to unlocking the agentic enterprise at scale.

AI agents cannot reason over raw data; they require deep context, strict governance, and instant interoperability. To usher in this new era, we are seeking AI-native systems thinkers to architect the foundational substrate that allows autonomous AI to query, understand, and act upon exabyte-scale datasets regardless of whether that data is stored directly within Snowflake or resides externally in a customer managed lakehouse.

The Mission: Interoperability and Metadata as the Engine for AI

As part of the Snowflake Interoperable Foundations organization, you will lead a 0->1 ground-up redesign of our core metadata and storage architecture.

Metadata engineering and open standards (like Apache Iceberg) are the linchpins of Snowflake's future. They are what allow us to bring Snowflake's industry-leading performance and governance to data sitting anywhere in the world. Your mission is to evolve this architecture so that open, multi-format data lakes are not just searchable by humans, but inherently AI-ready by transforming interoperable metadata into the contextual engine that powers agentic innovation.

Your Impact: Architecting the Data + AI Cloud

  • 0->1 Metadata Redesign: Lead the ground-up re-architecture of our core metadata systems. You will build the highly concurrent transaction frameworks that power query, DML, and AI-driven data interactions, ensuring our metadata layer scales to support the massive contextual demands of agentic AI.

  • Championing the Open Standard (Apache Iceberg): Drive industry-defining innovations on Apache Iceberg. You will ensure open table formats are no longer just storage abstractions, but first-class citizens that deliver native-level performance and governance for analytics, data engineering, and AI workloads without vendor lock-in.

  • Building the Agentic Foundation: AI needs context to act safely and accurately. You will build the rich metadata structures that provide AI agents with the semantic understanding and governance required to navigate and manipulate massive global datasets.

  • Scale & Systems Resilience: Solve non-negotiable challenges in fault tolerance, high availability, and extreme performance for a global ecosystem that treats multi-cloud resiliency as a baseline requirement.

  • Strategic Influence: Own the end-to-end platform architecture, set and shape the future roadmap for how metadata interfaces with AI, and mentor the next generation of engineers in a low-ego, high-impact environment.

What You Bring:

  • 15+ Years Systems Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and solving difficult multi-cloud interoperability challenges.

  • Database Internals Builder: Deep expertise in “building” database, metadata management, query optimization, data catalog, compaction, or large-scale state management systems.

  • 0->1 Technical Leadership: A history of implementing greenfield, cloud-scale solutions and migrating massive, high-throughput distributed systems to next-generation architectures.

  • Core Systems Fundamentals: Strong grasp of storage performance, distributed consistency trade-offs, and algorithms.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER IN SNOWHOUSE FOUNDATION, YOU WILL:

Build the future of data. Join the Snowflake team.

Snowflake’s Commercial sales organization continues to grow and we are actively seeking a Commercial Account Executive to join the team. Our Account Executives are customer-obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT FOR THE TEAM IF YOU:

  • Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and positive attitude with a passion for building customer relationships and closing new business opportunities. The Account Executive must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with Clients and support new customers through our on-boarding process.

  • You are driven to exceed performance objectives.

  • You are excited about being positioned right in the middle of the exploding cloud based economy and to develop and maintain a highly desired knowledge of Snowflake’s solutions.

  • You have an understanding of the Cloud application/computing space along with familiarity with data warehouse or analytic technologies.

  • You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills.

  • You have superb organization and contact management capabilities.

  • You are driven to achieve your mission and you love bringing the team together to achieve results together.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Build trusted relationships with Snowflake internal resources, external partners, and client account teams to qualify deals, identify business value, and provide technical guidance in order to set proper expectations to ensure customer satisfaction

  • Leverage knowledge of a domain or industry to align Snowflake’s value to the customers’ business and technical problems

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving technology and landscape while maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to deliver standard, customized and/or strategic solution demonstrations, white boarding, presentations, and best practices that showcase functional capabilities, competitive advantages, and business benefits of the Snowflake solutions throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation.

  • Guides customers in digital transformation and cloud adoption, understanding where Snowflake integrates with holistic architecture and strategy.

  • Provide ongoing, post-sales, technical guidance to the customer’s technical team to drive customer utilization of Snowflake and digital transformation success

  • 2+ years of field sales experience preferred with an emphasis on data, data analytics, database (SQL & NoSQL), ETL, or business intelligence.

  • Sales experience with emphasis on data, data analytics, database (SQL & NoSQL), ETL, or business intelligence preferred.

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Proven success in driving consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.

  • Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.

  • Proactive, independent thinking and a high energy/positive attitude.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

  • BA/BS preferred.

Snowflake is striving to become the cloud data platform of choice for everyone who needs affordable, reliable, scalable and elastic data management. Armed with great technical talent, our expanding product offering is designed for the cloud and automatically handles infrastructure, optimization, availability, data protection, and more so our users can focus on using their data, not managing it. And we’re doing this across all the major cloud providers, breaking new ground in what it means to be multi-cloud and cloud agnostic.


AS A TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, YOU WILL:

  • Be responsible for defining and delivering important programs with broad organizational, business and technical impact.

  • Provide cross-functional leadership with Engineering and Product Management, and inter/intra team communications to deliver outstanding program outcomes.

  • Bring strong, data-driven and strategic technical judgment to decisions.

  • Be hands-on, working closely with Software Engineers and Product Managers to design, build, and deliver the next generation of Snowflake services and apps.

  • Amplify your impact by educating and mentoring the TPM and Engineering communities on program management best practices.

  • Identify opportunities to improve execution of the organization as a whole, to increase engineering productivity through tools and light-weight processes. (Snowflake happens to have a nice data platform to use :-)

A TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE IS EXPECTED TO HAVE:

  • 5+ years of demonstrated industry experience and expertise leading medium to large complex engineering projects in current cloud technologies

  • Ability to thrive and succeed in a dynamic environment not slowed down by ambiguity or competing priorities

  • Experience working cross functionally with engineering, product management, and other functions involved in the product life cycle

  • Strong program management skills with technical and business acumen

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Observe by Snowflake
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause and resolution 10x faster.

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll own the experience for some of the most high-stakes, technically complex workflows in enterprise software. The kind where your design decisions directly affect whether an incident takes 15 minutes or 3 hours to resolve. Your users are SREs and platform engineers debugging critical failures at 2am. The work lives at the intersection of agentic AI, real-time data, and deeply technical user needs.

This isn't a specs-execution role. You'll partner as a peer with product and engineering, shape design culture on a team being built from scratch, and help define what world-class observability UX looks like.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end design for one or more Observe surfaces: AI SRE, APM, Metrics, Log/Trace Explorers, dashboards, or onboarding

  • Define interaction models for complex observability workflows; incident investigation, root cause analysis, service maps, and AI-assisted troubleshooting

  • Prototype early and often using AI-enabled tools to validate ideas quickly and iterate with engineering

  • Partner with PM and engineering as a peer in shaping product direction, not just executing on specs

  • Contribute to and evolve Observe's design system and shared interaction patterns

  • Present work clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and incorporate feedback without losing design integrity

  • Help raise the bar for product design

  • Keep abreast of competitor products and trends; perform competitive and comparative analysis to understand existing patterns

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product design experience working on complex, data-heavy or developer-facing products

  • A strong eye for design, with deep care for layout, motion, affordances, and visual polish

  • A design portfolio that showcases your ability to design software that is beautiful, powerful, and intuitive

  • Comfort designing for technical users and engaging with engineers on implementation tradeoffs

  • Experience with AI-native surfaces: chat interfaces, agent-driven workflows, or explainability and trust patterns

  • A prototype-first mindset; you'd rather show it than describe it

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate design decisions to PMs, engineers, and leadership

Bonus Points

  • Background in or deep familiarity with observability, monitoring, or incident response workflows

  • Experience designing CLI-adjacent or developer tooling surfaces

  • Familiarity with Observability tools

  • Prior experience at a startup or acquisition-stage product team

  • You have a deep desire to make things feel good, look awesome, and work great!

Additional Information

  • This is a hybrid role located in our Menlo Park, CA office.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is seeking an accomplished AI Product Sales Specialist to drive sales execution for our AI/ML workload within the Enterprise market. This is a strategic role that works closely with the broader field organization to ensure the successful customer adoption of Snowflake’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Achieve pipeline generation and revenue targets for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target account list

  • Execute tailored sales plays to capture market opportunities in AI/ML, helping customers optimize their use of Snowflake's platform.

  • Work directly with customers to understand their AI/ML needs, communicating insights to inform Snowflake’s product roadmap and ensuring alignment with customer requirements.

  • Become an expert in Snowflake’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions and provide executive-level insights to customers and partners, guiding strategic discussions that emphasize the value of Snowflake’s AI/ML capabilities.

  • Work with our Account Executives, Sales Engineers and Field CTOs to drive customer engagements from discovery and qualification through solution implementation and deployment

  • Track, analyze, and report on AI/ML sales performance metrics, using data-driven insights to optimize strategies and drive continuous improvement.

  • Partner with the broader cross-functional organization to integrate AI/ML sales efforts with Snowflake’s overall go-to-market plans.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of professional experience and at least 6 of years sales experience with consistently exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products

  • In-depth knowledge of AI/ML and Transformation technologies, with proven expertise in driving successful sales initiatives within these domains

  • A strong track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in highly competitive markets

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, capable of engaging with senior executives and key decision-makers at both technical and business levels.

  • Strong ability to work across cross-functional teams including Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Marketing, and Product

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent working experience

  • Fluency in both Japanese and English is required.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Functions
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to join our leadership team in AI Functions product portfolio, a hybrid director/principal engineer role at the forefront of AI-powered analytics. Join our Leadership team in AI Functions Product Portfolio.

 

Our mission is to democratize AI by surfacing powerful AI functions directly in SQL for analyzing structured and unstructured data, with minimal configuration. We handle the full AI lifecycle behind the scenes, so data analysts, engineers, and scientists can build data transformation pipelines with AI using the most sophisticated building blocks seamlessly within their existing SQL workflows.

 

The AI Functions product portfolio represents one of the most strategic and impactful product surfaces within Snowflake, bringing together two of the company’s core strengths: its industry-leading ability to process massive volumes of data and its growing capability to make that data AI-ready. By embedding advanced AI and LLM-powered functions directly into SQL, this portfolio transforms Snowflake from a data platform into an intelligent data system—where structured and unstructured data can be seamlessly prepared, enriched, and analyzed using AI at scale. This convergence enables customers to operationalize AI within their existing workflows, unlocking faster insights, more powerful applications, and a fundamentally new way to interact with data.

 

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Create and own architecture and design, influence our product roadmap, and identify new initiatives that push Snowflake's technology forward for our customers

  • Set the strategic vision for the team and drive accountability for plans and deliverables

  • Solve real business needs at scale by applying strong software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills

  • Drive team projects from ideation through implementation in partnership with cross-functional teams

  • Foster a culture of creativity and innovation while ensuring sound, practical decision-making

  • Lead organizational structure evolution and improve engineering efficiency

  • Hire, develop, and mentor senior technical leaders

  • Manage, Grow, and Mentor the teams that have a significant impact on the success of the overall Snowflake product.

WE WOULD LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE:

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with recent hands-on experience

  • 2+ years of engineering director experience, including managing managers

  • Deep experience with AI infrastructure and LLMs

  • Experience building large-scale query processing or distributed systems

  • Strong track record of recruiting and growing technical teams

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills across global organizations

 

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Join us at the forefront of AI innovation where you'll lead transformative initiatives that shape the future of data and artificial intelligence. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge LLM technology while building and mentoring high-performing engineering teams. Our culture promotes innovation, technical excellence, and collaborative problem-solving, offering you the platform to make a significant impact on enterprise AI solutions.
