jobs.title: Staff Frontend Software Engineer, AI Product: Observe by Snowflake
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world's leading data platforms.

This is a rare opportunity to define the future of AI-native observability. We are hiring a Staff Frontend Software Engineer on the AI Products team, the team responsible for the most transformative, customer-facing AI capabilities at Observe. You won't just ship features here; you'll set the technical direction for how AI agents, real-time integrations, and developer tooling come together to fundamentally change how engineers operate production systems. If you want to work at the frontier of agentic AI, in a product that ships to real customers solving real problems every day, this is the role.

AS A STAFF FRONTEND SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT OBSERVE BY SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Set technical direction for the AI Products frontend architecture, making foundational decisions about component systems, state management, and rendering strategies that scale across a rapidly growing product surface

  • Opportunity to work on the AI SRE product, Observe's flagship tool that helps engineering teams resolve production issues 10x faster through AI-powered signal correlation, driving its frontend architecture from concept through production

  • Design and build agentic AI interfaces that surface complex multi-step reasoning, tool-use results, and real-time streaming responses in ways that feel immediate, trustworthy, and actionable to users

  • Contribute to the design and development of the Observe Slack integration, creating real-time conversational surfaces that allow users to interact with the AI SRE agent directly inside their existing workflows, and own the technical strategy for future platform integrations

  • Contribute to the CLI tooling and evaluation pipelines, defining the developer experience for interacting with Observe's agentic systems and ensuring model and system quality through rigorous evals

  • Expand Observe's Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and extension architecture that grows the reach and capability of our agentic AI systems

  • Mentor and elevate engineers across the team through code review, architecture guidance, design documents, and pair programming, raising the technical bar for the entire AI Products group

  • Collaborate deeply with product, and design to shape the product roadmap, influence what gets built, and ensure every feature is as thoughtful in user experience as it is technically sound

OUR IDEAL STAFF FRONTEND SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 6 years focused on frontend engineering shipping production products at scale

  • Expert-level TypeScript proficiency, this is non-negotiable for the role; you write idiomatic, type-safe code and have opinions about how to structure large TypeScript codebases

  • Deep experience building complex, interactive web applications, you've owned entire product surfaces, not just individual components, and made architectural decisions that stood up over time

  • Production experience with agentic AI systems and tool-use patterns, including hands-on work with SDKs like the Vercel AI SDK, Anthropic Agent SDK, LangGraph, or equivalent, you understand how to build UIs for non-deterministic, streaming, multi-step agent workflows

  • Strong server-side Node.js experience (Express, Hono, Fastify, or similar), you're comfortable building APIs, middleware, and backend services, not just consuming them

  • Experience implementing or consuming MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, you understand the protocol and can design extensible tool interfaces for LLM-powered systems

  • Demonstrated technical leadership, you've driven architecture decisions, authored RFCs or design docs, and influenced technical direction beyond your immediate team

  • A product-obsessed mindset, you think in terms of user outcomes, not just technical correctness, and you push back on designs that don't serve the user

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Hands-on experience building evaluation (evals) pipelines for LLM-powered features in production, you've measured and improved model output quality at scale

  • Experience with Bun as a runtime for CLI tooling or server applications

  • Prior work building developer platforms, internal tools, or productivity infrastructure that meaningfully changed how an engineering team operates

  • Open-source contributions to AI tooling, observability projects, or developer experience tools

  • Familiarity with the observability ecosystem (OpenTelemetry, logs/metrics/traces, APM) or direct experience with Observe's platform

WHY JOIN THE AI PRODUCTS TEAM AT OBSERVE BY SNOWFLAKE?

This isn't your typical observability product. The AI Products team is building something genuinely new, an AI-native experience layer that fundamentally changes how engineers interact with production systems. You'll work with cutting-edge agentic AI, ship to customers who rely on the product daily at massive scale, and have the creative freedom to define how these products work from the ground up.

You'll get startup-level autonomy (small team, direct customer impact, no bureaucracy between you and shipping) paired with Snowflake-level resources (infrastructure, data platform, enterprise distribution). The technical problems are hard, the pace is fast, and the team is small enough that your work will be felt immediately by both customers and teammates.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst II
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Finance is where Snowflake's biggest financial questions get answered: what an acquisition is worth, where the company lands over the long term, what our EPS looks like, and how much capital each entity needs. Our work doesn't end at the model — we translate what the numbers say into clear points of view that help the CFO and senior leadership act.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a high-visibility role spanning corporate development, long-term planning, and technical accounting — a combination that's rare for a single analyst seat. You will build serious financial models and provide real decision-driving support to the executive level. This role is best suited for candidates from investment banking, private equity, or FP&A who are ready to work across M&A diligence, forecasting, and EPS simultaneously. You will work closely with a Senior Manager who owns methodology and will teach it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Financial Storytelling

Turn model output into a clear narrative for executive and board audiences — the headline, the key drivers, and the recommendation. Build exec summaries, ELT slides, and briefing memos where every number is defensible, and present your analysis directly to senior finance leadership.

M&A Diligence and Deal Modeling

Dive into target financials to understand unit economics, cost structure, and the operating model. Build acquisition models under the direction of the deal lead: standalone and pro forma projections, purchase price allocation, accretion/dilution, and sensitivity cases framed around what has to be true for the deal to work.

Long-Term Planning and 3-Statement Forecasting

Maintain and extend the total-company long-term model — full P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow — driven off bookings, revenue, headcount, and cost-per-head. Run scenarios and translate trade-offs into terms leadership can act on: growth versus margin, hiring pace versus operating leverage.

SBC and EPS Modeling

Run the monthly stock-based compensation forecast, including grant-level expense attribution, new-grant and refresh assumptions, and forfeitures by function and legal entity. Build quarterly and annual basic and diluted EPS forecasts using treasury stock method mechanics and share count roll-forward.

Entity-Level Cash Flow and Capital Planning

Build entity-level cash flow forecasts to size capital requirements and funding needs across international subsidiaries. Support Tax on transfer pricing analytics and convert entity-level detail into a plain funding recommendation: which entities need cash, how much, and when.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

• 1–3 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, transaction advisory, or corporate FP&A

• Ability to build or work extensively in a 3-statement operating model, and explain how the balance sheet and cash flow tie

• Familiarity with M&A modeling mechanics — accretion/dilution, purchase accounting, sources and uses

• Advanced Excel with disciplined model structure and a bias toward auditability over cleverness

• Strong written and verbal communication — able to take a complex analysis and land it in three sentences and one slide

• Solid GAAP fundamentals with genuine interest in SBC (ASC 718) and EPS (ASC 260)

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Bonus Points

• Experience building materials for a CFO, board, or executive audience

• SQL and Python proficiency — this team queries the data warehouse directly

• Workday Adaptive Planning or a comparable EPM platform

• Entity-level cash flow, capital adequacy, or transfer pricing exposure

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect - Data Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

PRINCIPAL SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT

We are seeking experienced professionals with deep expertise in Data Engineering, Cloud Data Architecture, and AI-assisted, agentic development practices to join our Services Delivery team to help create exciting new offerings and capabilities for our customers!

In this strategic role, you will help customers modernize and expand their use of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will take data pipelines from ideation to full production and pioneer agentic data engineering, where AI agents write, test, deploy, monitor, and optimize data workloads alongside engineers. You will use Snowflake's native capabilities across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and governance, along with our partner ecosystem, to advise clients on best practices for resilient, cost-efficient, production-ready data architectures. You will design tailored data engineering solutions and define repeatable agent-driven delivery patterns that speed up migrations and platform builds. You will also work closely with customer teams and Systems Integrators, providing the technical leadership and oversight needed for successful outcomes.

AS A PRINCIPAL SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Be a technical expert on all aspects of Snowflake as it applies to data engineering to provide customers with best practices given Snowflake's technology stack.

  • Work with customers to understand their data engineering and platform modernization goals, discover key requirements, and architect a Snowflake-centric solution to be delivered by Services Delivery.

  • Understand how to build and deploy data pipelines with Snowflake features within the Snowflake ecosystem based on customer requirements.

  • Pioneer agentic data engineering practices. Use AI coding agents and Snowflake's AI capabilities to speed up pipeline development, code conversion and migration, testing, documentation, and day-to-day operations. Turn these approaches into repeatable delivery patterns and accelerators.

  • Work hands-on where needed in SQL, Python, Snowpark, dbt, and agentic development tools to build POCs and reference implementations that show engineering techniques and best practices on Snowflake.

  • Follow best practices, including ensuring knowledge transfer so that customers are properly enabled and are able to extend the capabilities of Snowflake on their own.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of competing and complementary technologies and vendors in data engineering and in AI-assisted development, and know how to position Snowflake against them.

  • Guide customers through their specific technical challenges, such as complex migrations, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

  • Support other members of the Services Delivery team as they develop their expertise.

  • Work with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to keep improving Snowflake's products and marketing. Feed real-world delivery insights back into the roadmap for data engineering and agentic features.

OUR IDEAL SOLUTION ARCHITECT - DATA ENGINEERING WILL HAVE:

  • Minimum 5 years experience working with customers in a pre-sales or post-sales technical role.

  • Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Thorough understanding of the complete data engineering lifecycle, including data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data modeling, and data quality.

  • Thorough understanding of modern data architecture patterns, including batch and streaming pipelines, ELT, lakehouse and open table formats (Apache Iceberg), and data warehouse migration and modernization.

  • Strong understanding of DataOps, along with the technologies and methods for deploying, testing, monitoring, and governing data pipelines (CI/CD, observability, performance tuning, and cost optimization).

  • Hands-on experience applying AI coding agents and agentic workflows to accelerate data engineering work such as pipeline development, code conversion, testing, and operations.

  • Experience and understanding of at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

  • Experience with at least one data platform or integration technology such as Databricks, AWS Glue/EMR, Azure Data Factory/Synapse, GCP BigQuery/Dataflow, Informatica, Fivetran, etc.

  • Hands-on scripting experience with SQL and at least one of the following: Python, Java or Scala.

  • Experience with tools and frameworks such as dbt, Apache Spark/PySpark, Apache Airflow, Kafka, Pandas, or similar.

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR HAVING:

  • Experience migrating Databricks/Apache Spark or legacy ETL workloads (e.g., Informatica, SSIS, DataStage) to Snowflake

  • Experience building agentic workflows, custom agent skills, or MCP-based tooling to automate data engineering tasks

  • Experience with AI/ML workloads, including preparing data for feature engineering, RAG, or agent use cases, and understanding of ML/DL fundamentals.

  • Snowflake certifications (e.g., SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer or Architect)

  • Proven success within enterprise software

  • Vertical expertise in a core vertical such as FSI, Retail, Manufacturing etc.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Manager/ Senior Manager, Finance Analytics & AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:

We’re looking for a Manager/ Sr. Manager to lead Finance Analytics—redefining how Finance leverages data, automation, and AI to operate at scale. This role sits at the intersection of analytics engineering, data product development, and applied AI, and is responsible for building both the team and the systems that power next-generation Finance.

You won’t just deliver dashboards—you’ll lead the development of scalable data products, intelligent workflows, and AI-driven applications that transform how Finance operates, makes decisions, and drives efficiency.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring a balance of strategy, execution, and people leadership. You’ll partner closely with Finance, business stakeholders, and Engineering to translate ambiguity into durable, production-grade solutions.

In this role, you will:

Set vision and lead execution

  • Define and drive the roadmap for Finance Analytics, aligned to business priorities and long-term data strategy.

  • Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable data products, AI solutions, and automation initiatives.

  • Build and lead a high-performing team

  • Hire, develop, and mentor a team of analysts, analytics engineers, and data product builders.

  • Establish best practices across data modeling, experimentation, and product development.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, speed, and continuous learning.

Own data products end-to-end

  • Oversee the design, development, and adoption of data products, dashboards, and internal applications used to run Finance.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and deeply embedded in business workflows.

Drive AI-powered transformation

  • Lead the development of intelligent workflows, such as automation, copilots, agents, and decision-support tools, that increase leverage across Finance.

  • Identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation to core financial and operational processes.

Strengthen the data foundation

  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure high-quality, well-modeled, and governed datasets.

  • Establish standards for data quality, documentation, and discoverability.

Influence decision-making at scale

  • Deliver actionable insights and shape strategic decisions through data.

  • Act as a thought partner to Finance leadership, bringing a data-driven perspective.

Champion operational excellence

  • Identify inefficiencies and drive system- and process-level improvements.

  • Implement scalable solutions over one-off analyses.

What You Will Need

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering, BI, or related fields, with 2+ years in a people management role.

  • Deep expertise in SQL and building scalable, production-grade data models.

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms, such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, or similar programming languages, for data transformation, automation, or application development.

  • Experience building data products, not just dashboards, including tools, apps, or workflows used in business operations.

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI/LLMs, such as Cortex, OpenAI, Claude, or similar technologies, to real business problems.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.

  • Experience supporting Finance organizations.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ERP, financial planning, or business planning systems.

  • Background supporting finance, business operations, or analytics teams.

  • Familiarity with agile development practices.

What Sets You Apart

  • Builder + leader mindset: You can set strategy while staying close to the work.

  • Product orientation: You think in terms of user adoption, usability, and impact—not just delivery.

  • Systems thinker: You design scalable, reusable solutions that stand the test of time.

  • Bias for action: You move quickly, iterate, and prioritize impact over perfection.

  • AI-forward: You actively explore and apply emerging AI capabilities to unlock new ways of working.

  • User obsession: You deeply understand stakeholder needs and design solutions that truly improve their workflows.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is transforming the future of data and we are looking for a dynamic Sr. Manager, Technical Delivery to lead our Snowflake Professional Services team. As strategic experts in implementing the Snowflake platform, we engage with customers to optimize, accelerate, and drive meaningful business outcomes through cutting-edge technology solutions including Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI (GenAI).

As a Delivery Manager, you will lead teams executing complex migrations from legacy systems to the Snowflake platform. Your role will involve close collaboration with customers and system integrators to understand requirements, design robust migration strategies, oversee seamless transitions, and act as a strategic advisor to your customers. Your leadership will ensure that Snowflake is positioned as the premier solution in data warehousing and analytics, influencing both technical and executive stakeholders.

 

AS A DELIVERY MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a team of Solutions Architects and Consultants, who serve as our Snowflake implementation, optimization, development and delivery experts

  • Play an active role in sourcing and screening potential candidates and managing the interview process

  • Be a technical expert on all aspects of Snowflake

  • Provide delivery quality oversight and guidance for Snowflake engagements by ensuring adherence to technical and delivery best practices

  • Oversee the successful design, implementation, and deployment of complex AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions leveraging the Snowflake platform

  • Work with Professional Services Practice Directors and Sales Account Team on sales pursuits. Lead project scoping, performing code assessments, pricing services, creating statements of work, and providing strategic guidance on productionalizing AI and GenAI use cases

  • Develop methodologies to improve our services delivery

  • Provide guidance on how to resolve customer-specific technical challenges

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Present our methodologies, capabilities to both internal teams, external partners and customers

 

OUR IDEAL DELIVERY MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience working with customers in a pre-sales or post-sales technical role

  • Minimum 5 years of people management experience; experience mentoring, coaching and developing teams

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in selling professional services; scoping large projects, writing statements of work

  • Proven experience guiding enterprise customers on data strategies for building, deploying, and operationalizing GenAI engagements

  • Extensive knowledge of and experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, Greenplum, etc.)

  • Experience with non-relational platforms and tools for large-scale data processing (e.g. Hadoop, HBase)

  • Familiarity and experience with common data integration and data transformation tools (e.g. Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion)

  • Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Microstrategy, Business Objects, Tableau)

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience

jobs.descriptionHtml:

The Snowflake Global Revenue Enablement team is fanatical about building and certifying technical champions worldwide. We deliver innovative learning and enablement solutions that empower individuals to excel on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

We are looking for an elite Sr. Certification Development Program Manager (PM) to lead technical certification releases, assessment architecture, and exam development for the SnowPro Certification program. This hands-on, technical role requires a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and bridges the gap between technical implementation, psychometric exam development, and practical assessment experiences for a global network of Snowflake experts.

Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Assessment Architecture: Design, develop, and deploy lab-based practical assessments (including architectural concepts and automated scoring scripts), micro-credentials, performance-based tasks, and rubric-based evaluations for demonstrated hands-on skills.

  • SME Workshop Facilitation: Recruit, train, and lead global Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) through synchronous and asynchronous exam development workshops, including Program Design, Job Task Analyses (JTA), item writing, technical reviews, and standard setting (cut-score) sessions.

  • Technical Question Validation & Quality: Author, review, and technically validate advanced scenario-based exam questions to ensure alignment with Snowflake platform updates, AI/ML features, and architectural best practices.

  • Editorial & Style Governance: Review and revise exam content for grammar, punctuation, spelling, style, and tone, ensuring readability and strict adherence to Snowflake editorial standards.

  • End-to-End Program & Project Management: Use project management tools and methodologies to manage medium-to-large-scale exam development projects, directing simultaneous releases to deliver high-quality outputs on time.

  • Vendor & Psychometric Collaboration: Partner with psychometricians and delivery vendors (e.g., Pearson) to monitor statistical item performance, manage item banks, ensure QTI compliance, and enforce strict exam security.

  • Localization & Publishing Management: Oversee the operational workflows, publishing, maintenance, and global localization processes for all certification forms and program assets.

  • Enablement, Marketing & Launch: Drive new and updated exam launches by developing study guides, practice exams, web content, program articles, and blog posts to drive candidate success and program awareness.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Engineering, Product Marketing, and Technical Documentation teams to keep certification paths continuously synchronized with major platform releases and product roadmaps.

Requirements

  • Content & Assessment Expertise: 6+ years of experience in technical content development, certification design, assessment engineering, or IT/technical training in enterprise software environments.

  • Technical Proficiency: 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and building technical labs, practical assessments, or hands-on environments across enterprise cloud or data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Project Management & Operations: Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects from concept to launch using standard PM tools and frameworks in fast-paced or asynchronous environments.

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Engineering, Education, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex cloud architectural patterns into clear, evaluative assessment objectives and crisp editorial content.

Preferred Skills:

  • Certification: SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced Certified.

  • Platform Experience: Direct hands-on experience with the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, including proficiency in SQL and/or Python.

  • Assessment Tools & Standards: Experience with item banking platforms (e.g., Pearson ExamDeveloper) and assessment standards like QTI (Question & Test Interoperability).

  • AI/ML & GenAI Workflows: Hands-on experience or familiarity with LLMs, AI/ML workflows, and building agents.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Observe by Snowflake is a high-growth SaaS observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, enabling businesses to troubleshoot modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the Snowflake platform. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.


As a Senior Solutions Engineer for Observe, you will play a critical, highly-visible, role within our organization, serving as the primary technical resource for our Sales team. You will be responsible for driving the technical closure of sales opportunities by demonstrating the value of Observe to prospective customers. This role requires a blend of deep technical knowledge, strong presentation skills, and a customer-focused approach.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Technical Discovery and Presentation: Conduct in-depth technical discovery sessions with prospects to understand their current environment, challenges, and specific observability requirements. Tailor and deliver compelling product demonstrations and technical presentations that showcase how our solution addresses their needs.

  • Proof of Concepts (POCs): Design, scope, and manage technical evaluations and Proof of Concepts, ensuring the successful setup and demonstration of value within the customer's environment. Document findings and present clear, persuasive results back to the customer.

  • Sales Team Support: Partner closely with Account Executives to develop and execute technical sales strategies. Act as the technical subject matter expert throughout the sales cycle, from initial contact to final contract.

  • Feedback and Product Collaboration: Serve as the voice of the customer to the Product Management and Engineering teams, providing crucial feedback on product capabilities, market needs, and competitive landscape.

  • Content and Training: Develop and maintain technical sales collateral, including demo environments, presentations, and best practice guides. Deliver technical training to the broader Sales organization.

  • Travel: Ability to travel to client sites and industry events as required.

QUALIFICATIONS :

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect in the software industry.

  • Deep technical understanding and practical experience with modern Observability concepts (metrics, logging, tracing) and tools (e.g., Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK Stack).

  • Familiarity with cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices) and major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience selling to Developer, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) personas.

  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, high-growth Observability or Application Performance Monitoring (APM) company.

Job Description

  • Lead and execute Go-to-Market strategies and integrated marketing programs which include multi-channel campaigns, and events (of all sizes and formats) across a broad segment of customers.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

This role goes beyond keeping People systems running. It's an opportunity to modernize how they're run. You'll own the core platforms within our People Technology stack, such as Workday HCM, ServiceNow HRSD, Ashby, and the integrations that connect them. You will leverage AI, modern integration frameworks, and automation to eliminate manual work, and help build and operate the AI products and skills transforming how Snowflake works.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Platform operations: day-to-day support, release management, and change control for Workday HCM, ServiceNow HRSD, Ashby, and their integrations, including vendor releases from impact analysis through stabilization

  • Trust and compliance: data integrity, system security, and audit readiness across all People systems (SOX, GDPR, privacy)

  • Service excellence: operational SLAs and incident, problem, and request management that the business can count on

  • AI-driven automation: ticket deflection, proactive data-hygiene monitoring, automated regression testing, and faster release cycles

  • AI in production: operationalize, maintain, and support AI products and skills, developing robust runbooks, monitoring, and support structures once they go live

  • Roadmap influence: turn operational friction into prioritized requirements, and co-own the People Tech and AI roadmap with the PMO

  • Vendors: manage vendor and implementation-partner relationships for Workday, ServiceNow, Ashby, and connected SaaS tools including performance, escalations, contract management, and roadmap alignment

  • Team leadership: lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of People Systems Analysts and Integration Engineers

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years in HRIS or HR technology, including hands-on configuration, integration, and delivery experience

  • 4+ years of people management experience leading HRIS, systems, or integration teams

  • Deep Workday expertise (Security, Business Processes, Reporting/RaaS), including supporting a global implementation, plus a strong grasp of middleware and integration platforms

  • Hands-on experience with core HR systems beyond Workday, such as ServiceNow HRSD and Ashby

  • A strong operating discipline: release management, change control, incident and problem management, SLA ownership, SOX and privacy controls

  • Real experience applying AI or GenAI to HR operations, such as ticket deflection, data-quality monitoring, or test and release automation

  • Proven ability to influence leaders and prioritize against operational realities

  • Excellent communication skills and a customer service mindset in supporting the business

Business Development & Capture, US Public Sector

____

WASHINGTON, DC | RESTON, VA | REMOTE (DC METRO AREA)

WHO WE ARE

Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud, a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Inside the AI Data Cloud, organizations unite their siloed data, easily discover and securely share governed data, and execute diverse analytic workloads. jobs.title: Certification Coordinator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Snowflake Global Revenue Enablement certification team is fanatical about building and certifying technical champions worldwide. We constantly deliver innovative learning and enablement solutions to help individuals excel on the Snowflake Data Cloud.

We are looking for an action-oriented Certification Coordinator to support certification operations, vendor management, exam development, and candidate marketing. In this hands-on role, you will work closely with external vendors, internal technical experts, and candidates to scale and streamline the global SnowPro Certification program.

The ideal candidate is a high-ownership self-starter with a knack for identifying inefficiencies, automating manual processes, and managing vendor relationships. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, feel comfortable making real-time decisions with incomplete data, and drive projects to completion with minimal oversight.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Vendor Management: Serve as a primary point of contact for external certification vendors and partners, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs), operational alignment, and seamless integration with Snowflake systems.

  • Process Automation & Optimization: Identify operational bottlenecks, streamline workflows, and drive automation initiatives to eliminate manual tasks across candidate management and exam operations.

  • Candidate Marketing & Communications: Create, manage, and update all candidate-facing communications and web pages. Write engaging blogs, build email campaigns, and draft marketing assets to promote certifications and keep candidates informed.

  • Support & Operations: Manage global certification support cases in Salesforce, handle escalations, and oversee candidate workflows (voucher distribution, continuing education, accommodations, and exam security).

  • SME Program Management: Lead recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and communication for SnowPro Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Train SMEs on exam development best practices and Snowflake style guidelines.

  • Exam Development & Publishing: Support exam development systems, maintain exam forms, assist with study guide content creation, and participate in exam publishing and localization.

  • Project Ownership: Drive medium-to-large-scale certification projects from concept to completion, taking full accountability for quality and on-time delivery in a rapidly shifting environment.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Vendor & Operations Experience: Proven track record of managing external vendor relationships and collaborating with technical/operations partners.

  • Process Automation Mindset: Demonstrated ability to identify workflow inefficiencies and implement automated or optimized solutions to scale operations.

  • Marketing & Content Creation: Strong experience drafting candidate-facing communications, managing web page updates, writing blogs, and building marketing email campaigns.

  • Autonomy & Initiative: Proactive self-starter who takes end-to-end ownership of projects and makes sound, real-time decisions with limited oversight or imperfect data.

  • Agility & Tech Aptitude: Ability to thrive in a high-velocity environment, adapt quickly to platform releases, and navigate ambiguous situations with confidence.

  • Experience: 4+ years in certification operations, program management, or technical education support, plus 2+ years in IT, technical training, or technical writing.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Business, Education, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a strong foundation in remote and asynchronous workflows.

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • SnowPro Core or Advanced Certification.

  • Experience integrating, automating, or managing third-party tools (e.g., via APIs, workflow builders, or custom scripts).

  • Hands-on experience managing vendor operations with Pearson VUE or other major test delivery providers.

  • Familiarity with web content management systems, email marketing platforms, Certification Management Systems, and Question & Test Interoperability (QTI) standards.

  • Experience managing cases, automation rules, and workflows in Salesforce.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Efficiency
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake runs large scale cloud infrastructure to deliver its own service — production and internal deployments, Kubernetes fleets, CI/CD, etc. Our cloud spend is in billions of dollars per year. The Cloud Efficiency team builds a unified, self-serve cloud efficiency platform along with AI skills and agents that makes spend observable, attributable, governable while driving insights and optimization of our cloud spend.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable platform for resource ownership registry, usage attribution, utilization measurement, and cost modeling.

  • Build AI agents, tools and automation to enhance system monitoring, alerting, and root cause analysis.

  • Improve and optimize data ingestion, storage, and query efficiency for cloud utilization, cost and efficiency data at scale.

  • Collaborate with teams across Snowflake to understand attribution and observability needs and implement solutions that improve operational visibility.

  • Contribute to open-source and industry best practices in monitoring and distributed systems monitoring.

  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of team-managed platforms by participating in on-call rotations and incident management.

  • Partner with Finance, Product and Engineering teams to turn usage, cost and utilization insights into landed operational change.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR:

  • 7+ years of industry experience designing, building and supporting large scale systems in production.

  • Experience with cost optimization and efficiency work on systems built on large private clouds or public cloud providers

  • Deep system and architectural analysis experience to identify actionable performance and efficiency insights

  • History of delivering large cross functional projects with measurable impact

  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Go, Python or Java.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues in a production environment.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

  • BS / MS in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields

  • Prior background building AI agents and working with LLMs

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience developing or using observability infrastructure such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus etc

  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and its billing models — AWS, Azure, or GCP: compute instance families, storage tiers, networking and data-transfer charges, reserved vs. on-demand, and how billing/CUR exports are structured.

  • FinOps experience: cost attribution, chargeback, showback, or unit-economics programs.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Observe
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Observe business unit delivers AI-powered observability at enterprise scale, unifying logs, metrics, and traces across petabytes of telemetry data into a single, trusted, Snowflake-native platform. As organizations shift from reactive monitoring to proactive, automated troubleshooting, the implementation experience becomes a critical driver of product value.

Solutions Architects are the architectural foundation of the Observe post-sales practice. They bring deep platform and observability domain expertise to design durable, scalable architectures, ensuring every enterprise implementation starts with a sound technical foundation that Implementation Engineers (IEs) execute with confidence and customers build on for years. By owning the architecture layer, and establishing shared standards that demonstrate what great looks like, Solutions Architects multiply the effectiveness of the entire go-to-market team.

This role is ideal for a technically exceptional practitioner who has moved beyond execution into architecture. Someone who can assess a complex enterprise environment, design an observability system built to scale, document it with precision, and hand it off with confidence.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Take an active role in technical discovery on SA-attached engagements, working in tandem with the Implementation Engineer to assess existing telemetry, infrastructure, data volumes, tooling landscape, and operational requirements

  • Design end-to-end observability architectures on Observe, covering telemetry ingestion, pipeline topology, data modeling, enrichment and normalization strategies, alerting design, and long-term retention

  • Define the implementation approach and architecture blueprint that Implementation Engineering teams execute against

  • Validate that proposed configurations, pipelines, and data models will meet production-scale requirements before execution begins

  • Advise customers on OpenTelemetry adoption strategies

  • Have an active role in the architecture and planning phases of enterprise engagements, working in tandem with the IE from kickoff through handoff to dedicated IE team(s)

  • Produce clear, high-quality handoff artifacts (e.g. reference architectures, design decision records, implementation plans, and configuration standards)

  • Remain available to Implementation teams during execution for architectural blockers, scope changes, or decisions requiring architectural judgment

  • Conduct formal go-live architecture reviews to validate that the implemented solution matches the designed architecture and is production-ready

  • Design the target architecture and phased cutover strategy for complex migrations from existing observability platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic) onto Observe, minimizing disruption to production operations

  • Identify architectural gaps, data quality risks, and technical debt in existing environments; design clean, scalable replacements where appropriate

  • Partner with the Director of Implementation Engineering to develop and own internal reference architectures, design documents, runbooks, and implementation standards

  • Build and maintain field demo infrastructure — realistic, production-grade environments that pre-sales and IE teams use to show customers what a well-architected Observe deployment looks like

  • Capture reusable patterns from field engagements and translate them into assets the broader IE team can apply consistently

  • Serve as a technical authority on complex or novel customer scenarios

  • Act as a force multiplier for the IE team; set the technical example, structure, and tone on an engagement, and mentor and level up junior Implementation Engineers rather than taking over their work

  • Contribute beyond core Observe architecture where the engagement calls for it; integration with adjacent solutions and technologies, process (re-)engineering, and AI refactoring

  • Contribute field insights back to Product and Engineering to influence the platform roadmap

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 8+ years in customer-facing technical roles; Solutions Architect, Staff/Principal engineer, observability engineer, or SRE; with a demonstrated shift from hands-on execution to architecture-level thinking

  • Deep expertise in observability platforms and telemetry systems at scale, including data modeling tradeoffs across logs, metrics, and traces

  • Strong hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry: instrumentation strategies, collector configuration, exporters, and multi-signal pipeline design

  • Proven ability to design or lead migrations from commercial observability platforms (Splunk, ELK, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) to modern alternatives

  • Experience assessing complex enterprise environments and producing architectural designs that are durable, scalable, and practical to implement

  • Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized workloads, and Kubernetes-based environments

  • Strong communication skills; credible with both hands-on engineering teams and senior technical leadership

  • Experience producing high-quality technical documentation: architecture diagrams, design decision records, runbooks, implementation plans

  • Exposure to AI-assisted observability or AIOps

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Background in SRE, platform engineering, or DevOps with firsthand experience operating production observability at scale

  • Experience authoring internal standards, reference architectures, and enablement content for post-sales or pre-sales teams

  • Experience building or maintaining demo or lab environments for internal field teams

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes-native observability patterns and cloud-native monitoring tooling

  • Experience working in or alongside professional services organizations

  • Experience working directly with Observe.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

  • Time-to-first-value for new Observe customers

  • Customer satisfaction scores (post-engagement NPS/CSAT)

  • On-time and on-scope delivery rate

  • Escalation rate and time to resolution

  • Observe consumption growth attributable to successful implementations

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Cloud Security team. This team reduces risk to Snowflake at scale through software-defined controls rather than one-off fixes, building the platforms and pipelines that make entire classes of problems go away. You won't just find problems; you'll ship the systems that improve and verify the security posture of Snowflake products across 600+ million assets and three cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and GCP), with a growing focus on using AI to reason over posture data at a scale humans can't.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build solutions and services that operate, protect, and govern our security posture across 600+ million assets and three clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Automate security controls across cloud environments, including core primitives: IAM, detection and monitoring, configuration management, and data protection.

  • Build real-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting, using Snowflake technologies to make Snowflake more secure.

  • Define and maintain security baselines, policies, and standards for public cloud platforms.

  • Design and operate continuous, AI-augmented pipelines that ingest posture and telemetry across hundreds of millions of assets, score risk, and automatically surface the highest-impact issues.

  • Own security workstreams end to end and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, and technical guidance for the team.

  • Bring software engineering best practices to security work: documentation, testing, and observability, because a control you can't test, monitor, or reason about isn't a control.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience preferred, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience designing and owning secure, large-scale systems, with working knowledge of secure architecture principles and threat modeling.

  • A passion for developer experience: making security the default rather than a restriction.

  • Experience building software in one or more languages such as Java, C++, Go, or Python.

  • Familiarity with distributed architectures and building scalable APIs (e.g., gRPC, REST).

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • A commitment to data-driven, scalable decision-making that holds up over time.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience applying AI/ML to security problems (detection, risk scoring, prioritization) and building the data pipelines that feed them.

  • Proficiency writing, debugging, and optimizing SQL for data-driven security operations, as a supporting capability.

  • A strong grasp of algorithms and data structures applied to complex problems.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and IaC (Terraform, Pulumi).

  • Experience designing scalable, concurrent, resilient services for high-demand, multi-cloud environments.

WHY JOIN OUR CLOUD SECURITY TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Our work centers on a platform that makes security easy to deploy and maintain: unifying the developer security experience, increasing developer autonomy, detecting vulnerabilities before they ship, and delivering secure-by-default solutions. A growing part of that is using AI to turn raw posture signal into prioritized action at a scale humans can't match. If you want to build the systems that make entire classes of security problems disappear, and deliver a world-class security experience for developers at Snowflake, this is the team.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:

There is only one Data Cloud. Snowflake's founders started from scratch and designed a data platform built for the cloud that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. But it did not stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

Snowflake, the company that delivers the Data Cloud to Mobilize the World's Data, is actively seeking a Manager, Sales Engineering Enablement Business Partners. In this leadership role, you will lead, coach, and grow a team of three Sales Engineering Enablement Business Partners who serve as the voice of enablement across regional and specialized technical segments worldwide. You will be accountable for ensuring this team equips our global Sales Engineering organization with the technical mastery, domain knowledge, and enablement programs needed to secure the technical win. You will partner directly with senior Sales Engineering leadership and cross functional teams across Product, Marketing, and Sales Operations to shape our global enablement strategy and drive measurable field impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of Sales Engineering Enablement Business Partners, each embedded within a regional or specialized segment, ensuring they are positioned as trusted extensions of their respective SE leadership teams.

  • Partner with senior Sales Engineering executives and cross functional leadership to define the overarching technical enablement charter, strategic priorities, and regional delivery models.

  • Establish clear operating mechanisms for intake, prioritization, and resource allocation so your Business Partners can effectively manage competing regional and global enablement demands.

  • Drive operational excellence across the team in designing, localizing, and delivering segment specific enablement assets, technical curriculums, hands on workshops, Sales Kickoff sessions, and continuous learning programs.

  • Ensure your team coordinates and delivers seamless ongoing enablement activities, and field communication campaigns in alignment with the global enablement plan.

  • Champion rigorous metrics and business impact measurement, tracking enablement effectiveness and field readiness across all segments your team supports.

  • Foster tight alignment between Enablement, Product Management, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architecture to ensure the technical field stays ahead of product releases and industry trends.

  • Guide your team in standardizing best practices, scalable frameworks, and asset sharing across theaters to maximize velocity and consistency while honoring regional nuances and localization needs.

  • Act as an executive sponsor and escalation point for critical enablement initiatives, regional escalations, and executive stakeholder alignment.

  • Cultivate an inclusive, collaborative, and high trust culture centered on continuous growth, domain mastery, and empathy for the technical field.

Required Skills:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in sales engineering, technical enablement, solutions architecture, or technical consulting within high growth enterprise SaaS companies, with a deep understanding of the data analytics ecosystem.

  • 3+ years of direct people management experience leading technical enablement specialists, sales engineers, or technical business partners.

  • Deep understanding of the data cloud, modern analytics ecosystems, enterprise architectures, and complex technical sales cycles, processes, and methodologies.

  • Proven track record of designing, executing, and scaling enablement programs that demonstrably accelerate technical ramp and win rates.

  • Exceptional executive presence and relationship building skills, with demonstrated success influencing senior sales, engineering, and product leadership.

  • Strong strategic thinking, operational discipline, and analytical problem solving skills to manage global resource allocation and measure business impact.

  • Ability to thrive, provide clarity, and drive execution in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Ability to travel periodically as required.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff System Research Engineer – LLM Inference Optimization
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for talented systems developers and researchers to join the Snowflake AI Research team and advance the state of the art in LLM inference systems and optimization.

Our mission is to build the next generation of high-performance and intelligent inference systems. We optimize not only how fast and efficiently models run, but also how quickly inference systems can adapt to new models, architectures, hardware, and workloads.

Our work spans the full inference stack—from distributed serving and runtime systems to GPU kernels and model-system co-design. We explore techniques such as adaptive parallelism, speculative and parallel decoding, disaggregated inference, scheduling and batching, KV-cache optimization, model swapping, quantization, and GPU kernel optimization to push the frontier of latency, throughput, scalability, and cost.

Beyond optimizing individual models, we are building intelligent and adaptive inference systems that can automate performance optimization—rapidly profiling new models and workloads, identifying bottlenecks, selecting effective execution strategies, and adapting system configurations with minimal manual tuning. We embrace AI-native engineering, using AI not only as the workload we optimize, but also as a tool to accelerate system development, experimentation, debugging, optimization, and adaptation to new models. Our goal is to accelerate both the speed of inference and the agility of inference development.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with a world-class team, including founding members of DeepSpeed, vLLM, and TensorFlow. Together, we will push the boundaries of AI systems and bring cutting-edge research into production-scale AI.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop high-performance LLM inference systems, spanning distributed serving, runtime systems, GPU execution, and performance-critical kernels.

  • Develop novel techniques to improve inference latency, generation speed, throughput, memory efficiency, scalability, and cost.

  • Explore advanced inference techniques including speculative and parallel decoding, prefill/decode disaggregation, adaptive parallelism, continuous batching and scheduling, KV-cache management, quantization, and communication optimization.

  • Develop adaptive and intelligent inference systems that automatically optimize execution for new model architectures, hardware platforms, workload characteristics, and deployment environments.

  • Apply AI-driven and AI-native approaches to systems engineering, including automated profiling, bottleneck identification, configuration search, code generation, experimentation, runtime strategy selection, debugging, and performance tuning.

  • Independently identify high-impact performance and systems problems, formulate hypotheses, prototype solutions, and drive promising ideas from research through production.

  • Design distributed inference strategies across GPUs and nodes, including tensor, sequence, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism.

  • Develop efficient approaches for multi-model serving, dynamic resource management, model loading and swapping, and workload-aware scheduling.

  • Analyze and optimize GPU kernels and operators for attention, MoE, communication, and other performance-critical model components.

  • Explore model-system co-design, including model or post-training techniques that unlock substantially more efficient inference.

  • Profile and benchmark end-to-end workloads to identify bottlenecks across compute, memory, communication, networking, scheduling, and model execution.

  • Collaborate closely with model researchers, infrastructure teams, and product teams to deploy research innovations in production.

  • Open-source and publish innovations through technical blogs and top-tier systems and machine learning conferences.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree or PhD is preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: LLM inference systems, distributed AI systems, GPU systems, or high-performance computing.

  • Strong understanding of modern LLM inference architectures and the performance tradeoffs involved in serving large-scale models.

  • Hands-on experience with modern LLM inference and serving frameworks, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or similar systems.

  • Experience designing, extending, or optimizing inference runtimes, including areas such as scheduling, batching, KV-cache management, distributed execution, parallelism, speculative decoding, or disaggregated serving.

  • Strong understanding of GPU architectures and experience with CUDA, Triton, or similar GPU programming environments.

  • Experience with performance-oriented libraries and frameworks such as CUTLASS, cuBLAS, cuDNN, or related technologies.

  • Experience profiling and diagnosing end-to-end system performance using Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, or equivalent tools.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as an independent problem identifier and solver—recognizing important problems with limited direction, defining the right technical questions, and driving solutions through ambiguity.

  • Strong ability to work across model, runtime, distributed system, and hardware layers and reason about end-to-end performance tradeoffs.

  • Experience using AI-native engineering approaches to accelerate software development, experimentation, debugging, optimization, or system adaptation is a strong plus.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across research, engineering, and product teams.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

Position Overview

Snowflake Inc. is seeking a dynamic, strategic, and results-oriented Manager, Field Marketing - US Majors Financial Services to lead field marketing strategy and execution across our highest-value US Financial Services enterprise accounts (Banking, Asset Management, Capital Markets, and Insurance).

In this dual-impact role, you will balance high-level strategic planning with hands-on execution. You will directly manage a team of two field marketing individual contributors, driving targeted field marketing programs and executive engagements that accelerate adoption of Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud within the financial services sector. Success requires strong cross-functional leadership, deep alignment with Enterprise Sales leadership, and a data-driven approach to pipeline creation, account expansion, and ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Account Planning: Own and execute the end-to-end field marketing strategy for the US Majors Financial Services vertical, tailoring programs to address strict industry regulations, modernization trends, and enterprise buying cycles.

  • Team Leadership & Execution: Lead, mentor, and empower a team of two individual contributors. Drive operational excellence while staying hands-on in the design, planning, and execution of high-impact field initiatives.

  • Integrated Field Programs: Architect 1:1 and 1:Many campaigns, executive roundtables, customized roadshows, partner co-marketing initiatives, and high-touch customer experiences designed to penetrate and expand major financial accounts.

  • Sales & Partner Alignment: Partner closely with US Majors Financial Services Sales leadership, Account Executives, SDR teams, and Ecosystem Partners to align marketing strategy with territory goals, key target accounts, and revenue targets.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Product Marketing, Account Based Marketing, Growth Marketing, Partner Marketing, and Industry Solutions teams to deliver domain-specific messaging and tailored collateral to top financial institutions.

  • Performance & Analytics: Track, measure, and optimize program performance against critical metrics, including account engagement, opportunity acceleration, pipeline impact, and overall campaign ROI.

  • Talent Development: Foster a high-performing, collaborative team environment through clear career development pathways, continuous feedback, and active coaching.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of B2B field marketing experience in enterprise software/SaaS, with proven experience supporting high-value accounts (Financial Services/FinTech experience strongly preferred).

  • Leadership: 2+ years of direct people management experience with a track record of coaching and developing individual contributors.

  • Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance macro-level strategy with micro-level execution, willing to lead by example and directly roll up sleeves on major initiatives.

  • Sales Partnership: Strong executive presence with a demonstrated track record of building trusted partnerships with Enterprise Sales leaders and key cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: Hands-on experience analyzing campaign performance, tracking pipeline attribution, and managing field marketing budgets.

  • Marketing Tech Stack: Familiarity with enterprise CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase/6sense).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction.

  • Work Arrangement: Ability to adhere to a hybrid work schedule (2-3 days per week in office).

  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 40% of the time.

Apply today to bring your strategic vision, leadership, and domain expertise to Snowflake. In this high-visibility role, you will work closely with Sales leadership to reshape how we engage top-tier financial institutions, lead and develop a focused team, and directly influence pipeline growth for Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
