jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Account Executive is responsible for driving new client acquisition within enterprise businesses. Individuals who excel at this job have the ability to prospect, develop, and close business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements. The Enterprise AE's must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with clients and support new customers through our on-boarding process.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects at a very exciting time for the company. Snowflake is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused company in a large and growing market. If you are an energetic, self-managed professional with experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities, we’d love to hear from you.

 

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Achieve sales quotas on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

  • Develop marketing plans with the marketing team to drive revenue growth.

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace.

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities

  • Arrange and conduct initial Executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings.

  • Sales process management and opportunity closure.

  • Be familiar with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of field sales experience preferred with an emphasis on data or cloud related technology.

  • 5+ year’s industry focused experience generating new business

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Experience hitting quota of $1M+ of ARR per year.

  • A track record of success in driving consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.

  • Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.

  • Pro-active, independent thinker with high energy and a positive attitude.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced startup environment.

  • Executive level relationship management.

  • Ability to understand the "bigger picture" and the business drivers around IT.

  • Experience implementing MEDDPICC.

  • Professionally proficient in Finnish

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

  • Industry specific experience.

  • Experience selling software or cloud based applications to the Enterprise is desired.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customers’ most complex problems, closing large deals, and positioning organizations to enable Analytics and AI adoption quickly and easily. In this role, you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, product fit conversations, and support enterprise Proof of Concepts.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer, you must share our passion for reinventing the data landscape. You should have a proven track record of helping customers modernize their data stack to unlock Analytics/AI/ML capabilities. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives about Data, Analytics & AI strategies and "talking shop" with technical audiences about implementation.

Location: Must be located in or near Bogota, Colombia

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors, specifically focusing on how Snowflake serves as the engine for rapid AI innovation.

  • Work hands-on with prospects to demonstrate the value of Snowflake throughout the sales cycle, moving them from initial interest to value driving insights and business outcomes

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of Analytics, Generative AI, LLMs, and competitive technologies, ensuring Snowflake is positioned as the easiest path to enterprise Analytics and AI.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to share field insights on customer data platform and activation requirements to continuously improve our platform.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • Proven success in positioning data solutions to enable rapid Analytics and AI adoption, showing customers a clear path from raw data to actionable analytics, AI Agents and machine learning models.

  • Real world experience in one or more of these technologies: Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Cloudera, BigQuery, Analytics Open Source projects: Spark, Trino, Cassandra, Hive, among others.

  • Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business value.

  • Broad range of experience within Large-scale Database/Data Warehouse technology, ETL, and modern AI/ML frameworks.

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics (Python or R experience for data science is a plus).

  • The ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems to Snowflake’s Analytics, AI and Data Cloud solutions.

  • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake is reimagining what a modern Postgres experience can be. The Snowflake Postgres team is building a fully managed, cloud-native Postgres service that delivers the reliability, performance, and scale developers expect that is paired with a data experience that seamlessly ties into Snowflake.

As an Engineer Manager, you'll help define the architecture, push the boundaries of Postgres in the cloud, and shape one of Snowflake's most strategic new products

AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Provide strong technical leadership across both the Postgres dataplane and the orchestration/control plane required to deliver a managed service (HA, upgrades, backups, scaling, automation, and operational safety).

  • Break problems down and build consensus across multiple parties to reach solutions that are scalable, tractable, and timely.

  • Function as both a problem solver and a problem finder by building the roadmap while delivering it.

  • Leverage your experience to balance long-term thinking with more immediate business needs.

  • Understand trade-offs between consistency, performance, scaling limits, and costs to build solutions which can meet the demands of rapidly growing services.

  • Ensure operational readiness of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding durability, availability, performance, and security.

  • Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem solving skills.

OUR IDEAL ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale systems (distributed systems, databases, or cloud services).

  • 3+ years of experience building, managing, and leading high-performing engineering teams (and experience leading managers is a strong plus).

  • Strong track record of delivering large-scale, resilient systems and services in production.

  • Significant experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and building services with high availability and operational rigor.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional alignment and influence across org boundaries.

  • Strong hands-on technical ability; comfortable navigating complex codebases and diving deep into system design and implementation.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience.

    Postgres depth: experience with Postgres as an end user, operator, or administrator; strong understanding of database fundamentals and tradeoffs (consistency, performance, scaling limits, cost).

    OR

    Love of Postgres. You have worked with Postgres as an end user or administrator. You have a solid understanding of database fundamentals.

WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

  • Build an industry-leading Cloud Data and AI Platform.

  • Solve challenging technical problems related to security, parallel and distributed systems, programming, resource management, large-scale system maintenance, and more!

  • Work closely with our customers & partners, understand their use cases & needs, think strategically to seek the right problem to solve at the right time, and innovate with rigor.

  • Join a world-class team of both industry veterans and rising stars.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

  • Land, adopt, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

  • Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

Location: Brazil

There is only one AI Data Cloud. Snowflake’s founders started from scratch and designed a data platform built for the cloud that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. But it didn’t stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the AI Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

Our LATAM Solutions Engineering organization is growing again and seeking a Manager of Solutions Engineering to lead a highly skilled team of Solutions Engineers based out of Brazil. In addition to leading a team you will work directly with our sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate sales cycles and technical wins, provide value-based demonstrations, support POCs, close business, and fuel our LATAM expansion.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Build and lead a team of sales engineers who serve as our core product introduction, evaluation and education experts

  • Partner with sales leadership to achieve regional quota targets, our goals and ensure relationships are built

  • Provide guidance to revenue leaders on sales strategy, product obstacles/gaps and represent the team’s needs to executive staff

  • Leverage your AI and data analytics skills to find patterns and opportunities to up-level the team, improve tech win rates and continue our expansion across LATAM

  • Interpret complex problems, create simple solutions and collaborate closely with prospects, channel partners and our sales team to deliver winning solutions

  • Collaborate and maintain a close working relationship with product, engineering, sales, marketing and services

  • Play an active role in sourcing and screening potential candidates and managing the interview process

  • Act as a player/coach working with your team on and delivering compelling presentations to customers and prospects

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in a pre-sales capacity with 3+ years of direct line management experience (hiring, training and retaining top talent)

  • Industry expertise within Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics and/or Cloud Computing, Machine Learning and AI Agents

  • Strong hands-on technical skills within Databases, Data Warehousing, ETL and Analytics/Data Science

  • Experience working with cloud-based offerings including exposure to at least one of the major 3 clouds

  • Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solutions

  • Proven entrepreneurial experience having developed and successfully launched new territories and teams or initiatives from scratch

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • In addition to managing a team you will work directly with our sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate sales cycles, provide value-based demonstrations, support POCs and close business

  • Build and lead a team of sales engineers who serve as our core product introduction, evaluation and education experts

  • Partner with sales leadership to achieve regional quota targets, our goals and ensure relationships are built

  • Provide guidance to revenue leaders on sales strategy, product obstacles/gaps and represent the team’s needs to executive staff

  • Leverage your AI and data analytics skills to find patterns and opportunities to up-level the team, improve tech win rates and continue our expansion across LATAM

  • Own the Technical Win forecast at the regional level

  • Interpret complex problems, create simple solutions and collaborate closely with prospects, channel partners and our sales team to deliver winning solutions

  • Collaborate and maintain a close working relationship with product, engineering, sales, marketing and services

  • Play an active role in sourcing and screening potential candidates and managing the interview process

  • Act as a player/coach working with your team on and delivering compelling presentations to customers and prospects

 

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solutions Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful.

Our team works to ensure data and AI is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Customer Experience Engineering Team builds the internal and external technologies that scale Snowflake’s global support and sales organizations. We empower our technical experts by providing the advanced tools they need to resolve complex issues and drive customer success.

Our team specializes in software engineering, data-driven decisions, ML, and LLM-based solutions. We build production-grade systems to automate manual processes and augment the capabilities of our technical staff. Our current focus includes:

  • LLMs: Developing and deploying LLM and agent-based architectures for streamlining troubleshooting

  • Scalable Evaluations: Implementing large-scale evaluations to ensure the quality and reliability of our internal and external tools

  • Process Automation: Designing intelligent workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and allow our experts to focus on the most technical aspects of the Snowflake platform

  • Incident discovery: using embeddings, LLMs, clustering, and agents to detect potential widespread issues more quickly

Now, the team is growing, and we are looking for a Software Engineer to join us. In this role, you will work closely with the state of the art LLM models, fine-tune them, develop agents, apply various clusterings, summarizations, embeddings, and so on. Even though we usually use high-level libraries (e.g., scikit or Snowflake’s Cortex) rather than perform matrix multiplications ourselves, some prior ML experience is definitely useful.

As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of ML and LLM-based solutions, propose new ideas, and keep improving the existing models.

You will:

  • Develop and refine ML models that are critical to Snowflake’s business

  • Design metrics and experiments to validate your insights

  • Help to implement projects that span our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Snowflake and Kubernetes

  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including product management and design

  • Deliver features requiring close coordination with several partner teams

  • Be a participant in defining the product vision and team planning

  • Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions

Our ideal Software Engineer will have:

  • B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, or equivalent discipline

  • 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience

  • 1+ years of working ML experience

  • Interest in the State of the Art LLM-based solutions

  • Great communication skills, both verbal and written and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers

  • Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


Location: Hybrid (3 days) in Dublin, CA preferred; Menlo Park, CA also considered

About the team

Enterprise Apps & Agentic Systems is applying that standard internally. We partner directly with business teams to redesign high-value domains from first principles and turn them into software-defined, AI-native products. We are customer zero for Snowflake technology: we build first-of-a-kind solutions for our own teams, prove their value in production, and bring the learnings to our customers.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead products that make our Finance, People, Legal, and other enterprise domains AI-Native.

This is not an application management role. You will own the product problem from discovery through value realization. You will identify where work should be eliminated, redesigned, automated, or delegated to software; define the product strategy; align the business and technology teams; and lead the delivery of products that people choose to use.

What you will do

  • Set product direction. Develop a clear product vision, strategy, roadmap, and narrative for a meaningful business problem. Define the outcomes that matter, the choices required to achieve them, and the principles that guide trade-offs.

  • Partner directly with the business. Work side by side with business leaders, operators, and end users from problem framing through launch and adoption. Build shared ownership of the problem and the solution rather than taking orders or handing off requirements.

  • Build world-class products. Apply strong product judgment, user-centered discovery, and first-principles thinking to create simple, intuitive products that solve important problems and earn sustained adoption.

  • Redesign workflows end to end. Start with the desired business outcome, not the existing application or process. Decide what should disappear, what should be redesigned, and where software or agents can handle work end to end.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Security Foundations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Anti-Abuse team within Security Foundations. This team is responsible for protecting Snowflake and our customers from abuse on the Snowflake platform — building foundational security primitives across a complex multi-cloud environment to combat fraud, account takeovers, data exfiltration, and AI security threats at the scale of Snowflake’s hyper-growth.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SECURITY FOUNDATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Design, build, and scale security-by-default capabilities that protect Snowflake products across a complex multi-cloud environment

  • Develop intelligent security platforms and services that leverage AI/ML and risk scoring to identify, prioritize, and respond to security threats and policy violations

  • Build real-time detection and prevention systems to defend against account compromise, AI abuse, and data exfiltration through adaptive enforcement and granular policy controls

  • Create security intelligence and monitoring capabilities that detect suspicious account & user activity, generate actionable insights, and enable timely response

  • Partner across Security, Engineering, and Product teams to define security strategy, influence product design, and drive adoption of secure engineering practices

  • Raise the engineering bar by setting standards for system design, code quality, operational excellence, and scalable security architecture within the Security Foundations organization

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SECURITY FOUNDATIONS WILL HAVE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software development with one or more of the following: JavaScript, Java, Python, C, C++, or Go

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or a similar language for building detections and data pipelines

  • Experience designing, testing, and maintaining software solutions with a security focus

  • A track record of leading projects independently and setting technical direction

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field

  • Experience working with infrastructure across major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Hands-on experience with security primitives including static analysis, dynamic analysis, authentication and access management, DDoS mitigation, or security scanning

  • Background in secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for cross-functional partnerships

WHY JOIN OUR ANTI-ABUSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

The Anti-Abuse team sits at the intersection of security engineering and platform scale — you’ll be building foundational capabilities that protect millions of customers across every cloud, rather than maintaining legacy point solutions. You’ll have real influence over the roadmap and the opportunity to work on some of the hardest adversarial engineering challenges in the industry: fraud, account takeover, data exfiltration, and emerging AI security threats.

Our culture is built on ownership and collaboration. Every engineer has an equal opportunity to innovate, drive impact, and grow. If you’re energized by working at the frontier of security and data — where “get it done” means building things that last — this is where you want to be.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake is at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

Snowflake is rapidly growing its Alliances & Channel Organization. Value Added Reseller (VAR) and Reseller partners are an integral part of Snowflake's business, helping customers unlock the power of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. We are looking for a self-driven go-getter to help grow VAR and Reseller partners into profitable revenue streams and accelerate the growth of the business across EMEA South.

We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of successfully working with current and potential partners in the EMEA VAR and Reseller community. The ideal candidate will have strong business acumen in growing a business, channel, or partnership, with a passion for working closely with sales teams throughout the sales cycle. Knowledge of the broader data & AI platform ecosystem, products, and competition is essential to influence and be the partner’s trusted advisor.

Success in this position requires the candidate to be adept at managing relationships, executing programs, setting goals and metrics, and tracking and ensuring progress. The candidate will also need to help shape and deliver on a cross-functional strategy, working closely with the Partner Sales Director to build mindshare among Snowflake VAR and Reseller Partners.

As a Partner Solutions Engineer - VAR/Reseller, you will:

  • Help Solution Providers/Practice Leads with the technical strategies that enable them to sell their offerings on Snowflake.

  • Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging.

  • Strong understanding of how VAR and Reseller partners make revenue through the Industry priorities & complexities they face and influence where Snowflake products can have the most impact for their product services.

  • Help develop and launch joint differentiated solution offerings with VAR, Reseller Partners, and System Integrators taking part in the Resell motion.

  • Engage in conversations with other technologists, providing presentations at the C-level.

  • Act as a key technical resource during the sales cycle, enabling partners to effectively position and sell Snowflake solutions.

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

OUR IDEAL PARTNER SOLUTIONS ENGINEER - VAR/Reseller EMEA WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of industry experience within Partnership/Alliances Technical Pre-sales in the EMEA VAR and Reseller ecosystem, with a focus on selling business solutions and outcomes.

  • Ability to handle business topics of varying complexity and priority in an efficient way.

  • Strong architectural expertise, with the ability to provide upskilling workshops to Partner Solution Architects on various areas of the Snowflake Data Platform, implying:

    • Experience in developing and deploying data pipelines with different data platforms. SQL and PySpark are basic requirements, with experience in technologies such as Spark, Scala, Kafka a plus, and Apache NiFi a major plus.

    • Proficiency with at least one public cloud platform (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud) and experience with widely used DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalents, as well as Cloud integration technologies such as Fivetran, Azure Data Factory or AWS Glue or equivalents..

    • Developing and deploying Machine Learning models through the full Data Science life cycle, is a plus.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales and product managers, in an international environment.

  • MS/PhD in Computer Science or related majors, or proven professional experience in the data and AI field in technical roles.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst II
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

We exist to improve Product leaders’ understanding and decision-making on how to profitably grow the business. Our North Star is to increase workload contribution margin dollars above the current forecast by serving as an objective, full-stack business partner. We do this by measuring key metrics, inferring actionable insights, catalyzing strategic decisions, and accelerating operational efficiency across Product, Engineering, and Sales.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This is a high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of product strategy and financial analysis, giving you a unique vantage point to influence how we scale our business. This is a finance role embedded within product organizations. You’ll be asked to think like an investor or financial analyst first and use technical tools to accelerate your work. We aren't looking for someone to just execute tasks and pull data; we need a partner who can navigate ambiguity, drive workstreams, and anticipate the next steps. This role is best for proactive problem-solvers with business intuition and a high level of curiosity. You will work on critical projects and collaborate with executives to turn complex data into decisive action.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Develop & Maintain Financial Models: Build and iterate on financial models that track both revenue and cost drivers, enabling accurate forecasting and real-time visibility into workload contribution margins.

  • Drive Revenue & Margin Insights: Analyze historical and forward-looking trends for revenue, COGS, and margin to provide actionable recommendations that influence pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies.

  • Partner with PMs and Sales: Collaborate with Engineering, Product Managers and Sales to evaluate new product features or market opportunities. Support business case development by providing data-driven insights into revenue potential and profitability. Communicate complex technical or financial concepts in a succinct, easy-to-understand manner to stakeholders at all levels.

  • Data-driven Insights (SQL): Find the "why" behind the numbers. You will go beyond the surface by mastering our complex data structures and business drivers. By learning to navigate our schemas and tables, you’ll be able to ensure that you deliver timely and accurate insights.

  • Accelerate Insights with AI: Leverage Snowflake Intelligence and AISQL daily to automate manual reporting and speed up your insight discovery process. You will use our native AI features to streamline complex workflows, allowing you to focus less on manual data prep and more on driving strategic insights.

  • Build Scalable Reporting & Tooling: Translate your data findings into automated, high-visibility dashboards that Product and Finance leaders rely on for decision making. The dashboards you build will be maintained by Snowflake’s business intelligence team.

  • Optimize Cloud Spend & Infrastructure: While revenue is your focus, you’ll also identify and resolve abnormalities in infrastructure spend to maintain healthy margins. Provide recommendations to reduce COGS/OpEx and improve cost efficiency.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Strong Financial & Analytical Skills: Proven ability to build financial models, analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and juggle competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Bachelor’s Degree: In Finance, Economics, Data Science or a related field.

  • 2–5 Years of Experience: Background in Finance, Investment Banking, or Consulting. Experience in SaaS, Cloud, Data, or Fintech environments—especially partnering with Product, Engineering, and Sales as a finance analyst—is strongly preferred.

  • Data Driven Insights (SQL Preferred): You have a high aptitude for navigating technical systems and data structures. While you don’t need to be a SQL expert on day one, you possess the ability to quickly become proficient in understanding complex schemas and data logic. Prior experience with financial modeling tools and BI platforms is a plus.

  • Revenue & Margin Analysis Experience: Experience analyzing revenue, COGS, and margin trends. Familiarity with Salesforce or other GTM systems to reason about historical and forward-looking trends is highly beneficial.

  • Ownership & Problem-Solving Mindset: Adept at working through ambiguity and taking initiative. Anticipate next steps, coordinate with stakeholders, and push projects forward.

  • Exceptional Communication: Able to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-technical audiences. Comfortable presenting to VP/C-level leadership.

  • Continuous Improvement Mentality: You’re always looking for ways to optimize. The first version of your work is never your last—you believe there’s always a better way.

 

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


ABOUT THE TEAM:

We exist to improve Product leaders’ understanding and decision-making on how to profitably grow the business. Our North Star is to increase workload contribution margin dollars above the current forecast by serving as an objective, full-stack business partner. We do this by measuring key metrics, inferring actionable insights, catalyzing strategic decisions, and accelerating operational efficiency across Product, Engineering, and Sales.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

This is a high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of product strategy and financial analysis, giving you a unique vantage point to influence how we scale our business. This is a finance role embedded within product organizations. You’ll be asked to think like an investor or financial analyst first and use technical tools to accelerate your work. We aren't looking for someone to just execute tasks and pull data; we need a partner who can navigate ambiguity, drive workstreams, and anticipate the next steps. This role is best for proactive problem-solvers with business intuition and a high level of curiosity. You will work on critical projects and collaborate with executives to turn complex data into decisive action.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 - Develop & Maintain Financial Models: Build and iterate on financial models that track both revenue and cost drivers, enabling accurate forecasting and real-time visibility into workload contribution margins.

 - Drive Revenue & Margin Insights: Analyze historical and forward-looking trends for revenue, COGS, and margin to provide actionable recommendations that influence pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies.

 - Partner with PMs and Sales: Collaborate with Engineering, Product Managers and Sales to evaluate new product features or market opportunities. Support business case development by providing data-driven insights into revenue potential and profitability. Communicate complex technical or financial concepts in a succinct, easy-to-understand manner to stakeholders at all levels.

 - Data-driven Insights (SQL): Find the "why" behind the numbers. You will go beyond the surface by mastering our complex data structures and business drivers. By learning to navigate our schemas and tables, you’ll be able to ensure that you deliver timely and accurate insights.

 - Accelerate Insights with AI: Leverage Snowflake Intelligence and AISQL daily to automate manual reporting and speed up your insight discovery process. You will use our native AI features to streamline complex workflows, allowing you to focus less on manual data prep and more on driving strategic insights.

 - Build Scalable Reporting & Tooling: Translate your data findings into automated, high-visibility dashboards that Product and Finance leaders rely on for decision making. The dashboards you build will be maintained by Snowflake’s business intelligence team.

 - Optimize Cloud Spend & Infrastructure: While revenue is your focus, you’ll also identify and resolve abnormalities in infrastructure spend to maintain healthy margins. Provide recommendations to reduce COGS/OpEx and improve cost efficiency.

 


WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

 - Strong Financial & Analytical Skills: Proven ability to build financial models, analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and juggle competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Bachelor’s Degree: In Finance, Economics, Data Science or a related field.

 - 2–5 Years of Experience: Background in Finance, Investment Banking, or Consulting. Experience in SaaS, Cloud, Data, or Fintech environments—especially partnering with Product, Engineering, and Sales as a finance analyst—is strongly preferred.

 - Data Driven Insights (SQL Preferred): You have a high aptitude for navigating technical systems and data structures. While you don’t need to be a SQL expert on day one, you possess the ability to quickly become proficient in understanding complex schemas and data logic. Prior experience with financial modeling tools and BI platforms is a plus.

 - Revenue & Margin Analysis Experience: Experience analyzing revenue, COGS, and margin trends. Familiarity with Salesforce or other GTM systems to reason about historical and forward-looking trends is highly beneficial.

 - Exceptional Communication: Able to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-technical audiences. Comfortable presenting to VP/C-level leadership.

 - Continuous Improvement Mentality: You’re always looking for ways to optimize. The first version of your work is never your last—you believe there’s always a better way.

This is a highly cross-functional role, working closely with Account teams, Field Marketing, Technical Sales, Industry specialists, and Global PMMs to align strategy with execution. The successful candidate will thrive on program orchestration, enablement at scale, and surfacing regional insights to shape global direction.

What You’ll Do

  • Co-own and align marketing strategy for the Finance team personas, ensuring plans reflect customer insights and empower the field to execute with impact.

  • Develop and execute “big bets” by identifying opportunities for net-new integrated campaigns and targeted sales plays that accelerate adoption.

  • Enable the field at scale by running programs, sales plays, and delivering relevant messaging that drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Lead cross-functional working groups to ensure disciplined marketing program execution and alignment across teams.

  • Champion outcome-driven selling by equipping sales teams with messaging and programs that tie Snowflake’s value to measurable customer impact.

  • Translate Snowflake’s platform value into business value statements that resonate with decision makers across every industry vertical.

  • Support industry coverage and Data for Good initiatives by ensuring campaigns and narratives land with business and societal impact.

  • Proven success enabling large sales organizations through impactful programs, sales plays, and messaging that drive measurable outcomes.

  • Strong collaboration and influence skills, with the ability to align global strategy to regional execution.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. Snowflake is looking for Corporate Counsel or Senior Corporate Counsel (depending on level of experience) to join our Corporate Legal team. This role offers the opportunity to be at the heart of Snowflake's public company legal function, supporting ‘34 Act reporting, corporate governance, securities law compliance and equity compensation matters. This is an in-person role based in Menlo Park, CA or Dublin, CA, reporting to our Director, Assistant General Counsel - Corporate and Securities.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with the preparation and review of periodic reports, current reports and proxy statements, including the maintenance of disclosure controls and procedures.

  • Support all aspects of corporate governance, including maintaining the governance calendar, preparing materials for the board and committee meetings, and driving the annual shareholder meeting process.

  • Support insider trading law compliance, Section 16 reporting and 10b5-1 plan administration.

  • Assist with equity plan administration and compliance with equity award plans (US and international).

  • Maintain and ensure compliance with corporate policies, including the Related Party Transactions Policy, Insider Trading Policy, and 10b5-1 trading plan program.

  • Assist generally with public company securities laws compliance, including the 1933 Act, 1934 Act, 1940 Act and Hart Scott Rodino Act.

  • Support cross-functional initiatives relating to investor relations, governance, financing, compliance and international expansion.

About You

  • 4+ years of public company legal experience, ideally at a law firm and in-house.

  • Experience with public company reporting including the preparation of periodic reports, proxy statements, Section 16 reports and registration statements.

  • Experience maintaining a governance calendar for a public company board and its committees.

  • Ability to understand and clearly explain complicated and nuanced issues.

  • Highly responsive, with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Eager to jump in, take ownership and deliver excellent legal support in an extremely fast-paced environment.

  • J.D. from an accredited law school; active membership in good standing in California.

jobs.title: Intermediate/ Senior Software Engineer - Cortex LLM Training Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Senior Software Engineer — Cortex Training

The Snowflake ML Platform team's mission is to let customers run their most demanding ML/AI workloads inside Snowflake. Cortex Training is our LLM post-training platform: it turns scarce, expensive GPU capacity into a simple, composable service, so customers can adapt open-weight foundation models to their own business problems while we handle the hard distributed-systems parts, including scheduling, orchestration, multi-node training and inference, fault tolerance, and throughput.

The platform already runs post-training at scale. Under the hood, it decouples GPU computation from the training loop and exposes it as primitive APIs that compose into everything from SFT to full RL workflows. You'll work alongside a team that ships fast & sweats reliability and the researchers behind DeepSpeed. We're looking for an engineer who thrives in the ML infrastructure layer and brings a solid understanding of LLMs and post-training to help us scale and grow it.

 

YOU WILL:

  • Design and build across the full stack — from the public training APIs and SDK through the control plane to the GPU data plane.

  • Scale the distributed systems that make GPU compute serverless — multi-tenant scheduling, placement, and capacity-aware routing across regional GPU pools, with fault tolerance built in.

  • Drive end-to-end performance at scale — keep the training, inference, and RL loops fast and the data plane responsive under heavy concurrent load, with GPUs kept saturated.

  • Productionize research building blocks — partner with Snowflake Research to turn state-of-the-art training and inference techniques into reliable, composable components customers can run at enterprise scale.

     

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3 + years (Intermediate) | 6+ years (Senior) building and shipping production ML systems

  • Strong distributed systems and infrastructure foundation — designing scalable, fault-tolerant services and operating them on Kubernetes in production.

  • Familiarity with GPU and LLM infrastructure — e.g., PyTorch, DeepSpeed/FSDP, Ray, CUDA/NCCL, vLLM; able to debug across the data, infrastructure, and GPU layers.

  • Demonstrated ability to harden complex systems for reliability, throughput, and cost efficiency.

  • BS in Computer Science or a related field (MS/PhD a plus).

  • (Bonus) Hands-on LLM post-training / modeling experience — the strongest candidates pair deep infra skills with real post-training intuition.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Analyst, Snowgov Compliance for our SnowTrust GRC team. You will champion key public sector compliance initiatives, safeguard Snowflake's US public sector certifications, and align IT, Legal, Product, Security, and Engineering around the work that powers Snowflake's growth in government markets.

AS A SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, SNOWGOV COMPLIANCE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own and maintain core FedRAMP authorization artifacts, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Contingency Plan (ISCP), and Incident Response Plan (IRP), keeping them accurate and updated annually.

  • Manage the lifecycle of Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&M), tracking findings, risks, and remediation commitments through closure with clear ownership and realistic deadlines.

  • Coordinate annual 3PAO assessments and continuous monitoring, acting as the primary liaison between Snowflake, assessors, and federal agency stakeholders.

  • Advise Engineering and Operations teams so cloud configurations (FIPS 140-3 validation, boundary protection, access control, logging and monitoring) meet federal and DoD mandates.

  • Perform gap analyses for new or evolving public sector requirements, such as emerging CMMC or GovRAMP mandates and FedRAMP Consolidated Rules, and define technical remediation roadmaps.

  • Respond to customer and regulator inquiries about Snowflake's public sector security and compliance obligations, and build self-service resources so customers and field teams can increasingly answer these questions themselves.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, SNOWGOV COMPLIANCE WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, GRC, or a related governance function within a regulated or public sector environment preferred.

  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 controls and the FedRAMP authorization process.

  • Experience contributing to SSPs, POA&Ms, contingency plans (ISCP), and incident response plans (IRP).

  • Experience writing and maintaining audit-ready governance artifacts, including policies, standards, procedures, and control narratives.

  • Experience coordinating with 3PAOs, auditors, or assessors during annual assessments or continuous monitoring cycles.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, and Security to drive control implementation and remediation without direct authority.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent audit and assessment timelines and track findings through closure.

  • Experience using AI to automate or streamline manual compliance workflows.

  • US Personhood required (due to nature of covered federal data and government authorization work)

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, or other information security certifications

  • Experience with DoD Impact Level authorizations and CMMC certification

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Frontier Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake Frontier Engineeringは、Snowflakeプラットフォームの実装・戦略組織です。私たちはお客様のジャーニー全体を通じて、最適化・加速・ビジネス成果の実現を支援します。

私たちは、Snowflake Frontier Engineeringとお客様の間の重要な技術的橋渡し役を担うソリューションアーキテクトを求めています。このロールは、深いプラットフォーム専門知識とコンサルティング型セールスの能力を組み合わせ、プリセールスサイクルにおけるハンズオン技術リーダーシップを提供しながら、戦略的エンゲージメントにおける直接的な顧客デリバリーへの副次的な責任も担います。

理想的な候補者は、複雑な顧客のビジネス課題を、実現可能で説得力のあるSnowflakeソリューションに変換し、技術者および経営層の両方に自信を持ってそのビジョンを伝えることができます。

ソリューションアーキテクトとしてのあなたの役割

  • Frontier Engineering プラクティスマネージャーおよびプラクティスディレクターをサービスセールスサイクル全体にわたって支援する主要技術リソースとして機能します。

  • Snowflakeの顧客要件への対応能力を検証し、商談のクローズを加速させるための技術ディスカバリーセッション、ソリューションデザインワークショップ、アーキテクチャレビュー、概念実証（PoC）を主導します。

  • Snowflakeプラットフォームの機能に基づいた、デリバリー可能なソリューションの全体アーキテクチャを設計します。

  • 作業範囲定義書（SOW）に直接反映されるソリューションアーキテクチャ、工数見積もり、リソース計画、リスク評価などの技術スコーピング成果物を作成します。

  • ディレクター、VP、CTO、CDOを含む顧客技術ステークホルダーとのトラステッドアドバイザー関係を構築します。

  • 競争ポジショニング、技術的異論への対処、価値の明確化、拡張機会の特定を通じて、サービス案件の品質と受注率を向上させる技術的ソートリーダーシップを提供します。

  • 主にソリューションアーキテクトが発案したエンゲージメント、短期のアーキテクチャ検証スプリント、または戦略的アカウントにおける経営層レベルのチェックポイントセッションへ選択的に参加します。

  • 再利用可能なソリューションパターン、リファレンスアーキテクチャ、セールス資料、イネーブルメントコンテンツの作成に貢献します。

  • プラクティスマネージャーへの技術的ポジショニング指導、テクニカルアーキテクトへの顧客向けコミュニケーションスキル指導を行います。

  • 顧客要件、競争ギャップ、新興市場ニーズについてプロダクトマネジメントおよびエンジニアリングに構造化されたフィードバックを提供します。

  • このロールは、フルタイムの実装ロールではありません。デリバリーへの関与は時間制限があり意図的であり、プラットフォームへの精通を維持しながらセールスサイクル中に構築した顧客関係を強化することを目的としています。

理想的なソリューションアーキテクトが備える能力・経験

  • プリセールスおよび/またはポストセールスコンサルティング、ソリューションアーキテクチャ、または技術アドバイザリーにわたる顧客向け技術ロールでの5年以上の経験。

  • 案件追求を支援しながら技術プロジェクト業務を遂行する、セールスとデリバリーの交差点での業務経験。

  • 技術者および経営層に向けたエンタープライズ規模のデータプラットフォームソリューションの設計・提案の実績。

  • 日本のビジネスセールスサイクル（要件収集、RFP前のセールス活動、正式なRFPプロセスと対応）における実証された経験。

  • データアナリティクス、データエンジニアリング、またはAI/MLソリューション開発の文脈でのSQLおよびPythonの実践的な習熟度。

  • AWS、Azure、またはGCPのいずれか主要なパブリッククラウドプラットフォームへの深い理解。

  • 工数見積もり、ソリューションアーキテクチャ文書化、SOW作成を含むFrontier Engineeringスコーピングの経験。

  • データモデリング、ETL/ELTパターン、データガバナンス、モダンデータアーキテクチャパターンへの深い理解。

  • ホワイトボードでのチョークトーク、フォーマルなピッチ、ライブデモンストレーションなど、様々な場面での優れたプレゼンテーションスキル。

  • 顧客、パートナー、およびすべてのレベルの社内ステークホルダーとの信頼関係を築く卓越した対人スキル。

  • Systems Integratorとの協働を含むパートナーエコシステムの経験。

  • コンピューターサイエンス、エンジニアリング、データサイエンス、数学、または関連分野の大学学位、または同等の職業経験。

  • 日本語ネイティブレベルおよびビジネスレベルの英語能力。(Native Japanese and Business level English)

  • 必要に応じて顧客先へのオンサイト訪問のための出張に対応できる柔軟性。

以下に当てはまる方は特に歓迎します

  • コンサルティングまたは実装の立場でのSnowflakeまたは同等のクラウドデータプラットフォームの経験。

  • Snowflake SnowPro CoreおよびAdvanced認定資格。

  • クラウドサービスベンダーでのFrontier Engineering組織での経験。

  • 金融サービス、ヘルスケア、小売、メディア、製造などの主要業界における業界専門知識。

  • モデル開発、デプロイメント、MLOpsプラクティスを含むAI/MLライフサイクルの概念への精通。

  • Teradata、Hadoop、Netezzaなどのレガシープラットフォームのモダナイゼーションを含むデータマイグレーション方法論の経験。

  • AWS、Google、またはMicrosoftのクラウド認定資格。

Japan Benefit

  • Free lunch at office

  • DC（企業型確定拠出年金）

  • RSU, ESPP

  • 携帯電話通信費・ジム費用補助

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst, Governance Programs
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Analyst, Governance Programs for our SnowTrust GRC team. In this highly visible role, you will define and scale governance programs, strengthen our existing compliance architecture, and partner with leaders across IT, Legal, Product, Security, and Engineering to raise our security posture and build customer trust worldwide.

AS A SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, GOVERNANCE PROGRAMS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build a deep understanding of regulated-industry compliance requirements and how they apply to Snowflake.

  • Establish and run programs that manage Snowflake's compliance posture against those requirements, including readiness, how we communicate that posture externally, and leading customer and regulator audits.

  • Become an expert on Snowflake's control environment, security features, and best practices for customer deployments.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on Snowflake's security and compliance obligations and documentation, responding to customer and regulator inquiries.

  • Build self-service resources so customers and field teams can increasingly answer compliance questions on their own.

  • Join sales conversations to explain Snowflake's security and compliance capabilities.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, GOVERNANCE PROGRAMS WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, GRC, or a related governance function preferred.

  • Proven program management experience, including leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority over contributors.

  • Experience writing and maintaining governance artifacts, including policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, and Security to drive control implementation and remediation.

  • Solid knowledge of at least one recognized governance or risk framework, such as ISO 27001, SOC 1/SOC 2, or NIST CSF.

  • Ability to translate governance requirements into practical controls and processes that operational teams actually adopt, going beyond policy authorship.

  • Experience using AI to automate or streamline manual compliance workflows.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • CISSP, CRISC, CISA, or other information security certifications

  • Experience with NIST 800-53 or HIPAA

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Analyst, Customer Trust for our SnowTrust GRC team. You will own the full lifecycle of multiple customer-facing and third-party assessments, from defining scope and owning the project plan to driving deliverables across projects with moderate to high business or technical complexity. You will work daily with IT, Business, Procurement, Security, and Compliance teams, and regularly with leadership, to deliver the vendor and customer projects in your portfolio.

AS A SENIOR COMPLIANCE ANALYST, CUSTOMER TRUST AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Customer Trust

  • Respond to customer due diligence questionnaires and audits about Snowflake's security and compliance obligations.

  • Become an expert on Snowflake's control environment, security features, and best practices for customer deployments.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on customer and regulator inquiries about Snowflake's security and compliance obligations and documentation.

  • Join sales conversations to explain Snowflake's security and compliance capabilities.

Third-Party Oversight, Governance, and Risk Management

  • Conduct security risk assessments of new and existing vendors, evaluating their security posture against contractual, regulatory, and industry requirements.

  • Partner with Legal and Procurement to make sure security requirements are reflected in vendor contracts and security agreements.

  • Continuously improve the TPRM program by refining tiering criteria, streamlining intake, and shortening assessment turnaround times.

  • Monitor the vendor risk landscape for emerging threats and proactively reassess affected vendors.

  • Support customer and regulator inquiries about Snowflake's own third-party risk management practices as part of broader audit engagements.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontier Security Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Frontier Security AI team. Snowflake's Frontier Security AI teams develop production-grade LLM applications, intelligent agents, AI infrastructure, and evaluation systems for enterprise customers — products that must meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and efficiency while operating over sensitive data at large scale. In this role, you will lead the design and development of our Agentic Harness and agent evaluation platform, working across product, infrastructure, applied AI, security, and modeling teams to take new capabilities from prototype to dependable customer value.

 

AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Architect and build the Agentic Harness that executes complex, multi-step AI workflows across models, tools, data, and services.

  • Design stable interfaces for tool execution, context construction, state management, memory, permissions, retries, fallbacks, and human review.

  • Own agent quality end to end by building evaluation harnesses, representative datasets, automated graders, experiment pipelines, and release gates.

  • Convert ambiguous reports such as "the agent feels worse" into measurable failure modes, reproducible tests, and durable fixes.

  • Analyze production agent trajectories to identify failures in reasoning, retrieval, tool use, context, orchestration, and application code.

  • Close the loop between production incidents, root-cause analysis, evaluation coverage, and regression prevention.

  • Develop offline and online measurements for task completion, correctness, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost.

  • Build simulation and replay infrastructure for golden-set tests, adversarial scenarios, model comparisons, and large-scale experiments.

  • Improve agent efficiency through model routing, prompt and semantic caching, context compaction, tool-result management, and token optimization.

  • Productionize new model capabilities as secure, observable, multi-tenant services with clear operational controls.

  • Establish standards for evaluation design, including sampling, ground-truth quality, grader calibration, leakage prevention, and statistical significance.

  • Define technical direction across multiple teams and lead projects whose scope extends beyond a single service.

  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of architecture reviews, and remain directly involved in implementation and debugging.

 

OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 9+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex production systems.

  • Direct experience shipping and operating LLM applications, AI agents, or model-backed workflows in production.

  • Strong background in distributed systems, service architecture, high-throughput APIs, concurrency, and failure handling.

  • Experience building an agent runtime, workflow engine, developer platform, evaluation system, or similar infrastructure.

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate nondeterministic systems without relying on a single aggregate score.

  • Fluency in Python and strong proficiency in at least one systems or application language such as Java, Go, Rust, or TypeScript.

  • Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, structured generation, retrieval, context engineering, prompt management, and model APIs.

  • Experience with production observability, including structured traces, replay, metrics, logs, and incident diagnosis.

  • Ability to balance agent quality with latency, reliability, security, and inference cost.

  • Track record of setting technical direction and delivering results across organizational boundaries.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, product, and leadership audiences.

 

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Building evaluation or observability infrastructure for agentic coding, data engineering, or analytics systems.

  • Designing human-evaluation programs, scoring rubrics, annotation workflows, or grader-calibration methods.

  • Working with multi-agent orchestration, long-running agents, asynchronous workflows, or durable execution.

  • Developing synthetic tasks, simulations, adversarial tests, red-team exercises, or safety guardrails.

  • Building retrieval systems that use vector search, hybrid search, semantic indexing, ranking, or caching.

  • Operating multi-tenant systems that process sensitive enterprise data.

  • Working with model training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or feedback-driven optimization.

  • Evaluating and onboarding frontier models based on measured product outcomes.

  • Experience with databases, SQL engines, data platforms, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure.

 

YOU MAY BE A PARTICULARLY GOOD FIT IF YOU:

  • Treat evaluation as part of product engineering rather than a final validation step.

  • Can move between agent behavior, distributed infrastructure, data analysis, and production debugging.

  • Question metrics that do not reconcile and design tests that can expose misleading results.

  • Take ownership from early architecture through deployment, operations, and measurable customer outcomes.

  • Prefer evidence from representative tasks and production behavior over isolated benchmark results.

  • Work effectively in fast-moving environments where requirements develop through experimentation.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Engineering Manager, Cloud Efficiency

Snowflake runs large scale cloud infrastructure to deliver its own service — production and internal deployments, Kubernetes fleets, CI/CD, etc. Our cloud spend is in billions of dollars per year. We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the Cloud Efficiency engineering team. In this role, you will own the technical vision and execution for building a unified, self-serve cloud efficiency platform along with AI skills and agents that makes resource usage and spend attributable and governable while driving insights and optimization of our cloud spend.


AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER IN CLOUD EFFICIENCY, YOU WILL:

  • Lead and grow our talented team of software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.

  • Drive the roadmap for Cloud Efficiency — translating company-level spend objectives into engineering systems: authoritative cost data, resource ownership registry, attribution pipelines, cost and unit economics modeling, observability, governance policies, and optimization workflows — in partnership with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Data Science.

  • Set technical strategy for backend systems, data pipelines, and APIs that measure, attribute and surface cost and usage insights at massive scale.

  • Own delivery end-to-end: from planning and scoping to design reviews, execution, launch, and iterations based on customer feedback.

  • Partner cross-functionally with other engineering and cross functional teams to ensure smooth integrations and end customer success.

  • Represent your team in broader technical discussions, contributing to Snowflake engineering-wide initiatives and best practices.

We are looking for candidates with:

  • 9+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years in an engineering management role leading teams in designing and building large scale systems in production.

  • Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, data engineering, or cloud-native backend development.

  • Demonstrated ability to define and execute multi-quarter technical roadmaps while balancing short-term delivery and long-term platform health.

  • Experience building cost management, budgeting, billing or FinOps tooling in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with anomaly detection, time-series analysis, or ML-driven cost optimization products.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to distill complex technical problems for executive audiences and motivate engineers around a shared vision.

  • Track record of hiring, growing, and retaining strong engineering talent.

  • Strong hands-on skills. Can drill deep into complex system designs and implementation.

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
