jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer — Engineering Systems, Continuous Integration
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About Snowflake

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the infrastructure, tools, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake’s engineering organization. As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will help define the technical direction of critical CI infrastructure used by thousands of engineers across a rapidly growing, multi-cloud codebase.

As a Staff Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of large-scale Continuous Integration services and infrastructure.

  • Design, build, and operate distributed systems that support reliable, performant, and secure software delivery.

  • Lead the development of CI capabilities that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and release velocity.

  • Partner with engineering leadership, product managers, and teams across Snowflake to define quarterly and long-term technical roadmaps.

  • Drive architectural decisions across build systems, test orchestration, resource scheduling, workflow execution, and developer tooling.

  • Identify systemic bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and develop solutions that improve engineering efficiency at scale.

  • Establish high standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Lead complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices to keep Snowflake’s developer platform scalable and effective.

Our Ideal Staff Software Engineer Will Have

  • 7+ years of industry experience designing and building production software systems.

  • A track record of technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.

  • Deep experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

  • Experience building or significantly evolving enterprise-grade Continuous Integration or Continuous Delivery systems.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

  • Experience making architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.

  • A strong understanding of developer productivity and the software development lifecycle.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

  • A collaborative mindset and a demonstrated ability to mentor and influence engineers across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD and build systems such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bazel, ArgoCD, or comparable platforms.

  • Experience with build optimization, caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, or distributed test scheduling.

  • Experience designing multi-tenant systems with strong isolation, reliability, performance, and security requirements.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience operating large-scale developer platforms or engineering infrastructure.

  • Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and production operations.

  • Experience authoring technical roadmaps, architecture documents, project plans, postmortems, and root-cause analyses.

  • Experience working with data systems, distributed storage, or cloud-based services.

  • A history of improving engineering practices and multiplying the effectiveness of teams.

Why Engineering Systems at Snowflake?

  • Build infrastructure that thousands of Snowflake engineers rely on every day.

  • Solve challenging distributed systems and developer productivity problems at significant scale.

  • Help improve the speed, reliability, and quality of software delivery across Snowflake.

  • Work with experienced engineers across a multi-cloud data platform.

  • Influence the technical direction of critical engineering infrastructure.

  • Grow your impact through architecture, mentorship, and cross-team technical leadership.

Compensation

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

For the US-Market 1 location band, the compensation range for this role is:

  • Base salary: $236,000–$354,000 USD

  • Target bonus: 15%

  • Total target compensation: $271,400–$407,100 USD

  • Equity: Eligible for an RSU grant in addition to base salary and bonus

Snowflake also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP, paid time off, parental leave, disability coverage, and company-paid life insurance.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s responsibility to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

 - Establish high standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.

 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving.

 - Lead complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional dependencies.

 - Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.

 - Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices to keep Snowflake’s developer platform scalable and effective.


OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE

 - 7+ years of industry experience designing and building production software systems.

 - A track record of technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.

 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

 - Experience building or significantly evolving enterprise-grade Continuous Integration or Continuous Delivery systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

 - Experience making architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.

 - A strong understanding of developer productivity and the software development lifecycle.

 - Excellent problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

 - A collaborative mindset and a demonstrated ability to mentor and influence engineers across teams.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with CI/CD and build systems such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bazel, ArgoCD, or comparable platforms.

 - Experience with build optimization, caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, or distributed test scheduling.

 - Experience designing multi-tenant systems with strong isolation, reliability, performance, and security requirements.

 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Experience operating large-scale developer platforms or engineering infrastructure.

 - Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and production operations.

 - Experience authoring technical roadmaps, architecture documents, project plans, postmortems, and root-cause analyses.

 - Experience working with data systems, distributed storage, or cloud-based services.

 - A history of improving engineering practices and multiplying the effectiveness of teams.


WHY ENGINEERING SYSTEMS AT SNOWFLAKE?

 - Build infrastructure that thousands of Snowflake engineers rely on every day.

 - Solve challenging distributed systems and developer productivity problems at significant scale.

 - Help improve the speed, reliability, and quality of software delivery across Snowflake.

 - Work with experienced engineers across a multi-cloud data platform.

 - Influence the technical direction of critical engineering infrastructure.

 - Grow your impact through architecture, mentorship, and cross-team technical leadership.


COMPENSATION

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

For the US-Market 1 location band, the compensation range for this role is:

 - Base salary: $236,000–$354,000 USD

 - Target bonus: 15%

 - Total target compensation: $271,400–$407,100 USD

 - Equity: Eligible for an RSU grant in addition to base salary and bonus

Snowflake also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP, paid time off, parental leave, disability coverage, and company-paid life insurance.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s responsibility to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Role Overview

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. We are looking for AI-native builders and operators who use AI as a core part of how they think, learn, and execute.

The Startup Business Development Lead will be a key member of the Snowflake for Startups team, responsible for identifying, engaging, and growing relationships with the most strategic AI-native startups. This person will work across Sales, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, Ventures, and Solutions Engineering to help high-potential startups build with Snowflake and accelerate adoption of Snowflake AI.

This role requires a rare combination of startup ecosystem credibility, business development judgment, and practical understanding of modern AI application architectures. The ideal candidate can engage founders on both business value and technical direction, and can translate Snowflake’s AI platform into compelling growth opportunities for startup partners.

This is an individual contributor role and will be accountable for building a high-quality pipeline of AI-native startup opportunities, increasing activation and adoption of Snowflake AI products, and driving long-term consumption growth from strategic startup partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and grow relationships with high-priority AI-native startups, founders, venture investors, and ecosystem partners .

  • Develop and execute a startup GTM strategy to accelerate adoption of Snowflake with a heavy emphasis on Snowflakes AI products.

  • Serve as a trusted voice on AI-native startup trends, including model usage, data infrastructure, agentic workflows, and enterprise adoption patterns.

  • Help founders understand how to build and scale AI applications with Snowflake, including Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Document AI, Snowpark ML, and related platform capabilities.

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, and Snowflake Ventures to drive coordinated startup acquisition and expansion motions.

  • Create repeatable programs, founder engagements, and ecosystem initiatives that increase startup pipeline, product adoption, and workload growth.

  • Prioritize the startup landscape based on strategic fit, technical relevance, market momentum, and potential for long-term Snowflake consumption.

  • Track business outcomes, surface market insights, and provide regular recommendations to improve strategy, coverage, and execution.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, startup programs, venture, GTM, cloud, AI/ML, or related fields.

  • Experience working with high-growth startups, including founder engagement and cross-functional partnership execution.

  • Strong understanding of the modern AI stack, including LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, model serving, and data infrastructure.

  • Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into clear business value for founders, builders, and executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop partnership strategies, scale programs, and drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Strong executive communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

  • High comfort operating in ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution, and prioritizing in a fast-changing market.

  • Data-driven operating style with experience using metrics to evaluate opportunities, influence decisions, and improve execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the AI-native startup ecosystem as a founder, operator, investor, or partner leader.

  • Strong familiarity with enterprise AI application patterns such as RAG, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, governance, and model optimization.

  • Working knowledge of the Snowflake AI stack, especially Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Document AI, Snowpark ML, and AI Data Cloud adoption patterns.

  • Experience helping technical startups refine enterprise positioning, GTM motions, and customer adoption strategy.

Reports to

Head of Snowflake Startups,

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months

  • Built trusted relationships with a high-priority set of AI-native startups, key VC firms, and ecosystem partners. .

  • Increased startup adoption of Snowflake AI and expanded the pipeline of AI-native workloads built on Snowflake.

  • Established repeatable founder engagement and ecosystem programs that generate measurable startup pipeline and consumption growth.

  • Improved internal alignment across Sales, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, Ventures, and Solutions Engineering around the startup strategy.

  • Brought clear market intelligence and actionable recommendations on where Snowflake should invest to win with AI-native startups.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Why Join Us? What We Offer

We cultivate an inclusive, welcoming, and empowering environment where every intern is set up for success from day one:

  • Dedicated Mentorship & Support: High level of access to your manager and a personal mentor who provide guidance, constructive feedback, and continuous support without micromanagement.

  • Real Impact & Ownership: Work alongside world-class experts on meaningful, real-world projects that contribute directly to systems used by global customers.

  • Inclusive Culture & Flexibility: Work in a vibrant team with flexible working hours, work-from-home options, casual dress code, and an inclusive, community-focused startup culture.

  • Career Growth: Clear pathways for post-internship career opportunities, including full-time roles and additional internship options.

  • Perks & Community: Paid full-time internship, catered lunches, team outings, happy hours, access to gaming consoles, recreational games, employee resource groups, and great swag.

What You Will Learn & Gain

  • How to build enterprise-grade, reliable, and secure cloud software and services.

  • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge database internals, large-scale distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Practical knowledge in compiler design, query execution, streaming pipelines, and advanced SQL features.

  • Colleague mentorship and collaborative problem-solving experience in a modern tech stack (C++, Java).


What We Are Looking For

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university program during the time of the internship (from 3rd year Bachelor up to Master’s or PhD levels) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Physics, Math, or a related technical field.

  • Duration: 4 month minimum, 6 months recommended, up to 12 months supported, start date flexible

  • Target start dates: February 2027 and onward

  • Foundational knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and operating systems.

  • Programming experience in C++ or Java, and familiarity with systems programming concepts (e.g., multi-threading, concurrency).

  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and solve problems creatively.

  • Fluent written and spoken English skills.

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have, Not Required):

  • Coursework or familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, cloud computing, or compilers.

  • Experience or interest in big data engineering, data processing, or geospatial features.

  • Contributions to open-source projects, research experience, or publications in databases/distributed systems.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Associate Solutions Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Associate Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Observe by Snowflake is a high-growth SaaS observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, enabling businesses to troubleshoot modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the Snowflake platform. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high-visibility, high-impact projects within Observe by Snowflake, our observability platform built for modern data-driven organizations. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability, and remain open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team is deeply curious, always learning, and continuously pushing the boundaries of how customers gain insight from their data to operate more effectively.

 

AS AN ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, OBSERVE BY SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Become an expert on the Observe platform and its integration with Snowflake, conducting discovery calls, tailored demos, and presentations for prospective customers focused on observability, monitoring, and data-driven operations

  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding customers’ existing and future data, infrastructure, and observability strategies, positioning Observe as a critical component of their modern data stack

  • Qualify prospects and develop new sales opportunities, while building and maintaining a strong pipeline of recurring revenue

  • Drive full-cycle sales motions—land, adopt, expand, and deepen relationships with accounts in your region

  • Achieve and exceed sales quotas on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a strategic territory plan, target account list, and regional go-to-market approach

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales engineering, product, professional services, marketing, legal, and finance teams to deliver value-driven solutions

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundation DB
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

There is only one Data Cloud. Snowflake’s founders started from scratch and designed a data platform built for the cloud that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. But it didn’t stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

FoundationDB (FDB) is an open source, highly scalable database capable of ACID transactions at high frequencies and low latencies. FDB has been a core component in Snowflake's unique shared-metadata architecture since 2014, making possible Snowflake's vision to build the greatest data warehouse for the cloud. FDB performs millions of transactions per second across thousands of processes. The FDB team builds features on open-source FDB that improve the performance, scale, reliability and operability of the product.

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Software Engineer with a passion for large scale databases and distributed systems to help us take FoundationDB to the next level. FoundationDB powers all of Snowflake’s products and services and is rapidly evolving to meet Snowflake’s future needs. We are growing at a fast rate and we need to scale FoundationDB by at least one order of magnitude over the next few years. Additionally, new workloads are emerging that need FoundationDB’s reliability, high availability and strong consistency semantics. These workloads will require innovation to re-architect the core components of our system.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Identify strategically important problems, inefficiencies or opportunities for impactful improvements

  • Own the end to end delivery of your projects, from identifying a solution, to design, implementation, test and safe production rollout

  • Design and implement critical high performance systems to handle the ever growing request rate of our database

  • Build the next generation transaction system, caching, storage engine and multi tenant capabilities

  • Evangelize best practices in database usage and end-to-end architecture.

  • Analyze and understand performance and scalability bottlenecks in the system and solve them.

  • Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 6+ years hands-on software engineering experience.

  • Systems programming skills including multi-threading, concurrency, etc. Fluency in C++, C, or Java is preferred.

  • Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or web services

  • Experience with scalable Key-Value stores such as FoundationDB, RocksDB/LevelDB, DynamoDB, Redis, etc. a plus.

  • Strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Track record of delivering highly complex projects in the distributed systems space

  • Intense curiosity, willingness to question and passion for making systems better

  • Strong technical problem solving, communication, and collaboration skills

  • Excitement by the challenge of hard technical problems

  • BS in Computer Science; Masters or PhD Preferred.

Snowflake SIGMOD 2016 paper

FDB SIGMOD 21 Paper

FoundationDB Summit 2018 and FoundationDB Summit 2019

How FDB powers Snowflake Metadata Forward!

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Senior Corporate Counsel for our Strategic Product Partnerships team. You'll negotiate the deals that shape Snowflake's AI strategy, including partnerships with frontier and open-weight AI model providers, hyperscalers, and leading enterprise software companies. Few legal roles anywhere give you this much exposure to how AI is being built, licensed, and brought to market.

AS A SENIOR CORPORATE COUNSEL AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Structure, negotiate, and close high-impact AI, cloud, and SaaS partnership agreements, including model access and deployment, zero-copy data integrations, OEM/white-label, and co-sell arrangements.

  • Work with complex deal terms such as revenue share, licensing, fee structures, IP, and data use.

  • Partner directly with Business Development, Product, and Engineering leaders, giving practical advice that keeps deals moving.

  • Own the deal pipeline for the product partnerships portfolio, spotting bottlenecks and clearing them.

  • Build and improve templates, playbooks, and processes that make partnership contracting faster.

  • Work with privacy, security, finance, tax, and compliance teams to manage risk.

  • Track the fast-changing AI and cloud regulatory landscape and raise issues before they reach a deal.

  • Mentor colleagues and help set standards for the team.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR CORPORATE COUNSEL WILL HAVE:

A JD and active California bar membership, or eligibility to register as California Registered In-House Counsel.

  • 7+ years of practice as an attorney in technology transactions, at a law firm, in-house, or both.

  • Hands-on experience negotiating complex technology, SaaS, cloud, or data partnership agreements.

  • Strong working knowledge of IP, data privacy, security, and subprocessor issues in SaaS deals.

  • Sound business judgment, with the ability to weigh risk and land practical, market-aligned positions.

  • Clear, confident communication with senior stakeholders, and comfort running several deals at once under tight timelines.

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they can improve legal work.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with AI partnership structures, such as API access, model deployment, or data use agreements with model providers, hyperscalers, or neoclouds.

  • In-house experience at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

  • Experience building scalable contracting infrastructure, such as playbooks, templates, or deal desk processes.

  • Big Law training in technology transactions.

AS A COMMERCIAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - EXPANSION AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own a portfolio of existing commercial customers in Finland, driving expansion revenue, consumption growth, and renewals

  • Build account plans for each customer that map current usage, identify untapped business units and use cases, and define a clear path to expansion

  • Uncover new workloads across data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, and data sharing, and connect them to measurable business outcomes for the customer

  • Run the full sales cycle on expansion opportunities, from discovery and qualification through commercial negotiation and close

  • Partner with Solution Engineers to deliver demonstrations, workshops, and technical validations that accelerate adoption of new Snowflake capabilities

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partner teams to drive healthy consumption and a strong customer experience

  • Monitor account health and consumption trends, proactively addressing risks and identifying growth opportunities early

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management in Salesforce, and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual targets

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager and Evangelist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

 
 

BUILD WHATS NEXT FOR AI AND DATA IN KOREA

This is not a typical product marketing role.

At Snowflake, you’ll help shape how the Korea market understands, adopts, and accelerates the future of the AI Data Cloud. You’ll sit at the intersection of product marketing, technical evangelism, go-to-market strategy, and industry influence-bringing together customers, partners, sellers, and marketers around one of the most important technology shifts of our time.

If you thrive on turning complex technology into market momentum, love being in front of customers and communities, and want to make a visible impact in one of the world’s most exciting growth regions, this role was built for you.

 
 

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

Snowflake is scaling fast, and Korea is a strategic growth market. In this role, you won’t just support the business-you’ll help define how Snowflake wins in-region.

 

You’ll be the voice of Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud across the market, translating innovation into relevance for customers, shaping go-to-market strategy, and influencing adoption at scale. With more than 13,000 customers already using Snowflake to modernize data access, accelerate analytics, and unlock data-driven insight, you’ll help drive the next wave of growth powered by AI.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead Snowflake’s Product Marketing and Evangelism efforts across the Korea market.

  • Build and execute go-to-market strategies and innovative programs that strengthen Snowflake’s market position and accelerate growth.

  • Evangelize the AI Data Cloud through speaking engagements, social media, video, and community engagement across customers, partners, media, analysts, and broader industry audiences.

  • Develop compelling messaging, content, and sales enablement assets for Snowflake teams and partner teams.

  • Partner cross-functionally with demand generation, content marketing, sales, product management, and global stakeholders to align and execute regional go-to-market plans.

  • Own and lead end-to-end product launches for Koreaa, including internal and external briefings, spokesperson support, enablement content and sessions, and alignment with marketing and PR on launch campaigns and events.

  • Build market and competitive intelligence, and serve as a thought leader on the trends shaping the industry.

  • Champion diversity and belonging as part of how we work, lead, and grow as a company.

 
 

WHAT MAKES YOU A STAND OUT

You’re equal parts strategist, storyteller, and technologist. You can move comfortably from executive conversations to technical narratives, from launch planning to live evangelism, and from market insight to field execution.

 

Our ideal candidate brings:

  • 12-15+ years of experience spanning technology, product, and market-facing roles, with strong exposure to data management and AI/ML.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging internal leaders, external stakeholders, and public audiences.

  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling presentations and plans.

  • A track record of working on complex data solutions and demonstrating architectural or technical leadership.

  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret information and turn it into actionable insight.

  • Strong understanding of both the technical foundations and business value of modern data technologies, across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience with database products.

  • A BS/BA or equivalent practical experience.

  • A proven history of partnering with field GTM teams—across marketing, sales, and solution engineering—to create high-impact content and messaging that connects with diverse personas, from technical practitioners to C-level executives like the CMO, CFO, and CRO.

  • Deep insight into the unique technological landscape and market dynamics across Korea

  • Professional fluency in regional languages including Bahasa, Mandarin, Cantonese or Thai is strongly advantageous, complementing English proficiency.

 

WHY SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is growing quickly, and we’re building a team of people who challenge conventional thinking, move with urgency, and create meaningful impact. We care deeply about our people, customers, culture, and values-and we’re looking for people with the growth mindset to solve for today while building for the future.

If you want a role with visibility, influence, and the opportunity to shape one of the most important categories in enterprise technology, this is your moment.

 
 

READY TO MAKE YOUR IMPACT

Join Snowflake and help define how the AI Data Cloud wins in Korea.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Job Location: 135 Constitution Drive, Menlo Park, CA 94025.

ELT: Engineering

REQ ID: ASHREQ-8246

Joining this team means architecting the performance, scalability, and service infrastructure that will empower the world's largest enterprises to seamlessly govern their transactional and analytical data in one place. If you are passionate about building industry-leading technologies that solve real-world scale and performance problems, this is the place to be. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the evolution of our core product: an elastic, large-scale, high-performance data processing system. We are looking for smart, enthusiastic engineers who can quickly master complex technical areas and are passionate about building new, industry-leading technologies.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (MULTIPLE POSITIONS AVAILABLE) AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Design, develop, and maintain core components of AI/ML observability systems, including backend infrastructure for largescale data processing, storage, and data movement. Implement and optimize highly specialized techniques such as sketch based data aggregation and machine learning metrics to support accurate monitoring and evaluation of ML and Generative AI models. Develop and enhance AI/ML infrastructure to support reliable training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning workloads at scale. Build and extend platform features that enable scalable ML and Generative AI use cases while improving performance, reliability, and resource efficiency. Serve as a technical lead for the design and implementation of machine learning observability, data infrastructure, and model explainability capabilities supporting customer-facing ML and Generative AI products. Telecommuting permitted.

Minimum Requirements for Position:

  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering or a related field, and five (5) years of progressive post baccalaureate experience in the job offered or a related occupation.

Education or experience must include:

  • Designing and building database systems, compilers, and developer tools;

  • Building enterprise-grade, reliable, and trustworthy software and services;

  • Developing applications using Java;

  • Using SQL and other database technologies, including implementing internal database components;

  • Designing data warehouses, database systems, and large-scale data processing solutions;

  • Contributing to ASF open-source projects, including big data and Hadoop ecosystem initiatives; and

  • Performing implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, and design query compilation and compiler systems.

The base salary range for this role is $221,187 - $287,500

Why Snowflake ?

Snowflakeはデータ革命の最前線に立ち、世界最高のデータとアプリケーションのプラットフォームの構築に取り組んでいます。私たちのミッションはデータサイロ化を解消して、「世界中のデータをモビライズすること」を目指しております。急成長していくデータの未来を私たちと共に築いていきましょう！

Sales team’s Mission ?

営業チームは、様々なインターナルチームやパートナー様と協業しながら、お客様にSnowflakeの価値や魅力を伝えていくと共に、長期的なデータ戦略のアドバイザーとして活動しております。
日本のフィールドセールスチームは顧客サイズや業界ごとにチームを分けて活動しております。ビジネスの拡大に伴い、エンタープライズアカウントを担当頂ける優秀な方を募集しております。一緒に日本市場をSnowflakeで盛り上げていきませんか？

The Impact You will Make

  • Snowflake製品のエキスパートになり、ディスカバリーコール、カスタマイズデモ、見込み顧客へのプレゼンテーションを実施する。

  • お客様の既存および将来のITロードマップを理解することで、信頼できるアドバイザーとなり、Snowflakeのソリューションを市場内で推進する。

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Partner - LATAM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is in the middle of one of the most significant transformations in its history: becoming an AI-native company. This is not just a technology project — it is a people, culture, and organizational change program, and the Senior People Partner Manager – LATAM will lead it from the front across key markets including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, and Costa Rica.

This role is Snowflake's senior HR leader for the region — a strategic thought partner who can both set direction and get into the weeds to drive real change. Reporting to the Revenue organization People Partner leader, this role will partner with LATAM leaders and the global People team to shape people strategy, drive organizational effectiveness, and deliver a world-class employee experience.

Locations: This role is hybrid based in Mexico City

AS A SENIOR PEOPLE PARTNER MANAGER – LATAM AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to LATAM leadership, offering actionable guidance on organizational strategy, key people priorities, and leadership development while championing change across the region.

  • Champion Snowflake's AI transformation in LATAM by fostering AI literacy, easing adoption through clear communication, and implementing rapid, evidence-based pilot programs to drive alignment.

  • Maintain a hands-on approach by staying deeply connected to daily team operations, earning the trust of managers and individual contributors to execute initiatives efficiently.

  • Execute strategic, data-informed talent initiatives—including succession planning, retention strategies, org design, and executive coaching—to enhance team capability throughout the region.

  • Oversee core regional HR services—spanning total rewards, performance management, employee relations, and workplace safety—ensuring strict alignment with local labor regulations.

  • Collaborate across global COEs (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Operations, Analytics and Employment Legal) and business units (Product, Engineering, GTM, G&A) to build tailored regional people solutions.

  • Lead regional compliance efforts by staying current on LATAM employment laws and partnering with Legal, Finance, and local counsel to maintain compliant operational standards.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • 10-12+ years of broad HR leadership experience with extensive client-facing strategic advisory and executive coaching, including regional or multi-country oversight.

  • Proven expertise across LATAM markets with deep understanding of local employment laws, regulatory compliance and compensation practices across key jurisdictions (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia).

  • Proven track record of supporting international growth, including setup of new legal entities, country entry strategies, and operationalizing HR infrastructure across new LATAM jurisdictions.

  • Experience operating in fast-paced, high-growth tech environments with comfort managing cross-functional initiatives across global time zones and dispersed teams.

  • Action-oriented player-coach mindset with a track record of rapidly piloting, launching, and iterating initiatives to deliver practical business solutions.

  • Robust business acumen and analytical capability, translating people strategy into clear, quantifiable business results.

  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate credibility and influence key stakeholders at all levels—from frontline management to executive leadership—within matrixed organizations.

  • Fluent in English; professional fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred.

BONUS SKILLS:

  • Coaching certification or formal executive coaching practice.

  • Program or change management certification.

  • M&A or integration experience in a LATAM context.

  • Direct experience deploying or scaling AI tools within an HR or people function.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company's confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company's data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Postgres
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Snowflake Postgres team is building a managed Postgres experience inside Snowflake. This role is focused on the control plane, where you have the opportunity to work on both on distributed systems at scale and also to work on research grade optimizations at various layers of the software stack including but not limited to provisioning, managing, securing, and operating Postgres in Snowflake. You will work on core backend systems that sit at the intersection of distributed systems, database infrastructure, security, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build backend services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration of Snowflake Postgres instances.

  • Develop features in the access and user model, including authorization, secure administration flows, and customer-facing management capabilities.

  • Improve the reliability, observability, and operability of asynchronous workflows and background systems that keep the service healthy.

  • Partner with product, security, and adjacent engineering teams to deliver simple customer experiences on top of complex infrastructure.

  • Investigate production issues, participate in on-call, and drive fixes that improve resilience and reduce operational burden.

  • Contribute to technical design, code review, and mentoring while helping raise the engineering bar across the team.

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • 2+ years of experience building production software in backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems environments.

  • Strong programming skills in one or more of Java, Go, C++, or Python.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including concurrency, networking, APIs, and data structures.

  • Experience designing and operating reliable services in production, including debugging, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Experience working across technical boundaries with product, security, and other engineering teams.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, database internals, or managed database platforms.

  • Experience with identity, authorization, RBAC, or other security-sensitive systems.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, control plane systems, or highly asynchronous service architectures.

Why join this team?

  • Work on a strategic product area that expands Snowflake into transactional and operational database workloads

  • Build systems that directly shape how customers create, manage, and secure Postgres inside Snowflake

  • Tackle a mix of product engineering, infrastructure, reliability, and security problems.

  • Join a collaborative team with meaningful ownership, strong technical challenges, and room to grow

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the team

The Growth & Product Platform team builds the full-stack systems and services that power user onboarding, trial activation, product discovery, and intelligent engagement across Snowflake. Our mission is to build reliable services, experimentation infrastructure, and data-driven capabilities that help users discover and adopt the full value of the AI Data Cloud. As part of our team, you will work across the full stack: React and TypeScript frontends, Go and Node.js/TypeScript backend services, Java platform integrations, and SQL-based data platforms. A key area of focus is driving Snowflake's product-led growth (PLG) motion and developer adoption initiatives for Cortex Code, our AI-powered development environment. We design in-product discovery mechanisms, intelligent prompts, and contextual starter experiences that guide users to relevant workflows and deepen engagement. We balance rigorous platform engineering with fast-paced product iteration, caring deeply about building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and observable. Snowflake is growing fast, and we are looking for strong engineers to help scale the platform capabilities driving our core product growth.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER FOR THE GROWTH & PRODUCT PLATFORM TEAM, YOU WILL:

  • Design, build, and ship full-stack features and platform infrastructure that power Snowflake's user-facing product journeys.

  • Build and improve frontend experiences using React and TypeScript, including in-product onboarding flows, contextual prompts, and interactive UI components that drive user engagement.

  • Drive product-led growth (PLG) initiatives end to end, collaborating with product managers and data scientists to identify activation bottlenecks and build self-serve capabilities that expand product adoption.

  • Build full-stack systems and contextual experiences that drive discovery and adoption for Cortex Code, including intelligent prompts, starter workflows, and workspace integration points.

  • Drive product experimentation end to end: formulating hypotheses, collaborating on test design, implementing frontend and backend variants, and analyzing performance metrics to guide decisions.

  • Bring strong product thinking to technical design, translating user journeys and engagement signals into scalable system capabilities.

  • Analyze user behavioral data and platform telemetry to evaluate experiment outcomes, assess feature adoption, and inform technical architecture.

  • Build and scale critical backend services supporting trial activation, user onboarding, account provisioning, learning environments, and anti-abuse safeguards.

  • Debug and resolve complex production issues across distributed services, relational databases, and platform infrastructure.

  • Contribute across the full development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to testing, deployment, and operational ownership.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, data science, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact product features.

  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture through code reviews, technical design discussions, mentoring, and operational excellence.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WITH:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building large-scale distributed or user-facing systems in production environments, with experience across both frontend and backend.

  • A strong foundation in full-stack development. You should have experience with frontend technologies and frameworks like TypeScript and React, and experience building backend services in languages like Go, Java, or TypeScript/Node.js.

  • Strong product sense and interest in product-led growth (PLG), user onboarding, and feature adoption mechanics.

  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, or feature-flagging workflows.

  • Comfort working with data: querying analytical data stores (SQL), understanding product telemetry, and using metrics to evaluate user behavior and system performance.

  • Experience with distributed systems, REST/gRPC APIs, relational databases (such as PostgreSQL), or data platforms.

  • Strong coding and debugging skills, with the ability to navigate complex full-stack system architectures.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams.

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related fields, or equivalent practical experience.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we are scaling our team to help enable and accelerate that growth. We are looking for engineers who share our values, challenge conventional thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a meaningful career at Snowflake.

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is now building a world class OLTP service on Postgres. We’re hiring Senior Postgres Engineers to help build the new Snowflake Postgres service. This is an exciting opportunity to help build a large scale, multi-cloud Postgres offering with access to an existing customer base.

AS A SENIOR POSTGRES ENGINEER YOU WILL:

  • Develop orchestration layer/ control-plane of large scale databases

  • Work with AWS, Azure, and GCP APIs

  • Build High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions

  • Tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest datasets in the world

  • Secure and ensure customer data is protected

  • Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry and help redefine the space by inventing at various layers of the software stack — from broad distributed systems to low-level optimizations that fundamentally change the performance characteristics of the system to cater to our customer needs.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR POSTGRES ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years industry experience designing, building and developing large scale systems in production

  • Experience building and maintaining distributed, highly available, fault tolerant services

  • Excellent understanding of low level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, performance, and scale

  • Extremely strong fundamental computer science skills

  • Experience with Java, Python/Ruby & Go

  • Experience running & maintaining large Postgres servers

  • Familiarity with cloud networking (VPCs, PrivateLink, Peering, etc)

  • Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

THE FOLLOWING ARE CONSIDERED A PLUS:

  • Experience designing and implementing large systems for public or private clouds

  • FedRAMP and DoD deployment experience

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for an Solution Engineer who is ready to solve complex data challenges and help enterprises realize the full potential of the AI Data Cloud. While data architecture depth remains important, this role is especially suited to someone who can build trust on the ground, drive technical progress within complex customer environments, and help uncover new opportunities over time. You will also serve as a technical customer advocate internally at Snowflake, ensuring that your customer’s needs drive our product roadmap and innovation.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must excel at translating complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions that resonate with our customers. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to challenge assumptions and redefine the future of how work gets done.

 

In this role you will get to:

  • Partner with account executives and cross-functional teams to drive the technical win across the sales cycle

  • Present Snowflake’s vision, platform, and value to technical and executive audiences

  • Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate the value of Snowflake through discovery, demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements

  • Guide customers on modern data architecture, solution design, and implementation considerations across analytics, data engineering, AI/ML, performance, and governance

  • Translate customer business challenges into practical solution patterns that drive adoption and long-term value

  • Develop trusted relationships with architects, engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders within strategic enterprise accounts

  • Maintain an understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and position Snowflake effectively in relation to them

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to improve Snowflake’s products, messaging, and field effectiveness

  • Help customers stay current on Snowflake product innovation, roadmap developments, and emerging use cases

  • Represent Snowflake at customer meetings, executive briefings, workshops, and industry events

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • 6+ years of experience in a customer-facing solutions engineering, sales engineering, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales role

  • Strong competency across modern data stacks, including ETL/ELT, data warehouses, data lakes, analytics, and cloud-native data platforms

  • Experience working with enterprise customers in complex technical and stakeholder environments

  • Strong hands-on technical capability, including SQL and Python

  • The ability to connect a customer’s technical and business challenges to a practical Snowflake solution

  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences

  • Confidence facilitating whiteboarding sessions, technical workshops, and solution discussions

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and willingness to be hands-on in driving customer success

  • Strong relationship-building capability, professional presence, and the ability to simplify technical concepts into structured business narratives

  • A sense of agency, with a self-starter mindset to proactively seek out and drive opportunities forward

     

What success looks like in this role:

  • You quickly establish credibility with technical teams and key stakeholders across the account

  • You bring a practical, execution-oriented style that helps move opportunities forward

  • You translate Snowflake capabilities into clear business and technical value

  • You create technical champions and trusted relationships within your customer environment

  • You contribute to both immediate deal progression and the long-term growth of the account

     

About Our Team:

Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and serve as the bridge between our most strategic customers and our internal product organization. We believe in the transformative power of executive relationships and technical advocacy. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback, and are passionate about making our clients successful while ensuring their voice shapes Snowflake's future. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone while driving product innovation through customer advocacy.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

  • Contribute to the technical execution and delivery of user-facing frontend features, taking ideas from design concepts to production-ready deployments.

  • Write clean, performant, and maintainable TypeScript/React code while adhering to engineering best practices.

  • Actively participate in frontend architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews to ensure code quality and system scalability.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to convert user requirements into detailed technical tasks and robust UI components.

  • Monitor, maintain, and optimize the frontend platform’s responsiveness, availability, and user experience.

  • Partner with backend and cross-functional teams to integrate APIs and support backend services that power AI inference and data retrieval.

  • Use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools) as an integral component of your day-to-day software development workflow.

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 3+ years of professional experience designing and building production web applications.

  • Actively use AI coding assistants in daily engineering workflows

  • Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and the modern React ecosystem.

  • Solid understanding of core computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, UI design patterns, and state management.

  • Proven ability to turn design mocks and product specs into production-quality code.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration across engineering, product, and design.

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Elastic Global Services team is responsible for building the highly available, scalable, multi-tenant “Cloud Services” platform that underpin Snowflake services. Areas we work on include, the autoscaling of VMs from cloud providers, managing topologies of our compute clusters, cluster management, workload orchestration and many others. We are looking at expanding our team to handle the next big challenges for Snowflake customers.

Our product offering runs on multiple cloud providers including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud. Our infrastructure self-optimizes, provides high availability and data protection across cloud providers so our users can focus on using their data, not managing it. In our effort to enable our Data Cloud vision, we are actively hiring talented distributed systems engineers. This role is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on our elastic, large scale, high-performance computing environment.

To learn more about the team’s tech stack, see our recent talk at ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing! https://acmsocc.org/2022/assets/slides/99.pdf

AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Solving real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem solving skills.

  • Design and implement scalable distributed systems for our cloud services.

  • Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them.

  • Mentor and grow junior engineers.

  • Understand trade-offs between consistency, durability and costs to build solutions which can meet the demands of rapidly growing services.

  • Ensure operational readiness of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding availability and performance.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 15+ years of industry experience designing, building and supporting large scale infrastructure in production.

  • Experience building large scale distributed fault tolerant infrastructure.

  • Experience in container orchestration, cluster management, or autoscaling.

  • Excellent understanding of operating systems concepts including. multi-threading, memory management, networking and storage, performance and scale.

  • Solid understanding of the internals of Kubernetes, Mesos, OpenShift, or other container platforms.

WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

  • Build an industry-leading Cloud Data Platform.

  • Solve challenging technical problems related to security, parallel and distributed systems, programming, resource management, large-scale system maintenance, and more!

  • Work closely with our customers & partners, understand their use cases & needs, think strategically to seek the right problem to solve at the right time, and innovate with rigor.

  • Join a world-class team of both industry veterans and rising stars.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately close business.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the database space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences.

This is a location-specific role; candidates must be located within commuting distance of São Paulo, Brazil.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics

  • Hands-on experience with Python

  • Understanding of AI/ML principles and best practices

  • Ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solutions

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work.
