At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Commercial Solutions Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Commercial Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Team

We exist to improve Marketing leaders’ understanding and decision-making on how to profitably grow the business. Our North Star is to increase pipeline generation by measuring key marketing and financial metrics, inferring actionable insights, catalyzing strategic investment decisions and accelerating operational efficiency across Marketing and Finance.

Our team operates at the intersection of strategy, finance, and marketing execution - partnering closely with Growth Marketing, Brand & Creative, Strategic Events, Product Marketing and leadership to ensure that marketing investments are efficient, effective and aligned to Snowflake’s growth priorities.

About the Role

As a strategic finance partner to Snowflake’s Growth Marketing organization, you will own planning, forecasting and performance analyses across a global portfolio of marketing programs, campaigns, and events, and help leaders decide where to invest to drive pipeline and consumption growth. We are looking for a rigorous and driven senior analyst who can work autonomously, bring structure to ambiguous business questions, and influence decisions with clear financial recommendations. You will build trusted relationships with senior marketing leaders, influence decisions with clear financial insights and leverage Snowflake’s own platform to scale existing processes, increase productivity, and sharpen focus on high-impact strategic work.

What You Will Do

This role will support recurring reporting, own budgeting variance analyses, and help translate data into actionable, clear insights for Marketing stakeholders. You will collaborate closely with senior analysts and cross-functional partners, developing the skills to navigate ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, and continuously improve processes. This role is ideal for a proactive self-starter with strong analytical curiosity who wants to strengthen their strategic finance acumen.

What You Will Need

  • 4-7 years of experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, or Consulting, including at least 2 years supporting a GTM organization; ideally at a Saas or consumption-based company.

  • Strong command of funnel metrics and how investments drives pipeline, bookings and consumption

  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels

  • Proven advanced ability in financial modeling, forecasting, and data analysis to support strategic decision making

  • Strong sense of accountability with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach to learning, improving, and driving work forward

  • AI-first mindset, with track record of using automation or AI to scale reporting and analyses

  • Bachelor’s Degree: in Finance, Data Science, Economics, Accounting, or a related field

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Mobile Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Product Engineer for our Mobile Team. This team owns Snowflake's most visible AI products — Snowflake CoWork, our agentic AI workspace for enterprise knowledge workers, and Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code), our AI coding agent. In this role, you will build the mobile experiences that bring agentic AI to users wherever they work, spanning the full product lifecycle from conception through deployment.

AS AN ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build and ship polished, production-quality mobile features for Snowflake's agentic AI products, taking ideas from design concepts through App Store / Play Store releases.

  • Write clean, performant, and maintainable TypeScript and React Native code while adhering to engineering best practices.

  • Actively participate in mobile and frontend architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews to ensure code quality and system scalability.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to convert user requirements into detailed technical tasks and robust mobile UI components.

  • Partner with backend and cross-functional teams to integrate APIs and support backend services that power AI inference and data retrieval.

  • Contribute to the web frontend where needed — this team works across mobile, web, and the broader agentic ecosystem.

  • Use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools) as an integral component of your day-to-day software development workflow.

OUR IDEAL ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of professional experience designing and building production mobile applications with React Native.

  • Strong product mindset — you care deeply about user experience and can be trusted to own features end-to-end, from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome.

  • Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and the modern React ecosystem.

  • Solid understanding of core computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, UI design patterns, and state management.

  • Proven ability to turn design mocks and product specs into production-quality code.

  • Experience with mobile app fundamentals: navigation, gesture handling, offline behavior, push notifications, and app store release processes.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration across engineering, product, and design.

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (Telco)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake
Snowflake is the world's leading AI Data Cloud company, powering the future of data and artificial intelligence. Our mission is to mobilize the world's data — breaking down silos and enabling every organization to unify, govern, and unlock the full value of their data at scale. Built on a single, fully managed platform that is Easy, Connected, and Trusted, Snowflake empowers enterprises to run all of their data, AI, and application workloads — from advanced analytics and machine learning to generative AI and agentic applications — without moving data out of a secure, governed environment.
With thousands of customers across every major industry worldwide and a consumption-based model that scales with value delivered, Snowflake is one of the fastest-growing enterprise platforms in the cloud era. We believe that there is no AI strategy without a data strategy — and we are building the platform that makes both possible. Join us at the intersection of data and AI as we define the next generation of enterprise intelligence.

Account Executive Team
The Account Executive team works closely with internal cross-functional teams and partners to deliver Snowflake's value to customers and serve as trusted advisors on long-term data and AI strategy. The Korea sales organization operates across four industry-aligned teams to drive deep vertical expertise and customer intimacy. As part of our continued growth in Korea, we are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to own and accelerate Snowflake's business across major telecommunications accounts — one of the most data-intensive and strategically important verticals in the market.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Drive data and AI transformation for Korea's leading telcos: Lead Snowflake's go-to-market strategy across enterprise telecommunications accounts, enabling customers to harness the power of the AI Data Cloud for network optimization, customer 360, 5G data monetization, fraud detection, and AI-driven operations.

  • Become a Snowflake expert: Conduct discovery calls, deliver customized demos, and present tailored solutions that address the unique challenges of the telecommunications industry — from massive-scale data management to real-time AI inference.

  • Be the trusted advisor: Deeply understand each customer's business priorities, digital transformation roadmap, and competitive landscape to position Snowflake as a strategic platform partner — not just a vendor.

  • Drive full-lifecycle sales execution: Own pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and deal closure across your accounts — landing new use cases, expanding existing deployments, and deepening platform adoption across business units.

  • Build and execute strategic account plans: Develop comprehensive account strategies with targeted stakeholder mapping, competitive positioning, and quarterly/annual revenue targets. Proactively identify whitespace, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities.

  • Cultivate deep executive relationships: Build and sustain trusted relationships with CxOs, CTOs, CDOs, IT executives, and Line-of-Business leaders to drive strategic alignment and accelerate enterprise-wide adoption.

  • Navigate regulatory and compliance requirements: Understand and address the data governance, privacy, and regulatory requirements specific to the telecommunications industry, positioning Snowflake's built-in security and governance capabilities as a competitive differentiator.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration: Lead engagement across Snowflake's internal teams — including Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, Legal, and Finance — to deliver a seamless and unified customer experience.



Who You Are

  • 5–7+ years of quota-carrying field sales experience in enterprise software, cloud platforms, or data/AI solutions, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Deep understanding of the telecommunications industry and its technology stack — including BSS (billing systems, CRM, subscriber management, revenue assurance, partner management) and OSS (network management, fault management, service assurance, performance monitoring), as well as broader industry dynamics such as 5G, IoT, network modernization, and data monetization.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles — from initial engagement to negotiation and close — with experience selling into large telecommunications / communications service provider accounts.

  • Existing key relationships and a strong network within the Korean telecommunications ecosystem — including carrier executives, IT/data leadership, and ecosystem partners — are a significant advantage.

  • Experience navigating the regulatory and compliance landscape of the telecommunications industry is preferred.

Data & AI Business Acumen

  • アカウントプランニング、パイプラインマネジメント、顧客との関係構築を通じて成果創出できる方。

We are hiring an Sr Engagement Manager for our Frontier Engineering team. The Frontier Engineering team turns Snowflake's mission of mobilizing the world's data into concrete outcomes inside customer environments. In this role you lead both the business growth and the delivery success of Frontier Engineering across your region, owning the full cycle from opportunity creation through scoping, contracting, delivery, and continued growth, and acting as a trusted advisor who balances customer business outcomes with cloud data strategy.

AS AN SR. ENGAGEMENT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own accountability for Frontier Engineering quarterly bookings, consumption, and utilization targets across your assigned accounts and region, as part of the broader account team

  • Partner with Account Executives, Solution Engineers, and delivery leadership to identify services opportunities, scope engagements, author proposals and Statements of Work, and lead internal Deal Review and investment approval processes

  • Own and be accountable for the bookings forecast across your Book of Business, tying every engagement to clear customer outcomes such as revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction, and faster Time to Value

  • Design and continually refine the delivery roadmap for key accounts, managing project progress, schedule, deliverable quality, and early detection and escalation of scope, schedule, cost, and quality risks

  • Serve as the initial point of escalation for customers and project teams, earning trust on both sides and leading decision-making in difficult situations

  • Own project financials, including revenue forecasting and cost control, balancing healthy margins with customer satisfaction, and report outcomes, risks, and next steps to executive leadership

  • Provide delivery quality oversight and guidance for Snowflake engagements by assisting in the creation and execution of the overall vision for service delivery and client satisfaction, ensuring adherence to delivery best practices

  • Own, manage and communicate the operational relationship with assigned clients, including the creation, implementation, and tracking of relationship roadmaps

  • Manage key client projects by communicating effectively with project team members, management and project stakeholders on status, issues, risks, and project goals and objectives through clear project documentation, meetings and any required follow-ups

  • Build mid-to-long-term account plans and Data Cloud roadmaps with account teams, and design co-delivery and co-selling models with SI, GSI, and ISV partners, including scalable subcontractor and staff-augmentation models

  • Lead practice and operational improvements: SOW standardization and templates, risk-based deal review, reusable assets and best practices, and Cortex AI and GenAI-assisted workflows for contract and SOW drafting and engagement summaries

  • Mentor and coach delivery consultants, drive delivery governance through QA reviews and health checks, and share best practices with Practice Directors and peers across regions

OUR IDEAL ENGAGEMENT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience in a Sales and Services Delivery role, or equivalent experience, spanning complex enterprise technical projects such as cloud DWH and data platform implementation, modernization, or AI/ML adoption

  • A proven track record of achieving quantitative KPIs such as bookings, utilization, and consumption in a delivery or similar organization

  • Experience negotiating with and managing executive stakeholders from CxO to VP level across sales, delivery, product, and partner organizations

  • Direct experience in the data warehouse, business intelligence, or cloud data platform space, or equivalent experience

  • Both strong business literacy and technical understanding: able to translate customer business goals into Snowflake platform scenarios and to discuss architectural and implementation constraints and risks alongside technical teams

  • Clear, concise cross-functional communication with a track record of leading diverse groups toward consensus

  • Strong organizational skills and ownership, with the ability to autonomously manage multiple projects and accounts in parallel

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

We're looking for a talented and motivated Software Engineer to join the Cortex AI Functions Platform team. AI functions are how Snowflake customers call AI directly from SQL, running models over their own tables without moving data out of the platform. Our team builds the platform that makes this work at data warehouse scale, where a single statement can expand into a large volume of inference requests that must complete predictably, within expected cost, and without compromising the query when a dependency degrades or fails.

Current projects include a new architecture for multi-modal inference, quality gates that let us ship new functions and models with confidence at batch scale, and support for input data beyond plain text. Alongside these, we work continuously on throughput, cost and reliability as customer usage grows, and on making failures in the inference path easier to detect, diagnose and recover from.

For this role, you don’t need to have a research background, including pre-training or fine-tuning models.

 

Your journey as a Software Engineer

Working in our team you will:

  • Think creatively to find optimal solutions to our complex, often ambiguous problems

  • Participate in all stages of building and running the platform behind Snowflake’s AI functions, from design and implementation through rollout and production support

  • Work closely with research teams, as well as product and engineering partners, to understand and shape the short and long-term product development strategy

  • Serve as a mentor to less experienced engineers

Ideal candidate

  • 4+ years of experience building production backend or distributed systems in C++, Java, Go, Python, or a comparable language

  • BSc in a technical field (CS, EE, Physics, Math, etc), MSc/PhD is a plus

  • Experience designing and operating high-throughput services, including handling concurrency, backpressure, partial failures, and observability

  • Experience designing service or RPC APIs, such as REST or gRPC

  • Experience with software engineering best practices (programming, testing, version control, CI/CD, containers, agile development, etc)

  • Experience with building distributed systems that guarantee high throughput without compromising on reliability

  • High levels of curiosity and eager enthusiasm for open-ended problems, and the ability to turn a loosely defined problem into a scoped, testable design

  • Ability to articulate results and complex concepts to leadership

  • Must be able to produce solutions independently in an organized manner, as well as work in a team

  • Experience with SQL engines, query execution, or other large-scale data systems is a strong asset

  • Hands-on experience in the MLOps field (e.g., deploying ML models) is a plus

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Cloud Support Engineer (CSE)

Snowflake seeks early-career Cloud Support Engineers who combine technical expertise, customer empathy, and an AI-first mindset. You'll leverage and refine AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, improve knowledge bases, and reduce time to resolution—safely and responsibly. Experience in 24x7 technical support, escalation handling, on-call rotations, and incident management is ideal.

 

Key Responsibilities:

As a Cloud Support Engineer, you manage customer cases and are accountable for accelerating their time-to-resolution, ensuring platform stability, and driving a world-class support experience. Operating as a full-stack technical support resource, this role blends deep hands-on troubleshooting with the customer empathy and communication skills of a trusted advisor.

Customer Value and Incident Ownership

  • Own the Customer Experience: Manage customer issues from initial triage through resolution and follow-up, ensuring clear communication and timely updates.

  • Deliver Support Value with AI: Leverage AI assistants and diagnostics to accelerate triage and root-cause analysis while maintaining accuracy and safety standards.

  • Outcome-Based Support: Focus on business impact, ensuring resolutions fix issues, reduce recurrence, and improve reliability.

  • Customer Empathy and Communication: Provide technical analysis and guidance via email, web, and phone, adapting to customer expertise levels.

Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • AI-Assisted Triage: Use AI to summarize logs, generate hypotheses, and draft responses—critically validating outputs before sharing.

  • Tooling Expertise: Utilize Snowflake environment, connectors, and internal tools to investigate and test solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to resolve systemic issues.

  • Knowledge Management: Document solutions in knowledge bases, refining AI-assisted drafts for quality.

  • Feedback and Innovation: Provide input on product behavior, documentation gaps, and AI-tool performance.

  • Bug Reporting: Document and collaborate on bugs and feature requests with engineering teams.

  • Operational Coverage: Support holiday/weekend rotations and on-call requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • 2+ years in technical support (customer-facing, ideally 24x7).

  • Strong AI fluency, including prompt engineering, context management, and the ability to critically validate AI outputs and know when to fall back to manual investigation.

  • Experience with AI-powered tooling (e.g., coding assistants/agentic IDEs) and modern support environments.

  • Solid technical troubleshooting skills, including comfort with SQL, log analysis, and scripting/automation (e.g., Python, APIs, workflow tools) to diagnose issues and streamline tasks.SQL, log analysis, and scripting skills (Python, APIs).

  • Strong written/verbal English communication.

  • Basic understanding of Windows and Linux Operating Systems.

  • Basic understanding of Data Warehousing fundamentals and concepts.

  • Ability to write and understand basic SQL queries

  • Familiarity with end-to-end ML pipeline including ML modeling, feature engineering, ML model training, etc.

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, and associated tools within the LLM ecosystem, including Langchain, vector databases, co-pilot, and open-source Hugging Face models.

  • Being able to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to MLOps pipelines, model performance, and infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and web services

Preferred:

  • Snowflake or cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Advance Workflow automation / CI/CD tooling experience

  • AI-powered support or SRE workflow experience

  • Relevant certifications (SnowPro, cloud certs)

  • Knowledge about GPUs, CUDA, and low-level optimizations will be a plus.

  • Experience developing CI/CD components for production-ready MLOps pipelines.

  • Location: Bellevue, WA or Dublin, CA

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Escalation Manager

Our Staff Escalation Manager reviews automatic and manual escalation nominations and can quickly assess the viability of the escalation request. They can strike the proper balance between serving customers' needs and being Snowflake ambassadors. They assemble multiple data points from different systems to create an overall picture of the customer’s current situation.

A Staff Escalation Manager relies heavily on reporting and analysis to translate the overall customer situation into a consumable view for management.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Work on non-routine problems that require techniques for which solutions are not always established

  • Work within defined processes and helps determine the appropriate approach for new
    issue types

  • Work independently with almost no supervision on day-to-day operations

  • Prioritize tasks to manage their escalation queue effectively, rarely requiring input from their managers

  • Serve as a mentor to junior staff on escalation practices; however, has no direct supervisory responsibilities

  • Optimize AI-assisted workflows for escalation management, refining prompt strategies and tooling to improve team efficiency and output quality

In this role, you will:

  • Own medium to high complexity cases and account escalations that may require a higher technical aptitude

  • Work independently to define strategies for addressing highly complex escalations

  • Leverage data from escalation models to drive and influence action on escalations

  • Use AI tools independently to aggregate multi-source data, identify escalation patterns, and accelerate root-cause analysis, serving as a resource for peers on effective AI usage

  • Suggest improvements to the overall escalation process and methodology

  • Lead escalations for highly visible customers, including those nominated by senior leadership

  • Able to prioritize and manage multiple highly visible escalations, keeping all parties updated on progress regularly

  • Drive internal team alignment in preparation for customer meetings

  • Drive consensus from all necessary internal resources at the appropriate level before making commitments on behalf of Snowflake

  • Expertly navigates the right teams using the appropriate channels to create the action plan

  • Ability to influence resources across cross-functional teams involved in handling the escalation

  • Ability to take a big-picture approach to determine the root cause of escalations to ensure an adequate long-term solution is provided

  • Work independently across the org to create, polish, and send customer-facing post-mortems/RCAs based on the specifics of the escalation

Customer Advocacy:

  • Demonstrate strong escalation management practices to address customer issues for the long term

  • Provide guidance and mentorship in quality escalation management to team members

  • Present the Global Escalation program, process, and principles to an internal and external audience

  • Continuously monitor and keep a pulse on the customer's temperature

  • Demonstrate heightened awareness of the overall customer situation, how the customer responds to progress updates, and pivot approach as needed to drive customer satisfaction

Team Player and Community:

  • Proactively help others

  • Develop expertise in others

  • Cool under challenging situations; holds things together in tough times

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and making difficult decisions

  • Embody Snowflake Values, acting as a role model to more junior team members

  • Participate in the hiring process as a key interviewer and demonstrates the ability to assess the skills and potential of interview candidates accurately

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Software Engineer — Engineering Systems, Continuous Integration
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About Snowflake

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the tools, infrastructure, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake's engineering organization. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will help build reliable, scalable CI services that support thousands of engineers and a rapidly growing multi-cloud codebase.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and operate distributed systems that power Snowflake's continuous integration platform.

  • Build services and tooling that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and software delivery velocity.

  • Contribute to the architecture and implementation of scalable CI infrastructure across cloud environments.

  • Develop reliable APIs, services, and automation using languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

  • Investigate and resolve issues involving build failures, test infrastructure, performance, reliability, and developer workflows.

  • Partner with engineers across Snowflake to understand CI needs and deliver solutions that are simple, scalable, and easy to operate.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing, and production support.

  • Apply strong engineering judgment to improve system performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

  • Help evolve CI practices, tooling, and operational processes as Snowflake grows.

  • Contribute to an inclusive engineering culture through collaboration, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience building production systems.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Experience designing and implementing reliable software services.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based development environments and distributed applications.

  • Experience with testing, debugging, monitoring, and operating production systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous technical challenges.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate with engineers, product partners, and teams across the organization.

  • A strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering high-quality software.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with continuous integration, continuous delivery, or developer productivity systems.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Bazel, or similar CI/CD platforms.

  • Experience with build systems, test orchestration, distributed job scheduling, or resource management.

  • Knowledge of multi-tenant systems, reliability engineering, performance optimization, or security isolation.

  • Experience working with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience supporting large-scale repositories, build pipelines, or engineering platforms.

  • Familiarity with observability tools and production metrics.

  • Experience contributing to technical design documents, postmortems, or root-cause analyses.

Why Engineering Systems at Snowflake?

  • Build infrastructure used by Snowflake engineers around the world.

  • Work on challenging distributed systems and developer productivity problems.

  • Help improve the speed, reliability, and quality of software delivery at Snowflake.

  • Collaborate with engineers across a multi-cloud data platform.

  • Grow your technical skills while working on systems with broad organizational impact.

  • Join a team that values ownership, thoughtful engineering, and continuous improvement.

Compensation

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

For the Bellevue, WA market, the compensation range for this IC2 role is:

  • Base salary: $170,000–$204,000 USD

  • Target bonus: 10%

  • Total target compensation: $187,000–$224,400 USD

  • Equity: Eligible for an RSU grant in addition to base salary and bonus

Snowflake also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP, paid time off, parental leave, disability coverage, and company-paid life insurance.

Snowflake is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help build and operate the data pipelines and models that power internal decision-making on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will work alongside senior engineers, learn our platform from the inside as customer zero, and grow your ownership of production data products over time.

AS A DATA ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build and maintain production data pipelines and models on Snowflake, from ingestion through transformation and consumption

  • Develop dbt models with tests and documentation that follow team standards and governance practices

  • Build and support Apache Airflow DAGs that orchestrate Snowflake workloads reliably

  • Ingest data from enterprise sources using Snowpipe, Snowpark, and dynamic tables

  • Apply data quality checks and help monitor Snowflake warehouse cost and performance

  • Act as an internal customer zero, sharing feedback on Snowflake features with Product teams

  • Take part in Agile ceremonies including stand ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives

  • Partner with stakeholders and senior engineers to turn well-defined requirements into scoped technical tasks

OUR IDEAL DATA ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building data pipelines or data models in a production environment

  • Strong SQL and working Python skills, including basic query tuning and schema design

  • Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake

  • Working knowledge of dbt and an orchestration tool such as Apache Airflow

  • Understanding of dimensional modelling concepts

  • Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative, curious approach to learning

  • Ownership mindset: you follow problems through to resolution and ask for help when needed

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Exposure to Snowflake Cortex AI functions or other LLM APIs for data enrichment

  • Experience preparing data for ML model training or feature engineering

  • Familiarity with streaming ingestion such as Kafka or Snowpipe Streaming

  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including infrastructure-as-code

  • Awareness of data contracts or schema registry tooling

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager – Sovereignty & Public Sector, EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, building the world’s greatest data, applications and AI/ML platform. Our get it done culture empowers everyone at Snowflake to innovate, create work with lasting impact, and thrive in a collaborative environment.

Snowflake EMEA product marketers conceive of and execute go-to-market plans that drive awareness, adoption and drive success for our customers. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to build messaging and positioning around Data and AI Sovereignty in EMEA, execute targeted go-to-market strategy for the Public Sector, scale our impact through Snowflake’s partner ecosystem, and maintain momentum behind key regional sovereignty partnerships.

This is a highly cross-functional role, working closely with Account Teams, Field Marketing, Technical Sales, ABM, Partner Marketing, Demand Generation, and Global Product Marketing to align strategy with execution. The successful candidate will thrive on GTM orchestration, partner co-marketing, field enablement, and navigating complex regulatory and public sector buying landscapes.

This role is based out of Snowflake’s London office.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and align messaging and positioning for Data and AI Sovereignty in the EMEA region, ensuring Snowflake’s narrative addresses sovereign control, regulatory compliance, operational autonomy, and cloud resilience

  • Scale sovereignty messaging and regional reach through Snowflake’s cloud, systems integrator, and specialized partner ecosystem, orchestrating joint GTM motions and co-marketing programs that drive pipeline impact

  • Maintain and accelerate momentum around recent strategic sovereignty partnerships, converting key alliance milestones into high-impact sales plays, field enablement assets, and customer-facing collateral

  • Lead targeted campaigns on Data and AI Sovereignty in key markets based on local nuances, such as Digital Trust, Greater Local Control, and Data Residency with Global Innovation

  • Develop regional GTM strategy and execution for the Public Sector, designing targeted campaigns tailored to specific government departments, public institutions, and regulated markets

  • Enable field sales and technical teams at scale on sovereignty frameworks, public sector compliance requirements, procurement pathways, and competitive differentiation

  • Lead cross-functional working groups with ABM, Demand Generation and other Marketing teams to run high-touch campaigns against key public sector targets

  • Amplify the EMEA voice by synthesizing customer feedback, regulatory trends, and field insights to shape global product roadmaps, GTM priorities, and core messaging

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, solutions marketing, or GTM strategy within data, cloud, or enterprise software, specifically supporting Public Sector or highly regulated industries

  • Domain knowledge of Public Sector procurement dynamics, government compliance standards, and Data/AI Sovereignty requirements across EMEA (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR, national sovereignty frameworks)

  • Proven track record of developing and scaling joint GTM programs, partner co-marketing initiatives, and ecosystem alliances

  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate cross-functional, account-based campaigns targeting public sector institutions and government bodies

  • Excellent communication and storytelling abilities, with a strong talent for translating complex regulatory, governance, and architectural concepts into compelling narratives

  • Strong collaboration and influence skills, aligning global product strategy with localized EMEA market needs

  • Commitment to being a culture champion who builds trust, collaboration and inclusivity across functions and regions

  • An analytical, data-driven mindset focused on measuring campaign effectiveness, pipeline impact, and account engagement

  • BS/BA degree preferred

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time

Snowflake is scaling fast in EMEA, and we need builders who can think strategically and execute with urgency. If you are energised by building market positioning, driving public sector transformation, collaborating across partner ecosystems, and amplifying the voice of the region to shape global impact, we’d love to meet you.

How will you orchestrate impact at Snowflake?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

As a Project Manager, you are the foundation of our delivery team, focusing on mid-sized technical projects. You provide critical visibility, service reviews, and reporting throughout the implementation lifecycle. You are a professional who moves fast to discover simpler ways to deliver results for our customers while adopting a deeply "Customer-Centric" mindset.

 

WHY THIS ROLE?

  • Impact: Own and manage the operational relationship with assigned clients, ensuring their applications scale to meet business needs.

  • Growth: This "Journey-Level" position provides a clear path toward advanced project management by mastering "zero-surprise" reporting.

  • Innovation: Work with bleeding-edge data warehouse technology in a truly disruptive software environment.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Project Governance: Maintain project documentation and track task effort in Smartsheet or Certinia.

  • Work Structures: Create granular Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and associate effort and resource naming to specific tasks.

  • Meeting Leadership: Lead internal and client meetings with thorough documentation and rigorous follow-up.

  • Conflict Management: Navigate internal resource conflicts effectively to keep projects on track.

  • Success Metrics: Maintain project margins within +/- 5% of target and achieve CSAT scores greater than 4.0.

 

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • Typically 2-5 years of field experience in a services delivery or technical implementation role.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Strategic Events EMEA — 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Cover)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Contract: 12-month fixed term, starting January 2026 with a handover period before the start of leave.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced events leader to step into a 12-month fixed-term maternity cover as Sr Manager, Strategic Events EMEA. In this role, you'll drive and execute Snowflake's PAN-EMEA events strategy, lead a team of six (including four direct reports), and you’ll own planning for the next fiscal year. You'll keep EMEA closely aligned with the Global Strategic Events function and work in close partnership with EMEA Field Marketing, Product Marketing (PMM), Demand Generation, Partner Marketing, Communications, and other regional marketing teams. Together you’ll deliver cohesive, high-impact event experiences that fuel pipeline and deepen customer engagement.

This is a hands-on leadership role — you'll be accountable for the performance and development of your team, the planning and reporting rigour behind our Snowflake-owned event series, and the strategic oversight of our highest-profile third-party sponsorships across the region. Your job is to make sure the portfolio as a whole delivers for the business.

You’ll get end-to-end exposure to some of the most visible event investments in enterprise tech, including Davos, Cannes Lions, and Mobile World Congress, alongside Snowflake’s own flagship programmes across the EMEA region.

What You'll Do

  • Own PAN-EMEA events strategy and planning: Drive the comprehensive events plan — spanning Snowflake-led events, third-party sponsorships, and partner events — ensuring tight alignment with regional pipeline goals, the Global Strategic Events roadmap, and broader EMEA marketing priorities.

  • Lead and develop a team of six: Manage four direct reports and a wider team of six event professionals. Set clear objectives, run development plans and performance conversations, foster a culture of excellence and accountability, and ensure the team delivers consistently at a high level throughout the contract period. You’ll also hire for open roles as needed.

  • Plan and report on Snowflake-owned flagship events: Have oversight of and accountability for key Snowflake-led programmes including World Tour and the Data for Breakfast series, as well as EMEA presence at global tentpole events such as Summit.

  • Steer strategic third-party sponsorships: Ensure planning, global alignment, and performance oversight for Snowflake's largest third-party event investments — including Davos, Mobile World Congress (MWC), Cannes Lions, Gartner, and SAP conferences. Individual event planning and execution sits with dedicated team members; your role is to steer strategic alignment, cross-functional coordination, and performance management across the portfolio.

  • Shape executive programming: Make sure our highest-profile moments, from the Davos storefront to sponsorship hospitality, deliver meaningful C-level engagement with strategic accounts through executive meetings, roundtables, and dinners.

  • Drive measurable pipeline impact: Partner with Field Marketing, Sales, SDR, and Partner teams to ensure every event delivers qualified meetings, pipeline contribution, and opportunity acceleration.

  • Manage budget and operations: Own accountability for the overall EMEA events budget, covering forecasting, spend management, and ROI analysis across the portfolio. Individual event budgets and vendor/agency relationships are managed by team members; your role is to maintain visibility, enforce financial discipline, and report consolidated performance to leadership.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Act as the connective tissue between Global Strategic Events and EMEA marketing functions — including PMM, Demand Generation, Partner Marketing, Brand, and Content — to ensure consistent messaging and seamless execution.

  • Innovate: Bring fresh ideas and formats that differentiate Snowflake in the market and keep the events programme ahead of the curve.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in B2B event or field marketing, with 3+ years in leadership roles managing teams and large-scale event portfolios.

  • Proven track record delivering strategic events that drive pipeline and revenue in enterprise technology or SaaS.

  • Strong people leader with experience managing distributed teams — comfortable stepping into an established team structure and maintaining momentum from day one.

  • Exceptional executive presence, with the ability to engage confidently with C-level stakeholders, both internal and external.

  • Experience leading annual events planning: building a portfolio case, a budget and goals, and securing both cross-functional and leadership buy-in.

  • Highly collaborative, with a natural ability to align multiple marketing functions and global/regional stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing significant event budgets and ROI analysis.

  • Comfortable stepping into an established team and programme mid-flight, building context quickly, and delivering impact within a fixed-term engagement.

  • Willing to travel across EMEA as needed, including on-site at major events.

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent professional experience preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Capacity Planning
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager of Capacity Planning, you will:

  • Own the capacity planning program end-to-end — from demand forecasting and resource modeling to procurement coordination and delivery tracking across Snowflake's multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Drive cross-functional alignment between Engineering, Infrastructure, Finance, and Cloud Provider teams to ensure capacity meets projected growth, seasonal demand spikes, and new product launches

  • Build and improve forecasting models and frameworks that translate business growth signals, customer onboarding patterns, and workload trends into actionable infrastructure capacity plans

  • Establish governance and review cadences — own weekly/monthly capacity reviews with engineering leadership, surface risks and tradeoffs, and drive decisions on resource allocation and prioritization

  • Identify and mitigate capacity risks proactively — monitor utilization trends, flag bottlenecks, single points of failure, and lead constraint resolution before they become customer-impacting

  • Partner closely with engineering teams to understand workload characteristics, architecture changes, and new feature launches that affect capacity requirements

  • Drive efficiency and optimization programs — identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve utilization, and right-size infrastructure spend without compromising performance or availability

  • Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity health, spend trajectory, and delivery timelines

  • Influence infrastructure strategy by providing data-driven recommendations on cloud provider mix, reserved vs. on-demand strategy, and long-term capacity investments

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Required:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical program management, infrastructure planning, capacity management, or a related discipline at a cloud-scale technology company

  • Demonstrated experience managing programs across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP)

  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, networking, containerization, and resource orchestration

  • Experience with demand forecasting, resource modeling, and data-driven decision-making at scale

  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional programs spanning engineering, finance, and operations with VP/Director-level stakeholders

  • Excellent communication skills — ability to synthesize complex technical and financial data into clear executive-ready narratives

  • Strong program management fundamentals: dependency tracking, risk management, milestone governance, and stakeholder alignment

Preferred:

  • Experience with infrastructure capacity planning at hyperscale (10K+ node deployments or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with cloud cost management and FinOps principles

  • Experience with data platforms, data warehousing, or database infrastructure

  • Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent)

  • Background in building or improving automated capacity planning systems and tooling

  • Experience operating in a fast-growth, high-ambiguity environment where priorities shift quickly

SNOWFLAKE VALUES WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Get It Done — You thrive on turning ambiguity into executable plans and delivering outcomes, not just status updates

  • Own It — You treat the capacity program as yours end-to-end, anticipating risks rather than reacting to them

  • Integrity Always — You make data-driven recommendations even when they're uncomfortable, and communicate tradeoffs transparently

  • Think Big — You don't just plan for today's scale — you build the frameworks that prepare Snowflake for 10x growth

COMPENSATION

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. The base salary range and total on-target earnings for this role are listed below. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

MarketBase Salary RangeTotal Target CompensationUS-Mrkt 1 (Bay Area, NYC, Seattle)$194,000 – $291,000$223,100 – $334,650US-Mrkt 2$165,000 – $248,000$189,750 – $285,200US-Mrkt 3$155,000 – $233,000$178,250 – $267,950

In addition to base salary and bonus, this role is eligible for equity in the form of RSUs and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP, generous PTO, and more.

WHY SNOWFLAKE?

  • Join one of the fastest-growing enterprise technology companies in the world

  • Work on infrastructure that powers AI and data workloads at global scale

  • Collaborate with world-class engineering talent across Menlo Park, Bellevue, and beyond

  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and benefits that support you and your family

  • A culture that values ownership, speed, and delivering results

Snowflake is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Senior Solution Engineer (Expansion Patch)

As a Senior Solution Engineer, you will be a strategic technical leader for Snowflake’s existing enterprise customers in Singapore, with a primary focus on Financial Services (FSI) and Digital Native sectors.

You will partner closely with Account Executives to drive adoption, workload expansion, and multi‑line-of-business growth across your accounts. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior technical and business stakeholders, guiding them on how to use Snowflake as the core of their data, analytics, and AI strategy.

This is a field-facing, customer-first role that combines deep technical skills, strong industry context , and the ability to design and communicate high‑impact architectures.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Drive Adoption in Existing Accounts

  • Own the technical expansion strategy for a portfolio of Snowflake customers in Singapore.

  • Identify and map customer business objectives to workloads, use cases, and lines of business that will benefit from Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

Solution Design, Demos & POCs

  • Design and deliver compelling demos and technical narratives tailored to each customer’s architecture and use cases.

  • Lead and execute POCs/Pilots that prove value and de‑risk platform decisions, including success criteria definition and joint execution plans.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value and ROI for senior non-technical audiences.

Cross-Functional & Partner Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Partners to ensure successful customer outcomes.

  • Work with SI, ISV, and cloud partners to incorporate their solutions into customer architectures where relevant.

  • Capture and relay field feedback to Product and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities.

Thought Leadership & Evangelism

  • Represent Snowflake at customer workshops, executive briefings, industry events, and community meetups.

  • Create and share technical content (presentations, reference architectures, playbooks, demos).

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Extensive 10 years working experience in customer facing solution engineering role

  • Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science, Gen AI and Data Apps

  • Open Data Architecture Mastery: Proven experience implementing or migrating architectures to Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi. Solid understanding of object storage optimization (Parquet/ORC layouts) and catalog management (Project Nessie, Polaris, Hive Metastore).

  • Data Engineering Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Extensive experience with distributed compute frameworks (Apache Spark, PySpark) and modern data stack tools like dbt.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience architecting data solutions within major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), specifically around networking and security .

  • Excellent ability to present to both technical and executive audiences, whether through impromptu whiteboarding or structured presentations and demos.

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL & Spark

STRONGLY DESIRED:

  • Experience with large-scale cloud data and ai platforms

  • Programming/scripting experience (e.g., Python, Java, Spark)

  • Experience selling or supporting enterprise data/analytics platforms

  • Strong stakeholder management and value-based selling skills

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field skills

ADDED BONUS FOR:

  • Hands-on experience with Lakehouse architectures

  • Hands-On experience in Data Science / AI / ML / Generative AI workloads and integrations in multi-stack Data and AI estate

  • Cloud platform experience: AWS, Azure, or GCP

  • Ability to travel on short notice for in-person customer meetings in ASEAN countries (Malaysia, Indonesia)

  • Working knowledge of regional financial services technology regulations, including Singapore MAS TRM, Malaysia BNM RMiT, and Indonesia OJK IT Risk Management frameworks.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager - AppEx
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a hybrid role based in our Menlo Park or Bellevue office. You will split your time between working on-site with your engineering, product, and leadership partners and working remotely, giving you dedicated in-person time for planning, alignment, and the high-stakes conversations where being in the room matters.

AS A STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Define and own the program strategy for AppEx's highest-impact initiatives, spanning application surfaces, developer tooling, AI-powered experiences, and the underlying platform, from initial framing through launch and adoption

  • Lead programs that cross AppEx sub-orgs (Applications, Notebooks, Native Apps, Drivers, AIML, Developer Platform) and extend into partner organizations across Snowflake, driving alignment where no single team owns the outcome

  • Partner with Directors, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Principal Engineers to shape multi-quarter roadmaps, make tradeoff decisions explicit, and build execution plans that hold up under real-world complexity

  • Drive cross-org decisions on shared APIs, integration points, and developer-facing launches that touch multiple Snowflake product surfaces

  • Diagnose systemic friction in how AppEx plans and delivers, and design the operating mechanisms, including AI-assisted workflows, that improve engineering velocity and predictability across the org

  • Represent AppEx programs to executive leadership with clear, data-backed narratives, recommendations, and escalations that drive decisions

  • Raise the bar for technical program management across AppEx by mentoring other TPMs and establishing practices the wider organization adopts

OUR IDEAL STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of technical program management experience, ideally at a cloud software company, with a track record of owning complex, multi-team programs end to end

  • Experience leading programs at organization-wide scope, where success depended on aligning several teams with competing priorities and no shared reporting line

  • Deep familiarity with developer-facing products or platform engineering, and an understanding of what it takes to build great developer experiences and ship them at scale

  • Strong technical depth: you work directly with engineers and architects, go deep on system design and dependencies when needed, and keep execution on track

  • A proven ability to influence without authority across Engineering, Product, Design, and Go-to-Market

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining structure and direction where none exists and making progress before all the answers are clear

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, effective with engineers, executive stakeholders, and everyone in between

  • Experience with modern cloud-native software development, including CI/CD, release management, and API-first development

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience delivering AI/ML or generative AI products, such as LLM-powered features, agentic applications, or AI developer tooling, including the evaluation, quality, and launch-readiness challenges unique to them

  • Working familiarity with GenAI concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation, agents, model evaluation, and inference cost tradeoffs, enough to engage credibly with engineers on design decisions

  • A habit of using AI tools in your own work to plan, track, and communicate programs, and an appetite for finding new ways AI can make engineering organizations faster

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, data platforms, or developer tooling products such as Streamlit, Notebooks, Native Apps, Cortex, or Spark

  • Experience driving developer ecosystem programs such as SDKs, drivers, or work adjacent to developer relations

  • A track record of building data-driven program health mechanisms that leadership relies on for decisions

  • Experience in a high-growth technology company environment

WHY JOIN THE APPEX TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

AppEx is one of the most cross-cutting and high-visibility engineering organizations at Snowflake. The team owns the developer-facing surface area: the products developers open every morning to build, analyze, and deploy. From Streamlit's growth as a first-class app framework, to Notebooks as a unified analytics environment, to Native Apps enabling Snowflake's application ecosystem, to Cortex Code bringing AI-native development to the data cloud, AppEx ships the surfaces that define how the world experiences Snowflake.

As a Staff TPM, you will operate at the intersection of these surfaces, owning the programs that connect them and shaping how the organization delivers. Success in this role is measured not by outputs delivered, but by decisions influenced and outcomes improved.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Team

Snowflake engineering takes pride in building highly reliable and scalable products.In the era of autonomous AI agents and continuous deployment, a traditional testing model breaks down under massive PR volume. Our AI pilled engineers treat validation as a scalable, developer-first platform. The Release Validation Team builds test frameworks that make continuous deployment safe, cost-efficient, and agent-friendly. Our customers are Snowflake engineers and their army of agents. How do Snowflake engineers keep their agents running autonomous for hours and days, landing quality PRs with human interventions? They rely on layers of validation that agents can execute in high-fidelity production simulation.

We give Snowflake the confidence to ship at speed without compromising Snowflake’s core brand promise: extreme reliability.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and grow the team. Hire, mentor, and develop engineers working on test infrastructure, automation, and developer tooling. Build a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and focus on the customer.

  • Set strategy and roadmap. Define and drive the multi-quarter vision for release validation: faster signals, fewer blockers, better test quality, and lower cost.

  • Own the validation platform. Be accountable for the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our distributed regression and workload test frameworks, pre-production environments, and release validation pipeline..

  • Improve test health across the company. Work with feature teams to reduce flaky, non-hermetic, duplicate, and low-value tests, and set standards and incentives that keep them healthy.

  • Cut down release blockers. Lead efforts to improve how failures are traced to their cause, filter out noise from infrastructure problems, and speed up triage so real regressions reach the owning team quickly.

  • Drive AI and automation. Invest in AI-driven failure analysis and automated routing that remove manual work for engineers across Snowflake.

  • Work across teams. Act as the main partner to Release Engineering and engineering leaders on release quality

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience hiring, coaching, and developing engineers at different career stages.

  • Experience building and running large-scale CI/CD, test infrastructure, or developer productivity platforms, ideally for complex distributed systems.

  • A strong technical background, with enough depth to review designs, make architecture tradeoffs, and earn the respect of senior engineers.

  • A solid grasp of test strategy: regression vs. workload testing, hermeticity, flakiness, coverage tradeoffs, and release gating.

  • Experience driving work across many teams and influencing without authority.

  • A data-driven leadership style: you set measurable goals and use metrics to prioritize and show impact.

  • Strong communication skills, including explaining complex technical tradeoffs to both engineers and executives.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
