jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer 2 - OLTP
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Principal Software Engineer 2 - OLTP

Snowflake is building the next generation of transactional systems for applications, AI and agents. Across Snowflake Postgres and Unistore, we are combining the performance, reliability and developer experience expected from modern operational databases with Snowflake's cloud-native architecture and governed data platform.

We're looking for a Principal Engineer 2 to help define and drive the architecture across database internals, storage, compute and cloud infrastructure. A core part of the role is designing transactional systems for agent-driven workloads, where isolated state, rapid database lifecycle, safe autonomous operations, and deep integration with enterprise data are first-class requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the long-term technical architecture for OLTP across Snowflake Postgres, Unistore and the infrastructure they depend on.

  • Lead major architectural decisions across transactions, storage, concurrency control, replication, recovery, query execution and database scalability.

  • Shape the compute and storage architecture for low-latency, highly available transactional systems, including resource isolation, elasticity, networking, caching and container infrastructure.

  • Build database primitives for agent-driven workloads, including fast creation of isolated transactional environments, checkpointing and rollback, and efficient lifecycle management.

  • Define how agents safely read and modify operational state, with strong guarantees around consistency, recovery, access control and governance.

  • Determine where PostgreSQL architecture and compatibility provide leverage and where alternative approaches can deliver meaningful advantages.

  • Design for workloads where databases and transactional environments are created and operated programmatically at machine speed rather than primarily through human administration.

  • Lead complex, cross-organizational engineering efforts and establish technical direction across multiple teams.

  • Work closely with product leaders, senior engineering leadership, and strategic customers on the most important technical and product decisions.

As an Account Executive on our UK Public Sector team, you will own the Defence territory: selling the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to the Ministry of Defence, defence primes, system integrators, and allied national security organisations. This is a mission-driven, field-based role for someone who understands how data transforms Defence outcomes and can navigate the sensitivities of secure and sovereign environments.

As an Account Executive you will:

  • Prospect, win, and onboard net-new Defence logos across the UK, breaking into MOD commands, defence primes, and strategic SIs that are not yet Snowflake customers

  • Run complex, consultative sales cycles that align the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to mission priorities such as readiness, logistics, intelligence, and command and control

  • Position Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, and secure data sharing for sovereign, air-gapped, and high-assurance workloads

  • Partner with Solution Engineers to design architectures that meet Defence security, residency, and accreditation requirements

  • Navigate UK public sector procurement, including G-Cloud, Digital Outcomes, and framework and direct-award routes

  • Build trusted relationships with mission owners, programme leads, and procurement, from technical practitioners to senior leadership

  • Collaborate with partners, resellers, and cleared delivery teams to land and expand mission-critical data programmes

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline through the full sales cycle, from qualification to close and expansion

Our Ideal Account Executive Will Have:

  • 5+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, or data platform sales experience, with consistent quota overachievement

  • A proven track record selling into UK Defence

  • Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and long-horizon programme engagements

  • Working knowledge of UK public sector procurement frameworks and the realities of secure or classified environments

  • Fluency in articulating the value of data, analytics, and AI to mission outcomes

  • Strong commercial discipline across territory planning, forecasting, and negotiation

  • The ability to hold or obtain UK security clearance (SC or above) as required by the territory

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience selling cloud data platforms, data warehousing, or AI and machine learning solutions

  • An existing network across MOD, defence primes, or allied agencies

  • Familiarity with secure data sharing, data sovereignty, and high-assurance deployment patterns

  • Experience working alongside system integrators and cleared delivery partners

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Prepare financial statements and notes to accounts in accordance with local GAAP and internal policies.

  • Convert US GAAP trial balances to local GAAP or IFRS, reconcile balances periodically, and document GAAP differences.

  • Ensure entries in the local GAAP ERP are recorded accurately and on time.

  • Partner with the Tax team to provide information for interim and final tax provisions.

  • Prepare and review balance sheet account reconciliations.

  • Establish audit timelines with external auditors and standardize prepared-by-client (PBC) lists.

  • Communicate audit requirements and deadlines to stakeholders, monitor progress, resolve queries, and drive audits to completion.

  • Manage statutory filings, including certified annual financial statements and supporting documents required by local authorities.

  • Review financial close activities regularly to identify and resolve unusual items.

  • Collaborate with global Accounting Operations and cross-functional teams, including Tax, HR, Legal, and Compliance.

  • Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Maintain organized, accessible records and ensure timely data backups in accordance with internal policies.

  • Identify and implement accounting and process improvements to streamline operations.

  • Research changes to accounting standards, income tax regulations, and compliance requirements, and assess their impact.

  • Prepare disclosure checklists and ensure compliance with applicable accounting and disclosure requirements.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Deal Desk Manager for our Deal Desk team. This is a strategic, high-influence role at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations, where your commercial judgment shapes how Snowflake structures its most complex transactions and advances the deal frameworks that underpin our go-to-market motion.

AS A DEAL DESK MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales VPs and executive leadership on the structure, negotiation, and approval of complex, high-value transactions across Snowflake's Acquisitions and Enterprise accounts.

  • Own and drive deal strategy for a portfolio of strategic opportunities, setting the analytical and commercial framing that enables Sales leadership to make confident decisions at speed.

  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Accounting, Professional Services, and Operations, ensuring deal processes scale with Snowflake's growth and complexity.

  • Define, design, and continuously improve deal policies, approval frameworks, and escalation paths, serving as a primary voice on what good deal governance looks like at Snowflake.

  • Synthesize deal concession data and commercial trends into structured insights that directly inform Finance and Sales leadership decisions.

  • Mentor and develop junior Deal Desk team members, raising the overall capability of the team through coaching on deal structuring, commercial judgment, and stakeholder communication.

  • Partner with Sales Enablement and Operations to drive adoption of improved deal processes across the field, influencing behavior at scale.

  • Champion AI-assisted deal workflows and automation tooling to accelerate review cycles and free the team to focus on strategic judgment over process administration.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR DEAL DESK MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of experience in deal desk, commercial finance, contracts, or sales operations, with a demonstrated track record of owning complex deal cycles end-to-end.

  • Ability to read, understand, and draft contractual business terms and conditions for complex, multi-year transactions.

  • Deep understanding of revenue recognition principles and US GAAP, and their practical application in SaaS and consumption-based commercial models.

  • Proven ability to influence executive-level stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills that translate complexity into clarity across all levels of the organization.

  • Experience defining or significantly evolving deal policies and approval frameworks within a high-growth organization.

  • Ability to work across functional boundaries, building credibility and alignment with Legal, Finance, Sales, and Operations without formal authority.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to surface patterns in deal data and translate them into actionable guidance for leadership.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Previous experience with complex contract negotiations and long enterprise sales cycles.

  • Exposure to AI-assisted contract review or deal intelligence tooling.

  • Background working cross-functionally on GTM transformation or commercial strategy initiatives.

  • Experience scaling deal desk operations in a hypergrowth environment.

WHY JOIN OUR DEAL DESK TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Our Deal Desk team sits at the forefront of Snowflake's growth, working in close partnership with the Sales organization on the most complex and strategic transactions the company pursues. You'll operate at the center of every major deal, coordinating across Sales, Legal, Finance, and Operations to move opportunities from concept to close. In this role, you'll build relationships at every level of the company and have a direct line of sight to the decisions that drive Snowflake's revenue.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Build the future of data. Join the Snowflake team.

Snowflake is building the future of data and AI. Our public sector partners play a critical role in helping federal agencies modernize their data environments, improve mission outcomes, and deliver better services to constituents.

As Federal Partner Development Manager, you will build and execute joint go-to-market strategies with a portfolio of strategic partners, including Global System Integrators (GSIs), cloud and technology partners, and value-added resellers (VARs). You will align Snowflake and partner sales teams around priority federal accounts, create actionable business plans, and develop programs that generate partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue.

This role combines executive relationship management, sales strategy, partner activation, and operational discipline. You will work across sales, solution engineering, professional services, marketing, product, legal, and public sector leadership to help partners develop Snowflake expertise, bring differentiated solutions to federal customers, and scale repeatable routes to market.

Success will be measured by net-new partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won opportunities, partner activation and competency growth, execution of joint GTM programs, and the quality of the customer and partner experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Management: Own the alliance development lifecycle for your assigned partners, from strategy and business planning through pipeline management and execution. Identify priority federal customer targets and establish joint GTM initiatives with clear owners, milestones, and metrics.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with sales, sales engineering, professional services, product, legal, and marketing to deliver a seamless partner and customer experience. Share partner and customer insights with internal teams to drive continuous improvement, and work with technical experts to build solutions with partners.

  • Co-Marketing: Plan and execute co-marketing activities, including events, webinars, and content, to increase partner visibility and generate qualified leads.

  • Deal Support: Help partners navigate Snowflake's partner program and sales process, including deal registration, proposal support, and reporting. Align with Sales Leadership and internal teams to keep sales cycles smooth and efficient.

  • Performance Delivery: Monitor partner performance against defined metrics, including sourced pipeline, partner activation, and competency growth. Shift priorities, take calculated risks, and think creatively to deliver results while managing multiple priorities at scale.

  • Build AI-First Operating Practices: Use Snowflake CoWork, CoCo, Salesforce, Slack, and related tools to streamline partner planning, opportunity tracking, deal registration, executive briefings, and partner scorecards. Identify repeatable workflows that can be automated or augmented with AI, and experiment responsibly to improve speed, visibility, and decision quality. Experience building MCP-based workflows or applying AI to sales and partner operations is a strong plus.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. We look for AI-native thinkers who are curious, low-ego, and energized by reinventing how work gets done. You treat AI as a high-trust collaborator, thrive in fast-moving environments, and rapidly test emerging capabilities to find simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results.

Desired Experience

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager, Planning
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Revenue Operations team is hiring a Sales Operations Manager to own planning operations for our Partner and Product Specialist organizations. In this role, you'll run complex planning workstreams end to end, including territory design, quota setting, capacity planning, and in-year quota management. You'll be the trusted expert that Partner and Specialist leaders come to for methodology, tradeoffs, and decisions. At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise and we are building an AI-native planning organization. That means AI does the analysis and production work, and you own the judgment and decisions. You'll be expected to turn your expertise into reusable skills, self-service tools, and automated workflows that grow the team's impact.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of territories, quotas, and compensation plans for Partner and Specialist organizations across all geographies, and drive alignment with Finance, Commissions, HR, and Field Ops.

  • Define and govern global policies for account moves, quota changes, and in-year adjustments, including the methodology, guardrails, documentation, and change management behind them.

  • Lead quota and attainment reviews across global Partner and Specialist teams. You'll find root causes, surface tradeoffs, and drive resolution with senior stakeholders.

  • Anticipate how changes affect the field, Commissions, reporting, and systems, and design scalable solutions instead of one-time fixes.

  • Translate business requirements into process, data, and tooling changes in Pigment, Salesforce, and Snowflake.

  • Design workflows that produce decision-ready outputs, with methodology, confidence levels, and edge cases surfaced and validation built in from the start.

  • Encode institutional knowledge, such as quota methodology, territory logic, and planning rules, in versioned skills and documentation that capture the why along with the how.

  • Build and maintain production AI skills that encode planning methodology, validation logic, and recurring analysis for your domain. If a task runs more than twice, it should be a skill.

  • Lead small cross-functional project teams, present recommendations to senior leadership, and drive decisions forward.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 6 to 8+ years of experience in GTM strategy, planning, or sales operations, ideally at a high-growth enterprise technology company.

  • A track record of owning complex planning work-streams end to end, such as territory design, quota setting, capacity modeling, or compensation operations.

  • Experience solving ambiguous, cross-functional problems where the path isn't defined, especially during periods of rapid growth.

  • Strong influence skills with senior stakeholders, including the ability to frame tradeoffs clearly and move a group to a decision.

  • Hands-on experience building automated or AI-assisted workflows, such as scripts, bots, AI skills, or self-service tools, that replaced manual work, with the results to show for it (hours saved, errors caught, cycles shortened).

  • Deep experience with Salesforce and sales planning platforms such as Pigment or Anaplan.

  • A bachelor's degree in business, statistics, economics, or another quantitative field. An MBA is a plus.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company's confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company's data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Our UK enterprise sales team is expanding, and we seek a seasoned, outcomes-focused Account Executive to lead our net new logo acquisition efforts across the UK market. In this role, you will use disciplined, business-aligned prospecting to strategically pursue new businesses and win net new logos, selling the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to business and technology stakeholders.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own net new logo acquisition across a defined UK territory, building and executing a target prospect list and regional sales plan to consistently land greenfield accounts on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Prospect, develop, and close complex new business, articulating the value of Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, and the Data Sharing and Marketplace ecosystem to C-level and technical buyers.

  • Run disciplined discovery calls, facilitate customised demos, and deliver value-driven use cases that solve prospects' business pain points.

  • Be a multi-threaded, trusted advisor by understanding each prospect's business and IT roadmap to drive Snowflake adoption across the organisation.

  • Work intimately with Snowflake partners and service providers in the UK market to accelerate value realisation for net new customers.

  • Achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas by executing an enterprise complex sales strategy grounded in MEDDPICC or a similar methodology.

  • Collaborate across sales leadership, sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal, and finance to land and expand new accounts.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding quota, selling technical solutions and SaaS into the enterprise market.

  • Proven experience winning large, complex, net new logos in the UK enterprise market.

  • Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies within one of the following spaces: Public Cloud, Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science, or AI/ML.

  • A solution-based approach to selling, with strong command of a complex sales process, excellent presentation and listening skills, and strong organisation and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our brand and company like it is your own, defining and executing sales plans that meet strategic and financial targets by leveraging industry, partner, and Go-to-Market knowledge.

  • The ability to provide open, honest, and respectful feedback that contributes to an inclusive work environment.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Quantifiable C-level relationships within top UK enterprise accounts.

  • Experience selling data, analytics, or AI platforms into greenfield accounts.

  • A track record of building territory from the ground up in a competitive, fast-moving market.

  • Familiarity with partner-led and ecosystem-driven Go-to-Market motions.

Solution Engineer

____

Why Snowflake ?

Snowflakeはデータ革命の最前線に立ち、世界最高のデータとアプリケーションのプラットフォームの構築に取り組んでいます。私たちのミッションはデータサイロ化を解消して、「世界中のデータをモビライズすること」を目指しております。急成長していくデータの未来を私たちと共に築いていきましょう！

Solution Engineering team’s Mission ?

当社では、お客様の複雑な課題を解決し、大規模な案件に経験のあるシニアソリューションエンジニアを募集しています。シニアソリューションエンジニアはセールスチームやチャネルパートナーと協業して、お客様のニーズを理解し、セールスサイクルを元に案件支援を計画して、説得力のある価値志向のデモンストレーションを提供し、お客様のPoCをサポートし、案件の成約まで支援します。Snowflakeのソリューションエンジニアとして、「データ領域を再定義する」という当社の情熱を共有し、変化の激しい環境でも積極的に自ら関与して実行する柔軟性と意欲をが求められているます。ビジネスと技術の両方において、エグゼクティブと会話、技術的な方々と話をします。

The Impact You will Make

  • 見込み客やお客様のエグゼクティブやIT技術者にSnowflakeのテクノロジーやビジョンのプレゼンテーションを実施

  • 見込み客やお客様に対してデモやPoCなどの方法で営業サイクル全体を通してSnowflakeテクノロジーの価値を実証

  • 進化し続ける業界に身を置き、競合他社や関連する技術やベンダーを理解し、Snowflakeをどのようにポジショニングするかの理解

  • 製品管理、エンジニアリング、マーケティングと協力して、Snowflakeの製品改善やマーケティング活動を実施

 

Who You Are

  • 5〜8年の業界経験を持ち、プリセールス環境で3年以上の経験をお持ちの方

  • ホワイトボードでの即席プレゼンテーションやデモの使用など、技術者とエグゼクティブの両方へのプレゼンテーションスキル

  • 大規模なデータベース、データウェアハウス技術、ETL、アナリティクス、クラウドテクノロジーの幅広い経験

  • SQLとSQLアナリティクスのハンズオン知識

  • 顧客の具体的なビジネス上の課題とSnowflakeのソリューションを結びつける提案スキル

  • コンピュータサイエンス、エンジニアリング、数学、または関連分野の大卒、または同等の経験をお持ちの方

  • 日本語と英語に堪能な方

 

Japan Benefits（一部）

  • Free lunch at office

  • 401K（企業型確定拠出年金）

  • RSU

  • Phone & Gym reimbursement

  • 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Traffic & Networking
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a visionary Director of Traffic and Networking to lead the group responsible for the very circulatory system of our global cloud infrastructure.

The Mission

Every query, every login, every byte of data in Snowflake's Data Cloud travels through the systems this team builds. The Traffic & Networking group is responsible for the ingress, egress, domain management, and internal networking layers that connect thousands of customers to Snowflake across public and private connectivity paths. We build and deploy software to enable seamless service-to-service and user-to-service communication across all traffic types spanning every environment and cloud provider Snowflake touches. Your goal is to ensure robust domain management, efficient traffic flow, and reliable connectivity while relentlessly improving product velocity, and operational efficiency.

What You Will Do

As a senior engineering leader at Snowflake, you will be expected to:

  • Set the Strategic Vision: Define the roadmap for Snowflake’s networking foundation and be accountable for the execution of complex plans and deliverables.

  • Scale Infrastructure: Guide your team in building software solutions that automate and scale networking across multiple cloud providers including AWS, Azure, and GCP.

  • Drive Innovation: Lead projects from initial idea through design and implementation, collaborating with teams in the US, Ireland, Poland, and beyond.

  • Technical Leadership: Provide deep technical expertise with a focus on high-performance, security, and the abstraction of complex cloud networking layers.

  • Build the Team: Actively recruit, hire, and grow a diverse team of industry veterans and rising stars.

  • Mentorship: Be responsible for the career development of your reports through continuous coaching and mentorship.

  • Operational Excellence: Shift resources dynamically to respond to production issues and customer needs, ensuring high levels of reliability.

Your Professional Profile

We are looking for an exceptional leader who views infrastructure through a product development lens.

  • Experience: 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management leading leaders.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record in designing systems and managing large-scale production infrastructure with a focus on networking, compute, or storage

  • Cloud Fluency: Strong hands-on experience with cloud service providers.

  • SaaS Background: Deep experience working at scale within a multi-tenant or multi-single-tenant SaaS model, handling billions of complex queries and massive traffic ingress/egress.

  • Communication: Excellent collaboration skills to bridge the gap between complex networking requirements and cross-functional business goals.

  • Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why Join This Team?

  • Impact: You're actively evolving a network architecture, building new observability capabilities, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and designing the next-generation connectivity model across multiple clouds. Every Snowflake team depends on what this group ships. Infrastructure is our product.

  • Growth: This role will push your technical and leadership boundaries in an environment that values practical decision-making and creativity.

  • Security First: You will play a critical role in upholding Snowflake’s high standards for data security and confidentiality.

  • Builder's Culture: We ship our own proxy infrastructure, our own service discovery, our own network automation. This is a build role for someone who wants to own the full traffic stack.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for a well-rounded Brand Designer to join our Brand Design team, reporting into the Sr Manager, Corporate Design. You’ll help define and refine Snowflake’s visual foundations by developing core brand assets and templates that inform and evolve our design system and guidelines. You will also develop creative concepts and design for priority content marketing initiatives, including eBooks and related integrated marketing campaign assets, and contribute to executive, product launch and strategic presentations.

You bring strong conceptual design, typography, layout and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex content into clear, compelling design. You are a systems thinker at heart and enjoy exploring new ideas and translating them into practical, scalable systems. You can manage your projects, collaborate with internal and external partners and explain your design thinking with clarity and confidence. You bring strong attention to detail and craft to your work.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop and refine Snowflake’s visual brand foundations, including but not limited to typography, photography, graphics, diagrams and data visualization

  • Create, evolve and expand core brand assets, foundational templates and toolkits that help internal teams and external partners apply the brand consistently

  • Help develop brand guidelines through design exploration, clear usage principles and application examples

  • Develop creative concepts and design for priority content marketing initiatives and programs, including eBooks and related promo assets

  • Design executive, product launch and strategic presentations, including Tier1 keynotes

  • Collaborate with marketing, producers, production, content, motion and video teams to ensure cohesive brand expression and high-quality design outputs.

  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously to ensure timely delivery.

  • AI-Native Processes: Using Snowflake agentic AI products (CoCo, CoWork) conceptualize and build improvements and innovations within our workflows,

    WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 7-10 years of brand/graphic design experience, ideally in mid-to-large tech and creative agency environments

  • Mastery of and continued learning for industry-standard applications, including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, PowerPoint, and Google Slides

  • Strong conceptual design skills and a portfolio demonstrating typography, layout, visual storytelling and consistent brand application

  • Strong understanding and experience in developing and working within evolving brand systems

  • Systems-thinking with a collaborative and open mindset, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-volume and fast-paced environment

  • Technical expertise preparing deliverables for digital and print

  • Ability to advocate for the work, including brief-building with stakeholders to define a project’s parameters, thoughtful discovery and problem-solving, and excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present work to diverse stakeholders

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong concepts, exceptional craft and versatility across brand systems, digital and print content, and presentations, with clarity on your role in each project

  • Natural curiosity around AI tools and processes — you want to jump in to conceptualize and build AI processes that support creative exploration, accelerate workflows, and push visual innovation


PREFERRED SKILLS AND EDUCATION

  • Proven impact at scale—ideally a mix of mid-to-large tech and creative agency experience

  • Bonus points for basic animation skills (Figma animation, etc.)

  • Experience designing executive keynote presentations

  • Bachelor’s degree in Art, Graphic Design, Marketing Communications, or related field (or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience)


LET’S DO THIS!

The Snowflake Brand & Creative team is a tight-knit, dynamic group of creators and makers who are responsible for shaping the future of the Snowflake brand. We’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. If you want to play a part in creating this global iconic brand, we want to hear from you!

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Productivity
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world’s leading data platforms.

The Team:

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Productivity for our Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake.

As part of Engineering Productivity at Observe by Snowflake, you will empower engineering teams across the organization by building scalable developer tools, robust build and test infrastructure, and automated release systems. Working at the intersection of developer experience, build systems, AI agent systems, and cloud infrastructure, you will play a critical role in driving engineering velocity and reliability at scale.

In this role your will:

  • Design, build, and maintain internal tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and AI agent based developer workflows

  • Build and scale test infrastructure and test execution frameworks to accelerate developer feedback loops

  • Improve developer velocity, developer and agent environment tooling, as well as local debugging/testing workflows

  • Partner with development, infrastructure, and SRE teams to streamline release engineering, deployment reliability, and artifact management

  • Monitor and optimize build times, test flakiness, and CI performance across the engineering organization

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on engineering productivity, developer tooling, agentic workflows, build systems, or release engineering

  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD systems, build orchestration tools (e.g., Bazel, Nix, Go build tooling), and test automation infrastructure

  • Strong proficiency in server-side languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++

  • Hands-on experience with containerization, cloud infrastructure, and release automation

  • Deep interest in developer experience, developer velocity metrics, and building developer-facing products

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in backend application development

  • Experience with open-source developer tools, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code

  • Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or distributed tracing and logging systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger)

  • Open-source contributions to observability, data infrastructure, or developer productivity projects

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

 - Strong proficiency in server-side languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++

 - Hands-on experience with containerization, cloud infrastructure, and release automation

 - Deep interest in developer experience, developer velocity metrics, and building developer-facing products




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience in backend application development

 - Experience with open-source developer tools, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code

 - Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or distributed tracing and logging systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger)

 - Open-source contributions to observability, data infrastructure, or developer productivity projects

jobs.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Frontier Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

LEAD. STRATEGIZE. TRANSFORM.

Summary

Frontier Engineering's mission is to engineer guaranteed customer outcomes on Snowflake, the trusted control plane for AI-first business. We bring Snowflake engineers, AI specialists, and industry experts together with customers to modernize their data foundations and put AI into production, delivering measurable ROI in weeks and months, not quarters and years. We operate through two transformation engines: Data Transformation, which helps customers migrate, modernize, consolidate, and govern the data foundation that AI depends on; and Agentic Transformation, which helps customers build agents, intelligent applications, and AI-powered workflows that reimagine how their business runs.

As our first Engagement Manager based in New Zealand, you will be Frontier Engineering's in-market leader for your accounts across both Data Transformation and Agentic Transformation, and the single point of accountability for engagement outcomes, from first conversation through scoping, contracting, delivery, and expansion. You will work hand-in-hand with New Zealand account teams and with our Australia-based Services Solution Managers and Sales Solution Architects as one team: you bring local customer intimacy, deal shaping, and delivery leadership; they bring commercial and technical scoping depth. Together you will sell, shape, and deliver Frontier Engineering engagements that turn into production outcomes: Snowflake consumption and realized customer value.

Why This Role?

  • Build a market: Be the founding Frontier Engineering Engagement Manager in New Zealand, shaping how Snowflake delivers outcomes for some of the country's most important organizations.

  • Sell, shape, and deliver: Own the engagement lifecycle end to end, with clear line of sight from a customer's business problem to the value delivered in production.

  • Work at the frontier: Lead engagements across both Data Transformation (migration, modernization, governance) and Agentic Transformation (agents, AI applications, intelligent workflows), bringing capabilities like Cortex, Horizon, Iceberg, and Openflow into production for customers.

  • Grow with us: A clear pathway to Principal level for those who demonstrate portfolio ownership, deal engineering, and market leadership.

What You'll Do

Sell & Shape

  • In-Market Pursuit Leadership: Be the local Frontier Engineering point of contact for New Zealand Account Executives; qualify opportunities with account teams and engage early with executive sponsors to identify the business problem worth solving.

  • Discovery & Value Shaping: Lead customer discovery and journey workshops in New Zealand that align on use-case priorities, target outcomes, and the business case; anchor every engagement to measurable value (revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction, faster time to value).

  • Deal Shaping in Partnership: Work with Services Solution Managers on commercial strategy, value-based pricing, proposals, and Statements of Work (SOWs), and with Sales Solution Architects on solution scoping and estimation. Pressure-test scope, assumptions, and estimates for deliverability and margin before contract, and support internal Deal Review and approval.

  • Forecast & Pipeline: Contribute to and maintain an accurate bookings forecast and pipeline for your New Zealand accounts alongside your Services Solution Manager and account team partners.

  • Account Expansion: Build services roadmaps with account teams and identify "white space" where new Snowflake capabilities solve customer business problems, turning point engagements into multi-phase transformation programs.

  • Partner Ecosystem: Work with SI, GSI, and ISV partners in New Zealand on co-delivery and co-sell approaches, extending delivery capacity under Frontier Engineering standards.

Deliver

  • Sales-to-Delivery Ownership: Own the handoff from pursuit to delivery, ensuring delivery readiness and that what was sold is what gets delivered; lead engagement kick-off to align stakeholders on scope, roles, timeline, and success metrics.

  • Integrated Execution: Lead engagements through go-live and close-out; manage Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), RAID logs, and critical-path scheduling to mitigate schedule variance across multi-workstream technical implementations.

  • Scope Protection: Identify scope creep in real time and negotiate protective Change Orders that safeguard project integrity and customer trust.

  • Financial Ownership: Own engagement financials, including revenue forecasting, budget burn-down, cost control, and high Estimate at Completion (EAC) accuracy, protecting margin while delivering customer satisfaction.

  • Escalation Leadership: Serve as the initial point of escalation for customers, partners, and project teams; lead decision-making in high-pressure situations.

  • Value Realization & Close-out: Drive knowledge transfer, final retrospectives, and value readouts; secure customer references and identify the next opportunity.

Advise & Improve

  • Executive Engagement: Engage C-level and VP stakeholders to create and execute services roadmaps that drive real business outcomes; communicate risks and wins with clarity and transparency.

  • Voice of the Customer: Translate field-level technical blockers into actionable feedback for Snowflake Product and Engineering teams.

  • Practice Contribution: Feed delivery learnings back into scoping and estimation with Sales Solution Architects, contribute to Frontier Engineering reusable assets and playbooks, and use AI-assisted workflows (e.g., Snowflake Cortex Code for SOW drafting and engagement summaries) to work faster and smarter.

  • Operational Hygiene: Maintain accurate Salesforce and financial system data for your portfolio, and support utilization of delivery resources.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • Experience: Typically a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.

  • Sales & Delivery Background: 10+ years in a Sales and Services Delivery role interfacing with executives on complex technical implementation projects such as cloud data warehouse and data platform implementation, modernization, or AI/ML adoption.

  • Track Record: Proven achievement of quantitative targets such as bookings, utilization, consumption, and delivery margin.

  • Deal Shaping: Demonstrated experience leading discovery, shaping scope and value propositions, and closing services deals as part of a sales team.

  • Execution Rigor: Hands-on mastery of project governance (WBS, RAID, critical path), change management, and project financials (EAC).

  • Executive Presence: Ability to command a room of C-suite executives while holding technical credibility in deep-dives with engineering and data science teams.

  • Domain Expertise: Direct experience across data platform modernization (data warehousing, migration, BI, cloud data platforms) and AI/ML or GenAI adoption, with the range to lead both data foundation and AI application engagements; able to pivot from a high-level architecture discussion to a detailed task breakdown.

  • Collaboration Across Distance: Proven ability to work as one team with sales, pre-sales, and delivery colleagues across locations, building trust and alignment without relying on co-location, as a remote-based team member.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable switching instantly between sales support, project governance, and hands-on crisis management, and managing multiple accounts and projects in parallel with a high degree of autonomy.

Bonus Points

  • Established network across New Zealand enterprise, government, or the local SI and partner community.

  • Big 5 or boutique strategy consulting experience.

  • Experience in a technical advisory role such as solution architect or technical account manager.

  • Hands-on project experience with the Snowflake AI Data Cloud or other cloud data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience building a services practice or team presence in a new market.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT FOR THE TEAM IF YOU:

  • Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and positive attitude with a passion for building customer relationships and closing new business opportunities. The Account Executive must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with Clients and support new customers through our on-boarding process.

  • You are driven to exceed performance objectives.

  • You are excited about being positioned right in the middle of the exploding cloud based economy and to develop and maintain a highly desired knowledge of Snowflake’s solutions.

  • You have an understanding of the Cloud application/computing space along with familiarity with data warehouse or analytic technologies.

  • You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills.

  • You have superb organization and contact management capabilities.

  • You are driven to achieve your mission and you love bringing the team together to achieve results together.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Build trusted relationships with Snowflake internal resources, external partners, and client account teams to qualify deals, identify business value, and provide technical guidance in order to set proper expectations to ensure customer satisfaction

  • Leverage knowledge of a domain or industry to align Snowflake’s value to the customers’ business and technical problems

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving technology and landscape while maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to deliver standard, customized and/or strategic solution demonstrations, white boarding, presentations, and best practices that showcase functional capabilities, competitive advantages, and business benefits of the Snowflake solutions throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation.

  • Guides customers in digital transformation and cloud adoption, understanding where Snowflake integrates with holistic architecture and strategy.

  • Provide ongoing, post-sales, technical guidance to the customer’s technical team to drive customer utilization of Snowflake and digital transformation success

 
 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 2+ years of field sales experience preferred with an emphasis on data, data analytics, database (SQL & NoSQL), ETL, or business intelligence.

  • Sales experience with emphasis on data, data analytics, database (SQL & NoSQL), ETL, or business intelligence preferred.

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Proven success in driving consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.

  • Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.

  • Proactive, independent thinking and a high energy/positive attitude.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • BA/BS preferred.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is on a mission to mobilize the world's data by changing the old-world paradigm of “bring data to compute” to “bring compute to the data”. Our innovative built-for-the-cloud architecture revolutionized the data warehousing industry with the flexibility of big data platforms and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of the cost of traditional solutions. Our products enable thousands of enterprises to unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance.

We are looking for a talented, passionate Software Engineering Manager for our Snowpark product to build our elastic, high-scale, high-performance, cloud-native compute platform that makes bringing compute to data effortless and simple. Our mission is to make Snowflake the preferred platform to run all AI, ML, Data Science, and Data Engineering workloads. We are building the next generation of compute platforms to open up Snowflake’s doors to limitless opportunities of discovering structure and unstructured data at scale. You will be part of a highly productive, fast-moving, and growing team that is critical to realizing Snowflake’s Data Cloud Mission. This team innovates on behalf of our customers to build a fully managed compute platform that enables our customers to leverage their data to solve business problems without needing to manage required compute infrastructure.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER FOR SNOWPARK, YOU WILL:

  • Provide technical and strategic direction leadership to define and build a full ecosystem of technologies, technical roadmap, and vision.

  • Plan, lead, and execute complex technical projects through your team that interact with a wide variety of teams within the company.

  • Anticipate future trends and evolving customer needs accurately and drive strategies appropriately.

  • Influence leadership on technical direction and product/team investment/pivot needs.

  • Create tools/processes/solutions that improve team productivity and efficiency.

  • Identify and lead improvements to product stability and reliability, on-call and service health, customer support, diagnosability, and manageability of the product.

  • Identify and fill skill and expertise gaps in the team.

  • Mentor and guide engineers, growing strong technical expertise within the team.

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of industry experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems platforms that accelerate product innovation.

  • 2+ years of full-time Software Engineering Management experience.

  • Strong passion for making developers highly productive and enabling them to be successful and grow in their career.

  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and serverless compute platforms (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Run functions, etc).

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world’s leading data platforms.

The Team:

We are hiring a Software Engineer, Enterprise for our Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake. As part of the Enterprise Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake, you’ll build and scale core features, APIs, and business logic powering a high-performance observability platform. You’ll develop reliable, production-grade systems designed to handle massive volumes of telemetry for enterprise customers. Working at the intersection of data, infrastructure, and user experience, you’ll help deliver solutions that enable fast, actionable insights at scale. This is an opportunity to own impactful systems that directly support the reliability and performance of some of the world’s largest organizations.

In this role your will:

  • Design, build, and own core features, APIs, and business logic powering a high-performance observability platform for enterprise customers

  • Take end-to-end ownership from technical scoping and architecture through deployment, ensuring systems meet enterprise reliability and performance standards

  • Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and data teams to deliver solutions that enable fast, actionable insights for engineering teams worldwide

  • Partner with SREs and customer-facing teams to diagnose and resolve production issues, applying AI-assisted workflows to accelerate root-cause analysis

  • Contribute to high engineering standards through thoughtful code review, mentorship, and architectural influence

Qualifications:

  • 2 - 5 years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on backend application systems or distributed platforms

  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems at scale, handling high throughput, low latency, and enterprise reliability requirements

  • Strong proficiency in one or more server-side languages such as Go, Java, Scala, Python, or similar

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical problems from scoping through delivery, without waiting to be directed

  • Experience collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a track record of shipping impactful, customer-facing work

  • A BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or distributed tracing and logging systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger)

  • Experience building or contributing to AI-assisted developer tools or LLM-integrated workflows

  • Background in SRE practices, incident response automation, or root-cause analysis tooling

  • Open-source contributions to observability, data infrastructure, or developer productivity projects

jobs.descriptionHtml:

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

Position Overview

Snowflake is looking for a Field Marketing Manager based in Brazil to drive field marketing initiatives across the region. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and measuring end-to-end field marketing campaigns designed to build market awareness and accelerate pipeline for Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud in Brazil. This is an Individual Contributor position.

Working as a key partner to the local Sales team, you will blend strategic planning with hands-on campaign delivery. You will design localized programs, ranging from executive roundtables and proprietary roadshows to third-party industry events and account-centric initiatives that engage key decision-makers and support territory revenue goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Field Marketing Strategy & Planning: Own and execute the field marketing strategy for Brazil in partnership with Sr. Field Marketing Manager, tailoring global and regional marketing priorities to address the local enterprise landscape and market dynamics.

  • Integrated Field Programs: Architect and deliver multi-touch programs, including regional roadshows, executive roundtables, and high-touch customer experiences designed to generate and accelerate pipeline and promote customer growth.

  • Brand Awareness & Local Market Penetration: Drive targeted marketing initiatives to increase brand recognition and position Snowflake as the leading AI Data Cloud across key industries in Brazil.

  • Sales Alignment: Build trusted partnerships with Account Executives and SDR teams to align field marketing strategy with territory targets and key accounts.

  • Campaign Localization & Content Delivery: Work with Product Marketing and Customer Marketing teams to localize domain-specific messaging, content, customer stories and campaign assets for the Brazilian market.

  • Lead Management & ROI Tracking: Manage end-to-end campaign operations, from lead capture and SDR follow-up enablement to analyzing program performance, tracking pipeline attribution, and optimizing marketing ROI.

  • Vendor & Agency Management: Oversee local event agencies, vendors, and suppliers to ensure flawless execution within budget and timeline expectations.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of B2B field marketing experience in enterprise software, SaaS, or data/tech solutions, with a track record of supporting enterprise sales teams in Brazil.

  • Level/Scope: Proven success as an individual contributor leading end-to-end campaign execution from concept to post-event lead flow and pipeline tracking.

  • Sales Partnership: Strong executive presence with a demonstrated ability to build credibility and strategic alignment with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams.

  • Language Skills: Fluency in both Portuguese and English (written and verbal) is required.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: Strong analytical capabilities with hands-on experience tracking pipeline attribution, program conversion metrics, and managing field budgets.

  • Marketing Tech Stack: Familiarity with enterprise CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase/6sense).

  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in Brazil without restrictions.

  • Work Arrangement & Travel: Willingness to adhere to Snowflake’s local hybrid work arrangement and travel within Brazil/LATAM as required for field events (up to 30–40%).

How Will You Make Your Impact?

In this high-visibility role, you will directly influence Snowflake’s expansion in Brazil. By partnering closely with Sales Leadership, designing high-impact field programs, and building strong local market presence, you will play a critical role in accelerating adoption of Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud across top enterprises in the region.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Warehouse UX pod at Snowflake. This team owns critical warehouse capabilities spanning features, billing, and usability across the warehouse experience. Warehouses are one of the most mission-critical parts of Snowflake’s platform and a major revenue driver for the company, making this an opportunity to work on high-impact systems at significant scale.

Despite the UX pod name, this is not a front-end role. This team builds backend distributed systems that power warehouse behavior, customer-facing warehouse capabilities, metering and billing-related functionality, and the reliability and usability of core warehouse workflows.

This role is best suited for an engineer with 4 to 7 years of experience who can independently drive medium-sized projects end to end, contribute effectively to larger cross-team efforts, and bring strong technical judgment to systems that matter deeply to customers and the business.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate backend software and distributed systems that power Snowflake Warehouses.

  • Own medium-sized engineering projects independently from design through delivery, and contribute to larger initiatives across the warehouse organization.

  • Build and evolve capabilities related to warehouse features, billing, and usability.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational health of warehouse systems in production.

  • Work across the full software lifecycle, including technical design, implementation, testing, rollout, on-call participation, issue triage, and follow-through on production improvements.

  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, and adjacent teams to deliver durable solutions to customer and business problems.

  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, maintainability, and long-term architectural health.

  • Use strong debugging and systems thinking to resolve complex production issues and improve service behavior over time.

  • Raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews, operational rigor, and clear technical communication.

  • Apply AI-assisted workflows where they increase engineering leverage, speed, or quality without compromising judgment.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • BS in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4 to 7 years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong programming, debugging, and software design skills in one or more modern languages.

  • Experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in production.

  • Ability to independently execute on medium-sized projects and deliver them to completion.

  • Ability to contribute as a strong technical partner on larger, cross-team projects.

  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and engineering best practices across design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.

  • Experience participating in on-call, production support, or incident response for live systems.

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, low-ego working style.

  • A customer-oriented mindset and good judgment about reliability, usability, and business impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or large-scale backend services.

  • Experience working on billing, metering, control plane systems, or customer-facing platform capabilities.

  • Familiarity with performance-sensitive or highly reliable production environments.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and breaking down complex technical problems into practical solutions.

Join Snowflake customers, partners, and data providers already taking their businesses to new frontiers in the AI Data Cloud.

 

WHO YOU ARE:

Snowflake is experiencing exponential growth, and we are expanding our Alliances team to help us scale. We are looking for a strategic leader to scale our most critical Technology partnerships. As Sr. Partner Development Manager, Strategic Platform & AI Partnerships, you will own the 360-degree relationship for high-value technology partners. The primary focus of the role is supporting our joint customers and sales teams with effective joint go-to-market and resell/co-sell success. Reporting to Snowflake’s Enterprise Technology Partner leader, you will have a unique opportunity to work for the AI Data Cloud and lead one of Snowflake’s most important strategic partnerships.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive theAmericas focused - North America and LATAM end-to-end strategy across co-sell, resell, marketing, and product integration pillars.

  • Partner with Snowflake's sales teams across North America and LATAM to hit annual sales targets and by developing sales plays to improve field collaboration.

  • Collaborate with technical experts to develop joint solutions and create high-impact enablement materials that highlight differentiators for both Snowflake and partner teams

  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with senior executives and partner with marketing teams to create compelling programs that highlight the value of joint solutions.

  • Foster deep relationships across Product, Legal, and Professional Services to ensure a seamless experience. Act as the voice of the partner by sharing insights to drive continuous platform improvement.

  • Coordinate co-marketing initiatives (events, webinars, content) and utilize Snowflake systems to track key metrics, including joint pipeline and deal registration.

     

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Over 12 years of relevant work experience, including a minimum of 8 years in sales and alliances and at least 3 years at a director level or higher.

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience leading an ISV partnership (particular interest in experience managing partnerships with Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle, and/or Box) that generated more than $10M in annual co-sell/resell revenue.

  • A proven history of success leading alliance partnerships and identifying mutual business interests, with a background in software and SaaS.

  • A highly analytical, data-driven, and strategic mindset, with the capability for creative problem-solving and pragmatic execution.

  • Strong verbal, executive presentation, and communication skills to effectively articulate the partnership's strategy and impact, with a history of success working with cross-functional teams.

  • A proven track record as a self-starter with a high degree of initiative and the ability to learn quickly.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Software Engineer – File Ingestion (Customer-Facing Services)

Build the Future of the AI Data Cloud

Snowflake’s File Ingestion team owns the core engines behind COPY INTO and Snowpipe — the primary arteries landing customer data into the AI Data Cloud at hundreds of petabytes per quarter.

We are expanding our core mission to build next-generation, external-facing ingestion services that directly expose file-ingest capabilities to external platforms, partner ecosystems, and customer applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the architectural vision and execution for these mission-critical, customer-facing services. You will operate at the intersection of high-throughput distributed systems, API platform design, and direct customer feature delivery, defining how enterprise data seamlessly flows into Snowflake at global scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Technical Vision & Architecture: Define the multi-year architecture and technical strategy for high-throughput, external-facing ingestion services and APIs across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Deliver Customer-Facing Innovations: Lead the end-to-end execution of enterprise-grade external features, ensuring low-latency data landing, high availability, and seamless ecosystem integration (e.g., Snowpark Connect, partner connectors).

  • Set Technical Direction: Author foundational design documents, establish technical standards for reliability, security, and scalability, and lead high-stakes architectural reviews across engineering orgs.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Principal Architects, Product Management, Security, and external developer platforms to translate customer requirements into resilient system architecture.

  • Elevate Engineering Excellence: Mentor and sponsor Senior, Mid-level, and Junior engineers; raise the bar for system design, code quality, testing methodologies, and operational maturity.

  • Direct Customer & Strategic Impact: Engage with enterprise customer engineering teams to solve complex integration challenges, debug production edge cases at scale, and turn direct customer feedback into core platform capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud-native infrastructure in production.

  • Proven track record of architectural leadership, having successfully taken complex, customer-facing services or external APIs from initial concept to General Availability (GA) and global scale.

  • Expert proficiency in Java or C++ (strong preference for engineers comfortable working across both systems-level C++ and managed service Java frameworks).

  • Deep expertise in external API design, cloud service orchestration, and building resilient, multi-tenant customer-facing endpoints.

  • Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following: high-throughput ingestion pipelines, distributed query execution engines, messaging/streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar), or database internals.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to drive technical consensus across cross-functional leadership, product partners, and external technical stakeholders.

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building and scaling external developer platforms, SDKs, or public SaaS APIs serving external consumers.

  • Deep expertise with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and integration with ecosystems like Apache Spark or Ray.

  • Advanced performance engineering expertise: memory management, SIMD, vectorization, lock-free data structures, or I/O optimization at PB-scale.

  • Strong background in metadata management, transactional state machines, or consensus protocols (e.g., Raft, Paxos).

  • Active contributor to open-source data infrastructure, cloud-native compute systems, or query engines.

Why This Team

  • Massive Strategic Impact: You will lead the expansion of Snowflake's most critical data-path surface into direct, customer-facing integrations that unlock new platform ecosystems and drive platform volume.

  • Broad Architectural Scope: Your work will bridge edge API layers, control-plane orchestrators, file scanners/parsers, query planners, and underlying storage engines.

  • High Customer Visibility: Work directly on features that power the external integrations for Fortune 500 enterprises, seeing the immediate revenue and performance impact of your architecture.

  • Culture of Technical Leadership: Partner directly with Snowflake’s top architects and leads in an environment that values deep technical autonomy, rigorous engineering, and long-term architectural stewardship.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
