jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Agent Marketplace
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake Marketplace is the trusted enterprise channel for governed data sharing at scale. This role advances that mission into the next paradigm shift: transforming data-sharing infrastructure into an AI-first intelligence marketplace for autonomous agents, semantic models, remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and AI-ready data primitives.

As a Senior Product Manager for the Marketplace, you will own the strategy and execution for making Snowflake the definitive destination where third-party AI agents are built, governed, distributed, and monetized. You will act as a general manager operating at the intersection of platform engineering, developer ecosystems, and commercial strategy—connecting partner innovation directly to enterprise customer adoption.

Interested in our recent momentum? Check out our H1 2026 update on Snowflake Marketplace & Agentic AI Growth for context on where we're heading and the foundation you'll be building on.

AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Define the Strategic Vision: Set and socialize the product strategy for Snowflake’s AI-first marketplace, aligning product leadership, developer relations, partner engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams behind key primitive releases (including AI agents, semantic layers, and remote MCP integrations, etc.) – and be the trusted subject matter expert to educate and inspire our customers' adoption of these technologies .

  • Ship Category-Defining Primitives: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for third party agents, MCPs, Semantic Views and future AI Products.

  • Design Commercial Mechanics: Drive monetization design as a core product surface, including pricing and packaging, usage- and outcome-based billing and partner revenue-share structures.

  • Operate AI-Natively: Prototype listing workflows, build partner integrations, and utilize advanced telemetry and generative tools to inform roadmap prioritization and evaluate third-party agent performance hands-on.

  • Deliver Measurable Impact: Own overall business metrics, driving partner supply growth, enterprise buyer adoption of AI-first listings, and platform consumption pulled through agentic workflows.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • Product Experience: 6+ years in product management, with a track record of bringing AI, developer platform, or infrastructure products from 0-to-1 and scaling them to commercial adoption.

  • Ecosystem Building: Proven background in building two-sided markets—such as developer platforms, API marketplaces, enterprise app stores, or partner ecosystems—where you successfully curated supply and drove buyer demand.

  • Commercial Architecture Mastery: Direct experience designing productized commercial mechanics, including meter-based consumption, usage/outcome pricing, committed-spend drawdowns, and multi-sided revenue distribution.

  • Technical Depth in AI Architecture: Hands-on familiarity with modern AI agent stacks (MCP, agent-to-agent protocols, tool calling, semantic layers, and non-human identity/delegation mechanisms) to engage credibly with enterprise architects and developer teams.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Ability to navigate extreme ambiguity, define new product categories, and execute hypothesis-driven roadmaps without relying on existing templates.

  • Relevant Industry Background: Experience in cloud marketplaces, AI platform ecosystems, developer tools, or enterprise SaaS ecosystems (e.g., major cloud platforms, AI-native infrastructure vendors, or developer infrastructure companies).

Why Join Our Team at Snowflake?

This position offers true general-manager scope on a category at the absolute frontier of enterprise software—defining how third-party AI agents are commercialized and deployed at enterprise scale. You will work directly alongside cross-functional engineering and product leaders across core platform capabilities, governance, identity, and business development. As the voice of Snowflake’s agent ecosystem, you will lead high-visibility bets, shape the commercial model for the agentic enterprise, and build a career path toward executive product leadership.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects at a very exciting time for the company.   • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace.

We are looking for an Account Executive to drive new customer acquisition across enterprise businesses in New Zealand. You will own complex sales cycles from targeted prospecting through agreement and onboarding, helping customers understand how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud can support their business and technology priorities.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, ENTERPRISE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build and execute a territory strategy, target-account plan, and regional sales plan to achieve quarterly and annual goals for the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Become a trusted advisor by understanding each customer’s business priorities, data estate, cloud strategy, and AI roadmap, then connecting those needs to Snowflake’s platform.

  • Lead executive and CxO conversations that position Snowflake as a strategic platform for data engineering, analytics, application development, collaboration, and AI.

  • Orchestrate complex sales cycles across customer stakeholders, Snowflake solution engineering, professional services, partners, marketing, and customer success.

  • Develop regional marketing and partner plans that generate qualified pipeline and accelerate new-logo growth.

  • Apply MEDDPICC to improve qualification, stakeholder alignment, deal strategy, and forecast accuracy.

  • Negotiate and close enterprise agreements, then support a smooth transition into onboarding and long-term adoption of Snowflake.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, ENTERPRISE WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of relevant field sales experience, with a demonstrated record of selling complex data, cloud, or enterprise technology solutions.

  • A consistent record of generating new business, developing enterprise pipeline, and delivering against ambitious sales goals.

  • Proven ability to independently develop, manage, negotiate, and close complex new-client relationships.

  • Experience engaging executives and translating business and IT priorities into clear value propositions and commercial outcomes.

  • Strong discovery, presentation, listening, communication, and relationship-management skills.

  • Experience coordinating complex buying groups and aligning internal specialists around a customer outcome.

  • Practical experience using MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise qualification methodology.

  • The judgement, resilience, curiosity, and ownership mindset needed to perform effectively in a fast-moving environment.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Enterprise sales experience within industries that are strategic to the New Zealand market.

  • Experience selling cloud platforms, data infrastructure, analytics, cybersecurity, or AI solutions.

  • Familiarity with Snowflake, major cloud providers, modern data architectures, and enterprise AI use cases.

  • Experience using AI-assisted workflows to improve account research, prospecting, deal preparation, and customer engagement.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is an opportunity to shape Snowflake’s enterprise growth in New Zealand while working on visible, high-impact customer opportunities. You will partner with talented specialists across Snowflake to help new customers modernize how they use data and build for the AI era.

Snowflake combines the pace and ownership of a high-growth company with a platform used by organizations around the world. You will have the opportunity to build strategic customer relationships, influence regional growth, and develop your career alongside a collaborative global team.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer, Public Sector
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As a Senior Solution Engineer – Public Sector at Snowflake, you will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to drive ongoing success and growth within our existing Public Sector customer base in Singapore and the broader ASEAN region. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping government agencies and public sector institutions realize full value from the Snowflake Data Cloud, expand their workloads, and adopt new capabilities such as AI/ML and data applications.

This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong knowledge of the public sector landscape, and excellent customer engagement skills. You will lead technical discovery, architect new use cases on top of existing deployments, deliver compelling demonstrations, and guide customers through proof-of-value and production expansion. A strong understanding of the Singapore and ASEAN public sector regulatory environment (e.g., IM8, GovTech policies, data residency, cloud security and compliance requirements) is essential.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to identify, qualify, and execute expansion opportunities within existing Public Sector accounts (new workloads, users, departments, and data products).

  • Present Snowflake’s technology, roadmap, and vision to executives, technical leaders, and practitioners at public sector customers, clearly articulating business value and technical differentiation.

  • Work hands-on with customers to design and validate new solutions on Snowflake across analytics, data sharing, data engineering, AI/ML, and data applications – from ideation to proof-of-concept and production rollout.

  • Conduct technical discovery and architecture reviews to understand current usage, identify gaps, and propose best-practice architectures that increase adoption, performance, security, and cost efficiency.

  • Build and deliver tailored demos and technical workshops that showcase how Snowflake can power key government and public sector use cases (e.g., citizen 360, smart nation initiatives, public health analytics, regulatory reporting, fraud and risk, operational analytics).

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to:

    • Provide public sector–specific feedback and influence product roadmap.

    • Create and share reusable assets such as reference architectures, demo environments, playbooks, and best practices tailored to public sector expansion.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer technical stakeholders, helping them adopt Snowflake platform features (governance, security, performance optimization, data sharing, marketplace, AI/ML integrations) and embed Snowflake into their long-term data strategy.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies (data platforms, analytics, AI/ML tools, integration and BI ecosystems) and how to position Snowflake relative to them in the public sector context.

  • Support RFPs, RFIs, and security/compliance reviews with detailed technical input, ensuring alignment with government standards and procurement requirements.

  • Advocate for and demonstrate cost management and FinOps best practices on Snowflake to drive sustainable, value-based expansion.

  • Contribute to the broader SE and Public Sector community by mentoring peers, sharing learnings, and supporting field enablement.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Extensive working experience in a customer-facing solution engineering / pre-sales role, ideally focused on data, analytics, or cloud platforms.

  • Proven track record of driving expansion or upsell within existing enterprise or public sector accounts (e.g., increasing platform consumption, enabling new workloads, or landing cross-departmental use cases).

  • Strong competency across modern data stacks:

    • ETL/ELT, data warehousing / data lakes / lakehouse

    • Analytics, data science, AI / ML / Generative AI, and data applications

  • Excellent ability to present to both technical and executive audiences, whether through impromptu whiteboarding or structured presentations and demos.

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and at least one of the following: Python, Spark, or similar data processing technologies.

  • Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and key data-related services.

  • Strong familiarity with security, governance, and compliance concepts relevant to public sector workloads (identity and access management, encryption, data residency, auditing).

  • Experience working in or with Singapore / ASEAN Public Sector customers, or other regulated environments, with an understanding of government procurement and regulatory expectations.

  • Solid understanding of Singapore Government Commercial cloud - infrastructure, networking, security and data classification levels.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and value-based selling skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

STRONGLY DESIRED:

  • Experience with large-scale data platforms (e.g., Teradata, Netezza, Exadata, Greenplum, Hadoop) and migrations to cloud data platforms.

  • Programming/scripting experience (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, or Spark) for data engineering, automation, or proof-of-concept development.

  • Experience selling or supporting enterprise data / analytics / AI platforms in a pre-sales, consulting, or architecture role.

  • Familiarity with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and how they integrate with cloud data platforms.

  • Experience designing or optimizing OLAP data models and enterprise data architectures.

  • Background in Public Sector or Government – either as a practitioner (e.g., in a ministry, statutory board, or government-linked entity) or as a vendor/partner supporting public sector programs.

  • Experience working with ecosystem partners (GSIs, ISVs, resellers) to drive joint solutions and market motions in the public sector.

  • Exposure to Data Science / AI / ML / Generative AI workloads, including integration patterns with Snowflake and cloud-native AI services.

  • Cloud platform certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or data/analytics certifications (including Snowflake) are an added plus.

ADDED BONUS FOR:

  • Hands-on experience designing or operating data platforms on Snowflake or similar cloud-native data platforms in production at scale.

  • Experience with data sharing, data exchange, or data marketplace concepts, particularly for cross-agency or cross-domain collaboration.

  • Deep understanding of Singapore and ASEAN public sector frameworks, such as:

    • Government security and compliance standards

    • Data residency and sovereignty expectations

    • GovTech and Smart Nation initiatives

  • Experience driving multi-stakeholder programs in complex environments, including C-level sponsors, architects, procurement, and operational teams.

  • Experience with enterprise SaaS solutions and subscription-based business models.

  • Passion for helping public sector organizations unlock the value of data to improve citizen services, policy-making, and operational efficiency.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Director, Field Sales Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Revenue Operations organization is seeking a Director, Field Operations to support our USMajors Sales organization. In this role you will partner with cross functional teams in defining, landing and executing our key strategic priorities. You will apply your strategic planning, financial acumen, creative thinking and deep analytic background to sales engagements.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Field Operations, you will play a critical part in providing insightful analyses and actionable recommendations to the sales leadership team that will influence strategy and implementation of objectives that appropriately reflect our business goals. Our hyper-growth environment requires an ever-evolving approach to managing our go-to-market strategy, and increasingly, that means using AI as a core part of how the team plans, analyzes, and executes.

In this role you will get to:

  • Serve as a strategic operating partner to USMajors Sales leadership, translating business priorities into a focused operational agenda, territory designs, and optimal resource allocation.

  • Lead and scale a high-performing Field Operations team, setting clear expectations, coaching strategic judgment, and building talent for expanded organizational responsibility.

  • Represent the voice of the field across cross-functional decisions (planning, compensation, reporting, etc.), synthesizing insights and leadership relationships to resolve systemic barriers and influence investment priorities.

  • Own the end-to-end Majors sales funnel and revenue governance, maintaining disciplined tracking of pipeline growth, win/loss rates, coverage models, and quota attainment to deliver actionable insights to executive leadership.

  • Lead long-range operational planning for the theater, looking beyond the immediate fiscal year to build scalable multi-year GTM strategies, capacity models, and growth frameworks.

  • Establish and drive accountability for a unified operating rhythm, inspecting the pipeline, forecast, revenue performance, and overall book of business across the field, ensuring high-quality, reliable delivery while balancing standardized processes with regional flexibility.

  • Actively collaborate with cross-functional business partners (such as Finance, Planning & Compensation, Alliances, HR/Recruiting, etc.) to ensure an aligned approach to managing the business, all in an effort to maximize seller productivity and retain top talent.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Solution Engineering (SE) leadership to streamline operational workflows, optimize resource alignment, and support the continued expansion of the technical and field GTM organizations.

  • Drive the practical adoption of AI and automated workflows across core GTM operations—including forecasting, reporting, and pipeline hygiene—to increase capacity, accelerate analysis, and improve seller and manager productivity.

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • 10+ years of experience in sales operations, enablement, revenue operations or equivalent function with significant exposure to global sales teams

  • Demonstrated understanding of SaaS go-to-market models, sales support roles, business metrics and growth best practices

  • Ability to structure complex problems, derive insights from data, and articulate clearly with diverse teams up to the senior leadership level

  • Strong presentation skills and ability to influence varying org functions at varying levels of seniority throughout the org; basically you can execute as well as recommend

  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Cortex, Copilot, or similar assistants) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and decision-making

  • Bachelor's degree; MBA a plus

How do you want to make your impact?

Our hyper-growth environment requires an ever-evolving approach to managing our go-to-market strategy, and increasingly, that means using AI as a core part of how the team plans, analyzes, and executes.



In this role you will get to:

 - Serve as a strategic operating partner to USMajors Sales leadership, translating business priorities into a focused operational agenda, territory designs, and optimal resource allocation.

 - Lead and scale a high-performing Field Operations team, setting clear expectations, coaching strategic judgment, and building talent for expanded organizational responsibility.

 - Represent the voice of the field across cross-functional decisions (planning, compensation, reporting, etc.), synthesizing insights and leadership relationships to resolve systemic barriers and influence investment priorities.

 - Own the end-to-end Majors sales funnel and revenue governance, maintaining disciplined tracking of pipeline growth, win/loss rates, coverage models, and quota attainment to deliver actionable insights to executive leadership.

 - Lead long-range operational planning for the theater, looking beyond the immediate fiscal year to build scalable multi-year GTM strategies, capacity models, and growth frameworks.

 - Establish and drive accountability for a unified operating rhythm, inspecting the pipeline, forecast, revenue performance, and overall book of business across the field, ensuring high-quality, reliable delivery while balancing standardized processes with regional flexibility.

 - Actively collaborate with cross-functional business partners (such as Finance, Planning & Compensation, Alliances, HR/Recruiting, etc.) to ensure an aligned approach to managing the business, all in an effort to maximize seller productivity and retain top talent.

 - Partner closely with Sales and Solution Engineering (SE) leadership to streamline operational workflows, optimize resource alignment, and support the continued expansion of the technical and field GTM organizations.

 - Drive the practical adoption of AI and automated workflows across core GTM operations—including forecasting, reporting, and pipeline hygiene—to increase capacity, accelerate analysis, and improve seller and manager productivity.



On day one we will expect you to have:

 - 10+ years of experience in sales operations, enablement, revenue operations or equivalent function with significant exposure to global sales teams

 - Demonstrated understanding of SaaS go-to-market models, sales support roles, business metrics and growth best practices

 - Ability to structure complex problems, derive insights from data, and articulate clearly with diverse teams up to the senior leadership level

 - Strong presentation skills and ability to influence varying org functions at varying levels of seniority throughout the org; basically you can execute as well as recommend

 - Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Cortex, Copilot, or similar assistants) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and decision-making

 - Bachelor's degree; MBA a plus

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Snowflake’s product experience is how customers engage with our data and AI platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Horizontal UI Experiences, you will improve the quality, speed, consistency, and reach of Snowflake’s UI experience across the workflows and shared UI capabilities customers rely on every day.

You will own a focused, cross-product charter spanning core customer journeys, UI platform components, design systems, performance, accessibility, and global readiness. You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, and product teams to turn customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable improvements.

AS A SENIOR PM AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for horizontal UI experiences, balancing customer needs, product quality, technical constraints, and business impact.

  • Improve end-to-end experiences across login and authentication, the homepage, and core customer journeys.

  • Partner with design and engineering to evolve shared UI capabilities, including the design system and personalization, so experiences feel coherent across products.

  • Drive improvements to performance and product latency, working with engineering teams to identify the highest-impact opportunities and measure progress.

  • Make Snowflake work for more customers by advancing accessibility, localization, URL readiness, and support for additional regions.

  • Build a strong understanding of customer friction through research, usage data, customer feedback, and cross-functional input.

  • Define success measures, establish baselines, and use evidence to prioritize work and assess whether changes improve customer experience.

  • Create alignment across partner product teams and functions, making ownership, trade-offs, and decisions clear.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:

  • 4+ years of product management experience owning and delivering customer-facing software products or substantial product areas.

  • A track record of turning customer problems into a focused product strategy, roadmap, and shipped outcomes.

  • Strong product judgment for end-to-end workflows, usability, and consistent experiences across multiple surfaces.

  • Comfort using qualitative and quantitative evidence to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.

  • The ability to partner effectively with engineering and design on technically complex product areas, and to communicate trade-offs clearly.

  • Experience influencing multiple teams and stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain decisions and bring teams along.

BONUS POINTS:

  • Enterprise SaaS, data platforms, or complex multi-product environments.

  • Shared UI platforms, design systems, or horizontal product experiences.

  • Product work involving performance and latency, authentication, accessibility, localization, or regional availability.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You’ll work on product experiences that cut across Snowflake and matter to customers throughout their day-to-day use of Snowflake. The charter combines visible customer-facing journeys with foundational improvements to speed, accessibility, and global reach—and gives you the opportunity to shape a focused roadmap with engineering, design, and product partners.

jobs.title: Incident Response Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Security Incident Response Engineer to join our Incident Response team. You will help redefine how incidents are handled at scale, pairing autonomous AI agents with human judgment so that we can detect, investigate, and contain threats faster across a rapidly growing cloud and AI footprint.

AS A SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Join a high-impact team of security experts to scale security at one of the fastest-growing software companies ever

  • Spearhead an agentic approach to Incident Response by deploying, guiding, and refining autonomous AI agents that execute initial triage, context gathering, and rapid investigation alongside human Incident Commanders

  • Handle escalations, lead security investigations, and act as Incident Commander for critical incidents

  • Build scripts, automation pipelines, and agentic workflows that continuously enhance Snowflake's incident response capabilities

  • Partner closely with our Threat Detection, Automation, Product Security, Legal, HR, Cloud, and Data teams

  • Create and improve detections, threat signatures, and guardrails for both traditional and AI-driven attack vectors

  • Participate in a periodic on-call rotation, which may involve non-traditional working hours

OUR IDEAL SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in incident response or security operations preferred

  • Strong experience in incident response, security investigations, and running incidents as the Incident Commander

  • Advanced experience using security stack capabilities (EDR, SIEM, SOAR, DLP) across endpoints, identity providers, SaaS, and cloud workloads

  • Deep familiarity with AI/LLM tooling, security copilots, and AI-driven telemetry to accelerate investigations, threat triage, and post-incident reporting

  • Knowledge of securing frontier AI infrastructure, including model training and serving pipelines and AI agent permissions

  • Proven ability to detect and respond to modern AI-driven attacks

  • Proficiency in Python to build automated orchestration pipelines, reduce manual incident response toil, and programmatically enrich security alerts

  • Expert-level understanding of cloud security architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container runtime isolation (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Ability to translate incident findings and root-cause analysis into short-term tactical fixes and long-term security engineering objectives

  • Ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis using sandbox environments and modern AI-assisted reverse engineering tools

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with threat hunting or building detection-as-code programs

  • Experience running sensitive investigations alongside Legal and HR, such as insider risk cases

  • Familiarity with large-scale data platforms and using them to analyze security telemetry

  • Contributions to open-source security tooling, detection rules, or the broader security community

  • Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, or GREM

WHY JOIN OUR INCIDENT RESPONSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is an opportunity to shape what incident response looks like in the agentic era. You will work on the front line of defending one of the world's most important data platforms, building the AI-driven workflows that let a team of experts respond with the speed and precision that modern threats demand.

You will work across Detection, Product Security, Cloud, Legal, and HR, see incidents end to end, and turn what you learn into lasting improvements to how Snowflake protects its customers and its people.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Data Transformation is the foundational product portfolio that makes enterprise Agentic AI possible. Our mission is to transform the full enterprise data estate. We build the product that guides customers through every layer of a modern AI architecture: from Platform Foundation & Migration, through Data Ingestion & Engineering, to Semantic, Context, Ontology, & Governance layers. By unlocking each layer, we enable customers to deploy Agentic AI with full, governed access to their complete Snowflake data estate. The Data Transformation workflows are some of the most complex enterprise challenges and the most impactful for our customers and for Snowflake.

FRONTIER ENGINEERING

Sitting within Snowflake’s Frontier Engineering organization—a specialized team of Engineers, Product Managers, Solutions Architects, and AI Experts—you will own Snowflake’s Data Transformation product portfolio. Your scope spans intelligent migration products that understand and rewrite legacy application logic, multi-source ingestion pipelines, legacy data warehouse modernization, ETL/ELT transformation, and data platform rationalization. In this role, you will set product vision, lead a team of PMs, and deliver the tooling that turns fragmented legacy infrastructure into an AI-first enterprise platform.

AS A DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT, YOU WILL:

  • Define Vision & Strategy: Own the strategic roadmap across the full transformation stack—from platform migration to semantic and context layers—ensuring every initiative moves enterprises closer to an AI-ready Snowflake platform.

  • Lead & Scale a High-Performing PM Team: Build, mentor, and manage a team of product managers, fostering a culture of high velocity, accountability, and technical rigor.

  • Partner with Engineering Leadership: Deeply engage with technical leaders to shape execution strategies, balancing engineering effort and long-term architectural scalability across complex pipeline and query transformation workloads.

  • Drive Execution with an MVP Mindset: Champion speed and clarity, setting precise roadmap milestones, prioritizing ruthlessly, and ensuring seamless cross-functional alignment.

  • Own GTM & Customer Adoption: Partner with Marketing, field teams, and executive customers to position transformation capabilities, accelerate migrations, and drive platform adoption.

  • Drive Thought Leadership: Serve as an external voice for Snowflake, helping shape the industry narrative around legacy modernization, automated pipeline refactoring, and AI-first data architecture.


OUR IDEAL DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT WILL HAVE:

  • 12+ Years in Data Infrastructure: Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, migration tooling, query engines, or pipeline infrastructure.

  • Proven PM Leadership: Strong experience building, managing, and mentoring high-performing product management teams.

  • Deep Technical Foundation: Hands-on familiarity with modern data ecosystems—including SQL execution, ETL/ELT patterns, declarative pipelines, and workflow orchestration.

  • Applied GenAI Exposure: Practical understanding of AI-assisted capabilities, such as automated code translation, developer co-pilots, semantic validation, and LLM-driven refactoring.

  • Strategic & Analytical Execution: Ability to navigate technical ambiguity, make sound decisions using data and instincts, and reduce time-to-value for enterprise customers.

  • Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for customers, field leadership, and executives.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Content Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Content Marketing team is evolving into a Content Center of Excellence (CoE) that earns market authority through deep topic ownership, original research, and AI-powered workflows. We are looking for a Content Marketing Manager who will sit at the intersection of thought leadership, research, and AI innovation — someone who doesn't just write great content but builds the systems and AI workflows that scale great content across Snowflake.

This role is strategic and hands-on. You will drive original research initiatives, develop thought leadership narratives on priority topics, and architect AI-driven content workflows. You will also serve as an evangelist for the CoE's best practices, extending AI-powered content creation capabilities to product marketing, field marketing, and GTM teams across the company.

Our ideal candidate is deeply curious, a strong writer and editor, obsessed with AI tooling, and energized by the idea of building repeatable AI workflows that turn a brief into a publish-ready asset. If you get excited about prompt engineering, building AI agents for content, and using data to drive editorial strategy, this is your role.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area or Bellevue, WA.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

Research & Thought Leadership

  • Own and drive original research programs — surveys, data studies, competitive analysis, and industry benchmarking — that establish Snowflake as a thought leader on priority topics

  • Develop and maintain deep subject-matter expertise in 2-3 priority topic areas and build authoritative long-form content: research reports, executive bylines, data-driven blog series, and op-eds

  • Partner with internal SMEs, and executives to source insights and translate them into high-impact narratives

  • Track share-of-voice, search trends, and competitive positioning to identify content gaps and opportunities where Snowflake can lead the conversation

AI Workflows & Content Innovation

  • Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered content workflows using Snowflake Cortex, CoCo Skills, and Content Studio (our Streamlit-based AI content engine)

  • Create and maintain AI skills and prompt chains for content production: blog drafting, ebook generation, SEO optimization, copyediting, brand voice compliance, and content auditing

  • Serve as the team's AI workflow architect — evaluate new AI capabilities, prototype tools, and integrate them into the content production pipeline

  • Build self-serve AI tools that enable non-content teams (product marketing, field marketing, partner marketing) to produce on-brand, CoE-quality content independently

  • Measure and report on AI workflow adoption, time savings, and content quality improvements

  • Evangelize the CoE's content standards, AI tools, and workflows to product marketing, corporate communications, engineering blog, and partner marketing teams

Content Strategy & Production

  • Write and edit high-quality content across formats: research reports, ebooks, solution briefs, blog posts, web pages, executive bylines, and campaign assets

  • Ensure all content aligns with Snowflake brand voice, SEO best practices, and CoE editorial standards

  • Use content performance analytics (page views, engagement rates, scroll depth, downloads, pipeline influence) to inform editorial strategy and prioritization

  • Manage content calendars, production timelines, and cross-functional stakeholder relationships


REQUIREMENTS

  • 5-7+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, or digital content strategy — preferably in B2B technology or enterprise SaaS

  • Demonstrated experience building or using AI tools for content creation and content processes — prompt engineering, AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, or similar. You should be able to articulate specific AI workflows you've built, not just tools you've used

  • Strong writer and editor with proven ability to produce research-driven, long-form thought leadership content (bylines, research reports, data studies)

  • Experience designing and executing original research programs (surveys, data studies, benchmarks) that generate earned media and thought leadership positioning

  • Ability to work with technical concepts (data engineering, AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, security) and translate them into compelling narratives for business and technical audiences

  • Strong project management skills — ability to own and drive production schedules, manage stakeholders, and coordinate across multiple teams simultaneously

  • Experience using content analytics (traffic, engagement, SEO rankings, pipeline attribution) to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Comfort with data tools and willingness to learn Snowflake-specific platforms (Cortex, Streamlit, SQL basics) — you don't need to be an engineer, but you should be eager to build

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Snowflake, or similar cloud data platforms

  • Hands-on experience with AI/LLM platforms (building agents, prompt chains, RAG pipelines, or AI-assisted editorial workflows)

  • Experience working in or with a content center of excellence model

  • Work with Professional Services Practice Teams and Sales Account Teams to facilitate practice area enablement and support sales pursuits – scoping projects, estimating work, creating delivery proposals and providing regular delivery updates for ongoing projects

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Must have played the role of trusted advisor to C-Suite or Executive Sponsor of the Program at Fortune 500 customer

  • Must be extremely adept in executive communication and relationship management across multitude of stakeholders - customer, partners and internal teams

  • Must have direct experience in the Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence and/or Cloud field

  • Proven ability to communicate and translate effectively across multiple groups from design and engineering to marketing, advertising, and business development

  • Strong presentation skills and an ability to articulate to a business and technical audience (including senior level executives at large enterprises)

  • Bonus Points: Experience in a customer support and advisory technical role (Solution architect, system administrator, technical account manager or equivalent).

As a Principal Program Manager focused on Migrations, you will be driving new service opportunities related to migrating customer workloads to Snowflake, working with both customers and internal stakeholders. Success is defined by the SDM's ability to develop a quality migration service strategy per customer, capture and report on key migration metrics, identify upsell opportunities related to migrations and Snowflake adoption, and quickly become the client’s trusted advisor on all things migration to Snowflake.

 

AS A PROJECT MANAGER, YOU WILL:

  • Provide delivery quality oversight and guidance for migration engagements by assisting in the creation and execution of the overall vision for service delivery and client satisfaction, ensuring adherence to migration best practices.

  • Own, manage, and communicate the operational relationship with assigned clients undergoing migrations, including the creation, implementation, and tracking of relationship roadmaps focused on successful migration and ongoing Snowflake utilization.

  • Manage key migration projects by communicating effectively with project team members, management, and project stakeholders on status, issues, risks, and project goals and objectives through clear project documentation, meetings, and any required follow-ups.

  • Proactively provide input into the development of migration best practices, methodologies, and training materials for the Professional Services team.

  • Integrate migration-specific knowledge into practical configuration tactics, techniques, and procedures to ensure teams deliver well-rounded and well-developed migration solutions.

  • Work with Professional Services Practice Teams and Sales Account Teams to facilitate practice area enablement and support sales pursuits – scoping migration projects, estimating work, creating delivery proposals, and providing regular delivery updates for ongoing projects.

  • Work with Customers, System Integrators specializing in migrations, and Technology Vendors on migration project pursuits, cadence, and project progress.

  • Provide guidance and a vision on how to resolve customer-specific migration challenges, own escalations, and high-profile situations.

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s migration tools and offerings.

  • Determine areas for process improvements within both the client's existing environment and Snowflake's migration process.

 

OUR IDEAL SERVICES DELIVERY MANAGER - WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years of experience in a Services Delivery role (or similar capacity) dealing with complex, technical implementation projects, with a strong focus on data warehouse, database, or application migrations.

  • Track record of delivering on PS revenue targets for a set of accounts, including the ability to prioritize multiple, complex migration projects and deliverables simultaneously (project management).

  • Direct experience in the Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, and/or Cloud field, with specific experience related to migrations.

  • Proven ability to communicate and translate effectively across multiple groups from design and engineering to marketing, advertising, and business development, with a focus on migration terminology and concepts.

  • Strong presentation skills and an ability to articulate migration strategies and benefits to a business and technical audience (including senior level executives at large enterprises).

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in a client support and advisory technical role (Solution architect, system administrator, technical account manager, or equivalent) with migration expertise.

  • Deep understanding of various database technologies, ETL processes, and data modeling.

  • Experience with migration assessment tools and methodologies.

 

WHY JOIN OUR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES TEAM:

  • Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product and help migrate legacy systems to a modern cloud data platform.

  • Get unique, hands-on experience with bleeding edge data warehouse technology and its application to migrations.

  • Develop, lead, and execute an industry-changing initiative focused on migrations to Snowflake.

  • Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Anti-Abuse
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer for our Anti-Abuse team. The Anti-Abuse team sits at the core of protecting Snowflake and our customers from abuse on the Snowflake Platform. We strive to see the complete picture, leading platform-wide abuse and fraud detection while designing and deploying proactive controls for Snowflake's highest-risk capabilities: Snowpark, Data Sharing, Cortex AI, and the next generation of cloud engineering challenges as Snowflake rapidly scales. In this role, you will be the lead technical architect responsible for defining and driving our technical strategy for abuse prevention, detection, and response across the entire Snowflake ecosystem.

AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ANTI-ABUSE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Define and drive the long-term technical vision for abuse and fraud detection across the Snowflake platform, serving as the chief architect for platform-wide anti-abuse strategy

  • Partner directly with product and engineering teams building Snowflake's newest and highest-risk surfaces (Snowpark user code execution runtimes, Data Sharing and Marketplace, AI/LLM services) to design and deploy robust anti-abuse controls from day one

  • Architect and scale high-throughput, low-latency telemetry pipelines and risk-scoring engines capable of analyzing millions of queries, sessions, and data transactions across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Continuously model emerging abuse techniques, including trial compute abuse, cryptocurrency mining, bot-driven account creation, credential stuffing, and illicit network traffic routing

  • Design intelligent mitigation systems that automatically throttle, challenge, or isolate abusive workloads and malicious actors with near-zero false-positive impact on legitimate enterprise workloads

  • Raise the technical bar across the engineering organization through mentorship of staff and senior engineers, and influence architectural standards across adjacent platform teams

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ANTI-ABUSE WILL HAVE:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience in distributed systems, cloud platform infrastructure, or security engineering, with significant time dedicated to anti-abuse, fraud detection, platform trust, or threat mitigation

  • Proven track record architecting mission-critical, large-scale distributed services in Java, C++, or Python

  • Deep experience designing controls for code-execution runtimes, multi-tenant compute environments, cloud APIs, or data platforms (e.g., mitigating compute hijacking, sandbox escapes, abuse of serverless functions, or network egress abuse)

  • Demonstrated ability to build streaming event processing, anomaly detection, behavioral heuristic engines, or graph-based syndicate detection systems at enterprise scale

  • Strong intuition for attacker economics and mechanics, with experience modeling threat vectors across account lifecycles (signup, trial, payment, execution, sharing)

  • Exceptional ability to partner with product managers, infrastructure teams, and security researchers to embed safety controls into high-velocity product roadmaps

  • B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience building anti-abuse systems for multi-tenant cloud platforms or SaaS-at-scale environments

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM abuse vectors (prompt injection, model extraction, automated content generation for fraud)

  • Track record of designing zero-trust or defense-in-depth architectures for compute runtimes

  • Published research or industry contributions in fraud detection, adversarial ML, or platform trust and safety

  • Experience operating detection and response systems across multiple cloud providers simultaneously

WHY JOIN OUR ANTI-ABUSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

The Anti-Abuse team works at the intersection of platform security, distributed systems, and adversarial thinking. You will own the technical strategy for protecting one of the world's fastest-growing cloud platforms from novel and evolving threats. This is not a compliance checkbox role: you will architect real-time detection systems, embed native guardrails into new product primitives before they reach production, and partner directly with engineering leaders across the organization to anticipate threats no one else is seeing yet. If you want to build the immune system for the agentic enterprise, this is the role.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

 - Partner directly with product and engineering teams building Snowflake's newest and highest-risk surfaces (Snowpark user code execution runtimes, Data Sharing and Marketplace, AI/LLM services) to design and deploy robust anti-abuse controls from day one

 - Architect and scale high-throughput, low-latency telemetry pipelines and risk-scoring engines capable of analyzing millions of queries, sessions, and data transactions across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 - Continuously model emerging abuse techniques, including trial compute abuse, cryptocurrency mining, bot-driven account creation, credential stuffing, and illicit network traffic routing

 - Design intelligent mitigation systems that automatically throttle, challenge, or isolate abusive workloads and malicious actors with near-zero false-positive impact on legitimate enterprise workloads

 - Raise the technical bar across the engineering organization through mentorship of staff and senior engineers, and influence architectural standards across adjacent platform teams




OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ANTI-ABUSE WILL HAVE:

 - 12+ years of software engineering experience in distributed systems, cloud platform infrastructure, or security engineering, with significant time dedicated to anti-abuse, fraud detection, platform trust, or threat mitigation

 - Proven track record architecting mission-critical, large-scale distributed services in Java, C++, or Python

 - Deep experience designing controls for code-execution runtimes, multi-tenant compute environments, cloud APIs, or data platforms (e.g., mitigating compute hijacking, sandbox escapes, abuse of serverless functions, or network egress abuse)

 - Demonstrated ability to build streaming event processing, anomaly detection, behavioral heuristic engines, or graph-based syndicate detection systems at enterprise scale

 - Strong intuition for attacker economics and mechanics, with experience modeling threat vectors across account lifecycles (signup, trial, payment, execution, sharing)

 - Exceptional ability to partner with product managers, infrastructure teams, and security researchers to embed safety controls into high-velocity product roadmaps

 - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Experience building anti-abuse systems for multi-tenant cloud platforms or SaaS-at-scale environments

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM abuse vectors (prompt injection, model extraction, automated content generation for fraud)

 - Track record of designing zero-trust or defense-in-depth architectures for compute runtimes

 - Published research or industry contributions in fraud detection, adversarial ML, or platform trust and safety

 - Experience operating detection and response systems across multiple cloud providers simultaneously




WHY JOIN OUR ANTI-ABUSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

The Anti-Abuse team works at the intersection of platform security, distributed systems, and adversarial thinking. You will own the technical strategy for protecting one of the world's fastest-growing cloud platforms from novel and evolving threats. This is not a compliance checkbox role: you will architect real-time detection systems, embed native guardrails into new product primitives before they reach production, and partner directly with engineering leaders across the organization to anticipate threats no one else is seeing yet. If you want to build the immune system for the agentic enterprise, this is the role.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Software Engineer for our Snowpark Container Service, part of our Snowflake Compute Platform - to build our elastic, high-scale, high-performance, cloud native compute platform to enable bringing Compute to Data effortless and simple.

Snowpark Container Services is a fully managed container offering that helps our customers easily deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications without having to move data out of Snowflake. As a fully managed service, it comes with Snowflake security, configuration, and operational best practices built in. You will be part of this highly productive, fast moving, and growing team that is critical to realizing Snowflake’s Data Cloud Mission.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

  • Design and develop features, understand customer requirements and meet business goals.

  • Lead a team of engineers, including mentoring and guiding them, and build technical direction and strategy for large and critical parts of the product surface area.

  • Manage all aspects of the Project, including Design, Coding, Reviews, Testing, Observability, Tooling and On-Call support.

  • Build highly reliable and fault-tolerant software to meet the needs of the largest customers.

  • Ensure operational readiness and maintainability of the service with heavy focus on reliability, availability, debuggability and performance.

  • Design and build Kubernetes based OCI compliant container compute platform features and capabilities that scale and evolve with changing business and customer needs.

  • Snowpark Container Services is still in an early stage of development - it is an amazing opportunity for outsized impact on Snowflake’s growth story.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE MOST OF THE FOLLOWING QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Excitement to learn new things - passion to learn and grow are keys to success on this team.

  • Be a team player - Our team culture is a priority. Transparency, knowledge sharing, fun events, and helping each other are all part of our work environment

  • Work across functions and across teams - we don’t only work on code that we own, we work with other parts of Snowflake every day.

  • 4+ years of industry experience building features and capabilities of large scale systems or infrastructure level platforms.

  • Extremely strong fundamental computer science skills and experience building distributed systems.

  • Hands-on coding experience in Java, C++ or Go is highly desirable

  • Ability to work on-site in our downtown Bellevue office.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring an EMEA Solution Engineering Manager to lead a team of Solution Engineers focused on the Observability domain. You will coach a high-performing pre-sales team, partner closely with Sales leadership, and help customers across EMEA adopt the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to unify and analyze their observability data at scale.

AS AN EMEA SOLUTION ENGINEERING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Team Leadership

  • Recruit, hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of Sales Engineers across the region

  • Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular 1:1s, and foster a culture of technical excellence and accountability

  • Coach team members on discovery, demo methodology, proof-of-concept execution, and competitive positioning

  • Build career development plans and create a pipeline of future SE leaders

Technical Sales Strategy

  • Partner with Regional Sales Directors to develop and execute regional go-to-market plans for the observability portfolio

  • Drive technical win rates by ensuring impactful discovery, compelling demonstrations and successful proof-of-value engagements

  • Own the regional presales operating cadence: deal strategy sessions, execution alignment and resource allocation

Customer & Market Engagement

  • Engage directly with strategic and enterprise accounts as an executive technical sponsor

  • Lead or support high-stakes customer presentations, architecture workshops, and executive briefings

  • Translate customer requirements into product feedback and influence the observability product roadmap

  • Stay current on competitive landscape (Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana/Elastic, New Relic) and arm the team with differentiated positioning

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to ensure seamless handoffs and customer outcomes

  • Collaborate with Marketing on field events, webinars, and thought leadership content specific to observability

  • Partner with Snowflake core presales teams to identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities where observability complements existing Snowflake deployments

  • Align with enablement teams to ensure the SE organization is trained on new features, integrations, and use cases

OUR IDEAL EMEA SOLUTION ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE:

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in solution engineering, sales engineering, or technical pre-sales, with experience in data platforms, cloud, or observability technologies.

  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring technical teams in a pre-sales or customer-facing capacity.

  • Strong understanding of observability concepts, including logs, metrics, traces, and the modern monitoring landscape.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms and SQL, with the ability to speak credibly to both practitioners and executives.

  • Experience selling or implementing technical solutions to enterprise customers across EMEA.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English.

  • Ability to travel across the EMEA region as needed.

Preferred

  • Direct experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, New Relic, Grafana, or

  • Strong, direct experience with modern AI solutions, especially the ones related to observability and monitoring

  • Background in running proof-of-value / proof-of-concept programs at scale

Competencies

  • Builder Mentality -- You create structure, process, and rigor.

  • Technical Credibility -- You can go deep on architecture, data pipelines, and observability concepts. Your team and your customers respect your technical judgment. You prefer learning by doing and lead your team by example.

  • Coaching Orientation -- You develop people. You make every SE on your team better through hands-on mentorship and structured enablement.

  • Strategic Thinking -- You connect regional activity to company-level objectives. You prioritize and allocate resources where they have the highest impact.

  • Bias for Action -- You move fast, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct quickly.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Familiarity with the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, Snowpark, Streamlit, or Cortex.

  • Experience with leading observability tools such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or Elastic.

  • Background in migrating large-scale telemetry or machine data workloads to a cloud platform.

  • Additional European language skills.[ List ]

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Staff Designated Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake Support is committed to providing world-class resolutions that inspire customer confidence and ensure business continuity. The Staff Designated Support Engineer (DSE) is a trusted technical partner to our Priority Support customers. This role blends deep technical expertise with proactive account engagement, ensuring issues are resolved quickly while strengthening customer trust in Snowflake.

Note: This role is based in Dublin, with 3 days a week in the office.

You will be assigned to multiple Priority Support customers where your goal will be building strong relationships, in-depth knowledge of their architecture, use cases, and business priorities (“know your customer”) Rather than directly owning the majority of cases, you will be deeply involved in case progression and influence, ensuring that all Snowflake teams engaged understand your customer’s specifics and that issues move forward with clarity and context. You will deliver exceptional service by surfacing trends, consolidating related issues, and providing actionable insights, enabling customers to achieve the highest levels of continuity and performance from their Snowflake implementation. You will act as the connective tissue between Snowflake teams and the customer, making sure issues move forward with clarity and context.

 

You Will:

  • Operate as the primary point of contact for assigned customers on service delivery issues

  • Partner with support and account teams to drive the day-to-day progression of support cases, incidents, and escalations for assigned customers, ensuring issues move toward resolution and that key “know your customer” context is clearly understood and applied.

  • DSEs collaborate closely with the account team and customer to surface insights and enable productive discussions in areas such as:

    • Query performance in production workloads, including findings and recommendations to improve performance, prevent recurring issues, and reduce inefficiencies

    • Warehouse configuration and utilization, highlighting opportunities for cost optimization and performance improvements

    • User and account setup, with observations that reinforce Snowflake best practices for security, governance, and account health

  • Partner with customers to identify trends and complex production issues, ensure high case quality, and deliver well-documented root cause analyses (RCAs)

  • Establish regular touchpoints with customers to provide technical and executive-level updates, including performance and health insights

  • Advocate for customer priorities in account reviews and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure issues are prioritized and understood

  • Drive technical advocacy between customers and product/engineering teams, ensuring issues are well-understood and prioritized

  • Lead problem-solving sessions for complex technical challenges, coordinating across Support, Engineering, and Cloud Operations

  • Maintain deep knowledge of assigned accounts’ architecture, use cases, and critical success factors

  • Adhere to response and resolution SLAs and escalation processes to ensure customer business continuity

  • Identify patterns, propose solutions, and drive global initiatives to improve product quality and customer experience

  • Lead knowledge-sharing and training sessions for peers and customer teams to deepen understanding of Snowflake and data warehousing fundamentals

  • Provide coverage during holidays and weekends as required by business needs

 

Our Ideal Designated Support Engineer Will Have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent discipline

  • 8+ years of experience in Technical Support, Customer Success, or similar customer-facing technical role

  • Proven success in managing enterprise customer relationships and acting as a trusted technical advisor

  • Strong communication and writing skills in English, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for technical, non-technical, and executive audiences

  • High emotional intelligence (EQ), empathy, and customer advocacy skills, with the ability to influence outcomes across internal and external stakeholders

  • Experience with Data Warehousing, Database migration, and ETL

  • Experience working with a distributed database i.e., big data and/or MPP (massively parallel processing) databases.

  • Advanced SQL expertise, including debugging, query optimization, window functions, and performance tuning

  • Strong RDBMS knowledge (data types, aggregations, execution plans, workload management, database performance)

  • Experience with data integration and analytics: ETL/ELT and reporting tools (e.g., AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Informatica, Matillion, Tableau, Fivetran)

  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Avro, Parquet) and scripting/coding in at least one programming language

  • Knowledge of at least one major cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, GCP), including infrastructure, networking, and performance metrics (CPU, I/O, RAM, Network)

  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting database connectivity (drivers, connectors, client software) and cloud data migrations

  • Proven ability to collaborate across global teams, with an understanding of enterprise sales cycles and support processes

  • Experience mentoring or training peers on data warehousing and cloud fundamentals

  • Adaptability, flexibility, and eagerness to learn quickly in a dynamic environment

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with CI/CD platforms and tools such as Terraform, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.

  • Scripting/coding experience in any of the following: .NET, JavaScript, R, GO

  • Experience with Libraries/Frameworks such as Pandas, SciPy, TensorFlow, etc.

  • Experience supporting applications running on either Amazon AWS or MS Azure

  • Troubleshooting skills on a variety of operating systems (Windows, Mac, *Nix)

  • Proficient in the technical fundamentals of the internet, with strong knowledge of internet protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP/S, SFTP, and DNS, as well as the skills to use diagnostic tools for troubleshooting connectivity issues.

  • Experience with virtualization and Container solutions (VMware, Docker, Virtualbox, Kubernetes, etc.)

  • Understanding of cloud computing network and security concepts

  • Additional European languages are a plus

     

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
