Payroll Analyst / Sr. Analyst

About Snowflake

Our teams breed ambition, challenge ordinary thinking, push the pace of innovation, in-service of the exploding demand for accessible data.

Snowflake is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values and our culture! We’re also looking for people with a growth mindset and the pragmatic insight to solve for today while building for the future. And as a Snowflake employee, you will be accountable for supporting and enabling diversity and belonging.

Summary

Snowflake is looking for an experienced Payroll Analyst /Sr Analyst - EMEA. This position will be based in Pune, India. The position will support the EMEA region and hence working hours will be accordingly. You are versatile, motivated, creative, intellectually curious, analytical collaborator and a strong communicator.

Reporting into Payroll Lead / Manager, your main responsibility is to ensure smooth delivery of the day-to-day operations of the department. You will provide ideas and help brainstorm on process standardization, automation, and improvement in all aspects of payroll to ensure their scalability and continuing effectiveness amid all the changes that Snowflake has been undergoing. You are good at creating and maintaining robust process documentation. You adhere to the internal controls as specified by Company policies. You are expected to collaborate with cross functional business partners. This is the perfect opportunity for someone like yourself who is self-sufficient, possesses a keen attention to detail, and has an unwavering desire for continuous personal development.

Responsibilities

  • Working closely with existing international payroll partners to ensure accurate and on-time payroll processing. Overall delivery of end-to-end payroll operations including:

    • Preparing and adhering to a schedule / payroll calendar and agree the timelines with payroll vendor and other internal stakeholders

    • Accurately capturing all inputs to be provided to the payroll vendors in a timely manner

    • Thorough review of the output. Includes but not limited to performing payroll analysis such as total gross payroll to net payment, average paid per headcount by country, and comparison of analysis to prior period

    • Support monthly/quarterly accounting close activities, account maintenance and reconciliations, financial reporting and variance analysis, etc.

    • Provide hands off to the accounting teams post payroll close to ensure accounting of payroll within the timelines prescribed by the close calendar

    • Ensure compliance with local jurisdictions for activities within the payroll domain including statutory filings and key annual audits

    • Monitor and measure the SLAs as agreed with the payroll vendor. Raise matter where there are slippages and recommend corrective action to management

  • Working closely with other functional teams (e.g. HR, Stock Administration, People Operations, Benefits, Recruiting, Legal and accounting) to streamline cross-functional processes

  • Recognizing opportunities and recommending process improvements also involves assisting with the design and implementation of internal control measures to ensure proper payment authorizations and segregation of duties.

  • Providing excellent payroll support to employees and cross-functional teams by addressing inquiries, concerns, and requests.

  • Providing standard and ad-hoc payroll reports as needed by various internal departments such as Finance, Accounting, Legal, Benefits, and People Operations.

  • Creating and/or maintaining payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.

  • Providing support in various system implementation projects as needed.

  • Provide support to external and internal audits for the area of payroll

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s / master’s degree in business, Finance, or Accounting

  • 5 to 10 years of relevant and progressive payroll experience; public company payroll experience required

  • Preferred hands-on experience working on some of these payrolls – Poland, Israel, Spain and other EMEA countries.

  • Experience working with international payroll platforms such as ADP, EY, Cloudpay, or other global payroll platforms preferred.

  • Experience of other international payrolls will be an added advantage.

  • Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills

  • Highly proficient in utilizing various computer applications such as Microsoft Excel (Pivots, V/H Lookups) and Google Suite apps (e.g. Google Sheets)

  • Familiarity with Workday HCM and Workday Financials is a plus

  • Understanding of accounting, taxation, and finance concepts as it relates to payroll

  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of payroll-related compliance requirements

  • Adaptable to a fast-changing work environment; able to deliver accurate and on-time payroll regardless of the circumstances

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment

  • Ability to manage through change and to lead change when appropriate

  • Attention to detail, organized and thorough with the desire for continuous improvement

  • Proactive and problem-solving attitude

  • Good command on English speaking and writing

  • Adapts quickly to changes in a dynamic organizational structure and business processes

  • Flexible with working hour changes.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Cloud Support Engineer (CSE)

Snowflake seeks Cloud Support Engineers who combine technical expertise, customer empathy, and an AI-first mindset. Fluency in Japanese (spoken and written) and familiarity with Japanese business culture; experience living or working in Japan preferred. You'll leverage and refine AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, improve knowledge bases, and reduce time to resolution—safely and responsibly. Experience in 24x7 technical support, escalation handling, on-call rotations, and incident management is ideal.

 

Key Responsibilities:

As a Cloud Support Engineer, you manage customer cases and are accountable for accelerating their time-to-resolution, ensuring platform stability, and driving a world-class support experience. Operating as a full-stack technical support resource, this role blends deep hands-on troubleshooting with the customer empathy and communication skills of a trusted advisor.

Customer Value and Incident Ownership

  • Own the Customer Experience: Manage customer issues from initial triage through resolution and follow-up, ensuring clear communication and timely updates.

  • Deliver Support Value with AI: Leverage AI assistants and diagnostics to accelerate triage and root-cause analysis while maintaining accuracy and safety standards.

  • Outcome-Based Support: Focus on business impact, ensuring resolutions fix issues, reduce recurrence, and improve reliability.

  • Customer Empathy and Communication: Provide technical analysis and guidance via email, web, and phone, adapting to customer expertise levels.

Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • AI-Assisted Triage: Use AI to summarize logs, generate hypotheses, and draft responses—critically validating outputs before sharing.

  • Tooling Expertise: Utilize Snowflake environment, connectors, and internal tools to investigate and test solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to resolve systemic issues.

  • Knowledge Management: Document solutions in knowledge bases, refining AI-assisted drafts for quality.

  • Feedback and Innovation: Provide input on product behavior, documentation gaps, and AI-tool performance.

  • Bug Reporting: Document and collaborate on bugs and feature requests with engineering teams.

  • Operational Coverage: Support holiday/weekend rotations and on-call requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • 2+ years in technical support (customer-facing, ideally 24x7).

  • Fluency in Japanese (spoken and written) and familiarity with Japanese business culture; experience living or working in Japan preferred.

  • Strong AI fluency, including prompt engineering, context management, and the ability to critically validate AI outputs and know when to fall back to manual investigation.

  • Experience with AI-powered tooling (e.g., coding assistants/agentic IDEs) and modern support environments.

  • Solid technical troubleshooting skills, including comfort with SQL, log analysis, and scripting/automation (e.g., Python, APIs, workflow tools) to diagnose issues and streamline tasks.SQL, log analysis, and scripting skills (Python, APIs).

  • Strong written/verbal English communication.

  • Basic understanding of Windows and Linux Operating Systems.

  • Basic understanding of Data Warehousing fundamentals and concepts.

  • Ability to write and understand basic SQL queries

  • Familiarity with end-to-end ML pipeline including ML modeling, feature engineering, ML model training, etc.

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, and associated tools within the LLM ecosystem, including Langchain, vector databases, co-pilot, and open-source Hugging Face models.

  • Being able to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to MLOps pipelines, model performance, and infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and web services

Preferred:

  • Snowflake or cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Advance Workflow automation / CI/CD tooling experience

  • AI-powered support or SRE workflow experience

  • Relevant certifications (SnowPro, cloud certs)

  • Knowledge about GPUs, CUDA, and low-level optimizations will be a plus.

  • Experience developing CI/CD components for production-ready MLOps pipelines.

  • Location: Toronto, ON or Atlanta, GA

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Streamlit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Streamlit has become a defining force in the Python ecosystem, recently surpassing one million monthly active developers who use the Streamlit open-source library to build data applications. At Snowflake, we are turning that momentum into the premier enterprise destination for Python-based data applications. Streamlit in Snowflake allows developers to build, share, and deploy governed, interactive applications directly where their data lives.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead this transition from massive open-source momentum to an enterprise business. In this role, you will be the Product Manager of a critical product line, owning the strategy, growth, and P&L for Streamlit in Snowflake. You will bridge the gap between a beloved open-source community and the world’s most sophisticated enterprise customers, ensuring that building a data app in Snowflake is as easy as writing a few lines of Python.

 

AS A SENIOR PM AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Define the Mission: Own the end-to-end strategy for making Streamlit in Snowflake the gold standard for building and running enterprise-grade data applications and AI agents.

  • Drive Massive Growth: Lead the charge and work with Sales, Marketing and Engineering to grow the Streamlit in Snowflake business.

  • Own the P&L: Manage the business outcomes for your area, identifying levers for adoption, retention, and monetization across thousands of enterprise accounts.

  • Architect for AI: Partner with the Cortex AI team to define how LLMs and agentic workflows integrate with Streamlit, enabling users to build using Snowflake’s native AI primitives.

  • Collaborate Across Boundaries: Act as the primary interface between the Open Source Streamlit team and the Snowflake Enterprise team to ensure a cohesive "one-Streamlit" experience. You will also collaborate with Compute, Networking, Identity and Access teams at Snowflake to define the E2E Streamlit in Snowflake experience.

 

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical Robustness: A strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and the Python ecosystem. You are comfortable discussing technical tradeoffs with senior engineers and have at least a basic proficiency in writing Python code.

  • A Growth Mindset: A proven track record of taking ambitious products to commercial success at scale.

  • Dual-Lens UX Focus: High-judgment design skills. You can empathize with a developer using a CLI/SDK and an analyst using a low-code workspace, ensuring the "it just works" experience for both.

  • Analytical Rigor: You are data-driven and comfortable using metrics and AI-assisted analysis to identify growth gaps and prioritize a roadmap under ambiguity.

  • High Ownership: You are resilient, low-ego, and thrive in an environment where you are accountable for end-to-end outcomes, good or bad.

 

BONUS POINTS:

  • Prior experience with Streamlit (OS or Enterprise) or similar Python app frameworks (Shiny, Dash).

  • Experience in the AI/ML space, particularly with LLM orchestration or agentic frameworks.

  • Background in Marketplace or Native App ecosystems.

  • Prior experience at a high-growth developer-centric company (e.g., Applications Infrastructure or a major Hyperscaler).

 

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

This is a rare opportunity to own a P&L for one of the fastest-growing areas within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will be at the cutting edge of the technological shift toward AI-powered applications, working with a highly capable engineering team to capture a market of 10 million Python developers globally. If you want to build the "standard" for how the enterprise interacts with data, this is the role for you.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

As Senior Director of Worldwide Deal Desk at Snowflake, you'll be central to the company's growth. You'll partner closely with Sales leadership to structure, review, approve and negotiate our most complex and strategic opportunities. You'll lead a global team of Deal Desk professionals who connect Sales with Legal, Finance, Revenue Accounting, Services and Operations, so deals close quickly, compliantly and profitably. You'll also lead the Deal Desk's shift to an AI-native organization, using Snowflake's own AI capabilities to change how deals get built, reviewed and approved.

AS A SENIOR DIRECTOR, WW DEAL DESK AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Lead, scale and develop a global team of Deal Desk professionals that supports Sales across all regions and time zones.

  • Be a trusted advisor to Sales leadership on deal structure, pricing, discounting and negotiation strategy for complex, high-value consumption and multi-year agreements.

  • Coordinate cross-functional input from Sales, Legal, Revenue Accounting, Finance, Services, Operations, Product and Engineering to move deals from structure to signature efficiently.

  • Own deal review and approval governance, making sure deals follow company policies, revenue recognition requirements and risk thresholds.

  • Partner with Finance, Legal and RevOps leadership to define and evolve policies, approval matrices and deal processes, and drive their adoption across the field.

  • Define and report on Deal Desk KPIs (deal cycle time, approval SLAs, discount trends, non-standard term usage, etc.) to give executives insight into deal health and commercial risk.

  • Lead the AI transformation of the Deal Desk. Working with Data Analytics and Enterprise Technology, build an AI-native organization: deploy AI agents and copilots for deal structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract review and redlining, approval routing, and deal risk scoring.

  • Champion AI adoption across the team. Build AI fluency, redesign workflows around automation, and measure the impact on productivity, cycle time and deal quality.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR DIRECTOR, WW DEAL DESK WILL HAVE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 15+ years of experience across deal desk, procurement, sales finance, commercial finance, pricing, contract negotiation or sales operations, including significant time leading global teams.

  • Deep experience structuring and negotiating complex enterprise contracts with long sales cycles.

  • Ability to read, interpret and draft commercial terms and conditions.

  • Strong understanding of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and US GAAP.

  • Strong knowledge of SaaS and consumption-based business models, including commit, capacity and usage-based pricing.

  • Demonstrated AI proficiency: hands-on experience applying generative AI, LLM-based tools or automation to finance, sales operations or deal workflows, plus a clear view of where AI does and doesn't belong in governance-heavy processes.

  • Track record of designing and rolling out complex finance systems, processes and tools (for example CPQ, CLM, CRM).

  • Ability to break down complex issues and explain them clearly to everyone from frontline sellers to the C-suite.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and executive stakeholder skills.

  • A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, high deal velocity and quarter-end pressure, and motivated by helping Sales win.

  • Track record of driving cross-functional alignment and managing strategic relationships across Sales, Legal and Finance.

  • Proven experience designing deal approval governance and commercial risk mitigation frameworks.

  • Strong leadership in hiring, coaching and developing talent across distributed global teams.

  • Experience leading AI or automation programs that delivered measurable gains in efficiency or quality.

  • Familiarity with data platforms and analytics (Snowflake experience a plus).

  • MBA or equivalent work experience.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Parameters & Experimentation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the foundation for faster, safer innovation.

Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud supports critical enterprise workloads across multiple clouds and regions. As AI accelerates software development, the volume and pace of change are outgrowing what engineers can manually review, coordinate, and monitor. Moving faster requires systems that make safe delivery and trustworthy experimentation an integral part of how engineering works.

The Parameters & Experimentation team builds the configuration, feature-flagging, and experimentation infrastructure that enables Snowflake engineers to introduce capabilities, control exposure, and measure outcomes. We’re looking for a hands-on Principal Software Engineer I to help build its next generation, combining deep distributed-systems engineering with an AI-first approach to developer productivity and operational intelligence.

You will shape technical direction, solve challenging systems problems, and lead initiatives across engineering teams. The opportunity is to build the next-generation platform so that increasing development velocity translates into faster customer value without relying on ever-increasing manual oversight.

 

AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Architect and build distributed infrastructure. Design scalable configuration and feature-flag services with low-latency evaluation, clear consistency guarantees, fault isolation, and predictable behavior during failures.

  • Make a safety scale with change velocity. Build automated validation, targeted exposure, progressive rollouts, health-based guardrails, and dependable rollback. Reduce manual coordination while making changes observable, auditable, and recoverable.

  • Advance experimentation. Partner with engineering and data science teams to build reliable assignment, exposure tracking, and measurement infrastructure that helps teams evaluate changes and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Build and work AI-first. Make AI integral to how you design, implement, test, and operate software. Embed AI-powered capabilities into the platform for configuration discovery, risk assessment, rollout planning, and impact analysis. Establish rigorous evaluation, security, and reliability standards for these capabilities, and drive adoption of AI-first practices across the team.

  • Lead from architecture through adoption. Translate ambiguous needs into practical designs and milestones. Deliver intuitive APIs, libraries, and self-service tools; guide incremental migrations and simplify the full lifecycle from flag creation to retirement.

  • Raise the engineering bar. Write and review production code, diagnose complex failures, own operational outcomes, and mentor engineers. Influence across teams through technical depth, clear communication, and sound judgment.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex backend or infrastructure initiatives spanning multiple teams.

  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with strong understanding of concurrency, consistency, caching, failure recovery, and performance.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and hands-on proficiency in Java, Go, C++, or a comparable backend language, plus experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • An AI-first engineering practice: you actively use AI throughout the software lifecycle and can demonstrate how it improves your execution, problem-solving, and quality. You are ready to build AI-powered platform capabilities and help others adopt this approach.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous problems into delivered systems, balancing architectural investments with incremental progress, and driving adoption across engineering organizations.

  • Clear written communication, low-ego collaboration, strong ownership, and experience mentoring senior engineers.

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Especially relevant: Experience with feature-flag or configuration platforms, distributed control planes, progressive delivery, experimentation infrastructure, or AI-powered developer tools.

Help build the systems that let engineers innovate faster than manual processes can support, with the evidence and safeguards that critical workloads demand.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team. Our EMEA Partners & Alliances organization is seeking a Partner Sales Director to join our growing team in EMEA South (Italy).
GSI and RSI Partners offer consulting services and implement Snowflake in customer environments and refer new customers to Snowflake. We are looking for a self driven, go getter to help grow these Partners into profitable revenue streams and accelerate our Partner Ecosystem and the growth of the business.

We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of strong communication skills, diplomacy in successfully working with difficult partners (it’s easy when everything is going fine) and strong business acumen in growing a business/ channel/ partnership.

Reporting to the Regional Partner Director for EMEA South, you will have a unique opportunity to work for a disruptive company at the forefront of the Data & AI revolution, and lead the development of a vibrant Partner community.

AS A PARTNER SALES DIRECTOR (ITALY) YOU WILL:

  • Manage a portfolio of high performing Global Systems Integrators (GSI's) and Regional SI’s (RSIs) to achieve partnership goals such as net new customers and consumption

  • Support your partners in their go-to-market activities (business planning, pipeline development, QBR, marketing, enablement sales activities across different Go-To-Market options…)

  • Ensure successful execution of the business plan by developing and managing relationships across functional areas within the partner

  • Work with the partner to expand the partnership into new strategic areas (new Service Lines and Industry Verticals)

  • Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders (typically Partner/Managing Director Level)

  • Organise and execute events with and for our partner community

  • Pitch value proposition of Snowflake partnership on all levels (up to C-Level)

  • Ensure alignment of all relevant stakeholders on pursues in joint accounts

OUR IDEAL PDM WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Channel Management, Software/Services Sales, Consulting, and/or Business Development in Cloud or Software Technology

  • Experience in working with SIs (such as KPMG, EY, CapGemini, Atos, etc.) to leverage their strategic influence to drive technology sales in a joint sales offering

  • Proven experience in delivering strong results in pipeline generation and bookings, by leveraging existing and recruiting targeted new partners

  • Cloud Technology, AI/ML, Data, Analytics, API and platform experience and understanding

  • Ability to build, lead and implement strategy in a cross-functional environment

  • Strong executive selling and business development skills; proven ability to understand different partner GTM and organizational models

  • Ability to design and present business plans, track and articulate program progress, design and document program guidelines for distribution throughout the organization (all levels) and for external use

  • MUST HAVE: Excellent communication skills, verbal & written in Italian & and English. Strong problem solving skills and ability to organize priorities in a dynamic environment

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Be able to travel between 25% - 50% in some months

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE:

  • Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product!

  • Develop a brand new set of ecosystem alliances for Snowflake making data more accessible to customers

  • Develop, lead and execute industry-changing initiatives

  • Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals

jobs.title: Associate Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Associate Solution Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Associate Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

    Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

  • Migration Project Execution: You will work with multiple FDE teams that each focus on a specific customer. You’ll set architecture and direction for the team as it works to design, build, and deploy robust software systems, tooling, and automation required to support customer solutions on Snowflake.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager/Tech Lead Manager - Runtime Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Engineering Manager – Spark Runtime Engineering

Location: Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA

About the Team

The Spark Runtime Engineering Team brings Snowflake’s performance, efficiency, and reliability to Spark workloads. Our mission is to help customers scale data processing while preserving the familiar Spark APIs and semantics they rely on. We build the compiler and runtime integration that translate Spark workloads into efficient execution on Snowflake’s cloud-native query engine. This includes tackling complex challenges in compiler infrastructure, query-plan lowering, Spark compatibility, execution integration, and end-to-end observability to deliver faster, more cost-efficient data processing at scale.

We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who combines deep technical expertise with strong people leadership. You will shape the team’s technical direction, stay actively engaged in architecture and critical engineering decisions, and hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team to advance the future of Spark on Snowflake.

Role Overview

You will lead a team of approximately 5–8 engineers building production compiler and runtime capabilities for Spark workloads on Snowflake. You will guide architectural decisions, review critical designs and code, and help investigate complex correctness, performance, and reliability issues. In partnership with compiler, query engine, runtime, and product teams, you will turn customer needs into a focused roadmap and measurable engineering outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for Spark query compilation and runtime integration, including intermediate representations, type resolution, semantic compatibility, query-plan transformations, and efficient SQL generation.

  • Improve end-to-end workload performance and cost-efficiency through profiling, compilation-latency reduction, metadata-access improvements, and collaboration with query-engine teams.

  • Establish strong correctness and compatibility practices, including differential testing against Apache Spark, regression coverage, and clear handling of unsupported behavior.

  • Own the production quality of the team’s components, including observability, incident response, fault recovery, and safe rollout practices.

  • Hire, coach, and develop engineers; provide actionable feedback, manage performance, and support career growth across experience levels.

  • Partner with senior technical leaders and Product Management to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and deliver a realistic roadmap.

  • Validate changes against representative customer workloads and track measurable improvements in compatibility, latency, reliability, and cost-efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of direct engineering management experience, with demonstrated success developing engineers and delivering production systems.

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial work on compilers, query-processing systems, or runtime infrastructure.

  • Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, such as compiler architecture and IR transformations, relational query processing, language semantics and type systems, or runtime integration.

  • Proficiency in Scala, Java, C++, or a comparable implementation language, with the ability to review production code and guide technical decisions.

  • Strong systems fundamentals, including concurrency, memory behavior, and performance analysis, together with experience debugging complex production issues.

  • Ability to translate technical and customer requirements into engineering priorities and collaborate effectively across teams and locations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Apache Spark internals, Catalyst, Spark Connect, or DataFrame APIs.

  • Experience with relational algebra, SQL generation, query optimization, or database execution systems.

  • Experience with Scala/JVM performance, native runtime functions, metadata caching, or compilation-performance optimization.

  • Experience building compatibility-test frameworks, differential testing, performance benchmarks, or production observability for data systems.

  • Experience leading systems through customer adoption, production hardening, and staged releases.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why Join Us?

Help shape how Spark workloads run on Snowflake. You will work on technically challenging compiler and runtime problems, grow a strong engineering team, and make a measurable difference to the correctness, reliability, and cost-efficiency of customers’ data processing.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring an AI/ML Consulting Manager for our Frontier Engineering team in Australia and New Zealand. Our team within Frontier Engineering helps customers take agents, machine learning models, and full stack applications from ideation to production and beyond, using Snowflake and its partner ecosystem. You will lead a team of technical architects and oversee partner resources delivering projects on Snowflake's behalf, helping both groups translate customer priorities into effective technical solutions and successful delivery.

This is a customer-facing leadership role with a utilisation target, primarily fulfilled through technical leadership and project oversight. You will guide architecture decisions, assess delivery quality, and help teams resolve complex challenges. You are not expected to be the primary hands-on builder, but you will bring the technical depth to challenge designs, review implementation approaches, and guide others toward the right outcomes.

AS AN AI/ML CONSULTING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of technical architects across ANZ, setting clear expectations, supporting career growth, providing performance feedback, and building a collaborative team that shares expertise.

  • Serve as a billable technical lead and delivery advisor across customer engagements, achieving a utilisation target through architecture guidance, technical reviews, project oversight, and customer advisory work.

  • Own successful delivery of engagements by Snowflake architects and partner resources. Partner with customers and go-to-market teams to translate customer requirements into scoped engineering work, clear priorities, delivery milestones, and measurable acceptance criteria, balancing technical trade-offs with customer outcomes.

  • Guide customers and delivery teams from problem definition and solution design through development, evaluation, deployment, and operational handover for AI agents and generative AI applications, including retrieval-augmented generation and integration with enterprise tools and workflows.

  • Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, and executive presence. Coordinate across customer stakeholders, project managers, architects, and partners; manage expectations, raise schedule and reliability risks early, and act as the manager-level escalation owner, de-escalating issues and driving resolution and follow-through.

  • Coordinate team capacity and engagement assignments with delivery stakeholders, balancing customer commitments, technical fit, billable delivery, and time for coaching and professional development.

  • Review solution designs and delivery quality, including grounding, safe tool use, security, governance, evaluation, and observability. Understand technical debt, including code health, test gaps, regressions, and support burden, and guide teams in prioritising remediation alongside new capabilities, with clear ownership and customer handover.

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and the wider Frontier Engineering organisation on planning, delivery dependencies, and customer feedback, creating opportunities for field insights to inform product priorities and reusable delivery practices. Travel to work with customers on-site up to 25% of the time.

OUR IDEAL AI/ML CONSULTING MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience preferred in customer-facing technical consulting, solution architecture, or AI/ML delivery, with demonstrated responsibility for leading complex enterprise engagements.

  • Experience managing and developing technical professionals, including coaching, performance management, career development, and creating an environment where people can raise risks and learn from each other.

  • Experience taking accountability for customer outcomes across internal and partner delivery teams, translating customer needs into actionable engineering plans, coordinating stakeholders and resources, and resolving escalations through sound technical judgement and clear communication.

  • A thorough understanding of the generative AI application development lifecycle, including use case framing, model selection, prompt and context design, agent orchestration, tool integration, and evaluation, supported by experience guiding production delivery.

  • Strong understanding of production practices for LLM applications and AI agents, including evaluation and regression testing, deployment, observability, guardrails, human oversight, and reliability, along with knowledge of traditional ML and MLOps best practices.

  • Cloud architecture knowledge and experience with at least one public cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, with the ability to assess how Snowflake and complementary technologies fit customer requirements.

  • A practical technical foundation in Python, APIs, and frameworks for building LLM applications and AI agents, with the design and code-review judgement to coach architects, recognise technical debt and test gaps, and balance delivery speed, maintainability, and ongoing support cost without being the primary developer on every engagement.

  • Clear communication with technical and executive audiences, sound judgement in managing customer expectations and delivery trade-offs, and a degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience guiding delivery of generative AI applications and AI agents on Snowflake, including integration with enterprise data, APIs, and complementary tools in its partner ecosystem.

  • Experience improving consulting delivery through reusable architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval and vector search, or evaluation tools for generative AI applications, with additional experience in data science and traditional machine learning welcomed.

  • Industry expertise in areas such as financial services, retail, or manufacturing, with the ability to connect technical decisions to customer priorities.

Travel to work with customers on-site up to 25% of the time.




OUR IDEAL AI/ML CONSULTING MANAGER WILL HAVE:



 - 8+ years of relevant experience preferred in customer-facing technical consulting, solution architecture, or AI/ML delivery, with demonstrated responsibility for leading complex enterprise engagements.

 - Experience managing and developing technical professionals, including coaching, performance management, career development, and creating an environment where people can raise risks and learn from each other.

 - Experience taking accountability for customer outcomes across internal and partner delivery teams, translating customer needs into actionable engineering plans, coordinating stakeholders and resources, and resolving escalations through sound technical judgement and clear communication.

 - A thorough understanding of the generative AI application development lifecycle, including use case framing, model selection, prompt and context design, agent orchestration, tool integration, and evaluation, supported by experience guiding production delivery.

 - Strong understanding of production practices for LLM applications and AI agents, including evaluation and regression testing, deployment, observability, guardrails, human oversight, and reliability, along with knowledge of traditional ML and MLOps best practices.

 - Cloud architecture knowledge and experience with at least one public cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, with the ability to assess how Snowflake and complementary technologies fit customer requirements.

 - A practical technical foundation in Python, APIs, and frameworks for building LLM applications and AI agents, with the design and code-review judgement to coach architects, recognise technical debt and test gaps, and balance delivery speed, maintainability, and ongoing support cost without being the primary developer on every engagement.

 - Clear communication with technical and executive audiences, sound judgement in managing customer expectations and delivery trade-offs, and a degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - Experience guiding delivery of generative AI applications and AI agents on Snowflake, including integration with enterprise data, APIs, and complementary tools in its partner ecosystem.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

At Snowflake, we are building a high-impact team to help the world's most innovative companies unlock the power of AI. As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Frontier Engineering team, you will be a hands-on builder and a key technical partner to our most strategic customers, placing you at the forefront of the enterprise AI revolution. You won't just work with cutting-edge technology – you'll deploy it to solve real-world business problems at scale, building production-grade AI systems using Snowpark, Cortex, and our native LLM capabilities.

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Build Customer Solutions: Architect, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions, including sophisticated AI agents. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of your workstreams – from prototype to production – directly solving customers' most complex business challenges.

Own the Quality of What You Ship: Define what "good" means for the systems you build. Translate ambiguous customer goals into measurable quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and golden datasets – then run systematic eval loops to hill-climb on agent quality, catch regressions before customers do, and continuously raise the bar on accuracy, faithfulness, and safety. Treat measurement as a first-class part of building, not an afterthought.

Deliver with Velocity: Rapidly design, iterate, and ship high-quality code and pipelines. Translate ambiguous business objectives into robust, scalable, and performant solutions using Python and SQL.

Productionize AI at Scale: Own the full implementation lifecycle for your solutions – from prototype through deployment, monitoring, and optimization in secure, large-scale production environments. Build the safety guardrails, observability, and human-review workflows that keep AI applications reliable and trustworthy, and close the loop from production traces and user feedback back into your evals so quality compounds over time.

Be a Technical Partner: Partner directly with customer data science and engineering teams as a hands-on technical resource and trusted advisor on how to best leverage AI for their business challenges.

Collaborate to Innovate: Work cross-functionally with Snowflake's Product and Engineering teams, sharing real-world feedback from the field to directly influence the future of Snowflake's AI platform.

Have the opportunity to travel: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite, working closely with Snowflake's most strategic customers.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Willingness to travel.

  • Proven experience building applications using LLMs, especially with technologies like RAG and agentic workflows.

  • Hands-on experience defining quality metrics and running evaluations for LLM or agent systems, and using evals to systematically improve quality.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with an ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a desire to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing Generative AI environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building eval sets from production traces and synthetic data, and running structured experimentation (A/B tests, ablations, offline evals) to compare prompts, models, or agent architectures.

  • Familiarity with eval and observability tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Arize, Weave, Promptfoo) or experience building custom eval harnesses.

  • Experience with failure-mode analysis on agent or RAG systems – categorizing errors (hallucination, retrieval miss, planning failure, tool misuse) and driving each down with targeted evals.

  • Hands-on experience with the MLOps lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and evaluation in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Familiarity with core data science libraries and tools (e.g., pandas, numpy, Snowpark).

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., solutions architect, sales engineer, or professional services).

  • Startup experience.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Our Solution Engineering organization is seeking an AI Specialist who can provide hands-on expertise and support while working with technical decision makers and data scientists to design and architect AI solutions built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

This is a strategic role that works closely with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and the broader field organization to ensure successful execution and customer adoption of Snowflake’s AI & ML solutions.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Be the technical expert in the room that positions Snowflake’s AI and ML features and value to technical stakeholders at Snowflake’s customers across the Americas.

  • Partner with Snowflake account team teams and customer champions to scope and drive POCs to success and technical wins that prove the value of Snowflake’s capabilities, including executive readouts and business value cases.

  • Collaborate with Snowflake’s product and engineering teams to influence Snowflake’s AI and ML roadmaps based on customer feedback.

  • Publish content that helps the team and company scale beyond your individual efforts, like blog posts, presentations at conferences, or technical collateral like notebooks and demos.

  • Influence, tailor and maintain Sales Engineering AI and ML selling assets, including customer presentations, demonstrations, and customer stories.

 

ON DAY ONE, WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning and generative AI solutions in the cloud.

  • Familiarity and associated knowledge of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning that are used to operationalize enterprise AI use cases like interactive chat applications or text processing.

  • Deep knowledge of Python and common ML packages (such as LangChain, pandas, sklearn, and PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies like dbt, Airflow, and Spark.

  • Strong presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos.

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred.

 

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

  • Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.

  • Experience and understanding of large-scale infrastructure-as-a-service platforms (e.g. AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, etc.)

  • 1+ years of practical Snowflake experience.

  • Knowledge of and experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Snowflake, Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, etc.)

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, Data Processing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world's leading data platforms.

The Team

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our Data Processing team in Zurich. You will start with a pizza sized team with the goal to grow further.

The team owns the core engine that makes Observe work. That includes the systems that compiles our query language OPAL into SQL, the query execution pipeline that executes user queries, the scheduler which autoscales warehouses and packs workloads for high utilization and low query latencies, and our incremental view maintenance. Building features in these systems while keeping the system healthy, cost-efficient, and resilient at petabyte scale is a constant challenge. The team sits at the heart of Observe's differentiation: a full observability platform built entirely on Snowflake.

In this role you will

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of backend engineers working on compiler internals, distributed scheduling, query execution, and data materialization. Coach them on their careers and help each of them reach their full potential.

  • Hire top talent, and represent Observe and Snowflake to candidates.

  • Work closely with other Observe product and backend teams to plan and execute new product features and scale existing systems to meet new challenges.

  • Work with core Snowflake engineering teams in Germany and the US to integrate Observe more deeply with Snowflake technologies. Communicate Observe's needs clearly and drive improvements in the underlying platform together.

  • Strategically reduce technical debt in the area. Know where it lives, build a plan to pay it down, and balance that plan against new feature work.

  • Keep many ongoing projects moving in parallel, setting clear priorities and making sure nothing important falls through the cracks.

  • Own the operational health of the area: performance, compute cost efficiency, on-call load, and support cost. Lead the team through production incidents and customer escalations, and drive postmortems and follow-up work.

  • Stay close to the code: write, review, and fix code when needed, and dig into real production workloads alongside the team.

Qualifications

  • Proven record managing a team of 5+ engineers that delivered complex backend or infrastructure systems in a fast-paced environment.

  • A background in database systems, such as query processing, query optimization, storage, or compilers.

  • Solid experience building and operating distributed systems.

  • Hands-on engineering skills: able to write, review, and fix production code.

  • Able to run many concurrent projects at once and to prioritize clearly between them.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Software Engineer for our Trust & Platform Security team. This team is building the next generation of cyber security monitoring for Snowflake customers where discovery, detection and remediation occurs in the same system. In the agentic era, threats and vulnerabilities occur at machine speed and scale and we are building a platform to detect and respond to these threats in real time. This team is also responsible for building the next generation of network and data enforcement engines: context aware ingress, data exfiltration protection and unified data movement policies for Snowflake's cloud security infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of security policy and system enforcement, building features that help keep perimeter controls robust, scalable, and integrated with context-aware access frameworks.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build and ship components to detect security vulnerabilities and threats, shadow AI and other agentic threats.

  • Develop data loss and ransomware detection mechanisms and ensure signals yield low false positive rates.

  • Write and contribute to design documents for product features, with attention to reliability, latency, and auditability

  • Work with senior engineers and Product Management to turn requirements into well-scoped tasks and deliver them independently

  • Write well-tested, secure code and take part in code reviews

  • Own features through implementation, testing, and production rollout with guidance from senior teammates

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Working knowledge of network security fundamentals (TLS/SSL, HTTP/S, DNS), Zero Trust principles, or Data Loss Prevention (DLP) concepts

  • Solid coding skills in SQL, Java, Python and exposure to building distributed or backend systems and willingness for full stack exposure

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and their security or networking controls

  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow ownership over larger parts of the system

  • Clear communication and comfort collaborating with cross-functional partners

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Exposure to cloud-native security controls (e.g., VPC Service Controls, Private Link)

  • Experience with egress control, network perimeter enforcement, or policy engines

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling

  • Contributions to open-source security projects, security research, or CTFs

WHY JOIN OUR TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will work on security controls that protect customer data across Snowflake, at a scale few companies operate. This is an early-career role with real ownership: you will ship production features in a high-impact security area while learning from experienced infrastructure and security engineers.

 - Build and ship components to detect security vulnerabilities and threats, shadow AI and other agentic threats.

 - Develop data loss and ransomware detection mechanisms and ensure signals yield low false positive rates.

 - Write and contribute to design documents for product features, with attention to reliability, latency, and auditability

 - Work with senior engineers and Product Management to turn requirements into well-scoped tasks and deliver them independently

 - Write well-tested, secure code and take part in code reviews

 - Own features through implementation, testing, and production rollout with guidance from senior teammates




OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY WILL HAVE:

 - 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

 - Working knowledge of network security fundamentals (TLS/SSL, HTTP/S, DNS), Zero Trust principles, or Data Loss Prevention (DLP) concepts

 - Solid coding skills in SQL, Java, Python and exposure to building distributed or backend systems and willingness for full stack exposure

 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and their security or networking controls

 - Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow ownership over larger parts of the system

 - Clear communication and comfort collaborating with cross-functional partners

 - BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Exposure to cloud-native security controls (e.g., VPC Service Controls, Private Link)

 - Experience with egress control, network perimeter enforcement, or policy engines

 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling

 - Contributions to open-source security projects, security research, or CTFs




WHY JOIN OUR TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will work on security controls that protect customer data across Snowflake, at a scale few companies operate. This is an early-career role with real ownership: you will ship production features in a high-impact security area while learning from experienced infrastructure and security engineers.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Software Engineer – Metadata

Company Pitch

Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud. Thousands of organizations run their most critical data, analytics, and AI workloads on our platform. We built Snowflake for the cloud from day one: near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Our goal is to make every organization's data instantly useful and always available.

Team Pitch

The Metadata team owns the brain of Snowflake. Every query, table, transaction, and permission depends on the metadata layer we build. Our systems handle millions of metadata operations per second. We also power cross-region and cross-cloud replication and failover, keeping customer data available through outages. If you want hard distributed-systems problems with direct customer impact, this is the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design of core metadata and replication systems across multiple teams.

  • Set technical direction for scalability, consistency, and fault tolerance of the metadata layer.

  • Drive cross-region and cross-cloud replication toward lower RPO and higher reliability.

  • Solve hard problems in performance, availability, and correctness at global scale.

  • Partner with Product and architects to turn customer needs into durable designs.

  • Raise the operational bar through observability, safe rollouts, and blast-radius controls.

  • Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders on the team.

Requirements

Core Requirements:

  • 10+ years building large-scale distributed systems or database internals.

  • Strong development skills in Java or C++.

  • Proven record leading multi-team technical initiatives from design to production.

  • Deep understanding of consistency, transactions, and fault tolerance.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Any of the following would make you a stronger candidate:

  • Experience with FoundationDB or other distributed key-value stores.

  • Experience building replication, disaster recovery, or geo-distributed systems.

  • Experience with database metadata, catalogs, or query compilation.

  • Experience running services on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This position requires a hybrid work schedule with regular in-person attendance at our Menlo Park.

WHO WE ARE

Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud, a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Inside the AI Data Cloud, organizations unite their siloed data, easily discover and securely share governed data, and execute diverse analytic workloads. Wherever data or users live, Snowflake delivers a single and seamless experience across multiple public clouds. Snowflake's platform is the engine that powers and provides access to the AI Data Cloud, creating a solution for data warehousing, data lakes, data engineering, data science, data application development, and data sharing. Join Snowflake customers, partners, and data providers already taking their businesses to new frontiers in the AI Data Cloud. snowflake.com\


WHO YOU ARE
Snowflake is seeking a strategic, customer-obsessed Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy Programs to lead and scale Snowflake's flagship global advocacy programs, turning our most valued customers into powerful brand champions on the world's biggest stages.

You are the architect of Snowflake's most visible customer programs: iconic billboard campaigns, customer activations around LA28, our executive Customer Advisory Board (the Black Diamond Council), and Alpine Club, our premier co-marketing program for Snowflake's most strategic customers. At the same time, you are grounded in the fundamentals of customer marketing: identifying, recruiting, and nurturing the right customer voices, building durable advocacy, and translating customer outcomes into stories that create mutual value across the customer lifecycle. You see customer advocacy as a growth lever, not just a program, a way to deepen trust with strategic accounts, inform business and product strategy, and act as a true partner to Sales.

You thrive at the intersection of executive relationship management, program strategy, and creative ambition. You know how to earn the trust of a Fortune 500 CDO, design experiences executives want to be part of, navigate complex brand and legal approvals, and orchestrate a cross-functional team from concept through launch. You are equally comfortable facilitating a room of senior technology leaders and in a working session with a creative agency, and you operate with a bias toward bold ideas, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and a deep commitment to making the customer the hero.

This role reports to the Director of Customer Marketing and partners closely with Brand, Creative, Media, Events, PR, Product Marketing, Social, Web, and Sales teams, as well as Snowflake's external agency partners.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the strategy and end-to-end execution of Snowflake's customer advocacy programs, including billboard activations, LA28 customer activation, the Black Diamond Council, and Alpine Club

  • Lead billboard strategy and activation, identifying customer stories through creative development, customer approvals, media placement, launch, and amplification

  • Develop and execute Snowflake's LA28 customer activation strategy, designing differentiated experiences and storytelling moments that engage strategic customers and showcase their innovation

  • Lead engagement and strategic programming for the Black Diamond Council, Snowflake's executive-level Customer Advisory Board, including in-person meetings, virtual sessions, member communications, and recruitment

  • Translate Black Diamond Council insights into actionable recommendations that inform Snowflake's business, product, and marketing strategy

  • Oversee Alpine Club strategy, planning, and execution, recognizing and elevating Snowflake's most strategic customers through long-term, multi-faceted brand partnerships

  • Build program frameworks, activation calendars, and repeatable processes that ensure consistency, quality, and impact across all advocacy programs and regions

  • Put the customer first by building trusted, long-term relationships with senior executives at Snowflake's top customers and creating experiences and stories that deliver mutual value

  • Serve as a strategic partner to Sales, using high-visibility programs and executive engagement to strengthen relationships with strategic accounts and support retention, expansion, and growth

  • Serve as the central orchestrator across Brand, Creative, Media, Events, PR, Product Marketing, Social, and Web, owning timelines, dependencies, budgets, and launch readiness

  • Track, analyze, and report on program performance and impact; deliver regular program updates to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

WHAT YOU’LL HAVE

  • A customer-obsessed mindset with an instinct for the stories and experiences that move markets - and the patience and persistence to bring them to life

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives, including CIOs, CDOs, and communications leads, at enterprise-scale organizations

  • Strong understanding of the customer lifecycle and the role customer marketing and advocacy play across acquisition, expansion, and retention

  • Deep experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder advocacy programs, executive programs, or integrated campaigns from strategy through launch

  • Exceptional program and project management skills, with the ability to run multiple high-visibility programs and orchestrate cross-functional teams simultaneously

  • Strong strategic judgment - you know which customers, stories, and moments are ready to go big, and you know how to get them there

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executives both internally and externally

  • Experience managing agency and vendor relationships and budgets, and translating creative feedback effectively

  • Highly organized, self-directed, and effective operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EDUCATION

  • 8+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, executive programs, or integrated campaign management in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology

  • Experience building and running a Customer Advisory Board or executive community program for senior technology leaders

  • A track record of delivering high-profile brand moments, such as billboard and out-of-home campaigns, major sporting event or sponsorship activations, and marquee event programs featuring recognizable customer brands

  • Familiarity with corporate communications dynamics and the sensitivities of co-marketing with publicly traded or privacy-conscious enterprise brands

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders with confidence and credibility

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

  • Experience with Google Suite, Salesforce, Tableau, and Wrike

LET’S DO THIS!

The Snowflake Customer Marketing team is a small, tight-knit, dynamic group responsible for building and maintaining customer relationships to drive retention, loyalty, and advocacy. These programs represent the pinnacle of that work - putting Snowflake's most strategic customers at the center of our most iconic moments, from billboards to LA28 to the executive boardroom. We're looking for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it. If you want to shape the stories that define how the world sees the AI Data Cloud, we want to hear from you.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
