jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Service
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

There is only one Data Cloud. Snowflake’s founders started from scratch and designed a data platform built for the cloud that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. But it didn’t stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

Our product offering runs on multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Our infrastructure self-optimizes and provides high availability and data protection across cloud providers, so our users can focus on using their data, not managing it.

Our team is the Compute Service team. We build and operate the systems that schedule and run warehouse-backed work beyond a user’s interactive query: asynchronous and scheduled compute, elastic capacity for parts of live queries, and the scheduling control plane those workloads run on. We balance usability, performance, cost, and reliability for the teams and customers that depend on this compute.

We are actively hiring talented distributed systems developers. This role is an opportunity to shape the architecture and operation of core services that the rest of Snowflake runs on.

As a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer at Snowflake you will:

  • Solve real business needs at large scale by applying software engineering and analytical problem solving.

  • Design and implement scalable distributed systems for scheduling, queueing, dispatch, and completion of warehouse-backed work.

  • Analyze fault tolerance, high availability, performance, and scale challenges, and solve them.

  • Build admission control, isolation, and capacity management so shared compute stays fair and predictable.

  • Strong computer-science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Systems programming skills, including multi-threading and concurrency. Fluency in Java is preferred.

  • A track record of identifying problems and implementing creative solutions.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • A BS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is a plus.

  • Build an industry-leading cloud data platform.

We are hiring an Account Executive, Public Sector to grow Snowflake's footprint across Singapore's public sector. Agencies are scaling AI across government and need data foundations that are secure, well governed and ready for trusted AI. You will help ministries, statutory boards and government technology organisations get there, turning their data and AI priorities into lasting partnerships with Snowflake.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, PUBLIC SECTOR AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own a named territory of Singapore public sector agencies, building account plans that connect the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to each agency's mission, digital roadmap and AI ambitions.

  • Run complex, procurement-driven sales cycles end to end, including tenders, RFPs, quotations and framework or bulk tender arrangements, through to contract and expansion.

  • Show how Snowflake Horizon governance, secure data sharing, Cortex AI and Snowpark help agencies unify data across silos and deliver AI use cases that are transparent, auditable and secure.

  • Build trusted relationships from programme and data teams through to CIO and CDO level, influencing how agencies approach their data and AI strategy.

  • Co-sell with the systems integrators, cloud partners and marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) that deliver for the Singapore government, building joint pipeline and account plans.

  • Work alongside Solution Engineers, Professional Services and Partner teams to run proofs of value and drive consumption after go-live.

  • Forecast with discipline, keep a healthy pipeline and share field insight with APJ leadership, Marketing and Product.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, PUBLIC SECTOR WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of enterprise software, cloud or security sales experience, including meaningful time selling to Singapore public sector organisations.

  • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Hands-on experience with Singapore government procurement and a clear understanding of how agencies evaluate, fund and buy technology.

  • A working understanding of public sector cloud, data governance and security frameworks, and how they shape buying decisions.

  • Strong working relationships with the systems integrators and partners that serve government.

  • Fluency in a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or Value Selling.

  • Clear, credible communication with technical teams and senior non-technical leaders alike.

  • A degree or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience at a cloud partner or consultancy with a public sector practice, a cybersecurity vendor, or a data, analytics or integration software company.

  • Experience selling data platforms, AI or GenAI solutions.

  • Familiarity with consumption-based commercial models.

  • Exposure to public sector, healthcare or education accounts elsewhere in APJ.

  • Curiosity about using AI tools to sharpen account research, planning and forecasting.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Singapore's public sector is one of the most digitally ambitious in the world, and data is central to how agencies plan to deliver better services with AI. In this role you will help shape that journey as part of an experienced, collaborative Singapore sales team, with the full depth of Snowflake's product, partner and engineering expertise behind you.

You will build long-term relationships, close meaningful deals and grow your career while seeing the real-world impact of your work on citizens and communities.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

  • Lead business value conversations that show how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, including Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, secure data sharing and Snowflake Marketplace, delivers measurable outcomes for each customer

  • Engage confidently with both technical audiences (data engineers, architects, CTOs) and business leaders (CFOs, CEOs, heads of digital), tailoring your message to each

  • Co-sell with Snowflake's partner ecosystem in Malaysia, including systems integrators, data consultancies and cloud partners such as AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud

  • Run rigorous deal inspection and accurate forecasting, maintaining strong sales hygiene in Salesforce

  • Represent Snowflake across the Malaysian technology community, building trusted relationships with customers and partners

OUR IDEAL COMMERCIAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, ACQUISITION WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years of B2B sales experience, including success managing mid-market territories at a SaaS, cloud or data company

  • A proven record of personal quota attainment selling to customers in Malaysia

  • Demonstrated success creating pipeline from scratch and winning new logos

  • Strong business value selling skills, with the ability to connect technology to commercial outcomes

  • Disciplined deal inspection, forecasting and sales hygiene practices

  • Confidence selling to both technical and business stakeholders

  • A base in Kuala Lumpur, established relationships across the local customer and partner ecosystem, and a strong understanding of how business is done in Malaysia

  • A resourceful, self-directed approach and comfort working with limited support while a new territory is being built

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience selling to digital natives, including fintech or blockchain organisations

  • Experience at a cloud, data or SaaS vendor, or within the Snowflake partner ecosystem (systems integrators, cloud or data consultancies)

  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar qualification methodology

  • Ability to communicate in Bahasa Malaysia or other regional languages

  • Experience launching or rebuilding a territory

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE? Snowflake helps organisations across Asia Pacific and Japan get value from their data and AI. In this role, you'll shape Snowflake's presence in Malaysia, build lasting customer relationships and have a direct hand in growing a high-potential market.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who thrives at the intersection of data, AI, and complex enterprise architecture. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the data challenges of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, deliver compelling data-driven demonstrations, and support enterprise Proof of Concepts that showcase measurable business outcomes.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion for transforming how organizations use data — from raw ingestion to real-time analytics to AI-powered applications. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are equally comfortable whiteboarding a medallion architecture with a data engineering team and presenting data ROI to a C-suite, and you bring deep opinions about what good data platform design looks like.

Location Requirement: Must be in North Carolina or South Carolina.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake's Data Cloud vision to data engineering leaders, analytics teams, data scientists, and executive stakeholders at prospects and customers

  • Lead hands-on technical discovery to map a customer's existing data architecture — pipelines, warehouses, lakehouses, governance gaps — and design a Snowflake-native path forward

  • Build and deliver tailored demos and proof of concepts across Snowflake's full data platform: data engineering (Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe), AI/ML (Cortex AI, ML model registry), and data sharing (Data Clean Rooms, Marketplace listings)

  • Guide customers through modern data architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, real-time streaming pipelines, and unified governance frameworks

  • Translate ambiguous business problems — churn prediction, supply chain visibility, financial consolidation, operational analytics — into concrete Snowflake data solutions

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

  • Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

  • Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

  • Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

  • Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

  • Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

  • A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

  • University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

  • Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

  • Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

 

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

 

ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Our built-for-the-cloud architecture delivers the performance of a data warehouse, the flexibility of a data lake, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of traditional costs.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

 - Guide customers through modern data architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, real-time streaming pipelines, and unified governance frameworks

 - Translate ambiguous business problems — churn prediction, supply chain visibility, financial consolidation, operational analytics — into concrete Snowflake data solutions

 - Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

 


ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

 - 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

 - Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

 - Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 - Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

 - Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

 - Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

 - Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

 - A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

 - University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

 - Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

 - $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

 - Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

 


ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

 


ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Our built-for-the-cloud architecture delivers the performance of a data warehouse, the flexibility of a data lake, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of traditional costs.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

jobs.title: Principal Enterprise Architect, Data and AI (FSI), Applied Field Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Principal Enterprise Architect, Data and AI for our Applied Field Engineering (Field CTO) team, focused on the Financial Services Industry across Australia. This role sits at the intersection of Snowflake's most strategic FSI customers and our product and engineering organizations, shaping how banks, insurers, and capital markets firms adopt the AI Data Cloud. Success here is measured not by artifacts produced, but by the architecture decisions you influence and the industry outcomes you unlock.

AS A PRINCIPAL ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Serve as the senior technical authority and trusted advisor to CxO and chief-architect stakeholders at Australia's largest financial institutions, translating business strategy into durable data and AI architecture.

  • Define reference architectures and modernization roadmaps for FSI workloads such as risk, fraud, regulatory reporting, customer 360, and generative AI, grounded in the Snowflake platform including Cortex AI and Snowpark.

  • Lead high-stakes architectural engagements end to end, from discovery through to a defensible target-state design that balances governance, data residency, and regulatory requirements.

  • Influence the Snowflake product roadmap by channeling field insight and FSI regulatory needs back to product and engineering teams.

  • Partner with account teams, solution engineers, and SI and GSI partners to unblock the most complex technical decisions and accelerate platform consumption.

  • Set the technical bar for the Field CTO practice in the region, mentoring architects and solution engineers and codifying reusable patterns.

  • Represent Snowflake as a thought leader at executive briefings, industry forums, and regulatory working groups across the Australian FSI market.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture, cloud data platforms, or enterprise architecture, with deep exposure to financial services.

  • A track record of company-wide or industry-wide technical influence, shaping architecture decisions at the most senior stakeholder levels.

  • Deep understanding of data platform, analytics, and AI and machine learning architecture, including modern approaches to generative AI and retrieval-augmented workflows.

  • Fluency in the FSI regulatory and risk landscape, including data governance, residency, privacy, and operational resilience expectations relevant to Australian financial institutions.

  • While the role primarily focuses on Financial Services Industry (FSI), experience in the Telecommunications sector is highly desirable.

  • Proven ability to personally lead technical discovery and solutioning, not only to orchestrate specialists.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills with executive and technical audiences, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, or comparable cloud data platforms across AWS, Azure, or GCP, as a supporting capability.

  • Experience building or advising on generative AI and large language model applications in a regulated environment.

  • Familiarity with the Australian FSI partner, SI, and GSI ecosystem.

  • Prior experience in a Field CTO, office of the CTO, or principal customer-facing architect capacity.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to join Frontier Engineering in Sydney. You will lead the technical program across Forward Deployed Engineering engagements, working embedded with strategic customers' engineering teams to take data and AI solutions into production. You will partner with Engagement Managers and Program Managers, and connect customer needs to Snowflake's global Product & Engineering teams.

Frontier Engineering delivers Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements across Data Transformation and Agentic Transformation for strategic enterprise customers. You will work alongside Engagement Managers, who own the customer relationship and engagement commercials, and Program Managers, who own program coordination, reporting, and operating cadence. You will own technical execution across workstreams, including integration, engineering readiness, dependencies, and production delivery.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the integrated technical plan, cross-workstream dependencies and technical risk across multiple FDE workstreams building on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Drive workstreams from engineering readiness through integration, release, production cutover, and operational handoff, resolving blockers across customer and Snowflake engineering teams. Lead release and production cutover of Snowflake-based data and AI solutions.

  • Identify and prioritize customer-driven product gaps and defects, distinguish one-off requirements from recurring product issues, and drive resolution with global Snowflake Product & Engineering teams across time zones.

  • Give technical estimates, effort and risk input to Engagement Managers and Program Managers to protect delivery feasibility.

  • Provide commercial awareness of SOW/exhibit scope, change control and delivery done at risk.

  • Identify scope changes, delivery-at-risk decisions, and emerging technical constraints; provide the impact assessment needed by Engagement Managers to manage SOW scope and change control.

  • Report technical status clearly to Snowflake and customer stakeholders, from engineering teams to executives.

  • Use AI-assisted workflows, including Snowflake Cortex capabilities, to improve delivery tooling and execution.

  • Help establish the FDE Technical Program Management practice in ANZ.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • Typically 8+ years leading complex, multi-workstream technical programs.

  • Hands-on delivery leadership of technical programs into production, such as data platform, MLOps, GenAI/AI, or software and application development projects.

  • Experience leading technical delivery within enterprise customer environments, navigating customer-owned infrastructure, access constraints, and shared delivery responsibilities (e.g. consultancy, SI, vendor professional services).

  • Strong dependency and technical risk management across multiple engineering teams.

  • Technical depth to challenge engineering estimates, assess architectural and integration trade-offs, identify delivery risks, and drive sequencing decisions with engineering leads.

  • The conviction to challenge customers, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders when assumptions, technical decisions, or delivery plans don't hold up.

  • Operates independently in ambiguous environments, exercises sound judgment without waiting for consensus, and takes ownership of getting to an outcome.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience leading forward-deployed engineering engagements, with direct responsibility for integrating solutions into customer environments and taking them to production.

  • Strong point of view and the confidence to challenge customers and senior stakeholders when technical decisions or delivery commitments don't hold up.

  • Willingness to challenge conventional approaches, identify what's not working, and push for a better technical or delivery strategy.

  • Delivery in regulated financial services (e.g. banking, APRA-regulated environments).

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake (Cortex, Openflow) or other cloud data platforms.

  • An engineering manager or tech lead background in data platform or software/application development.

  • Consultancy or Big-4 technical program leadership.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

We are looking for a senior Enterprise Account Executive to lead Snowflake's relationships with a focused portfolio of our largest and most strategic public sector customers and prospects. You will own complex, whole-of-government and major agency accounts, expanding Snowflake's footprint across established customers while landing new strategic logos, and shaping multi-year transformation programs built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

AS AN ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, PUBLIC SECTOR AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own a small portfolio of complex public sector accounts, building multi-year strategic account plans that combine consumption expansion with targeted net-new acquisition.

  • Shape and close large, transformational programs that position the Snowflake AI Data Cloud as the enterprise data foundation for whole-of-government data sharing, analytics, and AI.

  • Grow strategic workloads across agencies and business units, including Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, Snowflake Marketplace, secure data sharing and clean rooms, and Snowflake Horizon governance.

  • Engage and influence senior executives, including Department Secretaries, Deputy Secretaries and Business Leaders, CIOs, CDOs, and program sponsors, aligning Snowflake to national digital, data, and AI agendas.

  • Lead complex procurement pursuits end to end, including large tenders, panel and framework arrangements, enterprise agreements, and security, sovereignty, and compliance accreditation.

  • Orchestrate a virtual account team across Solution Engineering, Professional Services, Partner, Legal, and Snowflake executives, and co-sell with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and global systems integrators.

  • Drive large-scale migrations from legacy data warehouses and on-premise platforms onto Snowflake, with clear value realisation and executive business reviews.

  • Forecast with precision and run rigorous deal strategy using MEDDPICC or a similar methodology across long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

OUR IDEAL ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, PUBLIC SECTOR WILL HAVE:

  • A deep, consistent track record of selling complex technical solutions (SaaS, cloud, data, or AI) into the largest, most strategic public sector or enterprise accounts.

  • Proven success closing large, multi-year, multi-million dollar agreements and growing them through disciplined expansion.

  • Demonstrated ability to run both expansion and acquisition motions within a strategic, named-account portfolio.

  • Established credibility with senior government executives and the ability to influence at the most senior levels of an organisation.

  • Expert command of public sector procurement, enterprise agreements, and the security and data sovereignty requirements that shape major government technology decisions.

  • Experience leading virtual account teams and partner ecosystems to deliver complex, high-visibility programs.

  • Mastery of MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification framework, with a reputation for accurate forecasting.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience selling data platforms, data warehousing, analytics, or AI/ML at enterprise scale into government.

  • Strong existing relationships with global systems integrators and hyperscalers serving the public sector.

  • Background driving consumption-based growth across large, decentralised organisations.

  • Experience positioning AI and GenAI initiatives with government leadership.

OUR IDEAL PUBLIC SECTOR ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:

  • A demonstrated, consistent track record selling complex technical solutions (SaaS, Cloud, Data, or AI) into the public sector market, with the strategic maturity to own senior, high-value agency relationships.

  • Ideally experience working with large Public Sector Agencies such as Health and ACC

  • Strategic thinking about how to advance all of government outcomes and cross agency value

  • Proven strategic engagement skills: the ability to navigate multi-stakeholder environments, challenge the status quo, and shape long-term, outcome-based agency roadmaps rather than transactional deals.

  • Fluency in New Zealand government procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, and multi-level approval processes.

  • Experience articulating the value of data, analytics, or AI platforms to non-technical and technical agency stakeholders alike.

  • The energy, independence, and low-ego collaboration style to help revamp and grow a strategic public sector book with ambition.

  • Experience selling into the health sector or to health-focused agencies (this is ideal, but, not a hard requirement, strong strategic engagement skills are the priority).

  • Experience helping public sector organizations adopt AI and generative AI use cases responsibly.

  • Existing relationships across New Zealand public sector agencies.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to help customers across India turn complex data and AI priorities into measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical expertise, consultative discovery, and executive communication to shape secure, scalable solutions on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

 

AS A SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Lead technical discovery with customers and translate business priorities into architectures built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Design and demonstrate solutions using Snowflake capabilities such as Cortex AI, Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Streamlit in Snowflake, and secure data sharing.

  • Build proofs of concept that validate performance, governance, interoperability, and business value for high-priority customer workloads.

  • Advise customers on modernizing data platforms and migrating analytical workloads to Snowflake while reducing complexity and operational overhead.

  • Partner with Account Executives, Product Management, Professional Services, and Snowflake partners to develop account strategies and remove technical barriers.

  • Guide customer stakeholders on security, governance, privacy, and responsible AI patterns using Snowflake Horizon and related platform controls.

  • Influence technical and executive decision makers through clear architecture narratives, workshops, demonstrations, and value-focused presentations.

  • Mentor Solutions Engineering peers and contribute reusable field assets, reference architectures, and product feedback that improve execution across the region.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in solutions engineering, data architecture, cloud platforms, analytics, or an equivalent customer-facing technical role.

  • A strong foundation in data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, and enterprise security.

  • Experience leading technical discovery and designing solutions for complex enterprise requirements.

  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, business leaders, and executives.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and at least one major cloud platform as supporting capabilities for solution design and validation.

  • A record of influencing customer decisions through consultative problem solving, demonstrations, and proofs of concept.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to lead across sales, product, services, partners, and customer teams without direct authority.

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with Snowflake, Cortex AI, Snowpark, Streamlit in Snowflake, or native application development.

  • Familiarity with GenAI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, model governance, and AI-assisted solution engineering workflows.

  • Experience supporting data platform modernization or migration programs in large enterprises.

  • Knowledge of data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations relevant to customers in India.

  • Experience mentoring technical presales professionals or leading cross-account technical initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager and Evangelist, ASEAN
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

 
 

BUILD WHATS NEXT FOR AI AND DATA IN ASEAN

This is not a typical product marketing role.

At Snowflake, you’ll help shape how the ASEAN market understands, adopts, and accelerates the future of the AI Data Cloud. You’ll sit at the intersection of product marketing, technical evangelism, go-to-market strategy, and industry influence—bringing together customers, partners, sellers, and marketers around one of the most important technology shifts of our time.

If you thrive on turning complex technology into market momentum, love being in front of customers and communities, and want to make a visible impact in one of the world’s most exciting growth regions, this role was built for you.

 
 

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

Snowflake is scaling fast, and ASEAN is a strategic growth market. In this role, you won’t just support the business—you’ll help define how Snowflake wins in-region.

 

You’ll be the voice of Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud across the market, translating innovation into relevance for customers, shaping go-to-market strategy, and influencing adoption at scale. With more than 13,000 customers already using Snowflake to modernize data access, accelerate analytics, and unlock data-driven insight, you’ll help drive the next wave of growth powered by AI.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead Snowflake’s Product Marketing and Evangelism efforts across the ASEAN market.

  • Build and execute go-to-market strategies and innovative programs that strengthen Snowflake’s market position and accelerate growth.

  • Evangelize the AI Data Cloud through speaking engagements, social media, video, and community engagement across customers, partners, media, analysts, and broader industry audiences.

  • Develop compelling messaging, content, and sales enablement assets for Snowflake teams and partner teams.

  • Partner cross-functionally with demand generation, content marketing, sales, product management, and global stakeholders to align and execute regional go-to-market plans.

  • Own and lead end-to-end product launches for ASEAN, including internal and external briefings, spokesperson support, enablement content and sessions, and alignment with marketing and PR on launch campaigns and events.

  • Build market and competitive intelligence, and serve as a thought leader on the trends shaping the industry.

  • Champion diversity and belonging as part of how we work, lead, and grow as a company.

 
 

WHAT MAKES YOU A STAND OUT

You’re equal parts strategist, storyteller, and technologist. You can move comfortably from executive conversations to technical narratives, from launch planning to live evangelism, and from market insight to field execution.

 

Our ideal candidate brings:

  • 15-20+ years of experience spanning technology, product, and market-facing roles, with strong exposure to data management and AI/ML.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging internal leaders, external stakeholders, and public audiences.

  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling presentations and plans.

  • A track record of working on complex data solutions and demonstrating architectural or technical leadership.

  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret information and turn it into actionable insight.

  • Strong understanding of both the technical foundations and business value of modern data technologies, across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience with database products.

  • A BS/BA or equivalent practical experience.

  • A proven history of partnering with field GTM teams—across marketing, sales, and solution engineering—to create high-impact content and messaging that connects with diverse personas, from technical practitioners to C-level executives like the CMO, CFO, and CRO.

  • Deep insight into the unique technological landscape and market dynamics across the ASEAN region.

  • Professional fluency in regional languages including Bahasa, Mandarin, Cantonese or Thai is strongly advantageous, complementing English proficiency.

 

WHY SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is growing quickly, and we’re building a team of people who challenge conventional thinking, move with urgency, and create meaningful impact. We care deeply about our people, customers, culture, and values—and we’re looking for people with the growth mindset to solve for today while building for the future.

If you want a role with visibility, influence, and the opportunity to shape one of the most important categories in enterprise technology, this is your moment.

 
 

READY TO MAKE YOUR IMPACT

Join Snowflake and help define how the AI Data Cloud wins in ASEAN.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Workplace Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are seeking a proactive, highly adaptable Senior Workplace Technician to be the full-time, on-site anchor (Mon–Fri) of our office campus. You are a natural self-starter who brings a warm approachable energy, a customer-first mindset and a sharp eye for the details that make a workplace feel exceptional.
Beyond your technical and practical know-how, your greatest strength lies in taking complete ownership—stepping up in grey areas, adapting to quick pivots, and executing high-impact solutions with ease.

GENERAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

In this role, you will keep our daily office environment running smoothly by taking ownership of a diverse set of workplace and operational functions, including:

  • Lead physical office modifications, move/add/change (MAC) activities, furniture assemblies, and spatial reconfigurations.

  • Skilled in both digital workplace platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, ticketing systems, space planning apps) and practical, hands-on physical execution like furniture assembly, basic repairs, and everyday maintenance.

  • Oversee campus EV charging stations by monitoring usage, troubleshooting technical issues on the spot, and partnering directly with vendors for hardware or software resolutions.

  • Operational Optimization: Stay three steps ahead by spotting bottlenecks early and bringing fresh, creative ideas to make our physical facilities run smarter and more efficiently.

  • Builds strong in-person relationships with cross-functional partners and team members to plan, coordinate, and deliver exceptional everyday workplace services.

  • Resolve facilities tickets efficiently and with care, keeping communication transparent and ensuring every workplace request is handled to the highest standard.

  • Manage project budgets efficiently: monitoring spend, driving cost-effective vendor solutions, and maintaining tight fiscal responsibility across all on-site initiatives.

  • Vendor Management: Manage on-site third-party vendors and contractors, ensuring service partners consistently meet standards of accountability and performance quality.

    WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience: You’ve spent 5+ years in facility operations, managing multi-floor spaces or large corporate campuses where things move fast. If you have trade certifications (IFMA, BOC, LEED AP, or similar), that's definitely a big plus in our book.

  • Ownership & Initiative: Drive project results from conception to completion with minimal supervision, keeping key stakeholders updated every step of the way.

  • Self-Starter Energy: You don't wait for a manual. You love taking ownership, solving unstructured problems, and getting things done.

  • Customer-Obsessed: You care deeply about people, bring great energy to every interaction, and take pride in crafting spaces people love working in.

  • Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive in fast-paced environments, ride the waves of change effortlessly, and stay cool under pressure.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving skills, strong verbal and written communication, and a customer-service mindset.

  • On-Your-Feet Readiness: Ready to move, lift up to 50 lbs, assemble or configure setups, and jump in to support occasional cool workplace events.

  • In-Office Dedication: Thrilled to be on-site 5 days a week, acting as the anchor for our physical space and community.


DISCLAIMER

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

How do you want to make your impact?

As a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Migration Services, you will lead scoping, architecture and technical direction as FDE teams embed with customers to modernise their data and application ecosystems on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will partner closely with customers to understand their business challenges, then design, build and implement modern data solutions on Snowflake. You'll act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers unlock the full potential of their data, drive insights, power AI initiatives and achieve significant business value with Snowflake.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Migration Leadership: Work across multiple FDE teams, each focused on a specific customer. Set the architecture and technical direction as teams design, build and deploy the software systems, tooling and automation needed for customer migrations to Snowflake.

  • Software Development: Contribute directly to Snowflake's product, as every Migration FDE does. Build prototypes, contribute to feature development and fix the problems we find, helping shape the product roadmap and deepening your product expertise.

  • Customer Collaboration and Enablement: Provide expert technical guidance, mentoring and training to customer teams on using Snowflake effectively, including data management, analytics, AI/ML capabilities and BI/reporting integration.

  • Platform Implementation: Design scalable data pipelines and modern data architectures on Snowflake, ensuring data quality, integrity and efficient processing.

  • Performance Optimisation and Best Practices: Analyse and optimise data models, queries and processing workflows for performance, efficiency and cost. Champion Snowflake best practices.

  • Modern Data Solutions: Evaluate, recommend and implement modern data integration tools and techniques that help customers evolve their data capabilities.

  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve technical challenges, performance bottlenecks and operational issues.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Experience working directly with customers on complex, multi-faceted technical projects

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, Go, Java or C++

  • Experience developing AI/ML applications

  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data warehousing, data lakes and cloud data platforms

  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a customer-facing environment

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

PREFERRED:

  • Experience delivering complex data and application migrations to the cloud

Travel: This role may involve up to 20% travel to collaborate with customers, teams and stakeholders.

Snowflake employees must abide by the company's data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

jobs.title: Principal Security Architect, Applied Field Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our Solution Engineering organization is seeking a Security Architect to join our APJ Field CTO Office to act as a security evangelist, architect, and hands-on subject matter expert/practitioner. In this role, you will cultivate key customer and partnership relationships, demonstrate thought leadership, and act as a trusted security advisor to current and potential customers. You will also collaborate with internal and external technical and business stake Security Architect, you must share our passion and vision in helping our customers and partners secure their Snowflake Accounts, thrive in a dynamic environment, and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop and deep diving with technical audiences.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Help to scope security related feature enhancements on behalf of customers to work with Product Management on ways to improve the product from a security perspective.

  • Assist in clarifying concepts of data engineering, data warehousing, data collaboration, AI and Machine Learning. Share industry best practices, and features in the Snowflake platform; Assist in building demos and prototypes using Snowflake in conjunction with other integrated solutions; Engage with other relevant Snowflake stakeholders internally.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support in order to drive customer security feature adoption.

  • Partner with our Product Marketing team to define and support Snowflake's AI and Data Cloud posture and Security DataLake workload awareness and pipeline building via marketing initiatives including conferences, trade shows, and events.

  • Work and collaborate with other Field CTO members in areas of: Enterprise AI, Gen AI, Data Engineering, Applications, as a security export you may be involved in collaborative engagements.

  • Partner with the best in the industry product team, helping to shape vision and capabilities for Snowflake Data Marketplace.

  • Share knowledge with internal and industry communities via webinars & conferences.


ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 10+ years of industry, customer-facing, and hands-on implementation experience with a core focus on data concepts, privacy, governance, networking, infosec and security technologies.

  • Strong understanding of security related concepts such as RBAC, OAuth, Identity and Access Management, encryption and data governance.

  • Expertise and in-depth working knowledge and hands-on experience in cloud platforms (at least one of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP), and its corresponding security, data encryption, and networking architecture and technologies.

  • Ability to build out demos, configure CSP environments, build out prototypes, and test use cases on the Snowflake platform and relevant integrations with CSP services and external security tools.

  • Ability to create security and networking-related reference architectures, security best practices and hardening guides, and articulate them to a customer audience.

  • A demonstrated knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK and how to articulate controls and security mechanisms within a Risk Assessment centred approach.

  • Knowledge of ANSI SQL compliant databases and / or data warehousing is preferred

  • AWS/Azure/GCP security and / or networking specialty related certification achievement is a plus

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IP routing, DNS, Proxies and CSP private networking technologies including NAT, Firewalls, TLS and related design and troubleshooting.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including cloud service providers like Azure, AWS, and GCP

  • Strong understanding of identity management use cases, including authentication (SAML), authorization (OAUTH), and identity governance (SCIM & RBAC)

  • Deep experience with large-scale infrastructure-as-a-service platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.)

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills, presentation and whiteboarding skills to a large audience, and the ability to successfully communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Fair understanding of the culture diversity across Asia Pacific Japan region and flexibility of working with customers and colleagues from multiple APJ time zones.

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Management Systems, or related field required. Masters preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We are hiring a Senior Solution Engineer dedicated to one of Snowflake's most strategically important enterprise customers. Depending on alignment, your client will sit within either Financial Services or technology, telecommunications & industrial manufacturing. You will own the full technical relationship, drive use case expansion across business units, and act as the go-to trusted advisor to CTO, CDO, and engineering leadership within the account. This is a senior-level, high-visibility role with global scope and direct exposure to Snowflake's leadership.


What You Will Do:

  • Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a single strategic Global Account in financial services or manufacturing/telco, from discovery and technical qualification through proof of concept, technical close, and ongoing expansion

  • Build and deliver compelling demonstrations, solution architectures, and executive presentations that connect Snowflake's platform capabilities to the specific data and AI priorities of enterprise buyers

  • Design and lead proof of concept engagements covering risk analytics, regulatory data platforms, real-time fraud detection, or smart manufacturing, supply chain telemetry, and AI/ML workloads

  • Act as a subject matter expert on enterprise data architecture, translating complex regulatory, operational, and technical requirements into practical, production-ready Snowflake solutions

  • Partner closely with the Account Executive/GAM and leadership as the sole technical owner of the account, co-developing the joint success plan and ensuring technical alignment across every active opportunity

  • Serve as the primary internal advocate for the account within Snowflake, coordinating across Product, Professional Services, Support, and Engineering to resolve blockers and accelerate adoption

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in pre-sales solution engineering, technical consulting, or data engineering in enterprise B2B technology, with significant exposure to financial services or manufacturing/telco customers

  • Deep understanding of enterprise data use cases across financial services or manufacturing

  • Strong hands-on expertise with cloud data platforms, ideally including Snowflake, and the ability to architect and demo enterprise-grade solutions live

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, and data engineering tools commonly used in enterprise environments (dbt, Spark, Kafka, or equivalent)

  • Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to engage credibly with CDOs, CTOs, and CIOs at global institutions

  • Track record of leading complex technical evaluations, winning competitive PoCs, and building lasting technical relationships with strategic enterprise accounts

  • Experience using AI and LLM-based tools in technical workflows, with the ability to articulate Snowflake's Cortex AI capabilities in an enterprise context

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience working within or selling to global financial institutions or enterprise manufacturers

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake including Cortex AI, data sharing, Snowpark, and Native Apps

  • Familiarity with enterprise cloud migration patterns and the technical landscape of legacy platforms (Teradata, Oracle, Hadoop)

  • Experience with real-time data architectures, streaming ingestion, and event-driven data platforms in regulated or industrial environments

  • Background in data mesh, data product design, or enterprise data governance frameworks relevant to industry compliance and operational requirements

As an Agentic Analytics intern on this team, you'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Sales, Developer Relations and Demand Gen to shape how the market understands and adopts Snowflake's answer to one of the most important questions in data and AI: how do you let agents do real analytical work that the business can trust? You'll get a front-row seat to how products are positioned and launched in the fastest-moving space in tech.

What You'll Do

  • Help develop go-to-market strategy and positioning for Snowflake's agentic analytics portfolio

  • Craft messaging that translates complex technical capabilities into clear business value

  • Conduct competitive research and market analysis that directly informs product and sales strategy

  • Build sales enablement assets, content briefs, and launch materials

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Developer Relations, and Demand Gen

  • Present your work to senior leaders

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a Master's degree (or equivalent graduate degree)

  • Analytical and curious: You like digging into data, competitive landscapes, and customer problems

  • Familiarity with databases, semantic layers, cloud platforms, or developer ecosystems

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving priorities

What You'll Get

  • Real ownership on live go-to-market initiatives

  • Exposure to the full GTM machine at a leading AI company, including product, sales, engineering, developer relations, content, demand gen, and more

  • A crash course in the Agentic Analytics and enterprise AI context, the market everyone is trying to understand right now

  • Prior experience in product marketing, product management, consulting, or technical roles

In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately help customers grow in their use of Snowflake.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the AI Data platform space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at Snowflake customers and prospects

  • Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology; identify use cases, and guide the customer to successfully take them from demo to implementation, and a successful go-live.

  • Present Customers with the innovations in Snowflake and the value these innovations add to their business.

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing.

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics

  • Ability to understand a customer’s specific business problems and translate these to Snowflake use cases

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred

  • Travel Required

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Security Architect, Applied Field Engineering (AFE)

OVERVIEW

Enterprises are modernizing data platforms at an exponential rate to meet demands for innovation, specifically with the rise of Generative and Agentic AI. As the leading AI and BI platform, Snowflake requires a secure-by-design foundation to drive business value. The Security Applied Field Engineering (AFE) organization is at the forefront of this effort, ensuring that security is a strategic accelerator rather than a bottleneck.

As a Senior Security Architect on the Applied Field Engineering team, you will drive strategic customer engagements and build the prescriptive frameworks required for the modern era. You will transition customers from legacy, siloed security tools to a unified Security Data Architecture. You will partner closely with Sales, GTM, Engineering, and Marketing to help customers transform their business within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud while maintaining a world-class security posture.

 
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Field Engineering & Security Architecture

  • Security Architecture Foundation: Drive strategic engagements focused on the Security Architecture, ensuring robust foundations across Identity, Data, and Infrastructure for applications built on Snowflake.

  • AI Security & Trust Foundations: Support customer strategy for secure AI adoption, leveraging Snowflake Cortex to bring state-of-the-art LLMs directly to customer data within a secure environment.

    • Architect trusted Agentic AI frameworks where Cortex Agents operate within governed boundaries, autonomously orchestrating tasks while inheriting Snowflake's native security perimeter.

    • Deploy Cortex Guard and AI Observability to filter harmful content and provide transparent, explainable AI interactions through rigorous monitoring and tracing.

    • Ensure AI governance by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data masking across all AI-driven insights and automated actions.

  • Modern Security Operations (SecOps): Deliver workshops and hands-on engagements to transition customers from legacy infrastructure to advanced SIEM Augmentation, Log Ingestion (Otel/Logs into Snowflake), and Cybersecurity Data Lake.

  • Governance & Identity: Build repeatable reference architectures and frameworks for Identity (IAM), Data Governance, Row-Level Security, and Encryption to accelerate well-architected deployments.

  • Resilience & Compliance: Guide customers through end-to-end journeys for BC/DR (Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery), including multi-region deployment patterns and measurable recovery outcomes.

  • Tooling and Content: Drive the creation of relevant technical content and tooling to showcase security best practices, accelerate new use case deployments, and adoption of new platform functionality.

  • Voice of the Field: Influence product roadmaps by serving as the Voice of the Field to Snowflake's product and engineering teams, translating customer needs into actionable feedback.

Core Experience

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Data, Security, Networking, Infrastructure or AI Engineering

  • Communication Skills: Strong technical communications skills with the ability to deliver compelling demos, whiteboard sessions, and presentations to both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Customer-facing Skills: The ability to act as a trusted advisor and establish credibility with senior leadership and enterprise architects.

Relevant Security Skill Sets

  • Generative AI Security: Deep understanding of LLM security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage) and mitigation strategies using tools like Cortex Guard.

  • Agentic AI Governance: Expertise in governing Autonomous Agents, ensuring "Human-in-the-loop" controls and auditability for agent-driven actions.

  • Data Privacy for AI: Mastery of techniques like Differential Privacy, Data Masking, and Secure Sandboxing to protect sensitive training and inference data.

  • Platform Observability: Proficiency in observability techniques including logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing on a platform level.

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Expertise in modern authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect) and implementing robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models across cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Secure Networking: Hands-on expertise in securing cloud and hybrid network architectures, including micro-segmentation, zero-trust principles, and secure deployment of services like Apache NiFi.

  • Programming: Hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and APIs.

  • Container and Kubernetes Security: Proficiency in securing the container lifecycle, from build (image scanning) to runtime (Pod Security Standards, network policies, service mesh), and managing secrets within Kubernetes.

  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC): Strong background in aligning security programs with regulatory frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and managing security risk through continuous monitoring and auditing.

Compliance & Standards (nice to have)

  • AI Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act) and their impact on enterprise data strategy.

  • Trust Certifications: Familiarity with how Snowflake’s AI Trust Center maps to SOC2, HIPAA, and HITRUST requirements for AI/ML workloads.

  • Industry Certifications: CISSP

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

   - Deploy Cortex Guard and AI Observability to filter harmful content and provide transparent, explainable AI interactions through rigorous monitoring and tracing.
   
   - Ensure AI governance by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data masking across all AI-driven insights and automated actions.

 - Modern Security Operations (SecOps): Deliver workshops and hands-on engagements to transition customers from legacy infrastructure to advanced SIEM Augmentation, Log Ingestion (Otel/Logs into Snowflake), and Cybersecurity Data Lake.

 - Governance & Identity: Build repeatable reference architectures and frameworks for Identity (IAM), Data Governance, Row-Level Security, and Encryption to accelerate well-architected deployments.

 - Resilience & Compliance: Guide customers through end-to-end journeys for BC/DR (Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery), including multi-region deployment patterns and measurable recovery outcomes.

 - Tooling and Content: Drive the creation of relevant technical content and tooling to showcase security best practices, accelerate new use case deployments, and adoption of new platform functionality.

 - Voice of the Field: Influence product roadmaps by serving as the Voice of the Field to Snowflake's product and engineering teams, translating customer needs into actionable feedback.


CORE EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of industry experience in Data, Security, Networking, Infrastructure or AI Engineering

 - Communication Skills: Strong technical communications skills with the ability to deliver compelling demos, whiteboard sessions, and presentations to both technical and business stakeholders.

 - Customer-facing Skills: The ability to act as a trusted advisor and establish credibility with senior leadership and enterprise architects.


RELEVANT SECURITY SKILL SETS

 - Generative AI Security: Deep understanding of LLM security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage) and mitigation strategies using tools like Cortex Guard.

 - Agentic AI Governance: Expertise in governing Autonomous Agents, ensuring "Human-in-the-loop" controls and auditability for agent-driven actions.

 - Data Privacy for AI: Mastery of techniques like Differential Privacy, Data Masking, and Secure Sandboxing to protect sensitive training and inference data.

 - Platform Observability: Proficiency in observability techniques including logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing on a platform level.

 - Identity and Access Management (IAM): Expertise in modern authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect) and implementing robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models across cloud and on-premises environments.

 - Secure Networking: Hands-on expertise in securing cloud and hybrid network architectures, including micro-segmentation, zero-trust principles, and secure deployment of services like Apache NiFi.

 - Programming: Hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and APIs.

 - Container and Kubernetes Security: Proficiency in securing the container lifecycle, from build (image scanning) to runtime (Pod Security Standards, network policies, service mesh), and managing secrets within Kubernetes.

 - Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC): Strong background in aligning security programs with regulatory frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and managing security risk through continuous monitoring and auditing.


COMPLIANCE & STANDARDS (NICE TO HAVE)

 - AI Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act) and their impact on enterprise data strategy.

 - Trust Certifications: Familiarity with how Snowflake’s AI Trust Center maps to SOC2, HIPAA, and HITRUST requirements for AI/ML workloads.

 - Industry Certifications: CISSP

Location: Pune, India

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.
