Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.

Snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago, and our biggest opportunity is also our customers' biggest challenge: migration. For every enterprise ready to harness the AI Data Cloud, there is a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. We believe generative AI is the key. We are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications.

We are hiring a Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed) to work at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. In this hybrid role, you will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who work directly with customers and partners on complex migrations, while also driving the development of AI-powered migration tools and products. Your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation, turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER, AI MIGRATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Lead and develop the team

  • Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, giving clear feedback and building growth paths

  • Recruit, hire and onboard engineers who can succeed in both customer delivery and engineering

  • Grow technical delivery leads and engineering leaders, including staff-level engineers

  • Foster a culture of creativity, innovation and practical decision-making

Deliver customer migrations

  • Lead complex migrations from legacy platforms such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza and SQL Server to Snowflake

  • Provide strategic oversight so projects align with customer objectives and Snowflake's goals

  • Act as the primary escalation point for delivery, working closely with customers and system integrators

  • Stay hands-on in strategic projects to assess quality and unblock teams

  • Partner with sales teams to scope opportunities, estimate effort, develop proposals and support account strategy

Build AI-powered migration products

  • Drive the design, development and iteration of AI-powered migration tools based on real customer needs

  • Guide the team in building AI-first products, including code translation, developer co-pilots and semantic validation

  • Turn field insights into engineering roadmap items and product improvements

  • Partner with Engineering and Product Management to align priorities and deliver high-quality solutions

  • Develop and share best practices, utilities and accelerators that speed up migrations and feed back into the product

Drive cross-functional impact

  • Influence go-to-market strategy and lead improvements across Sales and Engineering

  • Encourage knowledge sharing between field engineers and product engineering teams

  • Present migration strategy, product vision and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • A university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 7+ years of experience in technical roles spanning customer-facing delivery and engineering

  • 5+ years of people management experience, mentoring and developing technical teams

  • 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, ideally involving AI/ML or developer tools

  • A proven track record of leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformations

  • A strong foundation in databases, data warehousing and data processing, with hands-on experience on large-scale systems such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, Greenplum or Hadoop

  • A deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and the full data analytics stack, including ETL, data platform design and BI

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in SQL and scripting (Python, Perl or Bash)

  • Experience scoping engagements, including delivery estimates, proposals and project plans

  • The flexibility to step into product manager, program manager or architect roles when needed

  • Excellent presentation skills for technical and executive audiences

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • Experience with data integration and transformation tools such as Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion or dbt

  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy or Business Objects

  • Experience building GenAI-powered developer tools, such as code translation or co-pilots

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Global Account Manager dedicated to one of Snowflake’s most strategically important enterprise customers. Depending on alignment, your client will sit within either Financial Services or Technology, Telecommunications & Industrial Manufacturing.

You will work closely with the marketing team to develop account-based marketing plans and will act as a trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their IT roadmap and positioning Snowflake as the solution of choice in the market. The Global Account Manager will also be responsible for prospecting, conducting initial meetings, managing the sales process, and ensuring ongoing customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts on a quarterly and annual basis through the development and execution of strategic sales plans across financial services or technology, telecommunications & industrial manufacturing enterprises.

  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement account-based marketing plans to drive revenue growth.

  • Act as the trusted advisor to customers by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap and effectively positioning Snowflake as the solution of choice in the market.

  • Identify and qualify new sales opportunities and develop ongoing revenue streams across key business units and divisions.

  • Conduct initial executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings.

  • Manage the sales process and close deals to meet revenue goals.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships to ensure satisfaction and drive additional revenue streams.

  • Utilize a value-oriented and solution-based approach to sales and possess excellent presentation, listening, organizational, and contact management skills.

Requirements:

  • 10-15+ years of field sales experience with a focus on data or cloud-related technology preferred.

  • Extensive experience working with strategic global customers.

  • Can demonstrate opening and growing accounts from $m to tens of millions.

  • Proven success in leading sales account teams aligned to the customer at a regional level.

  • Experience closing seven-figure, multi-year deals and creating strategic account plans.

  • Strong understanding of customer requirements and the ability to effectively present solutions and articulate business value and ROI.

  • Demonstrated success in transformational and consultative selling, strategy development, and sophisticated negotiations.

  • Executive-level relationship management experience and an understanding of the business drivers for C-level stakeholders.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders such as partner sales, marketing, value engineering, legal, etc.

  • Deep industry and/or account-specific expertise within Financial Services (banking, capital markets, insurance) or Technology, Telecommunications & Industrial Manufacturing.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple opportunities and team members.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and time management skills.

  • Familiarity with sales processes and pipeline management.

  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM tools preferred.

  • Comfortable managing remote opportunities and virtual team members.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Solution Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

  • Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

     

On day one you we will expect you to have:

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

· Hands on experience with Python

· Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies

 
 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Our Enterprise sales team is expanding and we are seeking a qualified Account Executive with expertise in the industry. In this role you will use your creative prospecting skills to strategically pursue net new business.

Your role will encompass prospecting, developing, and closing business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability and be open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team carries a deep curiosity to learn and are always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers needs.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Become an expert on Snowflake’s product and conduct discovery calls, customized demos, and presentations to prospective customers

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

  • Land, adopt, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

  • Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 6+ years sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

  • Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

  • This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

  • A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is looking for a Senior Solution Engineer based in Israel to solve our customers' most complex data and platform challenges. This hybrid role requires two days a week in the office, with the remaining time dedicated to customer visits.

In this role, you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners across the region to understand customer needs, strategize on how to best support them through their technical evaluations, and guide them in choosing Snowflake as their core data cloud solution.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

  • Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

 

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solution Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Senior Manager, Global Meetings & Events

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Global Meetings & Events (M&E) will play a critical role in building and advancing the company’s global M&E program. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Travel & Expense and Events, this role will lead the development of scalable sourcing strategies, supplier models, governance, and technology-enabled processes that improve how meetings and events are sourced and managed globally.

The Senior Manager will lead strategic sourcing and commercial initiatives across the M&E portfolio, including event agencies, hotels and venues, production partners, destination management companies (DMCs), event technology, and other strategic suppliers. The role will leverage enterprise spend and demand to improve commercial outcomes, strengthen supplier performance, and create greater visibility and consistency across the M&E ecosystem.

Beyond individual sourcing initiatives, this role will help build the infrastructure of a modern M&E program — including preferred supplier strategies, sourcing and contracting standards, service tiers, spend analytics, performance measurement, and self-service capabilities.

Working closely with M&E Operations, Travel, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and business stakeholders, this role will help transform M&E sourcing into a scalable, data-driven global program.

Core Responsibilities

M&E Program Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and execute the global M&E program roadmap.

Snowflake are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

  • Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

 

On day one you we will expect you to have:

  • Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Experience in FSI

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solution Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Information Systems Security Engineer (Principal)

About the role

Snowflake's national security deployments are authorized to operate inside classified environments, and each authorization stands or falls on the security documentation behind it. This role owns that documentation. You assess the system against its security control baseline, assemble the evidence the authorizing official reviews, and you are accountable for the package getting to authorization on schedule.

Arc Reactor, a classified deployment for a US government customer, is the immediate assignment. The same work will apply to the deployments that follow it.

What you will do

  • Lead the security control assessment for an assigned deployment, from control selection and tailoring through the body of evidence to authorization.

  • Produce the assessment plan, the evidence collection schedule and the residual risk that goes to the authorizing official, and keep them current.

  • Direct the engineers and security staff producing control artifacts. Tell them which evidence to collect, review what they produce, and catch gaps in the requirements before they surface during assessment.

  • Be the person who can explain a Snowflake control implementation to a government security reviewer, and explain a reviewer's finding back to the engineering team in terms they can act on.

  • Track authorization status and blockers, and report them weekly to the engineering lead and the program.

What you bring

  • You have taken at least one system through authorization to operate under a government security control framework (NIST 800-53 / RMF, FedRAMP, or the DoD RMF and its Impact Levels), and you can point to the package you were responsible for.

  • You can read an engineering implementation and decide which control it satisfies and what evidence it produces.

  • You have worked with government authorizing officials or security control assessors, and you know what they reject and why.

  • You write the plan down. Assessment scope, control status, evidence gaps and residual risk live in a document the team can run without you, not in your head.

  • You are eligible for TS/SCI with a full-scope polygraph, or already hold it.

How this team works

The ISSE does not work alone and does not do all the collection. Engineers and supporting security staff produce the artifacts; you decide what is needed, review it, and own the result. The role reports into national security engineering and sits in the deployment's weekly engineering and security cadence. The work is done from the Washington, DC area, with regular time on site.

How do you want to make your impact?

This role bridges the critical gap by helping new and early-stage customers achieve rapid implementation, quick value, and a world-class experience on the Snowflake platform. You will be the dedicated customer technical partner, responsible for driving technical enablement and supporting the overall activation and adoption of our customers initial use cases.

This is a fantastic opportunity for technical professionals to develop deep expertise in cloud data architecture, make a measurable impact on customer success, and contribute to one of the fastest-growing technology companies.

Location: Candidate must be based in or near Seattle or Menlo Park.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Operating as a Full-Stack Technical Resource, this role blends deep hands-on expertise with the strategic acumen of a business leader.

  • Strategic Ownership and Value Creation

  • Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as primary technical partner during the activation engagement.

  • Driving Outcome-Based Utilization: Apply an outcome-based selling mindset to customer engagements, focusing on how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud helps them solve complex data challenges and unlock maximum business value—not just product features.

  • Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.

  • Deliver Technical Value with AI: Deliver technical value efficiently by leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools and automation to accelerate solutions and implementation guidance, helping customers move faster to production.

  • Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with critical, Snowflake-specific foundational guidance, including Architectural Best Practices, Workload Isolation & Warehouse Utilization, Resource Monitoring & Alerts, Budgeting, and RBAC/Security Setup.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Account Team to highlight risks and establish and nurture trusted relationships with internal Snowflake teams (e.g., Professional Services, Support) and external partners to ensure seamless resource orchestration.

  • Develop Scalable Programs: Create and deliver reusable, high-impact programs, such as Hands-on Labs (HoLs) and webinars, to educate a wide customer audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

  • Technical Feedback Loop & Innovation: Act as a key feedback loop from the field to influence future product development, working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Expert Support and Triage: Efficiently triage a broad array of incoming customer inquiries, assisting the field team with demos, troubleshooting, and identifying opportunities to qualify potential business value for the Expansion team.

Required Qualifications

  • We are seeking highly skilled and motivated technical professionals eager to launch their next career chapter with us.

  • Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience with Snowflake and SQL is required.

  • Data & Cloud Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding and experience with data architecture, data analytics, and the core concepts of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Growth Mindset: A strong desire to learn, grow your technical skills, and continue to deepen your snowflake expertise.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

  • Professional Skills: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and possess Project Management skills to track, manage, and drive customers to an agreed-upon timeline.

  • Education: University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience in a technical role.

  • What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SnowPro Core certification.

  • Proficiency in additional coding languages, particularly Python, Java, or Scala, especially in a data or application development context.

  • Experience with modern data technologies (e.g., CI/CD tooling, orchestration tools) or a basic understanding of Data Science concepts.

  • Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

Performance Assessment & Career Path

  • This role is designed as a direct path to a successful career within the Snowflake Solution Engineering organization.

  • Impact Metrics: Performance is primarily assessed on customer success and platform adoption metrics:

  • Consumption: Driving new customer consumption for the initial contract period.

  • Use Cases: Documented success of helping customers move Use Cases to Production.

  • Growth: Measured via customer retention and growth within the managed portfolio.

This role bridges the critical gap by helping new and early-stage customers achieve rapid implementation, quick value, and a world-class experience on the Snowflake platform. You will be the dedicated customer technical partner, responsible for driving technical enablement and supporting the overall activation and adoption of our customers initial use cases.

This is a fantastic opportunity for technical professionals to develop deep expertise in cloud data architecture, make a measurable impact on customer success, and contribute to one of the fastest-growing technology companies.

Location: Candidate must be based in or near Seattle or Menlo Park. 

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

 - The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Operating as a Full-Stack Technical Resource, this role blends deep hands-on expertise with the strategic acumen of a business leader.

 - Strategic Ownership and Value Creation

 - Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as primary technical partner during the activation engagement.

 - Driving Outcome-Based Utilization: Apply an outcome-based selling mindset to customer engagements, focusing on how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud helps them solve complex data challenges and unlock maximum business value—not just product features.

 - Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.

 - Deliver Technical Value with AI: Deliver technical value efficiently by leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools and automation to accelerate solutions and implementation guidance, helping customers move faster to production.

 - Technical Execution and Collaboration

 - Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with critical, Snowflake-specific foundational guidance, including Architectural Best Practices, Workload Isolation & Warehouse Utilization, Resource Monitoring & Alerts, Budgeting, and RBAC/Security Setup.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Account Team to highlight risks and establish and nurture trusted relationships with internal Snowflake teams (e.g., Professional Services, Support) and external partners to ensure seamless resource orchestration.

 - Develop Scalable Programs: Create and deliver reusable, high-impact programs, such as Hands-on Labs (HoLs) and webinars, to educate a wide customer audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

 - Technical Feedback Loop & Innovation: Act as a key feedback loop from the field to influence future product development, working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

 - Expert Support and Triage: Efficiently triage a broad array of incoming customer inquiries, assisting the field team with demos, troubleshooting, and identifying opportunities to qualify potential business value for the Expansion team.

Required Qualifications

 - We are seeking highly skilled and motivated technical professionals eager to launch their next career chapter with us.

 - Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience with Snowflake and SQL is required.

 - Data & Cloud Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding and experience with data architecture, data analytics, and the core concepts of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

 - Growth Mindset: A strong desire to learn, grow your technical skills, and continue to deepen your snowflake expertise.

 - Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

 - Professional Skills: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and possess Project Management skills to track, manage, and drive customers to an agreed-upon timeline.

 - Education: University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience in a technical role.

 - What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

 - SnowPro Core certification.

 - Proficiency in additional coding languages, particularly Python, Java, or Scala, especially in a data or application development context.

 - Experience with modern data technologies (e.g., CI/CD tooling, orchestration tools) or a basic understanding of Data Science concepts.

 - Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

Performance Assessment & Career Path

 - This role is designed as a direct path to a successful career within the Snowflake Solution Engineering organization.

 - Impact Metrics: Performance is primarily assessed on customer success and platform adoption metrics:

 - Consumption: Driving new customer consumption for the initial contract period.

 - Use Cases: Documented success of helping customers move Use Cases to Production.

 - Growth: Measured via customer retention and growth within the managed portfolio.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe is a SaaS powerhouse enabling businesses to investigate modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the AI Data Cloud. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join us at the ground floor of this expansion. At Observe, the SDR program isn't just a department—it’s our leadership pipeline. We view our SDRs as the next wave of Account Executives, and we invest in you accordingly.

If you are looking to turbocharge a career in tech sales, this is your training ground. We provide the tools, the mentorship, and the roadmap to turn high-potential talent into elite sales professionals.

What You’ll Experience:

  • Deep Investment: From our 2-week intensive bootcamp to weekly 1-1 mentorship and bi-weekly strategy sessions, we prioritize your growth over everything else.

  • The "In-the-Trenches" Culture: Our leadership team doesn't manage from the sidelines. We work alongside you to hone your business acumen and accelerate your path to productivity.

  • A True Meritocracy: We celebrate diversity and reward results. Our goal is to give you the confidence to generate pipeline, master discovery, and qualify opportunities at an enterprise level.

By joining Observe, you aren’t just taking a job—you’re making an investment in yourself that will define the trajectory of your sales career.

This role is based out of our Menlo Park office.

IN THIS ROLE YOU GET TO:

  • Identify high-potential businesses that would be a good fit to work with Observe across your region

  • Work with the Sales team to develop and lead inbound and outbound campaigns from idea-generation through to qualified call

  • Develop strong sales and product knowledge

  • Interact with engineering decision makers via telephone, LinkedIn and email

  • Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management

  • Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team

  • Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential

  • Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota

  • Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business

  • Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • New graduates welcome to apply

  • Fluency in spoken and written English

  • A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals

  • Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening

  • Extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals

  • Validated time leadership skills and ability to work either independently or through coaching

  • Desire to work in a driven and fast-paced environment

  • Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly

We are excited to have the ability to return to the office and focus on in-person coaching and growth. Especially in the beginning of your sales career it is crucial to have the ability to be close to your mentors and coaches to quickly ramp.

 

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

How do you want to make your impact?

The ideal candidate will be passionate about reinventing the database space and comfortable engaging with both executive and technical audiences.

Location Requirement: Must be based in Delaware, Maryland, or Virignia.

 

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors

  • Work hands-on with prospects to demonstrate value throughout the sales cycle

  • Maintain deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing teams

  • Support enterprise Proof of Concepts from design to implementation

 

WE WOULD LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE:

  • Outstanding presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences

  • Extensive experience with Database and Data Warehouse technology

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics

  • Python programming experience

  • Understanding of AI/ML principles and best practices

  • Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent experience

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Commercial Solutions Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Commercial Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

As a Snowflake Commercial Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives. 

 
 


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

 - Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

 - Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

 - Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

 - Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

 - Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a  deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

 - Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

 - Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

With AIM Virtualization we’re redefining interoperability for the modern data stack. Our platform makes existing applications instantly work on Snowflake by bringing the core tenets of virtualization to the database. The runtime empowers customers to move to Snowflake without changing SQL or APIs. As a result, AIM Virtualization makes time-consuming migrations obsolete.

As a leader in this team you get to shape how we tackle some of the most intricate database implementation challenges all while pioneering an industry-first framework which customers consistently describe as “too good to be true”.

If you’re looking to empower a high-performance team and accelerate the effective use of AI across the organization, this is the challenge for you. We are looking for an AI-first leader who is not afraid to take on hard and unusual tasks.

As an Engineering Manager, you'll shape the development processes for one of Snowflake's most strategic new products.

AS A SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL

  • Provide strong technical leadership across the entire product suite of AIM-V, including the runtime, tools and utilities, as well as deployment.

  • Drive an AI-based development process across the entire platform, from requirements analysis to design, from development to validation and release.

  • Collaborate with product managers, solution architects, and field engineering to empower our customers.

  • Define and improve our engineering processes around AI-based software synthesis workflows.

  • Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem solving skills.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale systems and enterprise software.

  • 8+ years of experience in managing expert engineering teams.

  • Track record of owning the full software development lifecycle from inception to release.

  • Comprehensive background in SQL and/or other functional programming languages.

  • Solid knowledge of database internals, with emphasis on query parsing, query optimization, and query execution.

  • MS/PhD in Computer Science: databases, high-performance computing, or related fields.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Billing Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Billing & Payments Platform team builds Snowflake's central systems for customer resource consumption, revenue processing, invoicing, and reporting. Our systems power Snowflake's business and enable every other engineering team. The architectures we ship also serve as reference patterns for customers building on Snowflake.

Computing Snowflake's bills is a distributed systems problem. Usage is metered across every cloud and region. The pricing catalog keeps changing, including new commercial constructs for Cortex AI, Snowflake Intelligence, and the broader agentic portfolio. The same systems have to catch abuse and fraud on a usage-based product, then produce a bill Finance can audit. The bar is accuracy, auditability, and processing that keeps up with usage as it happens.

This is a deeply cross-functional role. You will partner with Product, Finance, Legal, Growth, Go-to-Market Systems, Snowsight, Cortex AI, and product engineering teams to deliver experiences that customers and internal stakeholders depend on every day.

AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON BILLING PLATFORM YOU WILL :

  • Drive multi-team initiatives from an ambiguous business problem through design, launch, and operation, and set the technical approach other engineers execute. Own a bounded project end-to-end when that is the right scope.

  • Build the billing systems that meter, rate, and invoice usage across Snowflake services, on Snowflake's own product. Usage is collected across clouds and regions, then reconciled into an auditable bill.

  • Shape how Snowflake meters, prices, and bills AI products with Cortex AI, Intelligence, and Apps, including token-based inference, agent workflows, and AI-native subscriptions.

  • Be the go-to expert for a primary billing domain — metering, rating, invoicing, contracts, payments, threshold billing, fraud, or reporting — and influence the systems next to it.

  • Own reliability and correctness for what you build. Participate in on-call, debug across unfamiliar areas, and drive systemic fixes to monitoring, alerts, and quality rather than one-off patches.

  • Mentor senior engineers. Review designs, raise the bar on testing and rollout, and help others operate these systems.

  • Partner with Product, Finance, GTM Systems, Growth, Trust, and Legal. Write designs that both engineering and Finance can execute.

OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • Significant experience building and operating large-scale production distributed systems, typically 10+ years or equivalent impact.

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems: consistency, fault tolerance, idempotency, exactly-once processing, queueing, and stream and batch pipelines.

  • Strong fundamentals in databases and data modeling. SQL fluency, schema design, performance tuning, and an appreciation for the operational realities of large-scale data systems.

  • Proficiency in one or more of Java, Scala, Python, or Go, and the practices that make systems operable at scale: testing, observability, CI/CD, and incremental rollout.

  • A track record of driving outcomes that span teams. Framing the problem when Product, Finance, and engineering disagree. Writing the design. Making the tradeoffs. Landing the system in production.

  • Depth in at least one domain adjacent to billing — metering, rating, invoicing, contracts, payments, revenue, or financial reporting — with enough range to debug and influence the systems next to it.

  • Hands-on use of AI as a builder's tool in design, coding, debugging, and incident response. On this team that includes Cortex Code and Snowflake Intelligence, but prior use of those specific tools is not required.

  • Clear writing and communication with non-engineering partners. You can explain a pricing or contract change so Finance can audit it and engineering can build it.

Bonus points for:

  • Prior experience in billing, payments, metering, revenue, or financial systems at a SaaS or cloud company.

  • Experience with fraud detection, abuse mitigation, or trust and safety systems in a usage-based product.

  • Experience designing or evolving pricing models for AI/ML products, including inference, fine-tuning, and agentic workloads.

  • Experience building on Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms, including Snowpark, Streams and Tasks, Iceberg, Streamlit, or Cortex.

  • Contributions to internal AI developer-productivity tooling, agentic skills, or similar coding-agent workflows.

Why this role?

  • Build on Snowflake, with Snowflake. You will use Snowflake's own product, including Cortex AI, as the substrate for one of the most business-critical systems in the company.

  • Front-row seat to AI commercialization. Billing is where AI strategy becomes real for customers. You will help define how Snowflake meters, prices, and bills for the AI products shaping the next decade.

  • Real cross-functional scope. Few engineering roles touch as many parts of the company. Your work will be visible to Finance, GTM, Product, and the engineering teams shipping every Snowflake service.

  • Distributed systems at meaningful scale. Accurate metering and rating across every cloud, region, and service, with strict correctness and auditability, is genuinely hard and genuinely interesting work.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company's confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company's data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake's Global Customer Enablement team is looking for a strategic, self-driven GTM leader to own the go-to-market strategy for our customer education portfolio. This is a high-visibility role where you'll define how Snowflake takes education to market — with a particular focus on scaling our On Demand learning channel — and orchestrate across Dev Rel, Community, Partners, Marketing, and the field to drive measurable customer activation outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end GTM strategy for Snowflake's education portfolio

  • Define positioning, packaging, and channel strategy for On Demand learning

  • Build scalable demand generation motions: in-product pathways, campaign partnerships, community-led learning, partner co-marketing

  • Create the sales enablement toolkit for education: talk tracks, segment playbooks, competitive positioning

  • Orchestrate across Dev Rel, Data Superheroes, ATPs, Marketing, and CDEV to amplify education reach through every channel that touches learners

  • Own the measurement framework: education → product adoption → consumption → retention

  • Serve as the "voice of market" for education — synthesizing field signal, competitive intel, and learner data into portfolio and GTM decisions

  • Build the business case for scaling the education GTM function over time

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in product marketing, GTM strategy, growth, or demand generation — ideally in education technology, customer education, or SaaS enablement

  • Demonstrated ability to build and execute GTM strategy for digital/self-service products

  • Strong cross-functional influence skills — you've driven outcomes through teams you don't manage

  • Data-driven mindset with experience building measurement frameworks and ROI models

  • Experience working with or across partner ecosystems, community programs, or developer relations

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication — you'll be authoring strategy docs, presenting to executives, and building field-facing collateral

  • Comfort with ambiguity — this is a new function and you'll be defining the playbook from scratch

  • Bonus: Experience in the data/cloud/AI ecosystem or with Snowflake specifically

Why This Role Is Different

  • You're not joining an established PMM team — you're creating a new GTM function for an education business with massive untapped potential

  • Your leverage comes from influence, not headcount — you'll work across six ecosystem partners and the entire field org

  • You'll have a direct line to leadership and the mandate to shape how Snowflake's education portfolio grows

The application window is expected to be open until December 4th, 2026. This opportunity will remain posted based on business needs, which may be before or after the specified date.

Senior Manager, Finance Applications
Location: Dublin, CA | Workplace: Hybrid, 3 days in office

 

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset, rapidly testing emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Finance Applications to lead a team that designs, builds, and runs the systems behind Snowflake's Office of the CFO. You will bring a product-led mindset to finance technology, with a strong focus on AI and agentic applications that change how Finance works.

AS A SENIOR MANAGER, FINANCE APPLICATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Finance Applications across ERP (Workday Financials) and the connected finance stack. Set clear product goals, success metrics, and a prioritized backlog.

  • Act as the product owner for finance systems: run discovery with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Procurement users; turn their pain points into requirements and user stories; and ship iteratively in short release cycles.

  • Build new finance capabilities from scratch where none exist today, from problem definition and architecture through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead the design and rollout of AI and agentic products for finance use cases such as close automation, reconciliations, journal entries, AP, collections, revenue, and forecasting, using Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, and Snowflake Intelligence.

  • Champion "Snowflake on Snowflake" as Customer Zero: build finance data products, Streamlit in Snowflake apps, and native integrations on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, and share what you learn with Snowflake's product teams.

  • Embed SOX compliance, ITGCs, segregation of duties, and audit readiness into product design and change management, so that AI-driven automation is trusted, explainable, and auditable.

  • Drive end-to-end process transformation across Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, and FP&A, redesigning processes around automation and AI rather than replicating legacy workflows.

  • Lead and grow a high-performing team of product owners, business systems analysts, and engineers across global locations, building a product-led, AI-first culture.

  • Manage ERP vendors and implementation partners against product outcomes, timelines, and budget.

  • Define and report product KPIs such as cycle-time reduction, automation rate, adoption, accuracy, and control effectiveness, to show the business impact of the roadmap to finance and technology leadership.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR MANAGER, FINANCE APPLICATIONS WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience in finance systems, finance product management, or finance transformation, ideally in high-growth SaaS or technology companies.

  • 5+ years in a product manager or product owner role for finance or accounting systems, with clear ownership of a product roadmap from vision through delivery.

  • A proven track record of building finance systems or capabilities from the ground up, not just maintaining or upgrading existing platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major SaaS ERP (such as Workday Financials, Oracle Cloud/NetSuite, or SAP S/4HANA Cloud).

  • Domain knowledge of accounting and finance operations, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, revenue recognition, close, and FP&A.

  • Strong working knowledge of SOX, ITGCs, internal controls, and audit requirements for financial systems.

  • An AI-first product mindset, with practical experience applying GenAI, LLMs, or intelligent automation to real business processes.

  • Experience leading and building high performing teams, including teams across global locations.

  • A strong product toolkit: user research, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, agile delivery, and outcome-based metrics.

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to influence the CFO organization and technology executives.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience shipping agentic workflows or LLM-powered applications in production, especially in a regulated finance environment.

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, Python, or Streamlit.

  • A background in accounting (CPA, CA, or similar) or prior experience in a finance or controllership role.

  • Experience with process mining, RPA, or workflow orchestration.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will own the product strategy for how Snowflake runs its own finance function, built on the same AI Data Cloud our customers rely on. This team turns Snowflake's newest AI capabilities into real products for the Office of the CFO. Your roadmap will shape how a fast-growing public company closes its books, stays compliant, plans, and makes decisions.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Your role will encompass prospecting, developing, and closing business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability and be open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team carries a deep curiosity to learn and are always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers needs.

 

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Become an expert on Snowflake’s product and conduct discovery calls, customized demos, and presentations to prospective customers

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

  • Land, adopt, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

  • Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 10+ years sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

  • Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

  • This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT FOR THE TEAM IF YOU:

  • Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and positive attitude with a passion for building customer relationships and expanding business opportunities. The Account Executive must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with Clients.

  • You are driven to exceed performance objectives.

  • Self-starter comfortable with some ambiguity, demonstrating a willingness to learn/ramp quickly

  • You are excited about being positioned right in the middle of the exploding cloud based economy and to develop and maintain a highly desired knowledge of Snowflake’s solutions.

  • You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills.

  • You have superb organization and contact management capabilities.

  • You are driven to achieve your mission and you love bringing the team together to achieve results together.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

 

  • Build trusted relationships with Snowflake internal resources, external partners, and client account teams to qualify deals, identify business value, and provide technical guidance in order to set proper expectations to ensure customer satisfaction

  • Align Snowflake’s value to the customers’ business and technical problems

  • Drive revenue and increase market share in defined set of accounts

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving technology and landscape while maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Work hands-on with customers to deliver standard, customized and/or strategic solution demonstrations, presentations, and best practices that showcase functional capabilities, competitive advantages, and business benefits of the Snowflake solutions throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation.

  • Guides customers in digital transformation and cloud adoption, understanding where Snowflake integrates with holistic architecture and strategy.

  • Provide ongoing, post-sales, technical guidance to the customer’s technical team to drive customer utilization of Snowflake and digital transformation success

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 1+ years of sales experience full cycle sales or equivalent business to business sales experience.

  • Proven ability to independently manage and develop client relationships.

  • Ability to drive consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.

  • Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.

  • Proactive, independent thinking and a high energy/positive attitude.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • BA/BS preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
