jobs.title: Senior FP&A Manager - Partnerships & Investments
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the future of data. Join the Snowflake team.

We are seeking a highly motivated finance leader to join our team and support FP&A for Snowflakes Partnerships organization. In this role, you will be responsible for partnering across the Snowflake Partnerships leadership, Sales & Partner Operations and Corporate & Sales Finance teams to provide financial leadership for Global Alliances.

This is a strategic finance leadership role that will drive impact by providing day-to-day financial oversight of the Partnerships business, monthly financial close management, financial & business health insights, spend management, budgeting, forecasting & planning, and financial compliance.

As the Partner Programs & Investments Sr. Finance Manager, You Will:

  • You will be the finance FP&A lead supporting the Partnerships organization and partnering across the Partnerships Finance, Corporate Finance and Sales Finance teams

  • Responsible for leading and providing financial support in all Partnerships financial rhythm of business that includes monthly close, accrual management, BVA, forecast and monthly and quarterly financial & business insights

  • Responsible for leading the Partnerships financial planning in collaboration with business leadership and finance peers within Partnerships & Investment Finance and across Corporate and Sales finance.

  • Effectively scale and manage budgets and forecast HC and discretionary business investments

  • Identify opportunities to evolve and scale Partnerships financial & business health metrics and lead the alignment, development, automation, of reporting to support managing financial & business performance

  • Coordinate and represent the Partnerships organization on all financial deliverables to corporate functions.

  • Be a compliance champion and ambassador to ensure compliance with company policies and provide though leadership on appropriate governance and controls for partner and alliances

  • Create simplification and deliver efficiencies across financial forecasting, processes and reporting using Snowflake’s reporting & AI capabilities

Required Skills/Expertise:

  • 8+ years of related experience in FP&A with GTM Finance, Sales Finance and/or Channel/Partner Sales/ Ecosystem Finance experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field. Advanced degree or professional certification (CFA, CPA) is a plus

  • Experience leading financial rhythm of business (month end close management, budgeting and planning, forecasting) in a technology organization

  • Experience defining, creating business alignment, automating, and reporting out on financial and business key performance indicators (or OKRs)

  • Proficiency in MS office Suite and G-Suite

  • Experience with BI and Data Visualization tools is a plus

  • Exceptional financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills with previous experience in managing Salesforce, Adaptive, Looker, or similar tools

  • Ability to break down complex ideas and issues and communicate in simple terms to various levels of the organization

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills (written and verbal)

  • Strong customer service orientation and a desire to help others succeed

  • Prior experience in working and supporting large Channel/Alliances/Partner organizations

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Observe
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is a high-growth SaaS observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, enabling businesses to troubleshoot modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the Snowflake platform. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.


As a Senior Solutions Engineer for Observe, you will play a critical, highly-visible, role within our organization, serving as the primary technical resource for our Sales team. You will be responsible for driving the technical closure of sales opportunities by demonstrating the value of Observe to prospective customers. This role requires a blend of deep technical knowledge, strong presentation skills, and a customer-focused approach.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Technical Discovery and Presentation: Conduct in-depth technical discovery sessions with prospects to understand their current environment, challenges, and specific observability requirements. Tailor and deliver compelling product demonstrations and technical presentations that showcase how our solution addresses their needs.

  • Proof of Concepts (POCs): Design, scope, and manage technical evaluations and Proof of Concepts, ensuring the successful setup and demonstration of value within the customer's environment. Document findings and present clear, persuasive results back to the customer.

  • Sales Team Support: Partner closely with Account Executives to develop and execute technical sales strategies. Act as the technical subject matter expert throughout the sales cycle, from initial contact to final contract.

  • Feedback and Product Collaboration: Serve as the voice of the customer to the Product Management and Engineering teams, providing crucial feedback on product capabilities, market needs, and competitive landscape.

  • Content and Training: Develop and maintain technical sales collateral, including demo environments, presentations, and best practice guides. Deliver technical training to the broader Sales organization.

  • Travel: Ability to travel to client sites and industry events as required.

QUALIFICATIONS :

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect in the software industry.

  • Deep technical understanding and practical experience with modern Observability concepts (metrics, logging, tracing) and tools (e.g., Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK Stack).

  • Familiarity with cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices) and major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience selling to Developer, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) personas.

  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, high-growth Observability or Application Performance Monitoring (APM) company.

 

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI on our Cortex AI team, you will be a hands-on technical leader and trusted partner to our most strategic customers. You will own the end-to-end delivery of enterprise AI programs, leading a team of 2–4 engineers while staying deeply technical yourself. You will set the technical direction for your customer engagements, mentor your team, and serve as the senior technical voice at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success.

Note: This is a customer facing role & require frequent travelling within USA mostly

 
 

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Lead Customer Programs: Own the full lifecycle of complex, multi-engineer AI engagements – from scoping and architecture through deployment, monitoring, and handoff. Be accountable for delivery quality and customer outcomes for the projects you lead.

Own AI Quality: Define what "good" means for each engagement. Translate ambiguous customer goals into measurable quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and golden datasets – then run systematic eval loops to hill-climb on agent quality, catch regressions before customers do, and continuously raise the bar on accuracy, faithfulness, and safety. Set the standard for how the team measures and improves AI systems in production.

Grow and Mentor Engineers: Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentorship to a team of 2–6 Applied AI Engineers. Review designs and code, unblock teammates, and actively develop their skills and careers.

Deliver with Velocity: Remain a hands-on contributor – designing, iterating, and shipping high-quality ML pipelines and agentic AI solutions alongside your team. Translate ambiguous business objectives into robust, scalable, and performant solutions.

Productionize AI at Scale: Own the full implementation lifecycle for AI solutions, from prototype through deployment, monitoring, and optimization in secure, large-scale production environments. Build the safety guardrails, observability, and human-review workflows that keep AI applications reliable and trustworthy – and close the loop from production traces and user feedback back into your evals so quality compounds over time.

Be a Strategic Technical Advisor: Serve as a senior technical advisor to customer data science and engineering leadership. Set the standard for how Snowflake AI is deployed and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive stakeholders.

Collaborate to Innovate: Work cross-functionally with Snowflake's Product and Engineering teams, bringing real-world patterns and feedback from the field to directly shape the future of Snowflake's AI platform.

Drive Compounding Outcomes: Identify recurring deployment patterns and turn them into reusable assets – reference architectures, evaluation harnesses, and product feedback that scale Snowflake's impact across customers.

Have the opportunity to travel: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite, working closely with Snowflake's most strategic customers.

 

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer to join our Enterprise Acquisition team in Melbourne. You will solve complex problems and help close large deals with new Retail and Telecommunications customers. You'll work with sales and channel partners from first discovery through proof of concept to signed business.

AS A SENIOR SOLUTION ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Present Snowflake's AI Data Cloud vision to executives and technical teams at retail and telco prospects, showing the value of Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark and Snowflake Horizon

  • Work hands-on through the whole sales cycle: tailored demos, enterprise proofs of concept, solution design and implementation planning

  • Work with Account Executives and channel partners to plan and win competitive deals with new customers

  • Dig deep into customer architectures and map them to Snowflake's data architecture, including open lakehouse patterns with Apache Iceberg tables

  • Build retail and telco use cases such as customer 360, demand forecasting, personalisation, churn prediction, and data collaboration through Snowflake Marketplace and secure data sharing

  • Stay current on competing and complementary technologies and position Snowflake clearly against them

  • Work with Product Management, Engineering and Marketing to keep improving Snowflake's products and messaging

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOLUTION ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience, ideally in pre-sales or solution engineering

  • Proven experience with Retail or Telecommunications organisations, including their data, business drivers and stakeholders

  • Excellent presentation skills with technical and executive audiences, whether on a whiteboard or in a demo

  • Ability to build and own senior C-suite relationships

  • Broad experience with large-scale database and data warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud platforms, including Data Lake, Data Mesh and Data Fabric patterns

  • Hands-on SQL, SQL analytics and Python skills

  • Ability to connect a customer's specific business problems to Snowflake's solutions

  • A university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with global systems integrators (GSIs) such as EY, Deloitte or Accenture

  • Familiarity with retail data (POS, loyalty, supply chain, ecommerce) or telco data (OSS/BSS, network telemetry, subscriber analytics)

  • Hands-on experience building generative AI or ML solutions

  • A Masters in Data Science or Business Administration

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE? Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed, and we believe in the value we add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback, and care about making our customers successful. On the Enterprise Acquisition team, you will help bring Australia's leading retail and telecommunications companies onto the AI Data Cloud.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

  • Conversations with other technologists, providing presentations at the C-level.

  • Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging

  • 5+ years industry experience designing, building and supporting large-scale systems in production.

  • Passionate about improving overall developer experience, prior experience in Developer Platform, Developer Experiences or Developer Productivity is a plus.

  • Strong CS fundamentals, including proficiency with data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the foundation for faster, safer innovation.

Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud supports critical enterprise workloads across multiple clouds and regions. As AI accelerates software development, the volume and pace of change are outgrowing what engineers can manually review, coordinate, and monitor. Moving faster requires systems that make understanding, diagnosing, and resolving issues an integral part of how customers and engineers work.

The Observability team builds the telemetry, analytics, and diagnostic platform that helps Snowflake customers and engineers understand the health of their workloads and services, detect problems early, and resolve them quickly. We’re looking for a hands-on, product-minded Principal Software Engineer I to help build an AI-driven observability platform, combining deep distributed-systems engineering with a strong instinct for what customers and developers need.

You will shape technical direction, solve challenging systems problems, and lead initiatives from concept to customer launch across engineering, product, and design. The opportunity is to build a platform where AI agents and engineers detect, diagnose, and resolve issues together, so that growing scale and complexity translate into faster answers rather than more manual investigation.

AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Architect and build distributed infrastructure. Design scalable pipelines and services for ingesting, storing, and querying logs, metrics, traces, and events at very high volume, with predictable cost, low query latency, fault isolation, and clear data-freshness guarantees.

  • Ship observability products to customers. Partner with product management and design to define and deliver customer-facing capabilities, from telemetry collection and alerting to dashboards and diagnostics, that work natively within Snowflake. Turn customer feedback and usage data into product decisions, and own outcomes through launch and adoption.

  • Build AI-driven detection and diagnosis. Develop agentic workflows that correlate signals across the stack, surface anomalies, explain likely root causes, and recommend or take remediation steps. Ground these capabilities in high-quality telemetry and rigorous evaluation so customers and engineers can trust them.

  • Build and work AI-first. Make AI integral to how you design, implement, test, and operate software. Establish rigorous evaluation, security, and reliability standards for AI-powered capabilities, and drive adoption of AI-first practices across the team.

  • Lead from architecture through adoption. Translate ambiguous customer and developer needs into practical designs and milestones. Deliver intuitive APIs, SDKs, and self-service experiences built on open standards such as OpenTelemetry, and guide incremental migrations from existing tooling.

  • Raise the engineering bar. Write and review production code, diagnose complex failures, own operational outcomes, and mentor engineers. Influence across teams through technical depth, clear communication, and sound judgment.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex backend, infrastructure, or data-platform initiatives spanning multiple teams.

  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with strong understanding of concurrency, consistency, caching, failure recovery, storage and query efficiency, and performance.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and hands-on proficiency in Java, Go, C++, or a comparable backend language, plus experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • An AI-first engineering practice: you actively use AI throughout the software lifecycle and can demonstrate how it improves your execution, problem-solving, and quality. You are ready to build AI-powered platform capabilities and help others adopt this approach.

  • A track record of shipping products to external customers: partnering with product and design, turning ambiguous problems into delivered systems, making scope and quality trade-offs, and driving adoption, reliability, and customer satisfaction after launch.

  • Clear written communication, low-ego collaboration, strong ownership, and experience mentoring senior engineers.

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Especially relevant: Experience building observability, monitoring, or analytics platforms (logs, metrics, traces, alerting); OpenTelemetry; time-series or columnar storage; AIOps or agentic diagnosis systems; or developer-facing data products.

Help build the platform that lets customers and engineers understand and resolve issues faster than manual investigation allows, with the scale and trust that critical workloads demand.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Senior Product Manager: Extensible Compute

Location: MPK or Bellevue |
Workplace: Hybrid

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset, rapidly testing emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our Extensible Compute team, which builds Snowpark Container Services (SPCS). SPCS is the compute platform that runs customer container workloads and Snowflake's own first-party products, including Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, and AI agents. You will own the product for that platform: which compute we offer, how reliably and cheaply it runs, and how partner teams and customers get what they need without a one-off every time.

AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the SPCS product roadmap and ship it. That includes the compute instance portfolio across AWS, Azure, and GCP (general-purpose CPU, ARM, and GPU, including new Nvidia generations), and the storage and file system capabilities workloads depend on.

  • Turn requests from first-party product partners into platform capabilities. When Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, or an agent team needs a new instance, a networking change, or multi-cluster support, you decide what becomes a standard SPCS feature and what stays a one-off.

  • Take features from early preview to general availability. You set the launch bar, hold a release when security, reliability, or unit economics are not ready, and work the path through PrPr and PuPr with engineering. Work credibly with senior engineers on architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.

  • Own platform health that customers feel: startup time, isolation, storage reliability, and the unit economics of running a workload on SPCS. You partner with Finance on pricing ($/GiB, instance pricing) when the model has to change.

  • Be the product point of contact for our infrastructure partners (AWS, Azure, GCP, Nvidia) on the SPCS compute roadmap, and for account teams qualifying strategic customers onto SPCS.

  • Use AI as part of how you work: customer and partner synthesis, specs, launch reviews, and the analysis behind a prioritization call.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including several years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing product, or equivalent experience owning a technical product end to end.

  • Hands-on depth in at least one of: cloud infrastructure, container or serverless platforms, developer runtimes, or distributed systems. You can hold a design review with senior engineers and leave with a decision.

  • A track record of taking a platform capability from 0 to 1 or from early adoption to scale, across engineering and at least one partner team (product, GTM, or a cloud/hardware partner).

  • Evidence you can say no. You have turned a pile of bespoke asks into a smaller set of reusable capabilities, and you can show what you cut and why.

  • Clear writing and crisp communication with engineering leads, partner PMs, finance, and account teams. You do not need a slide to make the point.

  • A Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS

  • Direct experience with a container platform, Kubernetes-based service, or serverless compute product that customers run production workloads on.

  • Experience qualifying or launching GPU or accelerated compute instances, or working a hardware/CSP roadmap (Nvidia, AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Experience supporting data, AI, or developer workloads on a shared platform (orchestration, notebooks, apps, agents).

  • Familiarity with unit economics for compute or storage: instance pricing, $/GiB, or cost-to-serve for a multi-tenant platform.

WHY JOIN OUR EXTENSIBLE COMPUTE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

SPCS is the compute layer under a large and growing set of Snowflake workloads. A good call on an instance type, a filesystem, or a launch gate shows up in more than one product. You will work directly with the engineers who build it, the product partners who depend on it, and the customers bringing container workloads onto Snowflake.

Customers want to run their own services, pipelines, and models inside Snowflake's governance boundary, and Snowflake's own products need the same platform to get faster, cheaper, and more capable. You will have a concrete surface to own, a roadmap you can ship against, and visibility into how this platform is used across the company.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

AS A SALES DEVELOPMENT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Lead and coach sales development representatives to identify customer needs and communicate the value of Snowflake's AI Data Cloud.

  • Support hiring, onboarding and ongoing development, helping representatives build confidence discussing Snowflake's data, analytics and AI capabilities.

  • Own pipeline-generation performance for your team, focusing on qualified opportunities that connect customer challenges with Snowflake use cases.

  • Partner with Snowflake Account Executives and Marketing to prioritise accounts, align campaigns and improve opportunity handovers.

  • Use conversion, opportunity quality and ramp insights to improve the team's approach to bringing customers onto Snowflake.

  • Experiment responsibly with AI-assisted research and outreach to improve how the team engages prospective Snowflake customers, while maintaining accuracy and human judgement.

OUR IDEAL SALES DEVELOPMENT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • Relevant experience in B2B technology sales or sales development, with 8+ years preferred.

  • Evidence of coaching, developing talent and improving team performance in a sales development environment.

  • A track record of contributing to qualified pipeline creation, with a clear understanding of opportunity quality and conversion.

  • The ability to translate complex technology into customer-focused conversations, with curiosity about data, analytics and AI.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to align priorities with sales and marketing stakeholders.

  • An analytical approach to diagnosing performance challenges and turning insights into practical improvements.

  • Clear communication, sound commercial judgement and a supportive, accountable approach to leadership.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, cybersecurity or data and analytics solutions.

  • Familiarity with Snowflake's AI Data Cloud and capabilities such as Cortex AI and secure data sharing.

  • Experience improving onboarding, coaching programmes or career development for sales development representatives.

  • Experience evaluating AI-assisted sales workflows and measuring their impact on pipeline quality and productivity.

You will help people grow while connecting organisations with new possibilities in data and AI. This role offers the opportunity to combine people leadership and commercial impact, helping shape how prospective customers understand and engage with Snowflake.

jobs.title: Industry Principal, Office of the CFO (Regulated Industries)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Role

As an Industry Principal at Snowflake, you will represent Snowflake to the Office of the CFO in Regulated Industries, at the intersection of corporate finance, regulatory reporting, data, and AI. You will help finance leaders at banks, insurers, and asset managers rethink how they plan, close, report, and make decisions on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and its ecosystem of finance and data partners.

Your mission is to turn complex finance and regulatory challenges into repeatable, scalable solutions, from a governed finance data foundation to AI-assisted forecasting, close, and reporting. You will pair deep finance experience with modern data and AI capabilities, working alongside sales, solution engineering, product, and partners to shape how Snowflake shows up for finance leaders in demanding regulatory environments. You report to the Global Head Business Solutions.

What You'll Do

Lead strategic engagements with finance leaders Partner with CFOs, controllers, heads of FP&A, finance transformation, and regulatory reporting, and their counterparts in data and risk, on high-impact initiatives. You are credible in these conversations because you have lived these processes and can diagnose what slows a close or weakens a forecast.

Translate finance outcomes into vision and solutions Connect priorities in planning, close and consolidation, profitability, and regulatory reporting to practical roadmaps that create business, technical, and cultural value. Help customers see how a governed data foundation works alongside their planning and ERP investments.

Build for the business Use Snowflake's AI and data capabilities to create demonstrable, grounded examples of what is possible, such as:

  • Governed finance data foundations with lineage from source to report

  • AI-assisted forecasting, anomaly detection, and variance analysis that remain explainable

  • AI assistants that help finance teams explore results, run scenarios, and draft commentary within governance guardrails

  • Regulatory and management reporting pipelines built for audit readiness

Champion governed, auditable AI in finance Help finance leaders adopt AI responsibly, with outputs that are explainable, traceable, and able to withstand audit and regulatory review.

Be a visible finance and AI thought leader Share points of view and best practices through customer workshops, enablement, webinars, and industry events, helping customers and colleagues understand what great looks like for AI in the Office of the CFO.

Who You Are

Financial Services finance expertise

  • Meaningful experience inside a financial services organization in FP&A, controllership, finance transformation, or finance data and analytics, ideally complemented by time advising or selling to that same audience

  • Working knowledge of regulatory and statutory reporting in banking, insurance, or asset management; exposure to Healthcare and Life Sciences finance is a plus

Grounded in core finance processes

  • Practical understanding of planning and forecasting, close and consolidation, profitability analysis, and internal controls

  • Ability to translate finance processes into clear data models, workflows, and outcomes

Hands-on with data and AI

  • Experience building, guiding, or evaluating AI and analytics applications in finance, with a clear sense of where AI adds value and where it introduces risk

  • Familiarity with the modern finance technology landscape and how data platforms complement planning and ERP systems

Commercial and executive presence

  • A record of measurable business impact, including transformation outcomes, revenue, or programs you influenced

  • Confidence presenting to and advising CFOs and their leadership teams, and translating complex ideas into clear narratives

Collaborative and scalable

  • Proven ability to partner with sales, solution engineering, product, and partners to win and expand strategic relationships

  • Energized by enabling others and scaling impact through reusable approaches

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, information systems, or equivalent practical experience; MBA, CPA, CFA, or advanced degree preferred

  • 15+ years of experience across finance operations, finance technology, or finance consulting, with significant time in Financial Services

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, field events, and industry conferences

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Team Lead, Activation Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Account Engineer is a high-impact, cross-functional role designed to accelerate the customer journey from initial acquisition to successful platform adoption and expansion on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will contribute to this mission by driving initial utilisation, leveraging modern AI-powered tools and coding agents to ensure technical success.

As a Team Lead, Account Engineering, you will lead a group of account engineers who partner with Snowflake's enterprise customers to drive successful adoption and growth of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

AS A TEAM LEAD, ACCOUNT ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Act as a player/coach and lead a team of account engineers who guide enterprise customers through architecture, adoption, and expansion of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Manage a portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and be responsible for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth.

  • Partner with regional leadership on sales strategy, partnerships and initiatives to ensure quota targets and goals are met.

  • Build repeatable playbooks, runbooks, and reference architectures so the team scales its impact across accounts and regions.

  • Collaborate and maintain a close working relationship with product, engineering, sales, marketing, partnerships, and services teams.

  • Play an active role in sourcing and screening potential candidates and managing the interview process.

  • Lead scalable programs to educate a wide audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

  • Leverage your AI and data analytics skills to find patterns and opportunities to up-level the team, improve customer experience, and deliver successful outcomes for customers.

 

OUR IDEAL TEAM LEAD, ACCOUNT ENGINEERING WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions engineering, technical account management, or cloud data engineering.

  • Hands-on expertise with any leading cloud data platforms, and the ability to architect solutions for agentic enterprises

  • Experience managing enterprise escalations and communicating technical risk clearly to executives and customers.

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, Spark, containers, DevOps tooling, orchestration tools, Git, etc.).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical details for mixed audiences.

  • Experience building internal tooling, automation, or AI-assisted workflows that improve support and engineering efficiency.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Production experience with Snowflake or a comparable AI Data Cloud platform.

  • Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

  • 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Account Engineering sits at the centre of how our customers succeed on Snowflake. You will work on hard, high-impact problems across industries, with direct influence on how some of the world's largest organisations use data. You will also have room to shape how your team works, from the playbooks you build to the people you grow.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:

You will contribute to this mission by driving initial utilisation, leveraging modern AI-powered tools and coding agents to ensure technical success.

This role bridges the critical gap by helping new and early-stage customers achieve rapid implementation, quick value, and a world-class experience on the Snowflake platform. You will be the dedicated customer technical partner, responsible for driving technical enablement and supporting the overall activation and adoption of our customers' initial use cases.

This is a fantastic opportunity for technical professionals to develop deep expertise in cloud data architecture, make a measurable impact on customer success, and contribute to one of the fastest-growing technology companies.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Operating as a Full-Stack Technical Resource, this role blends deep hands-on expertise with the strategic acumen of a business leader.

Strategic Ownership and Value Creation

  • Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as a single point of contact for all customer needs.

  • Driving Outcome-Based Utilisation: Apply an outcome-based selling mindset to customer engagements, focusing on how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud helps them solve complex data challenges and unlock maximum business value—not just product features.

  • Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.

  • Deliver Technical Value with AI: Deliver technical value efficiently by leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools and automation to accelerate solutions and implementation guidance, helping customers move faster to production.

Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with Snowflake-specific platform guidance, data products and agentic workflows

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Account Team to highlight risks and establish and nurture trusted relationships with internal Snowflake teams and external partners to ensure seamless resource orchestration.

  • Develop Scalable Programs: Create and deliver reusable, high-impact programs, such as Hands-on Labs (HoLs) and webinars, to educate a wide customer audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

  • Technical Feedback Loop & Innovation: Act as a key feedback loop from the field to influence future product development, working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Thought Leadership and Evangelism: Represent Snowflake at customer workshops, executive briefings, industry events, and community meetups.

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive 8 years of working experience in data technologies

  • Technical Expertise: Strong competency in modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science, Gen AI and Data Apps

  • Data Engineering Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Extensive experience with distributed compute frameworks (Apache Spark, PySpark) and modern data stack tools like dbt.

  • Cloud Platform Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding and experience with the core concepts of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Growth Mindset: A strong desire to learn, grow your technical skills, and become an expert in the Snowflake platform.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

  • Professional Skills: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and possess Project Management skills to track, manage, and drive customers to an agreed-upon timeline.

  • Education: University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience in a technical role.

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Snowflake certifications/production hands-on experience

  • Proficiency in additional coding languages, particularly Python, Java, or Scala, especially in a data or application development context.

  • Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Strategic Ownership and Value Creation

 - Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as a single point of contact for all customer needs.

 - Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.

 - Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with Snowflake-specific platform guidance, data products and agentic workflows

  • Real-time personalization, agentic automation, identity resolution, and secure data collaboration with media, AdTech, and commerce partners

Marketing and advertising expertise

  • Meaningful experience inside a technology, media, or manufacturing organization in growth, marketing analytics, audience or data strategy, or marketing technology, ideally complemented by time advising or selling to that same audience

  • Familiarity with first-party data, identity resolution, programmatic AdTech, audience monetization, and B2B go-to-market data is a plus

Balanced across measurement, activation, and insights

  • Practical command of marketing measurement, such as mix modeling, attribution, and experimentation

  • Experience with audience strategy, customer data platforms, and real-time or event-driven activation

  • Ability to turn insight into decisions that changed budgets, programs, or customer outcomes

Hands-on with data and AI

  • Experience building, guiding, or evaluating predictive, generative, and agentic AI applications in marketing or advertising, with a clear sense of where AI and partner integrations create real value; complementary depth and understanding in Machine Learning (ML) ideal.

  • Comfort with modern data architecture and the ability to engage credibly with data and engineering teams

Commercial and executive presence

  • A record of measurable business impact, including revenue, pipeline, or programs you influenced

  • Confidence presenting to and advising senior executives, and navigating relationships where customers are also partners

Collaborative and scalable

  • Proven ability to partner with sales, solution engineering, product, and partners to win and expand strategic relationships

  • Energized by enabling others and scaling impact through reusable approaches

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, statistics, economics, computer science, or equivalent practical experience; MBA or advanced degree preferred

  • 15+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing technology, customer data, advertising, or related consulting

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, field events, and industry conferences

Your mission is to turn regulated marketing and advertising challenges into repeatable, scalable solutions, from privacy-safe measurement (MTA, MMM, incrementality) and identity resolution (IDR) to consent-driven activation, agentic AI workflows, and cross-channel optimization. You will pair deep marketing analytics, media, and MarTech/AdTech experience with modern data and AI capabilities, working alongside sales, solution engineering, product, and partners to shape how Snowflake shows up for marketing and advertising leaders in industries where trust, compliance, and regulations like FCRA, GLBA, and HIPAA are essential. You report to the Global Head of Business Solutions.

What You'll Do

Lead strategic engagements with marketing and advertising leaders Partner with CMOs, heads of marketing analytics, media directors, CRM, loyalty, MarTech, and AdTech operations, alongside compliance officers in risk and legal on high-impact initiatives. You are credible in these conversations because you have done the work: you have balanced marketing and advertising ambition against regulatory constraints such as FCRA, HIPAA, and GLBA, and can speak to both.

Translate marketing and advertising outcomes into vision and solutions Connect business priorities in unified measurement, deterministic/probabilistic identity resolution, audience activation, real-time personalization, and next-best-action intelligence to practical architectures and roadmaps on Snowflake. Help customers see how a governed customer data foundation supports growth, advertising efficiency, and compliance.

Build for the business Use Snowflake's AI and data capabilities to create demonstrable, grounded examples of what is possible, such as:

  • Privacy-safe multi-touch attribution (MTA), media mix modeling (MMM), and incrementality testing on unified first-party and media data

  • Consent-aware identity resolution (IDR), audience intelligence, propensity scoring, and compliant next-best-action decisioning models

  • Agentic marketing and advertising copilots built on Snowflake Intelligence (CoWork) that help teams explore campaign performance and run natural language analytics within governance guardrails

  • Secure data clean room patterns for publisher collaboration, retail media networks, and second-party data sharing under strict regulatory oversight

Scale through repeatable assets and partner alignment Package what works into reusable reference architectures, playbooks, and assets that help field teams and MarTech/AdTech partners engage marketing leaders with consistency and credibility.

Be a visible marketing and AI thought leader Share points of view and best practices through customer workshops, enablement, webinars, and industry events, helping customers and colleagues understand what great looks like for AI in regulated marketing.

Who You Are

Regulated marketing and advertising expertise

  • Meaningful experience inside a financial services, insurance, or healthcare organization in marketing analytics, AdTech, CRM, customer experience, or marketing technology, ideally complemented by time advising or selling to that same audience

  • Working knowledge of how FCRA, GLBA, HIPAA, state privacy laws, consent, and industry regulations shape customer data use and advertising activation in regulated sectors

Balanced across measurement, activation, and insights

  • Practical command of marketing and advertising measurement, such as MTA, MMM, incrementality testing, and ROAS/LTV optimization

  • Experience with identity resolution graphs, audience strategy, CDPs/AdTech activation platforms, and journey decisioning programs

  • Ability to turn insight into decisions that changed budgets, programs, or customer outcomes

Hands-on with data and AI

  • Experience building, guiding, or evaluating predictive AI, generative AI, and agentic workflows in marketing and advertising, with a clear sense of value versus compliance risk; complementary depth in Machine Learning (ML) ideal.

  • Comfort with modern data architecture and the ability to engage credibly with data and engineering teams

Commercial and executive presence

  • A record of measurable business impact, including revenue, pipeline, or programs you influenced

  • Confidence presenting to and advising senior executives, and translating complex ideas into clear narratives

Collaborative and scalable

  • Proven ability to partner with sales, solution engineering, product, and partners to win and expand strategic relationships

  • Energized by enabling others and scaling impact through reusable approaches

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, statistics, economics, computer science, or equivalent practical experience; MBA or advanced degree preferred

  • 15+ years of experience in marketing analytics, AdTech, marketing technology, customer data, identity resolution, or related consulting, with significant time working on or with brand-side marketing in regulated industries.

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, field events, and industry conferences

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

 

We're looking for a curious, driven Sales Development Representative based in Sydney to help grow Snowflake's footprint across the Australian market. You'll partner with our Account Executives and Marketing team to open conversations with data and technology leaders, build qualified pipeline, and learn how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud transforms the way organisations use their data. This role comes with structured training and a defined career path into Account Executive roles.

 

AS A SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Prospect into target accounts across Australia through phone, email, LinkedIn and social channels to generate qualified meetings for Account Executives

  • Follow up on inbound leads and Marketing campaigns, including Snowflake events, webinars and Data Cloud World Tour activity, converting interest into pipeline

  • Learn to position the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, including data warehousing, data engineering, data sharing and Snowflake Cortex AI, at a high level for business and technical audiences

  • Qualify opportunities using a structured framework such as MEDDPICC, uncovering business pain and use cases before handing over to the Account Executive

  • Research accounts and personas using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI-assisted prospecting to personalise your outreach

  • Log and manage all activity and pipeline accurately in Salesforce and your sales engagement platform (such as Outreach)

  • Work closely with Account Executives, Solution Engineers and Sales leadership on account plans, and join customer meetings where relevant

  • Attend local events, trade shows and internal enablement sessions to keep building your product and industry knowledge

 

OUR IDEAL SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 1+ years of prospecting experience, such as an SDR, BDR, inside sales or lead generation role, with a track record of booking meetings and building pipeline

  • A tertiary qualification or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to start conversations with senior stakeholders

  • Resilience and a coachable attitude: you take feedback, learn quickly and keep going after a "no"

  • Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise across many accounts and tasks

  • Genuine curiosity about technology, data and AI, and a desire to build a long-term career in tech sales

  • Full working rights in Australia

 

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Prospecting experience in SaaS, cloud or data technology

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Exposure to a sales qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC, BANT or Value Selling

  • Experience using AI tools to research, write or work more efficiently

     

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Snowflake's Sales Development team is where many of our future Account Executives and sales leaders begin. You'll receive structured onboarding, ongoing coaching and clear milestones on the path to an Account Executive role, while working with some of Australia's leading organisations as they adopt data and AI.

You'll join a growing, collaborative team in a business that is helping customers mobilise their data, build AI applications and share data securely across the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. If you're ambitious, curious and ready to learn fast, this is a great place to grow your tech sales career.

We are looking for a self driven, go getter to help grow these Partners into profitable revenue streams and accelerate our Partner Ecosystem and the growth of the business.

We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of strong communication skills, diplomacy in successfully working with difficult partners (it’s easy when everything is going fine) and strong business acumen in growing a business/ channel/ partnership.

Reporting to the Senior Partner Manager in France, you will have a unique opportunity to work for a disruptive company at the forefront of the Data & AI revolution, and lead the development of a vibrant Partner community.

AS A PARTNER DEVELOPMENT MANAGER (EMEA SOUTH) YOU WILL:

  • Manage a portfolio of high performing Global Systems Integrators (GSI's) and Regional SI’s (RSIs) to achieve partnership goals such as net new customers and consumption

  • Support your partners in their go-to-market activities (business planning, pipeline development, QBR, marketing, enablement sales activities across different Go-To-Market options…)

  • Ensure successful execution of the business plan by developing and managing relationships across functional areas within the partner

  • Work with the partner to expand the partnership into new strategic areas (new Service Lines and Industry Verticals)

  • Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders (typically Partner/Managing Director Level)

  • Organise and execute events with and for our partner community

  • Pitch value proposition of Snowflake partnership on all levels (up to C-Level)

  • Ensure alignment of all relevant stakeholders on pursues in joint accounts

OUR IDEAL PDM WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Channel Management, Software/Services Sales, Consulting, and/or Business Development in Cloud or Software Technology

  • Experience in working with SIs (such as KPMG, EY, CapGemini, Atos, etc.) to leverage their strategic influence to drive technology sales in a joint sales offering

  • Proven experience in delivering strong results in pipeline generation and bookings, by leveraging existing and recruiting targeted new partners

  • Cloud Technology, AI/ML, Data, Analytics, API and platform experience and understanding

  • Ability to build, lead and implement strategy in a cross-functional environment

  • Strong executive selling and business development skills; proven ability to understand different partner GTM and organizational models

  • Ability to design and present business plans, track and articulate program progress, design and document program guidelines for distribution throughout the organization (all levels) and for external use

  • MUST HAVE: Excellent communication skills, verbal & written in French & and English. Strong problem solving skills and ability to organize priorities in a dynamic environment

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Be able to travel between 25% - 50% in some months

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE:

  • Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product!

  • Develop a brand new set of ecosystem alliances for Snowflake making data more accessible to customers

  • Develop, lead and execute industry-changing initiatives

  • Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Data Lake
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. Engineering Manager - Data Lake

Bellevue, WA - USA


Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team!

We are hiring a dynamic and accomplished Engineering Manager to join our Data Lake team. In this role, you will lead and expand a talented team building on cutting edge open source data lake technologies. You’ll drive innovation, foster collaboration within the open source community, and ensure delivery of robust and scalable solutions for our enterprise customers. You will play a critical role in the growth and success of Snowflake’s business as we shape the future of open data management at scale!

As an Engineering Manager in the Data Lake team, you must possess a strong technical foundation with distributed systems, along with prior experience leading and growing engineering teams. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong critical thinking, clear communication, and strong decision making skills. If you have this mix of skills, and a passion for working in one of the world’s largest data domains, we’d love to hear from you!

AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Lead a team of talented and high-performing engineers in the design, development, and support of highly distributed and scalable data platforms, with a specific focus on optimizing and enabling workloads on top of open table and open catalog formats like Apache Iceberg and Apache Polaris (incubating).

  • Lead and participate in technical design and roadmap discussions relating to areas like Query Processing, Metadata Management, Performance, Scalability, and Open Source Interoperability

  • Have direct ownership to grow a strategic and emerging part of Snowflake’s business to address new and expanding market opportunities in Data Lake and Data Analytics workloads

  • Have direct impact on growth and development of your team through the full lifecycle of recruiting, hiring, mentorship, coaching, and identifying growth opportunities

  • Demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to work seamlessly across teams and organizations. Partner well with other leaders in the Engineering and Product organization on rhythms like annual & quarterly planning, staffing, project schedules, resource allocation, and more

  • Be comfortable and effective in delegation - effectively leveraging Senior & Principal engineers to maximize your team’s impact

  • Know when and how to shift resources across areas to achieve execution goals, while also ensuring effective ownership and longer-term alignment of work and skills

  • Translate product requirements into engineering work for your team, partnering closely with peers in Product and other disciplines - to make our vision a reality!

  • Use your strong technical foundation to set the bar for your team - build to last, deliver, and keep the quality exceptionally high!

  • Foster a healthy and diverse team culture

 

OUR IDEAL ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years industry experience designing and building distributed data systems, especially with a focus in database systems internals

  • 3+ years of software engineering management experience.

  • A track record of recruiting, leading, and growing high performing technical teams in a demanding talent market.

  • Experience building enterprise grade software - reliable, secure, and trustworthy platforms and distributed systems at large scale

  • Excellent problem solving skills, and strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Proven experience with authoring roadmap documents, project plans and RCAs.

  • Fluency in Java or C++.

  • Ability to work in a globally distributed team, collaborate well across disciplines, and mentor junior engineers.

  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills. Outstanding written and oral English language skills.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

  • Ability to work on-site in our Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA office.

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

  • Working with Apache open source projects and open data formats - Parquet, ORC, Avro - as well as with open table format standards - Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake

  • Modern data analytics technologies such as Spark, Trino, Presto. Experience with query processing.

  • Experience working and building on Data Catalog platforms, Metadata platforms, and Data Governance platforms, such as Unity, Glue, Nessie, Gravitino

  • Working with or building Distributed Storage platforms such as AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage

  • Internal design and implementation of query processing systems.

 

WHY JOIN US?

  • Lead and grow an exceptional team of high performing engineers - industry veterans, rising stars - in building game changing capabilities for the industry’s leading data cloud platform.

  • Opportunity to join in and take ownership of a fast moving and critical area for the company. Be at the forefront of Snowflake’s open source interoperability roadmap.

  • Take charge of your career - this role will push you to grow, both technically as well as a leader, in a supportive leadership environment.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Partner Sales Manager, Financial Services – UK&I
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our SI partners help bring our customers' data and AI ambitions to life. They implement the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and drive outcomes for our customers. from modern data foundations to enterprise AI agents. Snowflake is the Agentic Control Plane for the enterprise: one place to build, deploy and govern AI agents on a single, governed source of truth for data and context, with any model and any provider and no lock-in. Our partners help the UK&I's largest Financial Services organisations to give their people trusted data and AI where and when they need it, to engage customers better, run their operations more efficiently and change their products.

The Partner Sales Manager role drives sales alignment and go-to-market (GTM) with system integrator (SI) partners across Financial Services accounts in the UK&I. Your main objective is to strengthen and grow the collaboration between Snowflake and these SIs so both sides grow their business.

You will work closely with our Partner Development Managers, who run our strategic relationships with our top partners. As the subject-matter expert for Financial Services in the UK&I, you will build, lead and carry out the partner strategy. Success shows up as growth with our joint customers, delivery of key GTM programmes, partners building their Data and AI capabilities, and customer success.

Your success depends on driving compelling business strategies, GTM motions and partner relationships. Your success is measured by partner-sourced and partner-influenced co-selling. As well as adoption, consumption of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, tracked through use case go-lives sourced and implemented with and through partners. Strong communication, experienced strategic alliance leadership and problem-solving skills are vital to excel in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Go-to-Market:

Work with the Financial Services sales teams to identify the right SI partners in the territory, build joint account plans and run campaigns that grow Snowflake's footprint with existing customers. Using a strong understanding of customers' business and regulatory needs, you will identify partner solutions, offerings and capabilities that drive expansion and consumption of Snowflake, across data engineering, analytics, AI and agentic workloads (including Snowflake Intelligence, Cortex AI and Snowflake CoWork & CoCo). This may include Snowflake product partners such as ISVs and data providers. You will meet and exceed goals for co-sell pipeline, use case go-lives, consumption and demand-generation activity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Work with Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, Industry (Financial Services), Professional Services, Field CTO and Marketing to give partners and customers a seamless experience. Communicate the territory strategy, vision and priorities to partners. Articulate partner value propositions and share insights with the relevant teams so they can keep improving.

Deal Support:

Help SIs through the sales process, including education, deal registration, service registration, pricing and proposal support. Work with internal teams to keep the sales cycle smooth and efficient.

Performance Tracking:

Track the performance and commercial outcomes of joint initiatives with SIs. Analyse pipeline, use case and consumption data along with market trends, and communicate partner impact and outcomes clearly.

Delivery Success:

Keep communication and collaboration with SIs consistent through pre-sales and post-sales activity. Build relationships with key Professional Services and partner delivery leaders so use cases go live on time and turn into consumption.

Desired Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in partnerships, strategic alliances, sales, marketing or business development in technology

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of channel sales or channel programme management experience

  • Direct sales experience (preferred)

  • A track record of success and established relationships with UK&I SI partners, ideally within Financial Services accounts

  • Working knowledge of cloud, data and AI environments; familiarity with enterprise AI and agentic use cases is a plus

  • Understanding of the Financial Services landscape in the UK&I, including the regulatory and data governance needs that shape it (preferred)

  • Ability to manage regional business plans and to track and explain partner progress

  • Strong executive presence and polish

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to set priorities in a fast-changing environment

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

How do you want to make your impact?

Keep communication and collaboration with SIs consistent through pre-sales and post-sales activity. Build relationships with key Professional Services and partner delivery leaders so use cases go live on time and turn into consumption.




DESIRED EXPERIENCE

 - At least 10 years of experience in partnerships, strategic alliances, sales, marketing or business development in technology

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

 - 5+ years of channel sales or channel programme management experience

 - Direct sales experience (preferred)

 - A track record of success and established relationships with UK&I SI partners, ideally within Financial Services accounts

 - Working knowledge of cloud, data and AI environments; familiarity with enterprise AI and agentic use cases is a plus

 - Understanding of the Financial Services landscape in the UK&I, including the regulatory and data governance needs that shape it (preferred)

 - Ability to manage regional business plans and to track and explain partner progress

 - Strong executive presence and polish

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to set priorities in a fast-changing environment

jobs.title: Product Management Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re looking for dedicated students who share our passion for ground-breaking technology and want to create a lasting future for you and Snowflake.

What We Offer:

  • Paid, full-time internships in the heart of the software industry

  • Post-internship career opportunities (full-time and/or additional internships)

  • Exposure to a fast-paced, innovative culture

  • A chance to work with world-class experts on challenging projects

  • Opportunity to provide meaningful contributions to real systems used by customers

  • High level of access to supervisors (manager and mentor), detailed direction without micromanagement, feedback throughout your internship, and a final evaluation

  • Stuff that matters: treated as a member of the Snowflake team, included in company meetings/activities, flexible hours, casual dress code, access to our great office and benefits at the Menlo Park office

What We Expect:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college/university program during the time of the internship

  • Desired class level: 1st/2nd year MBA Students

  • Interest in Product Management and the technology industry

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work as part of a team

  • Dedication and passion for technology

  • When: Summer (May/June- September)

  • Duration: 12 weeks

What You Will Learn/Gain:

  • How to contribute to product strategy and planning

  • Experience in market research and competitive analysis

  • Exposure to product design and user experience principles, particularly in the era of AI

  • Understanding of data-driven decision-making

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing)

  • Opportunity to present findings and recommendations to senior management

Possible Teams/Work Focus Areas:

We are hiring in a few teams and your focus may include:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

  • Data Engineering and Development

  • Snowsight and user interface development

  • Product Platform (Billing & Monetization, Application Collaboration Frameworks, Database Security, Privacy, and Governance, etc..)

  • Data Platform (Data Pipelines & Streaming, Metadata, Storage & Data Lake, etc..), and our Service Runtime (Inc’l Snowpark & SnowPandas, Container Services, etc..)

    Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
